summary: Rectangle with 7 lights over California.
description:
On the evening of 8/11/14, I witnessed a craft that was a perfect rectangle with seven lights in a row followed by an eighth light on one end.  This craft was followed by a smaller craft that was also a perfect rectangle with three lights.  It was flying north to south.
I was outside trying to view the meteor shower despite there being a pretty full moon.    While I didn't spot any meteors, I did see this craft flying pretty fast.  My father told me that it could be the flying wing bomber flying from a nearby air force base.  
I researched the flying wing and it was definitely not the right shape.  After researching more, I could not find any current aircraft like the one I saw.  
This doesn't confirm that the craft was alien in origin however.  It could still be an experimental craft.  But I tend to believe that it was not of earth origin.  But that is only my opinion.
This report was originally posted for Colorado, which was indicated by the witness.  We have corrected the location of the sighting to California.  PD

summary: Three points of white light moved across the cloudy sky, one flashed once, and when their paths met they shook.
description:
In Boston, Massachusetts, at around 9:20 am  (sic.  p.m.), I saw a white light traveling from east-southeast to west-northwest.  It was about twice as large and bright as the few stars visible through light pollution and clouds.  
It flashed once about a quarter of the way across the sky.  At around the middle of the sky its path crossed two others, similar in size, traveling from the opposite direction, though not parallel.  
Their trajectories didn’t meet exactly, but when they were close they shook slightly, and continued on their paths.  
All were visible until below the horizon, which was obstructed by trees and buildings. 
There was at least one plane in the sky during this, to the north and heading west.

Last night my son and I were freaked out and stayed up half the night afraid something would happen.  As we were going to bed, I noticed my radio in the bedroom had some serious interference.  I started to feel sick and dizzy and had an over all feeling of being watched, but was going to bed.  I laid in bed feeling really uneasy.  
A few minutes later my 17 year old son came running up the stairs into my room, saying he felt like he was being watched and had a feeling like something was about to happen and his chest hurt.  He said his cell phone has no service which was odd because we never have that issue where we live.  I checked my phone and it was not working at all.  We didn't turn any lights on in our home and crept outside to see if a UFO was somewhere in site.  We didn't see anything, but both of us were too scared to really get out in the open to check.  
Like I said before, we see UFO's all the time out here.  I don't even…

summary: Red Saucer does a loop around Allentown before disappearing
description:
A flashing red light with a simultaneous white light, and was saucer shaped (a circular figure with a football shape through the center.  Could also be described as a round diamond or much like Saturn with the rings, except a solid red flashing light.)  
I was looking at the stars at night when a blinking like distracted me.  At first, I thought it was a plane, but upon closer inspection, the shape, colors, behavior and strangeness determine a UFO.  
The round object looked about 2 to 3 times bigger than a plane.  It moved incredibly slow and hovered, and would slowly zig zag up and down and then would sit stil and move quickly along.  
The flying object traveled from the south of Allentown to the west.  
When trees were blocking the UFO, I ran to the front of my house and no longer saw it.  After about five minutes, the UFO reappeared from my left (West) and traveled to my far right (North) within minutes before disappearing.  The stars in the sky appeared to have a reddish "twinkle," and the night sky looked active with distant faint flashes of light  surrounding individual stars (I swear I'm mentally sound…)  But the one-second flashes almost seemed to be charging the UFO…

summary: read sighting description ..
description:
Around 11:00 PM, me and my friend looked up and noticed a very bright object hovering at high altitudes in the airspace.  At first, we thought it was a star, but after looking at it for about 20 minutes we noticed the UFO was flashing, and very, very slowly moving across the sky.

summary: Multiple orbs, formations, triangle and fireballs seen, as well as lunar and atmospheric anomalies.
description:
On August 10th, 2014, at approximately 11:00 (23:00), I was pointing out the "triangle mothership" that is in the NE sky, when to the East was a shape-shifting "constellation". There were approximately 6 "stars" that shifted from a stem with bulb formation, to a polygon, and a straight line.  Meanwhile, in the NE sky and the SE sky, two "stars" were syncing flashes. Red, Blue, Green.
We then approached the West side of the building, and there witnessed more activity than I have ever seen.  In the NW, there was a red cloud, where 40+ orbs were "dogfighting" and making extreme maneuvers.  As this went on, there was a two light formation that went against the cloud movement at an incredible speed then stopped.
At this time, two neighbors came out and asked what we were doing, to which we pointed out.  Needless to say, they were in awe.
At approximately 1:00 am, the moon started flashing bright white circles in an increasingly fast pattern, till a wave of white crossed the moon and ensconced the moon in a white light brighter than anything I've seen.  It was almost as if the moon was "activated".
The cloud formations at this time became extremely detailed, to the point 4 people all…

summary: 6-7 lights in night sky moving from the west, some grouped, some slowly dropping to ground or moving northward and then disappearing.
description:
Saw multiple lights in sky all coming from one direction, thought at first airplanes or military helicopters, but no noise.  The lights on the ones we saw close up to us, did not appear to be planes or helicopter lights, too bright (red and white).  They all came in from the West, moving slowly, then seeming to float around, and then headed northward or slowly descending downward to land.  Either they disappeared into night sky behind clouds or dropped to ground, stayed lit for a few seconds, and then light disappeared.
Witness provides little contact information.  PD

summary: Glowing orange balls of light, flying in formation, no noise, definitely NOT anything explainable! (not flares, not planes)
description:
I had just gone out onto my back porch at 10:30pm to let my dog out, before going to bed, and she was acting weird.  She tried to ram her head through the screen door to get outside (she never does this!), and as I opened the screen door, I immediately saw three glowing orange balls in the sky flying west to east. 
I screamed for my husband and son who both came running and witnessed the glowing orange lights.  They were flying in a triangle formation and were making no noise at all.   They were flying approximately 200 meters off the ground (maybe a little less) and travelled in a north east direction at a steady rate of speed.  
Then a fourth orange glowing light flew in from the south west towards the three lights that were still flying in formation.  Then the three in formation blinked out and were gone suddenly.  
The fourth glowing ball continued flying north east in the direction of the three that disappeared and then it stopped and floated without moving at! all for about 10 seconds and then it blinked out.  
The night was clear and there was a full moon out.  My husband and I are skeptics by nature and definitely NOT UFO fanatics but there is no rational explanation for…

summary: Orange-ish light, no sound, no navigational lights.
description:
We witnessed an orange colored light travelling northwest in the direction of Lake Ontario and ultimately into Canada.  
This object showed no obvious aircraft navigational lights and the color of the visible light was not that of an ordinary aircraft.  
There was no sound from this object as well.  
Elevation was approximately at 3000 ft.  
Line of travel was straight and speed was constant.

summary: Circular object that hovered and moved with red and green flashing lights.
description:
The object we saw was for  circular with red lights flashing when moving.  When stationary green lights blinked around the red lights.  We discussed what this could have possibly have been.  
My son thought some kind of RC toy but my husband,  daughter and I thought too high up and no noise.  We thought some kind of drone or experimental craft out of McDill AFB but not quite sure what to make of it.  
My daughter ran to get a camera and binoculars but the object had left our viewing area by the time she returned.

summary: 3 intermittent glowing objects seen over Red Lion, PA, towards the southeast.
description:
Three silent glowing objects seen in total over a 30 minute period starting at around 9:50pm.  The first was a red fireball that was traveling over the Winterstown area as seen from Red Lion near Route 24.  It appeared suddenly and as it approached the woods in the distance it went completely black, I could make out an almost stationary triangular object illuminated by the full moon.  It then continued to travel and as it drifted behind the tree line it again ignited a bright red.
The second object was orange, rose from the horizon in the same area, went black as it rose and appeared to go up and around the moon from my perspective.  It then went almost straight down and dipped behind the horizon.  I was able to capture this on my cell phone on a short video.
The third was again red and rose from a similar point of origin on the horizon.  Although all three had slightly different origin points they appeared to be coming from the same area.  This third and final object rose into the sky and flew in a large arch towards the main town of Red Lion.  Again, this was caught on video.  All 3 objects were accompanied by the sound of a dog barking in the distance, you can hear it clearing…

summary: Oscillating black-ish/gray spherical object hovering in ther sky and disappeared
description:
Last night, my 3 friends and I were on the roof in Manhattan.  We had a few bottles of wine, so we were a little warm, but not incoherent.  It was bright out because of the supermoon, so we had a clear view.  
My friend, who pointed in the air, then told us to look.  3 of the 4 of us saw what looked like a thick blackish-gray disc, hovering in the air a few hundred feet out.  It was not a plane, because we had seen many moving around that night.  
I thought it was a balloon floating up but my friend and I stood up and approached the edge of the rooftop to get a better view and I quickly ruled that out.  What I personally saw was something that looked large enough to not be a balloon, and it was definitely oscillating.  It made no sound, but I did not expect it to at our distance.  
I rationalized at first it was a balloon floating from the light into the atmosphere and thus disappearing, but something was off about that idea.  However, as I approached it went from a darker color to gray, and then disappeared almost as if backing away.  
We all 3 were very creeped out and thought it was a drone or definitely a UFO.  
Still thinking about it, but it moved so quickly away once I…

summary: 4 orange/red shapes in formation
description:
Driving northbound on Granny White Pike my wife and I saw 4 orange/red shapes in an almost square formation that seemed to be slowly headed east.  They seemed to maintain the same distance from each other and were moving slowly.
Hard to tell what they were, but they didn't have any blinking lights that I could make out.
My parents driving behind us saw them too.  They were at least a couple miles away.

summary: Flat-bottomed triangle craft in residential area.
description:
Seen outside my bedroom window at about 9:25pm Sunday evening August 10, 2014.
Large triangle shaped object, completely flat on the bottom, with 3 orange/red lights, with white lights in the middle on each corner.  It had no wings or tail and made a strange shushing sound, as it went slowly past our house, from east to west.  
Not sure of the color, due to the twilight.  It looked VERY large to Me.
It appeared to be close enough to our house to touch!  I have never seen anything like this in my 72 years.  
I am 100% sane and not on medication that would cause hallucinations, nor have I read/watched or had any interest in UFO's, but what I saw is very similar to pictures my son (the one typing this report) has shown me online of 'black triangle' objects!!

summary: Three Bright Ruby Red Lights In Triangle Formation
description:
On August 10, 2014, at 9:19 pm est I was alone on my driveway washing my car in Oshawa It had just hit past dusk - with little light to the west I could suddenly hear a loud buzzing sound and looked north About about half mile away noticed three bright ruby lights moving across the sky They were moving from the east to the west at about the speed of a Cessna These three red ruby lights kept in a constant triangular formation as they moved across together They looked about one to two hundred yards apart at about few thousand feet in altitude I was frozen watching them in front of me for about twenty seconds I then ran into my house and retrieved my camera back outside in less than twenty seconds.
Once outside I snapped one clear followed by four pictures on a high zoom These images appear orb like due to zoom The formation continued heading west over Whitby heading southward towards Ajax,Ontario  I last picture taken reveals a structure between the lights - weird ! Could this well have been a triangle type aircraft that was cloaked ? There were others that had witnessed and reported this thing Even in Burlington,Ontario So it was first observed from Oshawa to Whitby to Ajax to…

summary: Three bright orange lights go from horizon to horizon almost directly overhead
description:
I went out side with my 8 year old daughter at about 9:00 p.m., 8/11/2014, to look at the supermoon.  I looked up and saw a very bright red light moving from north to south over the house.  
I told my daughter to look at the airplane.  It was moving across the sky directly overhead very fast. I looked like the speed of a low flying aircraft, but was not low.  
I watched for a minute then noticed another following it, and then another.  They were all in a line and quite a ways behind each other.  
All took the same path.  I would guess it to be at 10,000 feet and extremely bright orange. 
There was fairly heavy clouds cover to the south, and they disappeared behind the clouds before reaching the horizon.  I thought they were below the clouds due them being as bright as they were.  I watched them until they disappeared in the clouds in the southern sky.  
My wife was in the front of the house and asked me if I had seen them.  She said they looked like flares shooting out of the ground! when she first saw them.  I would agree that it had the color and brightness of a flare.  It flew like an extremely fast aircraft, but I never heard a sound.  The brightness of the orange light, the…

summary: It was very red, almost looked on fire.  It was a very large light when we first saw it.
description:
It was in the North sky and was heading Southeast.  
We watched it and noticed at some points it seemed to stop in the sky and then continue moving. 
We noticed that the light quickly got smaller and then seemed to just fade out and was gone.

summary: Circular object with a ring of green lights with 2 red lights next to each other
description:
I was taking the garbage out and looked up at the sky and saw this circle object with rectangle green lights all the way around except for 2 rectangle lights next to each other. 
The red lights were blinking randomly. Occasionally one green lights blinked.

summary: LARGE SILVER DISK SPOTTED OVER ASHEBORO, NORTH CAROLINA!
description:
The UFO looked silver and disk shaped.  It had lights on the top that appeared to be red in color.  And white lights on the side.  
When I came out of my house, I saw a slow moving object to the north of my house and then it took a westerly turn and was gone.  I also saw a small plane that came from the south.  
Although there was only one craft observed, it really scared me.  
The craft made a soft, but high-pitched, chirp as it moved.  And it is unknown if this craft landed or not.

summary: Bright red light at low altitude moved quickly and silently s to n.  An exact duplicate followed 3 min later.
description:
We were in our backyard and about 8:15 and saw a light come into view over the roof of the house.  At that point it was probably 4 miles away.  At first it looked like fireworks. But then we noticed it didn't burst.  It was moving over us maybe 1000 ft altitude or less.
It moved steadily and fairly quickly from south to north.(took about 1 minute to cover the sky from horizon to horizon)  When it was over us it was dead silent and was as bright as a road flare but not smoking and was much larger in diameter.  (Looked as big as a helicopter, which come over our house all the time but make incredible noise)  
It moved off to the north and either burned out or the light was up inside and we couldn't see it.  It didn't disappear, but was now a black object still moving steadily n the same direction.
The impression was it was a drone like craft with a bright red flare on the bottom.
The really odd thing was about 3 minutes later an exact duplicate did the same thing.
Witness provides little contact information.  PD

summary: Orange object suddenly appear and disappear at similar times.
description:
Object suddenly appeared and started to move in a lineear direction.  It was like flying fireball that had pulsations at it's lights.  After about a one minute flight it suddenly diasappeared.  The object had orange lights.  It had a shape like a globe.  I was on vacation with my cousin during this event and had a local person with us.  She told us that these objects were being observed offen.  
Anyway in Turkey Bodrum is known with high UFO activity.  After the first event we started to watch the object.  Following days the object appeared at similar times with same features.  After a few days no further observation happened.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

summary: I very bright light was in the air in north Phoenix and then flew away faster than any plane.
description:
There was something in the air above north Phoenix/Scottsdale that had a very bright light moving back and forth.  It was a ‘rolling light’ back and forth; it didn’t go from one right light to one left light, for example.
The light was significantly brighter than any plane and it was facing west.  After either heading west or staying in one place (I couldn’t tell), it turned and flew south.  I could still see the light as it traveled at a significantly faster speed than when I saw the light head on.  
The object moved significantly faster than a plane and after watching it fly south for a while, the light just went away.
Please confirm if anyone else witnessed this.
Witness provides little contact information.  PD

summary: 3 orange ball lights.
description:
My sister and I went out to the backyard to look at the supermoon, and we saw 3 orange, round lights, round-shaped light, over the 55 north freeway towards a Lincoln Avenue near Tustin Avenue & Collins, 
We video taped them and we upload to youtube, they were hard to get on my cell phone but when we saw them, they were orange,  They look like orange stars but they were closer to the ground or actually over the neighbor's house, first 2 were side by side, then we saw a 3rd on bottom left & it accented towards the other 2, they they disappeared.
Witness provides little contact information.  PD

summary: Object moving very slowly with smoke or vapor trailing behind it.
description:
Last summer in the evening my husband came in from outside and asked me to come look at something in the sky.  In the southwestern sky you could see a small object with something trailing behind it.  
At first we thought it was a flock of geese, but when we looked through binoculars we could see that it was some kind of craft with vapor or smoke coming out the back.  First thought, plane in distress, but it was moving extremely slow and kept on the same trajectory until we couldn’t see it because of the trees in our yard.  
I got in the car and drove to an open spot to see if I could spot it, again, afraid it was a plane in distress, but I could not locate it.   We watched the news that evening to see if a plane crashed, or nearly crashed had taken place, but there was no mention of anything.  It was definitely not a flock of geese, and it could not have been a meteorite as the vapor didn’t trail that far behind and it moved VERY slowly.  
We like to know if anyone else experienced this event.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

summary: diamond shape, low to ground, low noise, 3 lights, then 1 light moved closer to one otherr light
description: low to ground, diamond shape,3 lights. Then 1 light moved closer to another, low noise.

summary: Floating egg shaped object clearly visible with sunlight reflecting off a perfectly smooth surface with 2 antenna like protrusions
description:
White or silver egg shaped craft with 2 black long thin arms protruding from midway of craft down at a 45 degree angle hovering at about 200 feet above I-5 and S 204th Street. 
Very windy at the time but did not effect its position.  The sun was reflecting off of it. No windows.  Just a smooth flawless surface about 30 feet from top to bottom.  The 2 black antennas or arms were very long and pointed toward the ground.  
I lost site of it as I drove North.

summary: It was a diamond-shaped saucer, with red and white lights, verticle to each other.
description:
It Soared In The Sky About A Hundred Feet Above.  
We Are In The Country.
We have requested a more thorough description of the event, but have not received it, yet.  PD

summary: Triangular shape object in front of the sun.
description:
I was just taking a sun rise picture, I point the cellular phone camera to the sun and took this picture.  The weather as you can see is cloudy and is raining at the left of the object.  
I took just one picture and went inside my house and after while I was looking I notice this unsual triangular shape object.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  No photo received, and we are unable to contact the witness to request a copy.  PD

summary: Bright light moved in straight line rapidly across 4:45am sky in Thunder Bay.  No differentiation in size shape colour or brightness.
description:
I was sitting on my front stairs at 4:45am, looking toward the sky to watch the Perseid Meteor Shower.  I was facing north-east looking up at roughly a 45 degree angle.  
I noticed a few meteors falling from the sky, and then my eye caught a bright light which looked just like a star, moving rather quickly from my left to right.  It popped into sight from behind some trees, moved very rapidly across my field of vision, and disappeared to my right when I could no longer see past my house.  
What makes me believe it was not a meteor is that for the whole 10-15 seconds that I was able to look at it, it moved in a perfectly straight line, it was moving too slow to be a meteor, but too fast and high to be an airplane.  Also, it didn't get brighter, or fade out.  It remained consistent in brightness and speed the whole time.

summary: saucer spotted at an extremely low altitude, above neighbors tree in the backyard
description:
Flying saucer directly above neighbors' tree..
Beams of light coming from the center of the disk..  White red and green lights all around the edges of the object.  It was almost like I was spotted because as I was watching this faint light it came down and hovered.  
Then, as it lifted, it lifted one side of the craft higher than the other after swaying back and forth... 
It was at a very low altitude maybe .. I think it came about 300 ft a above me..  
I have always seen ships my whole life, but this was an extremely close encounter.  When the saucer came down, it was very slowly go from side to side from east to west almost rocking the vessel...  
When it got down as close as it did, the vessel seemed to tilt upward so I could see the entire underbelly of the ship.. 
This was a very real experience I have been scared all night..

summary: I saw an orb floating across my street and thru my yard, looking out of my bedroom window at 2:10 am. It was orange in color.
Orange light in the sky.
description:
At approximately 11:30 pm, I witnessed a bright orange light to the northwest, right above the elementary school.  It was moving from west to east at a fairly decent speed.  
I noticed the orange light starting to pulsate when it was crossing directly in front of me. 
Then the light just disappeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Red orange fireballs, Ocean City, NJ.
description:
Between 23:30 - 23:45 saw 2 red-orange fireball shapes, 1 at a time about 5-10 minutes apart.  
They flew South to North along the coast.  
It didn't fade out of sight but rather simply disappeared.  
It moved slower than an airplane but faster than a helicopter.  
Absolutely no sound.

summary: Strange half blue and half red spherical light
description:
As I traveling home from work in Warrendale, Pa, on the red belt towards Fair Oaks,Pa, about 11:20 pm, this light appeared over top of a hill.  
The light as it drew closer towards my car was half blue and half red.  
The object that I was able see was spherical in shape.  
It disappeared very quickly behind another hill.

summary: Orange fireballs came from treeline flying south and low then veered to the east and quickly ascended until it disappeared.
description:
On Saturday, August 9, 2014, at 11:15 pm, a bright orange fireball came from the treeline.  It was flying low just above tree and roof tops coming (south) slowly towards us.  
It veered left (east) getting lighter in color and then quickly ascended until it disappeared.  
Seconds later, a second fireball appeared from the same treeline and traveled in the same path as the first one.  
There were no air craft in the vicinity. 
The fireballs were silent.

summary: Bright orange fireballs appeared from the tree line and came towards us and veered off to the left and quickly ascended and disappeared
description:
On Saturday, August 9, 2014, a bright orange fireball came from above the tree line and slowly came towards us flying low just over tree and roof tops.  
As it got closer, it veered off to the left getting lighter as it quickly ascended, and then finally disappeared.  
Another fireball appeared within seconds from the same tree line and traveled the same path turning left and getting lighter in color as it quickly ascended and disappeared.  
There was a super moon during this event.  There were no air craft in the vicinity and fireballs were silent.

summary: Bright orange fireballs came from the tree line flying low then veered off to the left and then quickly ascended until it disappeared.
description:
On Saturday, August 9, 2014, at 11:15 pm, a bright orange fireball came from the tree line and came towards us flying (south) slowly and low just above tree and roof tops when it veered to the left (east) and getting lighter in color as it then quickly ascended away from the earth until it disappeared.  
Seconds later a second bright orange fireball appeared and traveled in the same pattern.  There were no aircraft in the vicinity.  
The fireballs were silent.

summary: Fireball in the sky no sound, was there for two minutes then completely gone.  Was not a plane was too close to be a plane
description:
I went out on my front porch to smoke a cigarette and talk to a family memeber, while we was talking we noticed in the sky a very bright red (almost like a plane on fire) circle going from east of the sky to the west not traveling very fast but was much closer than a plane...  It was the for a solid 2 minutes at least and then completely went away.
I'm not sure what it was but it was very odd and I have never seen anything like it before, and while this was happening, there was no sound or smoke or anything no trail behind the object, but it did have sorta like a haze all around it.  
It was completely by itself and looked almost like a air plane or something on fire but I know for sure it was not a plane... 
This object was entirely too close, and was moving faster than I've ever seen a plane move in the sky.  It was rather big, too, about the size of a penny in you hold a penny in your hand up to the sky.  
It was there, then gone..
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: We thought it was a satellite near the big dipper...the light got brighter then just disappeared....I am a believer my friend is not.
description: Until last night....no noise just a dim to bright light that just finished.

summary: About 14 minutes ago (23:00), my daughter and I took our dog out so he could do his job.
description:
While we were outside I looked up towards the Full MOON AND NOTICED a light traveling towards the moon.  While I was having a cigarette I waited to see if the light crossed the Full Moon or if it went behind the Full Moon.
This bright light traveled behind the Full Moon.
While I was having my cigarette I stared at the Full Moon and waited for the bright light to reappear on the opposite side of the Full Moon.
As I waited my cigarette was smoked and the bright light did not reappear.
This is Strange.
Did anyone else see what I saw?

summary: It was decently close and silent, it disappeared and reappeared and was bright red and moved around the sky in an unexplainable way.
description:
It was decently close and silent and it disappeared and reappeared and was bright red and didn't have blinking lights like a plane and it totally moved around in the sky in a weird/unexplainable way until it disappeared into the distance (although it actually seemed more like it vanished because I it didn't seem to fly away until it was gone.)  It actually was heading right towards us, but totally turned away and seemed be moving slowing in an unexplainable way.  It was indeed pretty far away.  We saw it over a cornfield, but I think not directly over i.  
It seams to dim from bright red to white.  I filmed it but it's essentially just a pixelated red dot in the sky.  
I also later saw a plane go past about where the ufo was and I could hear the sound of the plane in the distance even father from where the ufo had been, but the ufo still made no sound when I saw it earlier.
Witness elects to remain anonymous; provides little contact information.  PD

summary: Saw 5 orange lights in sky move southeast and then straight up.
description:
Noticed 2 orange lights in sky moving southeast.  Then noticed 3 more lights join the 2. 
Then they ascended straight up into the sky and disappeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Bright red light circle traveling quickly north to south in eastern sky - no sound.
Witnessed a group of orange/amber lights very low in the sky, south of PA turnpke in New Stanton PA
description:
My wife and I just entered the PA turnpike, heading west at the New Stanton interchange on the evening of August 9th, 2014.  
We were probably only about 5 minutes on the turnpike while I (driving) noticed lights to my left (south of the turnpike).  I was driving around 70mph, so the duration of viewing the lights was probably less than 30 seconds.  
The lights were low, very low and the surrounding trees obstructed my view and I could only see them in clearings of the trees.  But my initial reaction was to try to process what I was seeing for a few seconds until I said to my wife, "What ((deleted)) am I looking at to my left?"  
She then noticed them too.  It was dark out of course, so the lights, which looked orange/amber in color and seemed to almost look rectangular.  I think there were about 7 of the lights, and they first appeared in a staggered formation, with some higher than the others.  
However, the further we drove, they almost started to form a triangular pattern, with the tip of the triangle being at the highest light and the formation widening as the other lights were lower and underneath.  
We could not tell if the lights were moving, but I think they may have been…

summary: An orange sphere was moving very slowly from right to left, it stopped, was idle for a few moments and then took off in a straight line away from us at a very high rate of speed.
description: We just saw it getting smaller and smaller until it disappeared.

summary: Five bright large red lights in the Traverse City, Michigan, sky.
description:
Was going into the backyard to adjust the telescope for viewing the full moon.  
Noticed 5 red lights in formation first thought was it was aircraft but then realized the lights were large and close together.  
The line of sight was over some trees and I would guess that the lights were with in a mile from me and not that high in the sky.  
I was yelling for my wife to witness what I was seeing but she couldn't hear me.  
So, I ran to the house, and she ran out.  I would say that took less than twenty seconds for us both to be back to the spot of sight.  We witnessed one light disappear rapidly into the upper skyline at a very rapid rate not sure where the rest went.  
The lights were almost like a v shape and were a constant brightness.  I am reporting this as I am hoping others in the area may have seen the same thing at a better sight advantage.  
The length of time from the sighting to the red light disappearing into the night sky was less than two minutes it happened very quickly.  
Wish I had had more time to observe.

summary: Saw several orange lights coming from the northeast going west south west.  They disappeared one by one at about the same area.
description:
About two minutes later I saw one more on the same path, and it also dimmed and disappeared!  There was no sound. 
I estimate 20 objects seen total.  They were bright orange like fire balls.  
I know others must have seen. 
I'm sure more reports are going to be coming in.

summary: Orange ball over Lehigh Valley skies.
description:
Craft appeared to be low and dropping as though it was something on fire, and streams shooting downward from it. 
It was traveling south to north and then It seemed to pickup elevation and speed but continued to appear as though it was burning.

summary: Bright, round, orange ball suddenly appeared and drifted across sky from east to west before disappearing as quickly as it appeared
description:
A bright, round, orange ball, for lack of a better word, suddenly appeared in the sky (to the south), and drifted across the sky from east to west.  
It did not exactly go in a straight line, but also didn't move around or zig-zag.  
It seemed to dim slightly at one point, but then returned to its bright orange color. There were no flashing lights and no sound. 
It was visible for approximately two minutes, perhaps slightly less, and then disappeared as quickly as it appeared.

summary: Bright orange sphere moves side to side then hovers for 2 minutes, flies south, and fades out of sight.
description:
Bright orange light sphere changing to red and back to orange.  Hovered for 2 minutes.  
Moved south and faded out of site.
We suspect that the date is flawed.  We have amended the date above, to reflect a sighting on August 09th, 2014.  PD

summary: I seen a star that looked bigger/closer and just seemed different.  Different enough to bring two other people with me on the balcony to see what it is.
description:
With using binoculars, we noticed they were blue and red and not moving.  
While focusing on one of the objects little fast moving lights would appear.  
It seemed to have multiple crafts if they were even crafts.

summary: 2 orange/red glowing fireballs Cornwall, Ontario.
description:
Went to sit on our porch, as I stepped outside, I saw right above me in the sky, what looked like 2 orange/red glowing fireballs.  
My husband ran back into the house to get his camera, but by the time he got back and was ready to film, they were gone.  
They kept the same height - never went up or down as they passed over our house, slightly turning right until we lost sight of them.  
No noise, no engine - same speed....was unreal and what an experience to have!!!

summary: Black triangular shape with a red pulsating light underneath its center.
description:
At approx. 21:45 Sat the 9th of August 2014, I was looking out my rear patio doors, the doors face approx. South.  I noticed an object in the sky, it had a pulsating red light underneath it.  
I called my wife over to the patio door and said look at thing in the sky pointing to it.  She responded, "go get your binoculars".  
So I ran upstairs got the binoculars and attempted to look at it, but the overhang of my house was preventing me from a clear view.  
So I ran back downstairs and looked out the patio doors bracing the binocular against the glass, I could clearly see the triangular shape of the object and the pulsating Red light underneath in it's center.  
Looking out my patio doors the object was at the 10:00 O'clock Position.  
The object moved slowly across the sky moving West.  At which point my wife tried calling my son over for a look when the object started to turn and face south then slowly started pitching its nose up and the Red pulsating light was no longer visible.  I turned to my wife to say take a look through the binoculars, when I turned back to look the object was no longer visible.

summary: Three, circular, low flying, objects, reflecting a red light, consecutively fly over a lake, following the same trajectory.
description:
On the night of the 9th of August, I and two others have seen three unidentified flying objects.  We have observed three low flying objects emitting a constant bright red fire like light. 
The first was spotted as I and the other witnesses exited a lake we had been swimming in. We could not see the object, but we were sure that it was neither a plane, an asteroid, nor a comet, and it seemed too near to be a satellite.  The lake in question is about 10 km from Iroquois Falls.

summary: Two red and white blinking lights that stayed still in the night sky.

I eventually made it to my house and as I'm driving down my driveway, I notice a strange blinking light of all different colors.  It looked like it was fidgeting like an insect would.  I stared at it for a while looking for any hints as to find out what it was, but it never moved so it couldn't have been an airplane. 
I called both of my parents outside and they saw it too.  It was hard to see it because of the distance but you could tell the colors definitely included red, white, and a blueish green.  
I called my friends from a city away and they saw the same thing. We also noticed that there was another one not too far to the right.  They both looked exactly the same. 
We stayed out there for about an hour and noticed that very slowly they were traveling upward.

It was flying much too low for its distance from the airport.  It hardly made any noise and didn't have the regulatory green and red wing lights.  The bottom was fully lit up.  The craft appeared to be a shimmery charcoal grey.  My friend and I couldn't believe it and were filled with unease and curiosity.  We tailed the craft for a few blocks.  It made sharp unwavering turns like a helicopter before finally making its way toward Kenner (where the airport is).  It was too far to be that low.  
As we neared Cleary, we ran into a friend of ours and gave him a ride home.  After bringing up the strange "plane," our mutual friend took the words out of our mouths about witnessing this strange occurence.  He too felt the same gut-wrenching discomfort and curiosity.  It was unreal.  
My family has lived here our whole lives and not once witnessed something like that.  My father was just speculating the other day that if aliens exist and have been working with our government, their craft may look…

It passed about 75 feet over me, moving SSE at a very high rate of speed.  The noise I heard it make was most similar to the noise sandpaper makes against wood, but louder. 
I got home at around 5:00am yesterday,  I usually get home at around 4:00am, I chalked the tardiness up to me driving extra carefully because the road was damp, but the math just doesn't add up.  I want to know what happened on that road last night!   I drive this route 6 days a week to work from Cedar Rapids, Iowa, to Coralville, Iowa, and back.  
No remarkable event have ever occurred minus seeing some drunk crash into…

summary: Small light disc circling ball of light flies by.  Not a vessel.
description:
I was in my friend’s neighborhood last night around 12:45am (00:45).  He lives in a neighborhood with duplexes, and a public pool.  We were sitting in the pool deck area on pool chairs talking about politics, life, obscure theories, etc.  He was facing me, and just over his shoulder up in the sky, a small glowing disc quickly flew by.  I’ve never had a ufo experience before, and I don’t read up on them much, so I’ll use my limited knowledge to make a description:  
This didn’t look like your typical Hollywood UFO.  It was a very small disk in the sky.  At first, I immediately thought it might have been a shooting star, but it was too large, and not out in space.  I’ve seen shooting stars before and they are quick and faint, this was prominent, a little slower, and close.
I want to say it was less than 100ft off the ground, it seemed like it just went over the tree tops.

It repeated this another time until it disappeared from my sight behind the trees.  I could see the glowing red light from about one and a half miles down the road because of its brightness.
It happened in an area surrounding the interstate which was hilly and covered with trees. There were some fields.  I'm not sure if the field had crops or livestock since it was dark.  The sky was cloudy, so I couldn't see any stars. It wasn't near an airport either.  Someone said it was a helicopter, but the windows were open and I didn't hear any noise. summary: Unusually large orange ball of light seen.

At about 10:30 pm, my sister went outside to feed the dogs.  She then saw a big orange light moving slowly in the sky.  
She came inside and called me and my brother to come look at this strange light in the sky.  I thought to myself that she was probably seeing an illusion or a plane until we went outside.  
This ball of light was getting bigger as it approached our house.  
We got scared, run inside and closed the door.  We went and told our mom about it then my sister went on the back porch and screamed that it was still coming closer and it was getting bigger. 
My mom came on the porch and saw it.  It then moved over the house until we couldn't see it.  We all proceeded to the front of the house, opened the front grill and went outside and it was there.  
By this time two men who were walking by were also pointing to the sky.  The ball of light then quickly disappeared before our eyes.  
I came online to try and find out what it may have been, several people suggests that it may have been a ball lightning.  I have never seen one before so I cannot say exactly if it is.  
Just making a report on what we saw.

summary: Orange reddish orbs in the Orlando/Windermere area.

Pulling into my neighborhood on my way home from work.  Saw a giant orange, reddish orb in the sky towards the northwest.  It appeared to be traveling towards me.

The orb elongated into a narrow strip of light (as though it were speeding away and leaving a trail) and within a few seconds it was a pinpoint very high in the sky, and then I could no longer see it.  
Very exciting and curious to witness!

summary: Orange glowing orb, Wasilla, Alaska.
description:
I was traveling in my car westbound on Spruce Road heading home from work.  At 12:36 a.m., I witnessed an orange glowing orb about 50 feet above the treetops and approximately 100 yards ahead crossing the road from north to south.  When I reached the point of the object's crossing, I stopped and exited the vehicle.  I continued to observe the object while standing in the middle of the road (There was no other vehicular traffic}.
By this time the object was stationary, hovering at approximately 100 feet in altitude and perhaps 50-70 yards south of the road.  There was no sound emanating from the object. As it hovered, it began to move in a slow, tight, circling maneuver.  As it exhibited this circling motion, I observed a bluish-white light pulsating either from within the orange orb or on it.  The object then began to slowly move to the southwest, maintaining it's altitude and disappeared from my line of sight behind the tree line.
Judging from the object's distance and altitude, I approximate it's size to be that of a small compact automobile.  This was the apparent size of the glowing light, it was difficult to ascertain whether it was actually a solid object.  At 12:39 a.m I…

summary: Stationary triangular shaped UFO with 3 very bright lights sighted several times at 5-10 min intervals during a period of 1 hr.
description:
It was a little after midnight, while sitting in my car, I happened to glance out the window and saw a clear very bright light source that was stationary for about 5 seconds and then it dimmed a little, and then a little more until it suddenly vanished. 
I remained in the same place watching for it to return or, if possible, to determine if my eyes were playing tricks on me. I waited and then about 5-8 min later, the same light returned.  It followed the same pattern of remaining visible for about 5 seconds and then gradually dimming out of sight.  
About 10 min later it retuned again and this time I pulled out my Bushnell binoculars catching a clearer view of it for a brief moment.  Fascinated by its strange and mysterious appearance and its repeated return to my view I was able to view it twice more over a 10-15 min time span.  
Through the binoculars the light seemed to emanate from one large source at the top of its shape and from two slightly lower light sources.  
It was hard to tell at what distance it could have been and did not seem to be traveling but rather it seemed to have stationed itself in that portion of the sky for a short while.  
After my last viewing i waited…

summary: Pulsating floating red orb flies over home.
description:
I was not the first one to see this light object.  My mother went outside to hang some clothes when I heard her call me out.  She was calling me in a hurried manor.  I went outside just in time to see this orb floating directly above trees in our backyard and it floated over our home.
We watched it together for close to 5 minutes as it slowly floated by. It was an orange/red color.  Pulsating from low brightness to high brightness.  If I had to compare it to something it'd have to be like how a flare would look.
The orb came up low over trees in our back yard, flew over our home and ascended into the dark sky.  We watched it for about 5 mins before we couldn't see it anymore.  There were planes in the area flying above.  Our dog was with us as we stood out watching and it whimpered as if frightened.  It may be due to the light orb.

summary: 2 bright orange lights traversing the sky from east to west followed by a single light of the same magnitude, speed, and height.
description:
Looking south just after 9pm, noticed two bright orange lights moving east to west.  They were separated by less than 5 degrees vertically and took about 1 minute to traverse about 25 degrees horizontally.  They were approximately 10 degrees below the half moon.  They appeared to lose brightness as they traversed the sky but remained clearly visible in the sliver of sky I was able to see.   No sooner did the tandem lights disappear from my field of view than another single light appear traversing the same piece of sky at about the same position of the lower light in the tandem grouping.  Same bright orange characteristic moving about the same speed.  The apparent magnitude of these lights were brighter than the brightest planet I have ever seen.
They were not airplanes as I saw an airplane in the same section of sky and was easily able to compare the events.  I am an engineer working in aviation so know the difference.  In fact, I am attributing these lights to satellites reflecting the sun but since I have never seen three satellites traversing the night sky almost simultaneously and at that magnitude of brightness, I felt like I should report the event.

summary: Two red/orange plasma shapes, soundless, close range for 3 minutes by two witnesses one following the other by about 60 secs then vanished
description:
About 9 PM on 8/4/15, two orange/red UFO’s flew right over head on Bull Point.  The first one came from the southwest to the northeast, and disappeared up in the atmosphere over the bay.  
The second followed it a moment later, but was much lower, at least when I first saw it.  It pulsed like orange jellyfish and had no sound, but was quite bright, with a slight ocular quality like a cornea in an eye that kept pulsing.  
The second one was pretty low as they passed over the hill, maybe helicopter height, floating along slow enough to see some detail in the color shifts.  Not like a mechanical ship, more like an organic life form.  The light itself was the whole entity and it wasn’t geometrically structured, but more fluid in shape.  
As they disappeared, they grew smaller and seemed to have a tail, both in the same spot in the sky.  Probably accelerating up very fast.  
I definitely had the sense the second one was aware of us yelling at each other to see.  
I ducked in to get my camera, but when I got outside, it was trailing off.

I tried looking for a string or wire they could have been hanging off of, but I couldn't see anything.  
It was a cloudy night so I couldn't make out any stars or planes in sight.  These three lights just sort of hovered above the 25th St. shopping center near Olive Garden.  
We started to drive underneath them and I had to turn my head back to look at them (which means they were not moving or they were moving very slowly).  They were pretty bright lights and they did not flicker or flash at all.  They were pretty stagnant as well; they didn't move around a lot and they kept the triangle shape consistent. 
Today 8/4/14 my boyfriend drove on Rt. 22 again and drove on the same exact spot that we saw the lights at last night, but they were not there anymore.  They were too low to the ground to be air planes and too high up to be street lights.  
I tried for hours to try…

summary: Bright red orange triangular shaped object with erratic movement came to stop, then became lighter and smaller and disappeared Medina OH

One bright red light in sky observed from living room window and was moving directly towards us from the south.  Unusually bright and red orange in color for a plane.  
Went outside to observe and noted it was slowly moving but slightly erratic side to side then stopped.  There was no sound heard during this time as we normally do with jets that pass above.  
We live in a rural area and it is normally quiet and dark because of no street lights.  
As we watched it as it was stationary it appeared to change to a lighter color, and became smaller as we assumed it gained altitude and disappeared.  The event took place in about 5 minutes.
I am a  Physical therapist  and my husband is a commercial pilot and we have never observed red anything like this before.

summary: Weird ball of light falling to the ground
description:
My husband and I were sitting on our back deck enjoying a cigar and a cup of coffee, discussing our plans for this week.  
We have a large hill behind our house along with a few other homes.  We have a lot of planes that pass over our house due to the military air base next door, I always enjoy looking up at the different planes going by.  I happened to notice a small plane passing over but as it just went by the corner of my eye straight over the hill was what looked like a fireball falling rapidly.  
It was all white and no red or orange or yellow. but looked as if an object was falling to the ground. 
I saw no more as it either became fizzled out, disappeared or actually made contact with the ground.  
Right before we saw this object we had taken our puppy inside because he was trying desperately to get back into the house, whining, clawing and scratching at the sliding glass door.  He loves the outdoors but for some reason he did not want to be outside at all.
Just weird.

summary: Red ball of light traveling west and gaining altitude until lost in clouds.
description:
Heading south on route 1 in Waterford, CT, at approximately 21:20, my spouse and I happened to notice an orange object in the sky heading west and gaining altitude.  The object was somewhat square and solid orange, as if it were a ball of light or the bottom of a rocket burning fuel through the atmosphere.  
The object was several thousand feet up when spotted. I pulled over and got out of our vehicle while I handed my wife my iPhone to record the object.  There was no sound that we could hear being omitted from the object and we watched for almost 3 minutes before it disappeared into the clouds.  I must add that I specifically looked for flashing lights off of potential wings, but there weren't any.  Tonight is a relatively clear night and I can identify airplanes in the sky as I type this report.

summary: I saw what I can describe as a silent, stationary beacon in the night sky make a single revolution and vanish.
description:
I do not want to sound like one of those kooks that probably contact your agency all the time, but I have seen something that is a mystery to me.
I am a retired Federal employee (34 years USACE) and I have always had a fascination with aviation, military aircraft, the space program and the heavenly bodies above.  I've always got a eye on the sky (day or night).  For health purpose, I walk at night in my small town neighborhood.  
Tonight, 3 Aug 2014, at approx. 9:15pm Central time, I saw what I can only describe as a silent, stationary beacon in the night sky (like a lighthouse at sea) make a single revolution and disappear with no further sight or sound.  I pulled my cellphone and checked my “PlaneFinder” app, and as I expected, there was nothing there.  The truly amazing aspect of this event is that it occurred once before while I was walking at night, at roughly the same time in August of 2004.  Almost exactly ten years ago.
I live in northwest Mississippi, 30 mile south of Memphis International.  We get a lot of FedEx traffic in the evenings so I’m quite familiar with their aircraft, their lighting and their sounds.  And helicopters are extremely audible.  Nothing that I know…

It disappeared before I could pull over for a better view.  
I have never seen airplane or helicopter lights nearly that bright and no other lights were visible on the object.
The intensity of the white light and speed of the object precluded identifying any shape, even though it was slightly before dusk and only about 1/4 mile distant.   
I was unable to arrive at a plausible explanation for any ordinary object it could have been, hence this report.

My fiancee and I were heading North on Rt. 7 (Limestone Road) just south of Rt. 2 (Kirkwood Highway).  We pulled into the Shell gas station located at the 7/2 intersection. As we pulled up to the pump and he got out, I looked out towards the strip mall across rt. 2 where A.C. Moore and Kohl's is, and I saw what looked like 2 glowing balls of fire.  They were perfectly round, fairly large, and flickered just like a candle flame would.  It was not an on off twinkling that you see from airplanes.  They were moving slowly from the North to the South, the second ball seemed to moving just slightly faster then the first, as the gap between the 2 seemed to be shrinking.  Not sure if that was because of the angle I was seeing them from or not. I sat there watching them until they disappeared over the awning of the gas station.
Witness indicates that the date is approximate.  PD

The golfers face south to drive balls, looking directly at the butte.  The elevation provides for nice views of the town, surrounding landscapes and the Rocky Mountain peaks to the west.
The afternoon sky was clear above with some clouds gathering in the west over the mountains.  I drove a ball (using a 7-iron) and as it climbed at first it seemed to stop and hover, but I immediately realized I lost track of the ball and my eye picked up another object in the sky.  It looked small, round and white like a golf ball, but much higher in the sky.  I thought perhaps it was a plane, so I stopped to watch it for a minute.  After a minute or so, I realized it couldn’t be a plane because it was not moving forward, it was just hovering.
It’s not unusual for hawks to be flying around there, but this was much too high and looked rather inanimate.  My gaze wandered to the right (west) where I spotted 3 additional objects just like the original one.  There was another “tandem” object – the top part of that object looked like the other…

The object at times appeared to change from bell shaped to round and when it started climbing upwards appeared to be flipping like a coin tossed into the air, alternating from black to silver.

summary: Startled awake by my cat going crazy & a black shadow figure looking over my lower half.
description:
It was 05:05 am in my bedroom.  I was awakened by my cat yowling loudly.  I was laying on my right side which was strange as I have not done it in the 16 years since my spinal injury & resulting bad sciatica down my right leg, it was too painful to consciously do.  I turned around to see why my cat was going crazy.  I was startled by a black shadow figure about 5ft tall, slim with a large bald head.  It had green L.E.D. like lights in positions around its body.  As I looked on, it bent over me 2 times looking at my lower back & legs.  It stood upright in between the bends to examine my lower body.
All this time my cat was still yowling.  The perfectly black figure was lit from behind by a night light so I could see its outline distinctly, doing what it was doing, plus the green lights on parts of its own outline enhanced its shape.  I challenged it by shouting "who are you?" and "what do you want?"  I did this twice.
It made no noise.  It just did what it was doing.  I then plucked up the courage to move towards the lamp switch to turn it on. As I was changing position, it began to gradually disappear.  By the time the light was on, it was gone and my cat stopped his crazy…

summary: Red Orb siting in my bedroom on two occasions.

summary: Two Bright Flashes Lit Up A Clear Night Sky And The Interior Of My House
description:
I didn't see an actual craft.  I experienced bright flashes of light around 2:30 AM.  I was lying awake in bed and a bright flash of light lit up the whole interior of my house.  I sat up expecting a thunder clap but none came.  About 5 seconds later another flash lit up the house, again with no ensuing thunder.
The flashes were way too bright, and had lit up the house too thoroughly to be a distant lightning flash and I suspected a storm was approaching rapidly.  
I got out of bed and went out on the porch to check it out, because I had windows to close if the storm would be a strong one.  I saw a perfectly clear sky with lots of stars visible in each direction.  
Nothing was amiss or out of place a the neighbor houses.  
I'm baffled as to what the huge flashes of light may have been.

summary: Brilliant green diamond shaped UFO sighted over Everett, Wa

The craft was completely silent and had three solid red lights at each corner.  It was about 100ft from the ground.  I could easily identify the shape of the craft against the starry night sky.

summary: Red,orange and blue lights in a field forming a triangle
description:
My boyfriend and I were on our way home from Wisconsin Dells on Hwy A, headed towards 151.  It was about 12:15-12:20 am.  
We could see a red light in the distance and had originally thought that it was from a tower. When we came closer we could actually see that this light was in the middle of an open field and that there were two other lights along with it that were orange and blue in color. 		      
The shape of the lights formed an isosceles triangle, with the red light being on the top (pulsating), then the orange and the blue being at the bottom, closest to the ground.  
The object was huge and would have been bigger than a house or barn if it was placed next to one.  
None of the lights were moving and it remained stationary as we drove past.  We could not hear any noises coming from it either.  We could not see anything that connected the lights together; it just seemed like they were free floating by themselves making up this pattern. 
Another car coming in the opposite direction seen the same thing, and they pulled over to try and figure out what it was as well.  We did not stop since this object gave me a very uneasy feeling. 
 We have never seen anything like this and…

I walked out to my back yard with my dogs.  I looked towards the north and observed three reddish-orange objects/lights in the sky.  Two were in line with each other (south to north direction) and the third was slightly to the east.  
I went back into the house and called my wife to come outside to see this and grabbed my cell phone (to see if I could get a couple of pictures).
When we came back out, all three were in line (south to north direction) and moving slowly towards the south.  The lead one began to fade until it was no longer visible and each of the other two did the same as they reached the same spot in the sky. They made no sound.
After the third one had faded away a commercial jet flew from west to east near where they faded away at a much lower altitude than what the lights were at.

summary: Looked out the window and thought it was the moon, but it was very low in the sky and there was no lunar eclipse.
description:
I looked out of the bathroom window and there was a blood red object just above the tree line of the woods that I live near.  It was not right at the tree line, but it was in the sky.  
When I first saw it, I thought it was the moon, but the moon isn't that low, not at that time. And there was no Lunar Eclipse.  
I wanted to take a picture of it, but I did not want to wake everyone in the house and didn't think I could get a good picture inside. 
I went back to my room, and I could still saw it, but in a matter of minutes, it was completely gone and I didn't see it again. 
I asked people who were out last night, but they said the moon was a normal color and it was about the same time. 
So I guess I could only see it from where I was.
We are not certain that this is a serious-minded report.  PD

summary: Two bright orange orbs in Northwest Denver synchronized, traveling northeasterly above tree line, then disappeared.

They were well above tree line and houses, and were coming from the southwest traveling in a perfectly straight line at a stable elevation, coming from the Sheridan Avenue area in the Edgewater vicinity.
Two of us saw them.  They were traveling quietly and perfectly synchronized together. After between 30 and 60 seconds both bright orange glowing orbs kind of flashed brighter one time, then immediately disappeared, both at exactly the same time.  They did not appear to drop in elevation at all, they just disappeared.  They disappeared when they were probably over Yates and 41st Avenue area or a little farther northeast.
I would guess the two orbs, or what ever they were, were traveling about as high as a helicopter flies around Denver, maybe a little lower.  Very bright orange, almost red glowing, appearing to be round / oval in shape.  Pretty good size; smaller than the body of a helicopter but maybe about six or seven feet in…

summary: Blinking light with an abnormal trajectory
description: Coming back from the store on a moped with a friend. We noticed a strange light to our left. What stood out to us was that the object/light was moving in ways an aircraft simply couldn't. I pulled over on the sidewalk, and we got down to watch this object/light. My partner at the time started recording, and with my two eyes I can see the phone recording. The object/light was moving in triangular patterns, back and forth, side to side. There was a cloud in sight, which then the object/light moved behind. I was so sure this was UFO I even called my dad to run to the end of the street to catch a glimpse. Before he can make it to where we were, the object/light transformed into what seemed to be a plane. With plane lights and all. I'm 1000000% sure of what we saw that night and left us both in shock. Hands shaking and all, we make our way back to the house and pull out the phone to review the video.. Video was not in phone. I don't have an explanation of how this could've happened after I looked and made sure it was recording. I was left mind blown, could not sleep that night.

summary: Looked like a Blue Star, that flew SE from its NorthWest location and faded out of sight.
description:
I went to the living room to close the blinds and noticed a single star.  I thought it was a bit bright considering there were no other stars in the sky due to the thick cloud/chemtrail cover.
I watched the "star" for a few seconds and it began to slowly move South-Eastish from its location.  As it was moving, another dimly lit 'star' appeared and remained stationary.  The first "star" kept moving in a SE direction and the second star faded in and out.
After about 30 seconds of movement from the first star, it simply disappeared, no flashing lights or anything.  It was simply a "star" moving, and then gone.
The second star completely dimmed out after the first one faded away.
I hope this helps, it was a strange sight and I see quite a few of them up here at night, usually from 1am to 4 am. I'll update you again with the next one.

summary: 2 orange, floating objects

I arrived home around  21:45 on Saturday, Aug. 2nd.  I drove car into garage, parked my car, went to the back to remove items.  
As I rounded back of car I noticed an orange light glowing in the sky, heading towards my home.  
I proceeded to my driveway area and watched briefly before I turned on my phone video.  I captured the floating object, which continued on a northerly direction.  
I stopped video and continued to watch, and it floated for another 10-15 sec before it blinked on/off, then finally disappeared.  I began walking back to my garage, looked again in the same direction and saw another orange object floating in the sky.  I attempted to video tape it, but couldn't get it in my viewfinder.  
It started a NW direction, but soon went north, then north east and did the same blinking, before it disappeared.  Both were at around a 30-40 degree angle from the horizon, with perhaps a 500' height above ground.

Then a black shiny polished looking orb flies over in a perfect trajectory flying S.E. (like the ISS, I see it fly over at night alot)  The elevation could be around 2 - 4 hundred feet.  
It could not have been affected by the wind as it seemed to be in an orbit like the ISS.  Did not make a sound and I continued watching until it went out of sight in the far S.E. and I know it wasn't ISS because this was under the clouds, black and much larger.  
It did not appear to change in elevation during the 30 seconds it was viewable.  Again it was black and had a shiny polished look to it.  
The size was not large from my perspective about the size of a half dollar at arm's length at its closest from my back yard it was just a bit east of my position in west Spokane but almost straight over so I got a good look at it. 
I watched it until it got smaller and smaller until it was no longer visible.
We spoke via telephone with this witness, and we…

summary: Green and red light hovering silently around treeline block away from my house.

First I noticed it come from the south side of the tree, its a bushy tall tree so like 150 feet tall and sits in the back of a vacant home on Grace.  The lights came half the distance closer to my patio at one point, staying at the same height then went back to the other side of the tree and went behind, then it went up real fast like it was propelled.  
I'm from England but moved here 12 years ago and have gotten used to heavy airplane and helicopter traffic and this was neither because it was only a block away and didn't hear anything.  It went on for several minutes I thought it was longer but can't remember.  
It seems as though it was looking for something in the tree the way it went back and forth and behind it.  The red and green lights were just glowing and basically and nothing else was seen.  I find it hard to describe.

She handed the binoculars to me (I could not find nor see the object with my naked eye) and instructed me to follow a certain cloud pattern upwards to find the object. I did, and…

summary: A blue meteor that suddenly stopped
description:
On August 2, 2014, 5:58am I was driving westbound on John T White Rd in east Fort Worth, just off Eastchase Parkway.  
My wife was in the passenger seat.  I witnessed a blue meteor directly through my front windshield just to the left of my rear view mirror.  I started to point and tell my wife there was a meteor and then it stopped in place.  She asked me why I was pointing at a star and I told her it could not be a star.  
The object appeared to have come from the northwest and traveled across the sky rapidly like a typical meteor only it stopped suddenly.  It stopped in the western portion of the sky about a quarter of the sky up from where the sun would set before I lost visual.  There was no fluctuation in the light at all and no tail.  There were no blinking lights only solid blue like a bright star.  I told no one about this except my wife who was with me.  
The next day on Facebook a few friends mentioned seeing a blue light in the sky behaving oddly so I knew it was not just a onetime fluke.

summary: Blue circular light streaked above the beach and disappeared.
description:
I was fishing at Anglin's fishing pier early in the morning when I saw the object, it was somewhere between 3 - 5 am. 
It was a slow day for fishing so I stared at the beach waiting for a bite.  From the point of view on the pier to the beach, a blue ball of light streaked above the left side of the beach.  It moved from top right to left arcing downward, it left a red trail as it moved and then disappeared.  It moved very fast and I expected a crash or some kind of noise but there was none.  
The guy fishing right next to me witnessed it at the same time.  We asked around but no one else seemed to see the blue object that we saw.  It was witnessed by an Oriental male and an African-American male.

The lights covered a large section of the night sky as they travelled.  The three lights travelled from 11 o'clock to the 1 o'clock across the night sky in like 5 seconds, then they were totally gone. 
Afterward I looked around the sky and I could see two airplanes.  The airplanes were totally different.  They moved much slower and the airplanes had flashing red/blue/white lights.  
The UFO that I saw was not an airplane.  It was fast and it disappeared.  Airplanes do not disappear.  Airplanes travel in a straight line forever.

summary: While star gazing on a clear night, I watched 3 UFO's fade into visibility, one after the other.
description:
I was star gazing on my back patio, no clouds in sight, it was a beautiful night, when I saw three UFO's directly above me.  I noticed in my peripheral vision a very bright light, heading north, directly above me.  It was brighter than any star visible, and I watched it fade into sight from the darkness.  
In full sight, I watched the light began to fade away quickly, when another UFO appeared nearly exactly where the other disappeared, traveling south-west, directly above me.  This one was not as bright, but I knew it was not an airplane, nor satellite, I also watched this sprout from the blackness. 
The third I saw also faded into being from the blackness of space, but this was not like the other two. It was a faint orange light, with a blinking red light.  The light was not flashing in a pattern, like you would see on any other aircraft, and the UFO was not moving smoothly.  It was almost "jumping" or stuttering on its path.  Eventually, it flew into a treeline and I was unable to tell if it faded away or not.

summary: Yellow/orange fireball, triangular in shape, formed from three circles, shot straight up, then turned laterally and became faint.

It was exactly 11:25pm, when I noticed a very obvious and huge orange/yellow fire ball blasting straight up into the sky.  We had reached the Fort Orange exit at that time.  
I immediately pulled over and asked my wife to get out of the car.  At first I thought a space shuttle launch was occurring.  It soon dawned on me that the flames and sound were missing.  It was just a great intense glow. 
After it reached about 15 thousand feet, it shot south in a lateral direction leaving behind a trail as if a meteor were moving through the sky, and the orange/yellow dimmed to white and started to look like a distant star.  
Trust me, that's when I knew we were witnessing a most unique occurrence.  I couldn't close my jaw, and my wife pointed out it was triangular, seemingly formed out of three balls. 
Seriously speaking, this made my a! nniversary trip...the coolest ever.  I feel very lucky to have witnessed it.

summary: 10pm Thursday July 31, 2014.
description:
My son and I arrive home at 10pm.  As we were parking, at about 45 degrees up, to the north, we witnessed an object, a orange more yellow circular object that disappeared then, reappeared several times as it seemed to travel down. 
As it approached approx. 30 degrees, it split in two with what seemed like a lava lamp separation with particles between two separated parts.  
As it fell to a tree line that obscured our view there was a flash more like lighting, though the skies were clear with the exception of a few Sirius cloud whiffs.  
My son got scared and went into the house, and after about 30 seconds, there was a secondary flash that seemed to be  an angle on the ground.  
I continued to watch and a third flash occurred approx. 2 minutes after that, that seemed to be at ground level.  
Though we are near a regional airport and a Coast Guard Station, no sound accompanied this sighting .

summary: Crimson red to orange lasted 5 seconds.
description:
One never changed location, disappeared in five seconds, the other lasted longer.  It disappeared suddenly, away from the other one.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Orange circular lights in Coos Bay Area.
description:
We saw a orange glowing circle appear north of Tenmile Lake by Coos Bay.  
My son and his friend and my co-worker were camping.  Skies were clear, we heard fighter jets fly by and were looking up at the sky.  
A few moments later, we saw a single glowing orange circle in the sky, when we got up to take a closer look and walked a few steps, it turned into 2 glowing circles.  
They appeared to have glowing circles within the circles, that fluctuated the color slowly between the orange spectrum.  
Then they shrunk and disappeared within 3-4 seconds.

summary: I fly drones for hobby and even the top end private drones don't look or act like this or capable of such an odd flight.
description:
Red/orange light with less bright white"sparks"around the craft at random intervals.  
Appear and disappeared 3 times,each time reappearing 1/4mile(est) away from last pos almost instantly.  
Moving southeast at random speeds(slow glide to a hover to faster pace to vanishing and reappearing) last contact about 22:05 headed south/southeast before stopping for 30sec then was just gone.  
Was at slightly above the altitude I see aircraft take on approach to Newport News airport
