summary: Triangle of lights over NYS thruway near exit 20.
description:
We were driving down the nys thruway near exit 20 and saw 3 bright lights in the sky in a perfect Triangle formation.  
At first we thought it may be a plane but the lights were stationary and too far apart.  
Then we thought it may have been a tower, but on closer inspection there was nothing under the lights and it was directly over the highway.  
It was hovering over the highway and making no noise.  
We drove right under it.  It did not move.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Saw four orange lights in the sky.
description:
About 9:05 pm on 7/31/14, I left my home & was traveling in a southeasterly direction to run an errand, when I saw two bright almost oval orange lights in the sky.  These lights were not really high in the sky, nor directly over me, more like in the sky in front of me.
I stopped my vehicle to look more closely, thinking it may be a meteorite falling from the sky.  However, the orange lights did not blink or fall from the sky.  They were moving through the sky almost horizontally.  They were fairly close together, like military planes in formation, but the lights were bright & much larger, similar to the little red blinking light on an airplane...maybe as much as 5-10x the size.
I opened my window on my vehicle, to ascertain whether I could hear any sound of an engine.  I heard nothing but some traffic from a nearby intersection.  Then I noticed a third identical light following the first two, though the distance between the last two was 3x the distance between the first two lights.  I thought it was strange but after sitting in my vehicle looking up for ~1-2 minutes decided to continue to my destination a 1/4 mile away to see if I could still see them.  I came to a red traffic…

summary: Red dot circling around me on my porch at home.
description: Caught on video a red dot spiraling around.  Thought it could be a glare at first, but it kept getting closer.  It wasnt a laser, just a dot that circled around, and i have a video of how clear it looks.

summary: several orange lights seen flying over sun prarie
description:
5 circular crafts flew rather low and red/orange-ish in color and absolutely no sound.  
There were no flashing lights.  Just a solid ball of light. 
They flew past rising higher into the sky and just seemed to disappear.  
These were followed by 5 more doing the same.  2 more came by and finally one more.  
All flew in the same direction. 
They seemed to vanish as quickly as they appeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Pulsating bright white light formation take off at amazing speed
description:
Driving from Southern and McClintock drive in Tempe, AZ, towards US 60, we saw an intense almost glittery pulsating bright white light formation hovering, almost over Freeway towards the end of Rush hour.  
It did this for a couple of minutes, we couldn't believe our eyes thinking maybe it was a helicopter, then flew off at light speed north and was gone! 
Others had to have seen this!  We've been looking for news, but so far nothing.
Source of report elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  The witness didn't see anything in the news, probably because he/she did not report it to the news.  PD

summary: Green, red light that hovered, moved, hovered and disappeared.
description:
Small object with two green lights and one red light.  
Hovered for a few moments, moved a few feet sideways and continued hovering. 
Proceeded to move up and down several times, hovered for a few more moments, then slowly rose out of sight.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Greenwich, CT 07/31/2014 - blue/white luminous "object" streaked across the sky.
description:
Traveling southbound on Merritt Parkway at approx 5:25 am, between exit 28 (Round Hill Road) and exit 27 (120A).
An electric blue/white luminous "object" streaked across the sky going southwest.
I first thought it was a meteorite or a firework because of the tail, but then the object stuttered, stopped, and suddenly zipped southeast at a right angle and then poof!  Gone!  
It was not a plane, not a helicopter, no sound.

summary: Chevron shaped object over Milford, NH, with many lights flying low making no sound.
description:
At approximately 3:45 am I was standing at our kitchen window when I saw what I thought was an airplane moving overhead heading in a northerly direction.
I immediately went out side onto our deck to get a better look because I could not hear it in spite of how low it was flying.  It was shaped like a chevron or triangle, flying quite a bit lower than air traffic does in our area, was making no sound at all and had more lights than an airplane usually does.
I could not see the object itself, just the lights.  What struck me was the total silence.  As low as this thing was flying I heard nothing at all.
As I watched it continued to move north silently until I could not see it anymore.
I am a 51 year old female and have never seen anything like this before.
Witness provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Non-satellite object grows brighter in evening sky and then flies away.
description:
I was looking at the night's sky over the Tacoma area and watching what I thought was probably a satellite.  I was watching it traverse the sky and all of a sudden it started getting brighter and brighter.
It got brighter to the point that it was like having a flash light shown right in my face. A very fine white light, but extremely bright.  Then, it suddenly changed direction and flew across the sky and out of my view literally within a second.
The time was 2:45 a.m. on July 31st 2014.

summary: Bright flashes light up whole sky, many colors Red, Orange, white.
description:
Since about midnight, I first saw my window light up like a flash on a camera coming from outside. 
My girlfriend and I and her son went out front and there has been flash after flash off in the distance at about treeline high coming from all over the sky.  
The flashes are so bright it lights up the whole sky and has different colors from red to orange to white.  '
It's been over an hour and the flashes are still happening.  It is very weird.  
It can't be lighting there is no thunder and different colors.
We received a telephoned report of what sounds to us to be the same event.  We are awaiting that report.  PD

summary: I was outside our house with my children when suddenly we seen a bright blue flash and when we looked up a rectangle shape object flew past us.
description:
There was no sound coming from the object.
It was approximately 30 ft. above us and lasted 20 seconds.
We suspect that the object was not a meteor, given that a 20-second duration meteor is very long.  PD

summary: Military jet chasing orbs.
description:
Was out near Quinault, Wa.  Camping with family at North Fork campground.  
At 11:30 pm, we heard a jet in the distance, looked up and saw what looked like a military jet chasing a bright red orb.  
About an hour later, heading in the opposite direction, we heard the jet again, this time it was the same jet chasing 2 green bright orbs.

summary: Brilliant orange/red, large as the moon object flying(?) parallel to Earth at a constant speed with non-erratic movement.
description:
At approximately 2327 hrs. on 7/30/14, I was putting my dogs away for the night when a movement in the sky caught my eye.  I saw a huge fiery, brilliantly colored orange/red “thing” moving towards the N/NW direction at a fairly high rate of speed.  
It was parallel to the earth and appeared to be as big as the moon.  It was not irregular in movement.  The shape appeared to be a bit elliptical, but I may be wrong.  
I witnessed it for approximately 1 minute until it disappeared over the Koolau Mountain range on the windward side of Oahu near Kahaluu.  
I called a local television station to see if they had received any other reports and they stated they had not.  
This is the first time I have ever witnessed such a thing and it was enough to scare me and keep me awake and watching the sky most of the night.
We spoke via telephone with the woman who submitted the report, and she sounded to us to be quite eloqent, sober-minded, and responsible.  We suspect that she is a very good, and reliable, witness.  PD

summary: Daytona Beach UFO Triangle shaped  red/orange SW-NE.
description:
Object had three red/orange lights making the object appear to be a triangle shaped  moving steadily from southwest to north east outwards to the ocean.  
At one point the first ufo either turned off “lights” or disappeared from sight and then re-appeared a second or two later on the same heading.  We lost sight of it as it went behind trees.  
The second ufo appeared from no where with about the same heading but not in the exact path as the first one.  
We heard no sounds, but from the altitude they were at, we should have heard something as there were actual small aircraft that we could hear in an area farther and in a different direction than the ones being reported.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: What looked like Mars only 3 times larger then came down to cruise over as a glowing red/orange fireball craft
description: I was coming out of a hotel beside the city's airport and getting into my car when I seen a bright red star up in the east.  I am always looking at the stars being an amateur astronomer kind of guy.  It reminded me of Mars but was way too bright.  My house at 1300 Mary Street West was only a couple of blocks away and when driving home I could still see it high up in the east sky.  The object then moved toward the airport right over my head but was still high up. I called my daughter out of the house to come and see this thing. It flew by us to my surprise I was so happy that I had another witness.  It took off without sound from the big dipper area towards Cassiopeia then disappeared. We waited around to see anything else around when maybe 20 minutes later I seen it or another one come right over a tree in front of my house heading directly east.  We were both amazed as it was very close to ground this time and appeared as a red/orangey fireball as my daughter put it.  It then gained altitude quickly and sped off towards Cassiopeia again and disappeared.  Most remarkable it didn't make any noise and there were no blinking lights like the many aircraft I am used to seeing in my…

summary: Orange-red crescent shaped object in sky, approximately 10 miles west of Lancaster City Park.
description:
Object was shaped like a half-moon.  Over the span of approximately one minute, the object's bottom half dissolved.  Then, two red orbs descended from the bottom of the object.   It slowly began to reform back into a crescent shape, and then proceeded to disappear.
Five minutes later, the object reappeared 10 miles to the north, in the same section of the sky.  During the second appearance, it maintained its crescent shape for the duration of its visibility.  It once again began to fade and completely disappeared.

summary: Orange lights silent pass over Groton, NH
description:
A bright orange light, soundless, passing SW to NE over Groton.  Large and bright.  
Thought it was Mars initially before it began moving.  Then it was gone.  
Thought maybe satellite or ISS, until 5 mins later, another identical orange light fly over on exact same flight path.

summary: Flashing star UFO in West Point.
description:
Wife and I were laying on the tramp, watching shooting stars.  
Suddenly, something flashed at us in the sky.  It was like a star appeared out of nowhere and flashed at us.  It did this 3 times in about 10 seconds.  A very bright vivid flash.  The light was a pure white and seemed to have a blue hue around it.  
Sky was clear, except for a few very high thin clouds. Many satellites visible. This light we saw was not a plane and we both felt like it was flashing AT us, as though it wanted our attention.  This couldn't have been the case though, because as soon as we started talking about it, it was gone.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Hovering object seen with red and white light making very erratic movements
description:
At approximately 10:15 pm, myself and 4 other family members witnessed something hovering in the sky that we could not identify or explain.  We were on the back patio of my house, and observed a large object floating in the same spot with a very bright red and white light.  The lights were not blinking, not strobing, just on.  There was no sound either. We were not able to make out the shape of the object.  
We assumed what we were seeing was a helicopter at first, until we saw it move.  It would suddenly move one direction, then dart the other way without stopping (from left to right without pausing).  It would seem to float and dip, and then suddenly accelerate a short distance, and then freeze.  It also would suddenly descend and ascend.  
All of the movements seemed very erratic, and not at all like any normal flight pattern.  I do not believe that a helicopter would be capable of the movements we witnessed.  
We watched the object for about 3 minutes as it slowly traveled several miles away and out of view.  
Hoping others witnessed!??

summary: 3 Stange objects  seen scanning an airplane in New Jersey.
description:
We collectively saw 3 strange multicolored objects hovering.  Then one of them shot out a white light then disappeared.  The second one disappeared then the third one slowly faded off into the distance.  
A commercial airplane in the area of the objects was lit up by the white light that shot out of the UFO, as if it was scanning the airplane.  There where multiple witnesses who seen this happen.
After a few minutes helicopters flew in the same direction as the objects. We where looking north-northeast.

summary: Small buzzing boomerang/triangle distinct quiet buzz.
description:
I heard a buzzing sound out of an open window.  Seems pretty normal being 2 miles from worcester airport.  I happend to go outside for a smoke and heard a quiet buzz getting closer and closer.  The idle sound got very quiet as this boomerang object passed over my house.  
The sky still had pink in it from sundown so I had a visuaul straight over my house about 300 ft up.  Had one solid bright white light and green flashers on each wing.  
The object was plane-like, except extra long in the front but wings toward back of this object.  Looked between a boomerang and a triangle.  
It continued to swoop toward a landing near airport but turned and looped around and over my house another 4 times.  It was not a plane because it hummed or buzzed like a dirtbike.. 
I've now seen the bright green flashers and bright solid light in the entire valley randomly since last winter. Has a distinct hum/buzz sound. Are these drones?

summary: 6 brightly lit low hovering objects in DuPage County.
description:
6 bright lighted objects flying low and over DuPage County yesterday evening.  Not proper lighting to be a plane and too low, no sound to be a helicopter and we thought it could be the personal hobby droids that can be purchased but too high for that.  
Baffled.  
Lights flickered and were blue, red and green.  They would slowly paced and would circulate for a few minutes and then disappear.  Nothing more, nothing less.  
Just curious if anyone else saw this as can't find anything else about it.

summary: Four aircraft circle like vultures then shoot off at great speeds
description:
I was watching a plane dump out a chemtrail when I noticed what looked like four "vultures" very high up in the sky.  They were at the very least 4000 ft in the air, yet their shape was quite visible, and unusually large.  
They made unusually quick circles for several minutes, then I finally decided to try and film them with my iPhone; and as if it was scripted I kid you not they stopped circling and shot off at an insanely fast speed, one by one. 
 Of course the noon sun made it impossible to capture via the iPhone 5s, but my eyes (shaded by raybans) saw everything in 20/20 vision.  I wouldn't waste our time with a fairy tale, this was a unique event.

summary: flying saucer makes touchdown then flees the scene
description:
I was over a friend's house yesterday.  We were drinking a little and just having a good time at his place in west Suffield CT.  When we both stepped outside for whatever reason at the time and saw what appeared to be a great orb of light at first.  It was apparent that this was not an airplane because it was not moving.  
It just remained still for about 30 sec then suddenly started to jump in random spots in about a .5 mile radius from its original spot.  
Then as crazy as it sounds I could actually make out the shape of the craft.  Classic old sci-fi movie flying saucer is what it appeared to look like with a system of lights around the circular edge.  What really freaked me out is when I looked even closer and could make out what appeared to be what some call a (touchdown).  But the beam of light coming from the bottom of the craft wasn't light at all. It blended in with the sky and I could only see the edge of it.  
When suddenly the beam of whatever it was disappeared and the crafts lights flashes starting with one bulb and went around the saucer ending with a single red flash from a bulb.  That red flash was the last I saw from the craft as it quickly disappeared into the…

summary: Bright diamond-oval, low in night sky with multi-color, rotating red, green & white lights and erratic movements.
description:
My roommate was walking outside at about 10:35PM, when suddenly she saw, going from West to East, what at first she thought might be a meteor, then thought it might be a plane crashing.  She soon realized that it was neither because it quickly went back and forth, up and down, and at one point straight up. 
After watching it for about 5 minutes, she told me to come outside and look up in the sky, and I saw it too.
The object appeared to be sort of a diamond-oval shape, low in the night sky.  The lights, which were larger than plane lights, didn't flash-the object appeared to be rotating its red, green and white colors.  Sometimes it moved very fast and it was also stationary once.  
It darted about only about 1/4 to 1/2 mile away from us and I believe it went as high as at least 1000 ft.  
I watched it for about two minutes, when it suddenly went in a downward direction and we didn't see it again.

summary: Large red object over eastern Cape Cod.
description:
Standing in Harwich Center, looking ENE a bright, distant, large red object with a small yellow center was seen.  It appeared to be traveling eastward.
It was shaped like a triangle but with round corners.  If you hold a quarter at arms length, that was it's apparent size in the sky.  Many times larger that the light formations of airliners.  Much, much larger than stars.  Entire object had a red hue.
At first I thought it was fireworks, then maybe those military flares with parachutes.  But it kept moving away and did not change in brightness or color.

summary: Lights appeared in northern sky in triangle formation, then broke off into separate groups.
description:
The lights were bright red, appeared to be round, and blinked.  
Once they broke off, they scattered throughout the sky and moved south, fading away in the distance.  No sound.
We assume a nighttime sighting, and have amended the time above.  PD

summary: Orange fireball moving in sky.

Driving home using PW PARKWAY saw a fireball (orange) directly up and in front of me moving quickly.  
I pulled over opened my door and tacked it heading from west to the east/north east. Viewed for 3 miniutes.

summary: I saw a bright lighted circle just above a tree which then quickly dipped straight down behind the tree blocking my vision of it.
description:
I walked out of my house to take out the trash, and I saw a large, brightly illuminated white circle just above a tree across the street.  It then immediately dipped behind the tree and I couldn't see it any more.  
Many planes go over my neighborhood on their way to and from Logan, so I know it wasn't a plane.  It was much too large and amorphous to have been a plane,traveled too fast, and dipped very quickly straight down.  
I knew I had seen something inexplicable, and I am a keen observer of the skies.  
I have never seen anything like this before, and my heart was pounding with fear.

summary: Two objects one red, one white seen in ENE sky over Blacklick, Ohio.
description:
Two objects appeared in the ENE sky.  One object solid red in color, other object solid white.  
Red object was seen gaining speed to catch up to other object, then began circling white object.  
Both objects proceeded on same course for approx 4 min.  Then both objects slowly gained altitude and faded.

summary: Triangle Shaped Object Red w/Green Lights - No Sound
description:
My husband and I were driving on Highway 41 towards Fresno, Ca.  This is flat farmland country and you can see for miles.  
We had a clear view of the horizon at all times, when we approached Highway 198. I saw a large triangle formation above us (approx. 500 feet), with 5 lights, green with red behind the green lights.  There was 1 in the middle and 2 down each side.  
This object appeared to be at least a football field in width, we have no idea on length.  I yelled to my husband "what is that," he was as startled as I was.  It appeared to change shape into a straight line, mimicking the radio towers we have seen in various locations. 
This object made no noise, we had our windows down.  We just couldn't believe what we were seeing.  
We immediately pulled off the road within 10 seconds we were out the car, and we saw nothing, heard nothing and there were no radio towers.  The sky was just black, like we had seen the prior 50 miles.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 2 objects spotted in Southwest Boise, late evening.
description:
Two objects at cloud level moving slowly in a uniform direction.  Unable to identify what types of objects.  Seemed to be about 100 ft away from each other moving from southwest toward northeast.  Silver/ Black in color.  
A video was taken of the objects.  Very odd shape, hard to identify precisely, there were no wings and the objects moved fairly slowly.  
The objects apparently shifted direction mid-air and moved southwest according to the second witness.

summary: Solid orange round light floated across sky for 30 seconds then disappeared (totally unlike airplane lights. It was fairly close, too,)
description:
Solid Orange ball of light flying southeast (opposite direction from airplane approaching Boca airport) Altitude approx 2,000 FT.  (It seemed to be a couple miles away from my vantage point)  Object was silent and appeared to be travelling exact opposite as a nearby plane which had the usual flashing multi-color lights.  I didn't see any stars in sky due to cloudcover.
After 30 seconds it just dissappeared completely and suddenly I took photo and it appears as solid perfect round light in photo.
Size was about 1/5 of what a full moon is.  It wasn't extremely bright, and didn't flash or change speed...just glided above tree line for what looked like a mile then vanished (as if turned off by a light switch)

summary: I was standing outside when I saw something in the sky not moving and it rapidly went away in a flash.
description: I'm outside the front of my house in the street listening to Frank Ocean and I'm dancing by myself with my dog and I look up and my dogs looks up as well I can't move I see something in the sky and it looks like a plane but it's not moving and it has the green lights that a plane usually has and I'm staring at it and it then moves extremely fast zooming so fast that it appears to be a flash of white light and then it's gone.

summary: I saw a round object yellow in color about the size of star or a little larger do two loops and fly off and disappear.
description:
The event all happened in about 5 seconds.  
I have never seen anything like it.

summary: Round metallic object moving slowly over Boeing field
description:
On Tuesday July 29th at 4:30pm as I was driving N/B on Martin Luther King Way a reflection of light in the sky caught my attention.  This was a beautiful sunny day with no clouds in the sky.  I observed sunlight reflecting off of a round-smooth metallic (chrome) ball in the sky.  It appeared to be hovering about 500 feet over Boeing field.  
As the object began moving very slowly to the N/W I could see it clearly.  There were no markings on it and appeared to be perfectly smooth and chrome in color.  It’s hard to judge the size because of nothing near it to compare to, but I’m guessing it was about the size of a house.
As I watched the object move slowly to the N/W it seemed to “fade out” or blend into the sky (I could still see the shape of it).  I continued watching it until it went completely out of view.  I kept looking in the area to hopefully see it again.  The round metallic object reappeared and began to slowly ascend straight up-then it just disappeared!

summary: Three triangular craft with lights emitting from them tumbling in formation at high altitude and moving across sky in broad daylight.
description:
Good light and clear sky with a few streaks of stratospheric clouds.  Saw glinting which I thought was a high altitude large aircraft.  Very high, ~40,000 ft.  
Got binoculars.  Amazed to see it was triangle with lights on tumbling.  One bright light on one end.  Not reflected from sun as light stayed in same place on object.  Regular tumbling motion as it moved across the sky.  
Looking at the scene were three of these objects in total. identical in size, attributes and behaviour.  They were evenly moving together.  I'm used to tracking planes, space station and satellites, but these were not.  
I'm not a UFO believer but am not scared as I am a practicing Catholic, and soI  called on Jesus to save us and prayed the St. Michael prayer, as whatever these things are in the heavens - military, natural or supernatural, they cannot be from God or for our good.

summary: Multiple lights and strange star like objects seen.
description:
I was outside on my back porch having a cigarette and some coffee early that morning while it was still dark and noticed a formation of whitish blue colored star like objects in a formation moving left across the night sky.  Some of them would push in closer to the other or move up higher.  
I also noticed to my right another whitish blue object that was actually bigger than the other objects to the left and it seemed to be moving upwards in the sky and would dim it's lights and then become faint then glow really bright. I think that particular light was originally lower in the sky and when i looked at it through my binoculars it seemed to be shaped like a spherical galaxy or what you would call a saucer.  
The most eerie aspect of these sightings was the last object i saw not far from that one which was a yellow light that was the same size as the blue whitish one and it was also moving across the sky even farther right to the last one. Only traversed a few degrees of arc before vanishing.  Mode of disappearance was odd: imagine a flash-light pointed toward the observer, being tilted up until the light was no longer visible.
Cloud cover:  Nearly cloudless night, possibly a few high wisps.
Moon:  None; sighting was two days after new moon.
Sound:  none.
Navigation/running lights/strobe:  None observed.
Meteor: sighting had none of the characteristics of a meteor: slow movement, no trail.
Delayed reporting this until I was reasonably satisfied that it was not a satellite or an aircraft.  Believe it was too late at night for a satellite.  
Subsequent observation of aircraft in the area has shown that navigation lights/strobe lights are quite visible to the naked eye, even on high flying craft.  I looked for these lights at the time of the sighting, was not able to observe any.

description:
At approx. 8:15am PDT, I was sitting on the front porch having a smoke, and I looked toward the Olympic mountain chain to the west. The object slowly moved from my left to my right (NW or NNW).  Distance appeared to be at least five miles and the object's airspeed appeared to be 150 to 200mph.  
When I first saw it, its azimuth was approx. 9°, and it appeared to slowly descend as my view of it became obstructed by a small stand of trees approx. 200' away; it never reappeared on the other side of the trees (probably because its rate of descent would have placed it near ground level and I do not have an unobstructed view of the ground from where I was positioned).
No lights or exhaust plume were visible, and no sounds were audible (even taking into account the many seconds of delay there would have been between the object's first appearance and its subsequent disappearance).

I was pulling up to a stoplight and the light was turning red.  If I wasn't looking up at the traffic light I would have missed this.  It was lit up and moving low and fast.  Maybe 200-300 ft up (or less) and at a slight angle downward.  
I thought it was a helicopter at first, but by the time my brain told me so this thing was gone out of sight.
I thought I might have imagined it until I got the the stop light line and another car with two people inside it were rolling down their window, pale and looking a bit freaked out, asking "did you SEE that?".

summary: Red and green lights flashing, moving slowly in circle.
description:
I saw a bright white light from bedroom window, then few minutes later saw an object with two red lights flashing then one red ans one green flashing, swaying in circle right above the condo community.  
Then flew right over my condo patio deck with two red lights.  
First time I ever see anything strange.

summary: Organized fireballs over Belmont, NH.  Coordinated with separate occurrence also visible.
description:
Driving home my friend and I noticed a bright orange light entering the horizon from our right.  We immediately asked each other what it was noticing it was moving very slow, wasn't blinking and seemed to burn orange with no tail or sound.
The light drifted a visual distance of a foot to a foot and a half before it appeared to drift in our direction.  We would later comment that it seemed to notice our headlights and swerved in to investigate.  I put my car in park as the second light entered from the same direction.
The second light passed with seemingly more resolve.  It was larger and passed by much the same way. The first light had seemed to pick its spot in the sky to diminish in brightness.  Light number two seemed to decide on turning in our direction more aggressively at this point I felt nervous and turned off my headlights.
Upon turning off my headlights, the second light went the same as the first.  This one persisted as the third enter from the right.
My co-witness captured crude photos on his cell phone as well as a short video capturing their pass.
The third light, more consistent in brightness did not seem to notice us as it passed by and went the way of the…

summary: Fiery blast of light near Delaware Bay Villas, NJ
description:
A bright red flash out our bedroom Windows.   High over trees.  No object seen or heard. 
Appeared like trees were on fire. Lasted approx 10 seconds and vanished.
We have amended the time and date above.  PD

summary: saw bluish green light going north to south and hooked to the opposite direction and then dipped below skyline what looked to be Indian Rocks Beach.
7/26/14 Cheyenne, WY 11:10pm--Saw 5 lights in the saw in a triangular shape chasing a meteorite with a pinkish hue.
description:
I went outside of my apartment complex for a cigarette with my two good friends.  We stood out facing south-southeast.  
I looked up first and saw a meteorite with a pinkish hue streaking fairly long across the night sky in a south-eastern direction.  
I mentioned this to my friends as they had not seen this event, but roughly 30 seconds later, all three of us saw what looked like a triangular shape of 5 lights in the sky follow the trial of the meteorite that I had seen earlier.  It appeared out of nowhere and slowly followed the path until banking away (rolling, tilting leftwards away from our view) and eventually fading into the black of night.  As if it were following the meteorite curiously.

summary: Glowing red sphere traveling across night sky.
description:
I watched a red sphere travel across the night sky; a solid glowing red object going from north to south. 
The object then faded and abruptly disappeared. 
The object was traveling smoothly across the sky.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: The object rose above Lake Michigan 80-100ft and moved in every direction sporadically.
description:
It looked like a white light that apparently turned to reveal green-blue and red lights.  
We observed these lights two streets from the lake. 
It moved smoothly and silently, disappearing behind trees to the south.

summary: Helicopters investigate red lights hovering over everett, and snohomish WA
description:
Standing on my front porch, looking east a formation of red lights, three of them, formed a line over as though they were moving together.  
It was the shape of a saucer and it hovered and blinked as more red lights showed up in the sky just a short distance away. 
As we were watching multiple white lights in triangle formation popped up out of nowhere.  
They hovered as the sounds of thunder echoed through the sky yet there were no clouds no lightening, the booming sounds continued for ten minutes consecutively every 30 seconds.  
There were no flashes in the sky until the sounds were done then randomly they started to light up the sky.  
As the sounds stopped the lights continued to flash in a pattern and we could hear helicopters and see their flashing lights as they seemed to investigate the red lights.  
After all this in the dense wooded area one of the red lights landed on the ground and pulsated for some time until disappearing.

summary: Two sets of two dull white lights in each moving quite slowly; north from Lake Ontario and east through Port Hope towards Cobourg.
description:
Last night at approximately 11:15 pm, my friend and I were walking eastbound on Lakeshore Rd. in Port Hope, Ontario, when we both seen two soft white lights that were horizontal to each other moving north from over Lake Ontario.  
They seemed to only be a km away when we first seen them, and the lower elevated light aligned completely horizontal under the other one, as the two of them began to travel east about 700-800 ft in the sky. 
All throughout this time we had the opinion that this was one object, until two other lights began to follow the same path as the first two; operating in the same manner.
All four lights traveled quite slowly, about the speed of a slow plane; however, once the second set of lights turned east, the first set traveled quite a bit quicker.  That was when we were certain that these were four different objects, because the upper light of the second set sped up as if it was attempting to keep up with the first set, and the lower light remained traveling at the same speed.
After about eight to nine minutes of activity, the first two lights quickly disappeared, with the third light doing the same shortly after.  
Eventually, the fourth light was out of sight…

summary: Three bright orange orbs traveling east out of town.
description:
My daughter and I were taking our nightly walk and when coming down a hill three orange orbs came from behind the hill in front of us.  
We were looking south and they were traveling east.  
They were first traveling very close to one another. One took off south another east and the last just seemed to disappear. 
I got to pictures not very good though.  This is the 5 the time in two year we and other witnesses have seen them over Slatington, PA.
They were very bright orange.  
Very cool to see.

summary: Saw three bright glowing orange orbs, moving slowing west to southwest and then slowly dim out.
Orange lights in the sky.
description: Orange circular lights moving east across the sky.

summary: Huge rectangular light..Shape unknown
description: I was observing stars when I noticed two red lights parallel to each other, I pointed it out to two friends and a huge light came on rectangular in shape. The outside shape of the object could not be made out due to the dark night sky. The light seemed to have something moveing inside of it to the left side of the light.  A huge red light came on just left of center inside of the cf the craft. I was amazed to say the least, so was my friends. The light stayed on for several minutes then just went out.  There was several red lights on the object that weren't extremely bright like an aircraft would have and had only red lights no other colors. The object moved off to the left, our viewpoint was going to be blocked by a mountain so we ran towards it to get a longer look at the object. It was at that time we thought we may have saw more than one but with our excitement and hearts pounding it was hard to tell if it was just my nerves or shakeing causeing me to think stars were moveing. At that time the object moved overhead of us and appeared low in altitude.  It had several red lights and two on the rear were blinking.  It made no sound and for an object to be so low I didn't…

summary: Three amber dots chased by two other lights in western sky over Bakersfield.
description:
Watched three amber dots being chased by one craft followed by a second one.  The three amber dots were in a triangle shape and moved across the western sky headed to the south. 
The three amber dots were in a triangle shape and pulsating. 
As the dots moved south one dot broke off and sped away at a remarkable speed. 
They eventually left our sight as they disappeared behind a building.
We suspect that this may not be a serious-minded report.  Contact information for witness is bogus.  PD

summary: Several bright, round, silent, large objects going across the sky in formation, then disappearing.
description:
My next door neighbor and myself were outside talking, as we often do.  I myself am outside nightly observing the sky.  I have seen hundreds of shooting stars, the ISS, drones, satellites, etc.  
All of a sudden I looked up, and saw a formation of several large, round, bright lights moving across the sky.  They were completely silent.  I was yelling to my friend "do you see that"?  We both just stood and stared.  
Some were in a line, some in a triangular shape, followed by more in a line.  Looking up they went along much faster than any aircraft we had ever seen, and then just disappeared one by one. 
About a minute after they were gone, three more came across, one by one, followed the same path as the others, and disappeared as well.  They remained completely silent.  
They were about 1/2 the size of a full moon, but much more brilliant.  
I myself have also seen, 3 times in my life, UFO's. This was nothing like any of them. What did we see?

summary: String of white twinkling Christmas lights.
description:
At 10:03 p.m. myself, a former law enforcement agent, and my boyfriend, a high school teacher, observed a string of lights in the sky from the Assembly Point peninsula.  The lights looked like a string of white Christmas lights that were twinkling brightly and then dimmed while gaining more distance upward.  They seemed close at first, and we thought they were remnants of fireworks we heard earlier, but they continued traveling and dimming with distance.  
I tried to get my telescope to focus in on them, but couldn't in time.  
The sighting lasted between 7-10 minutes.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Fireballs circling over Mactaquac Provincial Park, near Fredericton, NB.
description:
Sitting by a campfire, we witnessed a fireball flying above - we were star gazing when this huge round fireball flew by on a circular path, 5 minutes later it flew by again, OR it could have been another fireball on the exact same path above, yet another 10 mins later it flew by again on the exact same path.  
We didn't have full view as trees blocked us so we couldnt see if it was doing a circle above or if there were 3 different fireballs flying on this path.
It was far bigger than an airplane as a plane flew below it at one point at the same time and had clearly different lights and shape.
it really looked like a flying fireball. but no trail, no flames following just a glowing red circle with yellow inside. Never seen anything like it!

summary: 2 amber bright lights flying over 1 after the other
description:
Saw 1 bright amber light east of us heading north/north east.  It got bright then slowly dimmed out as it started crossing out of view range.  
Did not blink or anything just steady light except for slowly dimming as it went. about 30 sec. after first light passed a second one exactly the same on same path went by until it also dimmed out as it neared the horizon out of viewing range.  
Looked to be very high up and to the east of us.  
Closest similarity in my experience is too seeing missiles flying over around the time they reach a certain altitude and level off etc.

summary: Six orange orbs in the sky near Oceanside.
description:
On 7-26-14, my son and I were coming home from an outing.  It was around 10:00 PM.  
As we were coming down our road  we noticed in the sky 4 orange colored floating orbs  grouped in twos.  They were fairly close to each other.  They looked as though they were barely moving. They were not at all like airplanes.  There were no flashing lights.  It was almost as if they were drifting very slowly in the sky. 
Within a few minutes we noticed two more of them come up on the right side like they were trying to catch up.  
After they were all together they started to fade out one by one until they all disappeared.
These orbs were seen out above the ocean near Oceanside. 
I would say the sky was somewhat cloudy but the orbs were very visible .
It was something we had never seen before so we had to pull off to the side of the road so we could take it all in.  
We wondered if anyone else had witnessed this as well.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Orange orb hovering below the clouds.
description:
Saw a single orange orb hovering under the cloud ceiling for a few minutes as a storm was approaching.  
Object was seen while traveling north on US Highway 27 in Chippewa County near Holcombe, WI.  
Position of the object was in the line with the road.

summary: Eight objects seen in the sky and dog barking at everyone he saw too.
description:
Three of them in triangle formation and the other five came out one at a time and one went straight up and others flew north.  
They came up over the tree line down the road and the three flew sideways and then went north and the other four flew sideways and went up and down fast then headed north.  
They came out a couple minutes apart except the first three all together.  
My dog also barked every time I saw them.  
The lights were a reddish orange color.  
No noise and no blinking lights.

summary: Red steadily glowing sphere in NE sky moving SE not an airplane.
description:
Red glowing sphere visible from Northport harbor in NE sky, moved steadily to the east and disappeared. Not an airplane.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Red orange flickering ball across cruising the sky in Scotchtown (Middletown), NY
description:
Driving home from dinner my wife and I saw a red orange ball moving horizontally across the sky.  It was a little smaller than the moon and my original thought was it was like a flickering candle flame shaped like a ball.  
I was driving so I kept my eyes on the road while glancing at the thing in the sky.  When we reached our driveway we got out and watch it recede -- still in a straight line -- while another plane taking off from Stewart Airport (in nearby Newburgh) was flying the opposite direction at a slight angle.  When the thing became small in the distance (still bigger than a point-like star) it just turned off.  
We waited a bit to see if it would come on again but it didn't.

summary: Two yellowish-orange lights flying in the sky and then vanished.
description:
My girlfriend and I were driving down Maple Ave. Middletown, RI, towards West Main Road, when I pointed out two yellowish-orange lights in the sky.  As we continued to drive, we were able to keep up with the objects.  
We observed the two lights zigzag, and eventually crossed one another.  
As we continued to drive now on East Main Road, the two objects flew parallel, one trailing slightly behind.  
Then, we got stuck at a red light at the corner of Shell gas station, the objects flew farther away and out of nowhere disappeared.  
We continued driving on East Main Rd. to see any signs of them, but saw nothing but sky.

summary: Strange fire-like ball of lights in the skies of Pomona, California.
description:
Bright lught like fire burning object spinning and emitting light upwards no sound moving at a fast pace too low to be an airplane and it wasnt a helicopter for sure.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: V-shaped craft stationary in pearson airport flight path
description:
I am writing this on behalf of my mother who witnessed and photographed the V-shaped craft.  It was sitting stationary for over an hour, the crazy thing being it was directly in the Eastern flight path of YYZ Pearson airport!  She said planes were going right and left to dodge the stationary craft.  
Neighbor phoned the police, they said "what can we do about it."   
I'll email both pictures, one from daytime and one from night.  
As the sun went down the craft lit up and mom said it was flashing.  She went back to look a while after taking 2nd pic and it was gone.

summary: Zoom, zoom back and forth in the sky very quickly, then hovered, before disappearing

The whole thing larded about 2 minutes

Observed through sun-roof while driving on Sunrise hwy Saturday night.

It was moving then the first craft also began moing both swooping in our direction wings came out we for a moment thought they were birds then lights came on the wings they then swooped back up the second craft disappeared but now it is back they are far  apart from each other not moving but lights seem to be going around the craft we have been observing this for almost 2 hours.  unfortunately we do not have binoculars they are to the south

summary: Two red lights moving at constant speed one following the other 2 people viewed
description:
2 red lights moving at slow speed over lake.  
Both on same direction from north to south, and then both turned to the East at the same time and slowly disappeared to the East.

summary: UFO was performing some sort of ground operation
description:
Noticed a black dot in the sky that was in the flight path of airlines.  the object was stationary for approx. 45 min.  I reported the sighting to the police because of the proximity to the flightpath.  
About 1 hour of observing the object it was approached from a light from the north west,  The light went right up to the object and then they both moved to the east at a high rate of speed.  they both returned and they were separated from each other with one object to the north and the other (lit one) to the morth east.  The black object left travelling north and the lit object remained flashing strange patterns of light (red, green and white) for approx. 1 hr  
At one point there were lights that appeared to come from the ground flashing and pointing straight at the lit object.  It appeared that it was sending out light pulses to the ground.  
The police came to my house and witnessed the light and filed a report.  The lit object left at approx. 10 pm.  I did not witnes! s the object leave because I was with the police
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Four equidistant white lights forming a diamond shape from the rear of what appeared to be a silver-gray cylinder.
description:
On July 26th, at approximately 4pm DST, my son and I observed four equidistant white lights forming a diamond shape.  These emanated from the rear of what appeared to be a silver-gray cylinder.  The object flew south to north, in an apparent straight line just west of the beach at Rehoboth Beach DE.  It traveled a minimum of 2 lateral miles in the 2-3 seconds we observed it, before disappearing into the clouds.
The object was gaining altitude as well but, we were unable to determine at what altitude we first observed it or what the change in altitude may have been.
The lights did not appear to be reflections of the sun as, they were a steady bright white for the entire time we observed them, the object was between our position and the sun and the object was observed below the sun on the horizon.
We heard no noise and saw nothing that would have identified this as a conventional  aircraft EG: wings, port or starboard lights, white strobe light.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Flock of lights moving in the sky
description: Was leaving friends house when we saw a flock of lights moving upward in the sky.  We chased them until they dissapeared while flickering into the sky.

summary: Round, long, cylinder.  White, non-metallic.  Hovering no sound.  Moves away slowly off into the distance.  Object made no trails.
description: Object white PVC shaped round long.  Remained stationary for a minute.  Made absolutely no sound.  Object begin to look smaller heading towards Fargo.

summary: Single moving lights in the night skies south of Santa Rosa, New Mexico
description:
I was stopped on a north bound entrance ramp to highway 84 south of Santa Rosa, NM.  I am not sure about the exit number.  I stopped to take a break and short nap at approximately 03:00. 
I woke around 04:00 and noticed what I thought was a shooting star.  I was amazed at how clear and bright the stars were and especially how apparent the Milky Way was, because of the ultra low amounts of ambient city light.
As I looked up in the general area of the shooting star, toward the west, I noticed what I thought was an airplane or satellite moving across the sky, but it was not strobing or flashing and appeared to be a solid white color.  It stopped all of a sudden and then moved for a short distance in a different direction.  
The light disappeared and then I noticed a few others near the same spot in the sky moving short distances in different directions.  
The duration of these moving lights only lasted for 15-30 seconds and I didn't see any after.

summary: I was getting out of bed in the second story room of our home and I looked out my window and saw 3 bright white lights in the sky in a triangle formation.
description:
I thought it was a plane but it stopped in the sky for a few seconds and continued to move again.  
It moved rather quickly and disappeared eventually.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: unknow object seen flying in the sky at great speed.
description:
Yellow, white and gray object seen over long island Farmingdale western skys seen from Whyndanch area.  At around 3:15 am 7-26-2014,  
I came outside to put some bags in my car and looked up at the sky, I notice a round object at stand still for 2 seconds then moved fron southwest to northwest at lighting speed.  This object I believed was a flying saucer,  
It moved so fast with a tail and just disappeared.  
This object was in the same path the planes take coming from the south to line up with JFK and LGA in the sky.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: White light moving at extremely high speed and left a streak for a brief time of only seconds.
description:
A low object emitting white light was spotted flying over my house last night in Staten Island NY at extremely high speed.  It occurred after I heard a strange noise coming from my driveway.  
As soon as i was done investigating the sound i turned around and that is when I saw the white light.  
It had to be under 1500 feet because the clouds were low last night and it was visibly flying below the clouds.

summary: Around 3:00 AM, a purple light shot across the sky in a wave-like manner.  It went across, peaked, lulled, across again and then vanished.  From point A to B looking like; ____/\____.
description:
The house where I was is mostly surrounded by woodland with a house every half mile or so.  No houses are visible in the direction that the light was seen.  
As it was very late, no other houses in the area had lights on (indoor or outdoor).

summary: Me and a long time fire were walking out to his car and I saw this amber light an brought it to me buddies attention.
description:
He thought it was a plane but he watched it vanished after I ran to get a pair of binoculars.  When I came back it was gone.  
So we watched again.  And another one came across the sky.  This time I got the binoculars up on time to see it.  
It was an egged shaped object.  I saw it for about two seconds, long enough to indentify it as that shape. 
I tried to get my friend over to see it in the binoculars, but by time he made it over, it had flickered out.  
We both sat there for about 10 minutes, waiting on it to come back, but it never did.  
I know for a fact what I saw wasn't a plane or helicopter of any thing I've ever seen. I'm not sure what else to say but I'm still in shock.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information.  PD

summary: Fireball changing speed and direction witnessed by two near Sumner, IA. Second sighting at this location
description:
Upon walking out of a house to get to my car, I looked at the stars and noticed movement. Around 500 yds from ground and over a mile away was a red-orange fireball moving North, then SW and stopped.
I asked a friend to look for anything odd in the sky, and the witness immediately noticed, stating this was the second time he saw a fireball at this location within a month.  Using hunting binoculars, I was able to steady the view to confirm that the fireball was moving quickly once again.  I did this by focusing the binoculars on a star, then witnessing the red light cross the star and continue going.
Witness and I watched the light change course, from going N/NE to slowing, then heading W for a short distance before regaining course N, until the fireball was behind the treeline. 
Calm and clear night in a rural area, the object didn't make any noise.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Large brilliant light with no sound and disappeared
description:
After doing late night chores and coming back up to the house, we noticed a brilliant ball of light about the size of a helicopter going across the tops of our woods.  
This light was heading north along SR 61.  There was no sound or flashing lights from it.  
It progressed out across the field then shot up into a cloud and disappeared. 
The dogs noticed, as they were barking as it was coming down across the tree tops.  
Could not see anything other than the blinding white light that was produced.

summary: Bright orange light changes direction abruptly.
description:
My family and a couple of friends where enjoying a fire in the back yard.  (6 witnesses) At approx 12:00 my nephew pointed high in the east sky and asked what is that.  We all looked.
It was a very bright orange light moving very similar to a satellite, but unusually bright, About 5 times brighter than the ISS.
About 20 seconds of watching it go west, at approx imately directly overhead, it changed its heading to 90 degrees and moved south, without slowing down.
Moving south after about 15 seconds it started to dim and finally faded completely out about 20 degrees above our tree line, also very similar to a satellite.
If it wasn’t for the 90 degree turn, I would have thought it was the ISS with just the right angle.
I’ve witnessed and identified ISS over 100 times since the early 2000’s.  This was way too bright.

summary: I was looking up at mars and saw a single light moving left to right and up and  shot up.
bright light in eastern nd sky
description:
I went out to have a smoke at 11:00 pm.  Looking up at the stars i noticed one bright light that I thought was a plane.  It was a bright white light with no flashing lights.  It seemed to turn, and as it did, it turned into three bright lights for a few moments and disappeared.  
I watched for it to reappear and it never did

summary: Lights hovering in the sky for extended period of time in NE Wisconsin.
description:
I saw this object late Friday night in the sky.  I watched it for about an hour.  I have not seen it since.  
It was facing west over North East Wisconsin.  I took these pictures on a Sony A-100 with a 4.5-5.6/75-300 lens with a long exposure.  It appeared to be slanting toward the left and hovered over the same area.  There were no noises and it was higher than a plane with blinking lights.  There are no radio towers or tall buildings in this direction.  It's a rural area.

2 dot like an aircraft were moving slowly and crossing each other at extremely fast rate of speed and then disappeared.
