summary: 3 rust colored lights dog fighting with a possible commercial airliner
description:
At about 9:45 p.m., I went out front of my house to have a cigarette.  I looked north towards my neighbor's house and noticed bright orange-rust colored lights, possibly over Corona, California.  
I wear glasses to correct my vision so I took off my glasses to make sure it wasn't an optical illusion on my lenses.  The lights were still there.  
I put my glasses back on and watched as 3 orange lights danced around what looked like a commercial airliner.  I could tell it was an airliner because of the red and white strobe lights and the slow movement of the craft. 
They looked almost like they were dog-fighting with the airliner.  They were pulling some weird maneuvers around this airliner--for instance, going very very fast and then suddenly stopping near the airliner, then moving very fast past the airliner, then stopping suddenly again and repeating the process.  
The airliner looked like it made some course corrections, as if it was affected by the lights. 
Then one of the rust-colored lights became more dim, and then dissipated, like it just dissolved into nothing.  
The 2 remaining lights danced around as the airliner kept its original course heading approximately south-south…

summary: Hi Altitude above normal ISS path traveling 2 times ISS speed makes two course corrections!
description:
Object appeared to be at a higher altitude that what we would expect for the International Space Station.  I check and the ISS is over Afganastan at this time.  
Object appeared as a satellite in orbital path heading north by northwest slightly.  
I took it as a possible satellite until 2 minutes into my observation, the object made a course correction about 15 degrees to the right as if to miss something.  
About 15 seconds later the object corrected again, this time about 25 degrees to the left.  
Object was NOT a Satellite.  Very High and traveling at a speed about twice the speed of what the ISS is normally observed at.  
That is All.

summary: Bright red spherical object with a rectangular center appearing like fire
description:
My property is located in the middle of a cul-de-sac which backs up to a large wooded area.  My wife and I were sitting outside when a light drew my attention to the northeast, facing two trees on my property and the beginning of our neighbor's backyard.  First instinctual thought was that a plane was about to pass, but we had not, as of yet, heard any indactive sounds.  As the light began to clear the obstruction of the trees, details became visible and our full attention was drawn to the object, which continued on in a southwestern direction without making any sound.
The object was a red spherical object filled with a central rectangular section of what appeared to be orange fire.  The object was either relatively large or relatively low in altitude, and was bright enough to have drawn our attention before actually becomming visible.  The object roughly appeared to be the size of a full moon in the sky.  We continued observing it with an unobstructed view as it passed almost directly over our property before beginning to take a turn more distinctly toward the west-northwest which began to put it over the large wooded area our property borders.  The object was not fast moving but…

summary: My husband and I were driving home when we saw a really bright LED light in the sky.
description:
At first I thought it might be an airplane but when we drove more down the road you could see the LED light was beaming down through some haze.
When I looked up the UFO was in the shape of a line and it had 3 lights coming from it in total, as we drove more down the road I noticed it also had a blinking red light. 
We could not tell what color the UFO was.

summary: Strange orange light lbject flying overhead.
description:
On Friday, July 25, 2014, at 1020 pm local time (Central time zone), in Minnesota,  I was walking home with my digital camera.  I was shooting wildlife pictures earlier when there was light, but when it got to dark, I just put the lens cap on and turn off the camera.  I then went for a 4 mile walk.  
About a block from my house, I looked up in the pitch black sky and saw a strange orange light – sort of like an “orange moon” color when the moon is low on the horizon.  This was just a very small sliver of orange light, so I was thinking it must be a slice of the moon low on the horizon. 
As I watched this light, it was approaching me, and now it looked like an object that was on fire flying though the air.  I was thinking this was an airplane on fire and would be falling to the ground.  
This orange light was bright, it looked like a campfire type of orange – like it was on fire.  I suddenly realized I had my camera with me and by the time I got the lens cap off, camera, turn on the object was directly overhead.  I had the camera in full auto mode, so my first shots the flash was on and the auto-focus could not operate properly due to low light – the shutter stayed open because it…

summary: Saw an object hovering over the interstate right outside of Grand Forks at night.  It had a lot of blinking lights.
description:
Saw a circle shape craft hovering over the interstate.  There were a lot of blinking lights on the object.  We saw this object just right outside of Grand Forks.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Four bright red lights in the sky, shaped like a box standing still, then took off at high speeds.
description:
I looked out bay window and saw 4 bright red lights out just above the trees.  The strange thing was they were in the shape of a box and not blinking as they should on a plane or tower and they were standing still. 
As I went for my camera, my wife went out on the deck and she said, "They are not making any noise."
As I got back and snapped a photo, the object in the lower left hand side had started moving to the north, then each followed, perfectly spaced, until they disappeared behind the trees. 
I went out my front door and went two houses down to the corner where I was them come out from behind the trees, stop for 5 second each than take off to the north climbing steeply and were not visible in 8-10 seconds.  
My wife came down and said two more came in behind the first four.  We watched all 6 do the same exact stop in the sky for 5 seconds than off they went.  
I took 3 photos but only one turned out because of the street light and flash.

summary: Very bright white disc moving across the sky in a very populated suburban town
description:
Both of my parents, who are Russian immigrants, saw it while they were talking in the backyard.  My mother has never seen a UFO in her life.  She asked my father what it was.  
Apparently, he hesitated when he saw it, then proceeded to run back into the house yelling for me.  I thought there was a medical emergency because he has never yelled like that before.  
He ran up the stairs and ran to the room across from mine.  We both looked out the eastern window and I was in shock.   
In the distance was what looked like a rotating disc with lights around the circumference.  It was moving fairly quickly, maybe 100 feet per second.  
The whole object was lit up and was clearly visible since it was the brightest object in the sky.  All it did was move south.  
I live in a suburb and the object appeared to be above the local golf course.  From my location, I estimated that it was about half a mile away because the object was briefly obscured by the trees on a hill on the golf course.  I can't imagine it being any farther than that because that would mean the object would have to be unimaginably huge.  
I never believed in any UFO sightings because I always thought people photoshopped…

summary: Cloud level greenish white shooting star like something just baffled me.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Orange light that moves slow.
description:
First witness was in a back room of their home and states that they did notice the orange light but thought nothing of it due to frequent helicopter travel above the home.  
First witness then noticed the light had not moved, cats outside froze as they looked up at the light and then ran off when it moved.  
The light then proceeded to slowly and steadily move upwards and towards the house.  
The frst witness began to record the light and then realized the orange light was going descending toward the house.  
Frst witness ran outside to attempt to record but became frightened when they realized the orange light made no sound.  
They then procced to rally two other witnesses and follow the light above the front of the house when it descended up into the sky and disappeared.  
Witnesses say it seemed like an object but the orange lights over came the object.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: it was oval different tapes of blue and redish pink very big moved slowly than disappeared.
description: We have requested a more detailed report, and a report from the second witness.  PD

summary: Triangle with white  lights on the sand fire in  northern ca
description:
My wife and I were watching the glow of flames from the sand fire.  We live at 1300 feet in South Auburn. 
While watching the glow from the fire, we witnessed a Constellation in the form of a triangle, hovering just to the north of the main fire.  
After observing it for a short period of time, the lights one by one disappeared.
We checked the sky 2 nights in at the same time.  No triangles appeared; skies were clear

summary: I saw a blue light above my house. It then darted off.
description: Too low to be a plane and it wasn't a shooting star.

summary: Object moving at speeds 5 to 6 times faster than satellite.
description: Sitting on back deck looking at the stars and saw an object which was coming out of the west at an extremely high rate of speed.  There was no noise or trail and the object vanished off the horizon within 5 to 6 seconds.  We were looking for satellites, and saw several, one prior to the event and two after the event.  This object was traveling at 4 to 5 times the speed of a satellite.

summary: Standing outside restaurant, one person said, "What is that?"
description:
Look up and saw an upside down L shape in 5 to 7 orange lights.  The lights were moving in perfect unison and there was the exact distance from each light as it moved.  
The lights slowly faded away one by one but it was followed by a singular light of the same color a small distance behind the upside down L.

summary: Unidentified object in distance during an electrical storm in Clarksville, TN.
description:
While photographing an evening lightning storm, I captured an image of a craft that I cannot explain.  At the time, I did not know the craft was present in the distance, it was not discovered until the following day while I was looking at and editing my pictures for content and color.
Initially, I thought that I had captured an extremely bright star, but as I zoomed in on the object, it appeared to be below the thunder/lightning and clouds.  It seemed to stay stationary and or keep pace with the clouds.
Yes, the picture do appear to be edited, only to the point of adjusting some colors in order to bring out the object in as much detail as I possibly can.  The originals are still intact and unedited, but they are harder to see and make out the object in question.

summary: Orange glowing light hovering in sky.
description: On my boat on our way out to see the fireworks over weirs beach. There was an orange glowing cigar shaped light in the sky stationary it stayed there for about 15 minutes looked like it may have been hovering over Gilford, NH.

summary: Large circle object looked like sun but moved quickly.  Bright orange yellow and coral colors
description:
Large sun looking object bright orange yellow coral colors.  Looked like sun in sky, as drove closer it floated backward through neighborhoods over trees, tried following it down the streets but it was too high and fast In sky to keep up with it.
We wonder whether the sighting occurred in the morning, as indicated above, or at night.  Witness provides no contact information, so we are unable to confirm the time shown above is correct.  PD

summary: Green light moving to the north very fast, west of Scott State Lake.
description:
Friday, July 25, 2014, at 5:00am, a light green light was moving very fast straight north. 
 It was very high in the sky just west of the Scott State Lake.

summary: Three Triangular Glowing Craft.
description:
Three triangular craft glowing reddish/orange flying in a triangular formation across Rte. 6.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Looked like a star, but then flew a bit and disappeared out of sight.
description:
We watched as it looked like a star, but suddenly, out of nowhere it flew about a foot (if measured with a shoe looking in the sky) and disappeared.  
We thought a shooting star, but it was not at all a shooting star as it did not clear over the horizon.

summary: 4 Red lights in shape of a square float over avalon
description:
We were sitting on the beach and we saw four red lights in the sky, in the shape of a square, fly over us very slowly, it was not a plane or helicopter because no likes were flashing.  
Coincidentally I spotted two shooting stars go by about 20 minutes before this.  
We eventually looked away and it disappeared.  It wasn't traveling in a straight line, it was sort of wobbling a little bit as it if was being affected by wind.
Witness provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Red and white pulsating lights hovering over Sykesville, MD
description:
I went to let my dog out when something in the western sky caught my attention.  I am an avid star gazer and to my astonishment there was an inordinately bright set of flashing lights in an area of the night sky where no star or planet should be.  
This in itself may not seem that strange as aircraft fly over this area very frequently, however this did not act like any aircraft I have ever seen.  For starters the object was silent and remained in the same place while a series of multi-colored lights flashed it what appeared to be a pattern.  The lights themselves would flash off and on in a series of revolutions around a singular red beam, the white lights would flash in a circular motion around the constant red light.  
The object just remained in place until about 1:20am, it was at that time another object, most likely a plane judging by its sound and speed had moved relatively close to the object in question.  
It was here when things got even crazier. The object projected a huge orb of light around it and it flashed as bright as the sun and vanished.  The other object flying towards it made a quick turn to the south and continued flying a normal course as if it were heading…

summary: Hovering object with 4 lights that took off once we got a good look, and then it was gone within seconds!
description:
I saw two lights in the sky that I first thought were stars and then as we drove closer I saw that the lights were part of an object.  The object didn't seem to be moving.  It seemed to hovering over this one spot.  
Then as soon as we got to the place it was hovering over it started to move.  It just so happened to be moving the same direction that were headed and were able to get a better look at it.  It looked like it had a diamond shape to it and it had 4 lights.  
It was lower to the ground than a plane would be which is another reason why it caught my friend's and my attention.  
Once we reached our destination and we were able to really look at it, it just took off and within seconds it was nowhere to be seen!

summary: Flying blue sphere off JFK airport.
description:
Unknown object flying near by JFK airport.  Approx 2 miles from the airport.  
The object glowed a blue color for about 2 minutes then vanished.  
It looks like it was flying north east.

summary: During an evening outdoor event at a retreat center in the mountains, on of 14 witnesses drew out attention to a couple of bright lights off to the south west of where we were standing in a field.…
description:
Suddenly, we saw a search light emit from the overhead light source and it appeared to be sweeping down on the tree tops.  As the two lights got closer we could see they were actually 4 bright lights and a central less dim light blinking on and off.  At this point we could make out a dark shadowy shape connecting the outer four lights, two on either end.  
This craft was making no audible noise (a windless night) and approaching almost in our path heading south east.  I estimate the craft to be at about 1500 feet above us.  
As it was almost directly overhead, we could make out a faint  constant engine noise.  
It was a cloudless night and the dark craft appeared to have no standard aircraft body, but appe! ar to be sort of winged shaped.  I estimate the length from one to end to the other be about 200-300 feet.  Its speed was similar to the speed and approach of an airline jet approaching an airport, however there is no close airports.  There were no red or green navigation lights visible.  The craft continued on its straight path until leaving our view over a nearby mountain.

summary: Facing east on sandy beach.  Three bright lights flying in triangle formation drifted across the sky above the damn flying south to north.
description:
The Objects then took up speed & disappeared into the night sky, followed by four more that were in no particular pattern.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Huge rectanguler white light then red circle appeared inside it, moved slowly and made no sound, was low in altitude.
description: I saw two red orbs the same size as stars.  I was puzzled to why the stars was red and not white, or if a planet orange looking.  I pointed it out to my two friends and instantly a huge rectangular light came on low in altitude, not moveing, and made now sound.  We whatched the light and inside something was moveing, causeing shadows to move.  Being I have always been religious, I thought it was God.  We whatched the light for a couple of minutes and then a red light appeared inside the rectangle, just left of center.  It stayed for a minute or so, then the light went out completely.  Exactly were the light was there was a craft of some type. It only had red lights and they were dim.  It began to slowly move off to our left. It went out of sight to our vantage point so we ran to were we could possibly see it longer.  We saw it again and it had changed its direction and was moveing back to what had been right hand side.  It moved almost directly over top of us and we could see the bottom of the craft which had I think I recollect counting nine dimly lit red lights with the two on the very end blinking alternately.  It still had made no sound.  I need to add that it was a very dark…

summary: Three bright balls appeared in the sky in front of two witnesses.
description:
Observed stationary light of varying colors, orange, red which slowly became smaller until it couldn't be seen.  
At that time another yellow ball of indistinct shape became visible moving north.  It became ball shaped changing colors, red, yellow, orange.  It slowly over a period of a minute or so became smaller until it also was lost in the sky.  
At that time another ball appeared and repeated the same thing.  It did not appear as a sky lantern as I have observed them before.

summary: No sound.  Bright red balls, slow speed.
description:
Fly toward Grand Glaze pool, below Grand Glaze Bridge west to east +-.
One followed by a second (20 sec later) then turn south and elevate for 2 minutes maybe 2000 feet and disappear.
Three followed by a four (20 sec later) then turn south and elevate for 2 minutes maybe 2000 feet and disappear.
Five followed by a six (20 sec later) then turn south and elevate for 2 minutes maybe 2000 feet and disappear.
The next 3 were more random but same flight path.
The last flew directly towards the pool and was bigger but seem to drop some red flair type material

summary: 6 silent black objects moving in formation.
description: 6 black objects, rising slowly, moving rapidly from west to east, very close.  First one by itself, next three in formation, last two apart from the main group.  All following the same trajectory.  No sound at all.  Flying against the wind as altitude increased.  Watched until they disappeared into the clouds.

summary: Orange oval-shaped object, with orange droplets, seen over Myrtle Beach.
description:
Around 20:00 hrs., an orange oval appeared in the sky.  It almost appeared to be a star, but was much to bright.  
After not moving for a few minutes it looked as if droplets were dripping from the craft.  These droplets were the same color as the craft.  
It remained stationary for about 5 minutes before slowly fading away.
I'm usually very skeptical of UFO sightings, but this was something I couldn't explain.  My sister was also outside with me and saw the same thing.  
I was lucky enough to get a video of it, sadly my phone doesn't have the best quality, but never less I feel lucky to have a video regardless of the quality.
After searching on the internet I was easily able to find similar stories containing UFOs that are explained exactly as I just did, even down to the droplets I saw.

summary: Cuenca/Cahas, Ecuador lights
description:
Sitting west of Cuenca, 40 miles away over Cahas National Park mountains @ 14,000 ft.
Red & White lights, 2 large + 13+ small following, moving erraticly from north to south.
Lost site w/ night cloud cover moving in from the east.
This is direction of airliners approach to Cuencia airport, these planes are large and fly low over house from where we viewed this sitting.
We live @ this location 2 1/2 years. 
This is our 1st sighting in Cuenca.

summary: A silver light traveled south and vanished against the sunset.
description:
I looked up at an airplane flying overhead and closer to the horizon, a light caught my eye. The light was in the western sky, moving southward in a straight and slightly downward trajectory, much faster than the airplane above.   
It was silver and apparently very bright, for it stood out well against the orange and red sunset.  The light was also apparently below the clouds, since as it passed by them, it was not covered up.  
As it moved, the light faded transparent, not dimmed, and disappeared. 
There was no sound.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: An unidententifiable vehicle at significant speed.
description:
A red, football shaped craft, entered my view in the southeastern sky, proceeded at high speed, as well as i can estimate according to estimated altitude, and crossed the sky to exit my view in the west.  
In my life, I have never seen anything like this craft.  I am 62.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Loud hovering sound...couldn't see anything in the sky
description:
Loud hovering sound like a huge aircraft above house..  But I did not see any craft at all... 
Second night in a row…

summary: Bright blue object explodes.
description: As me and my buddies drove up main st. to work we noticed a bright blue object falling at a rapid speed.  The light increased and I noticed a smoke trail behind it.  The object seemed to be burning.  I had my window rolled down and it flashed and made a very loud boom.  Not sure what exactly this is.

summary: Yellow and White Light falls to Earth, breaks to pieces/seperates and turns to all white lights
description:
I ended a phone call and went to the balcony to smoke a cigarette.  I sat down on the chair, light my smoke and looked up.
I saw a yellow whitish light moving at a decline towards the earth and immediately thought UFO.  At this point, my instinct was to record with my phone, but it was in the house.  I proceeded to the door to get my phone, looked back to make sure I wasn't crazy, and saw the light.  I was fascinated, so I was in a gaze.  Moments later, the light broke into pieces and turn into a white color and fell towards the Earth light fireworks at a big display.  As the white lights fell, it disappeared.
This was not a firework.  The angle it was traveling and the speed would make it impossible to be a firework.  This object fell from the sky and towards the Earth at an angle that would make it impossible to be.  Only other explanation would be a meteor falling to Earth and breaking up.

summary: Blinking lights over Los Angeles
description:
there was a steady blink in the night sky.  Thought it was aircraft a few days ago, third night (not consecutively) seeing the same even re-occurring in various places in the night sky.  Tonight, it remained in the same spot.  A very bright, white light.  Slow and steady blink.  No movement.  White only.  Blinks lasted about a second in between few minutes variables.  If I see a 4th night, I will pay keener attention to timing.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Thick flash of light with red tip/outline squiggling across Miami sky.
description:
I was pointing out a dog/gazelle shaped cloud to my friend though the sky was pretty clear, and about 2 seconds after he turns his head to look-a large thick flash of light with red at the tip (and kind of as an outline) flashed across the sky.  
It came out of nowhere and randomly squiggled in the sky before jetting off in one direction to the left.  It was completely random and sudden.  Unexpected and completely without noise.  
My friend and I just stared at each other bewildered as we confirmed that we both had seen the same thing.  We talked about what it could possibly be but could not come up with anything we had ever seen before.  It was most definitely not a plane, weather balloon, helicopter, drone, or falling star.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  We suspect an evening sighting, and have changed the time above.  We have no way to contact the witness, in order to confirm the time.  PD

summary: I was over at my neighbor's house using her washing machine.  She and her cousin were sitting on the front porch, this was around midnight.
description:
My neighbor came running in the house yelling for me to hurry come outside, there's a UFO!  
I ran outside and looked in the direction they were pointing, and sure enough, there was an object hovering in the sky.  
I could not really make out the shape of the object but, it appeared to have a string or bar of white lights on it.  The lights were not flashing or anything.  It was just hovering there, no noise or anything.  
Then it slowly began to move behind the trees and we lost sight of it. Just after it went out of sight, a commercial airplane flew by moving a lot quicker than the object we just witnessed. 
So, we are positive it was not a plane.

summary: Red orbs
description:
First sighting was one glowing orb shining bright orange, dimming to red.  
It disappeared in thin air, then another appeared.  
Then after it, 2 more.  
All moving across the sky.  They could not be mistaken for lanterns, as they appeared above the tree line, moved across the sky then disappearing.  
Saw the same thing last year, but last time there were about 10.

summary: Four red lights moving silently across the sky in Ypsilanti, MI.
description:
There were four red lights moving in different directions.  They looked like they were sparrow (bird) shaped with a bright red ball of light in the center.  
One began to shrink and suddenly disappeared.  The other three continued to move in a SW direction and then they suddenly vanished.  They made no sound at all.

summary: 3 bright orange silent circles moving across the sky.
description:
It was 10:00 p.m. on July 23rd.  It was a clear, dark night with stars clearly visible in the sky.
A bright orange circular object appeared from line of sight in a suburb above the house across the street.  It traveled over our house, making no noise, and continued along the same direction moving quickly across the sky from the NE to the SW, until it was obscured by our house.
The size was comparable to 30’ diameter sphere.
fter the third object appeared I grabbed my phone and did a video of the object as it traveled across the sky.  The video is not good quality and did not show the color as orange and it was in person.
I noted they traveled about the height that a helicopter would use.  After studying the night sky in between sightings I made some observations.  We live in a high traffic area for planes.  This was not a plane, nor a helicopter.  It made no sound.  Plane traffic had stopped in the area.  They normally circle above us at varying heights.  It was like nothing I have ever seen.
I also noted that two helicopters were moving around the area within 10 minutes of the second object, about 5 minutes before the third object appeared.  This also coincided with the obvious…

summary: Round, silent, red and green ufo spotted hovering for seven minutes
description:
My friend called me outside and we could see a round object hovering in the sky.  It was green and red.  There was no sound, no trail, no glow around it like a street or car light, no blinking lights... it hovered for about six or seven minutes then started moving away to the left and disappeared.  
Being prior service military, I know it was not a radio controlled helicopter... I've never seen anything like this…
We spoke with both witnesses, husband and wife, and they seemed to us to be quite serious-minded and sincere in their decription of the sighting.  PD

summary: Big red ball in the sky, moving really slow
description:
I was in the back yard of my house with my friend.  I saw something red on the sky and I told to my friend, "Look, Marte is right there."  ((sic.  Mars??))
She said " is Venus is not Marte". and than we saw the red moving really slow, and we tough that it was a airplane.  
But the lights were not flashing like airplane so we keep watching the red ball and after seconds the red ball disappear.

summary: White cylindrical object very high moving slow, no contrail
description:
Object was white it was still daylight, with blue sky.  
I was kayaking on Chippewa River near Dead Lake.  Closest city was Durrand, WI.  
When I kayak I am leaning back a little which gives me a great shot of sky.  Object was very high, it had white cylindrical shape, no contrail which is odd.  
Appeared to be going fairly slow which would be unusual for a plane.  
Object then just seemed to fade away, also very odd. 
Sighting lasted about 1 minute or so.  
I should add this is the 2nd time I saw similar object in same area of WI.  
I wish I would of had my binoculars.

summary: 2 objects over ocean in Ocean City MD.
description:
Walking on boardwalk, noticed a object (dark in colour in center and lighter in colour on edges, no blinking lights) over the ocean.  
Noticed a second object, identical as the first.  
Both objects approached each other.  Thought they were going to collide.  Moved slowly.  
After they criss-crossed, they stopped, at a stand still for a few seconds.  
In a instance one disappeared, then the other.
Witness indicates that the date is approximate.  PD

summary: Fighter jet seemed to be dispatched to intercept a flying object based on direction of jet sound and object going opposite direction.
description:
After arriving at Lyon County State Fishing Lake, I exited my vehicle and immediately heard what sounded like a sonic boom, but not as loud.  
I then heard what I thought was a fighter jet on an easterly heading because the sound seemed to go west to east.  
I looked up and saw an object that appeared to be flying at a high rate of speed and heading west.  It was only visible for minute or less, but the sound of what I thought was a fighter jet heading east was still apparent and I perceived the sound to be going east. 
The object heading west was not a light but looked metallic and I couldn't tell what the shape was because it was, what appeared to be, miles high and I didn't have binoculars. In the past I had heard of fighter jets being scrambled to investigate and try to intercept unidentified flying objects, and this was almost an immediate thought.  
I feel our military was scrambled to investigate something or I did not perceive things the right way.

summary: Bright blue light breaks into two bright blue lights.
description: Traveling on Hwy 21 north my son said look at that while he was driving we noticed a bright blue light traveling from east to west low to the ground traveling in a straight line moving very fast then broke into two bright blue lights then disappeared over the tree line...My son and I witnessed the same object he almost crashed my truck looking at it..

summary: Giant white flash followed by a boom, no airplanes in sight, no military fields near by, no airports near by.
description: Around 5:50 AM looking East saw an enourmous white flash which seemed to be traveling west and quickly disappearing leaving behind a huge boom-as if a lightning stike had hit right in the backyard.

summary: Red flashing light moving at impossible speed at night in middletown DE
description:
Bright red light traveling at a very high rate speed, seen over amazon in middle traveling south down 301.  The red light was leaving trails because my eyes could not keep up with its speed,  I have never seen anything travel this fast on this earth!  It was dark out and the craft or whatever it is had no white head light for seeing, only a  bright red light that seen to be very close because it appeared to be large in size.  
It lasted for a very short duration and made no sound, either this light was leaving trails behind it or it had smaller red light traveling with it I'm not sure, but I can tell you, it shook me up a bit when I seen it.

summary: It seemed to be cylinder on shape and flying very low and as it flew over my house.  I waited to hear if there was a delay in sound, but no sound followed even as it past over.
description:
I did notice one solid red light never blinking and there were four blinking white lights around the red light.  It was too fast to be a plane.  It flew from west to east directly over my house.
I really don't find this odd since i do see quite a bit of this in the skies over the rez, but thought it would be good to share this info.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Plane-like except much smaller, shorter, and slower.
description:
My mother and I were driving down the road late this evening when we noticed what appeared to be an airplane.  We thought it was odd seeing an airplane so low to the ground.  
As we drove close I realized that, while the craft was shaped like a plane, it contained more to its shape than a plane.  It had an extra barrel and it was shorter than a normal plane.  It was just the one craft.  However, unlike a normal plane, it was much lower to the ground, had a darker paint job, was very thin, flew very very slowly, and had lights in a triangle formation on the bottom of it.  It made no noise and left no trail in the sky.
Once I saw the craft, I pointed out to my mother that it was much different than a normal airplane.  She suggested that we turn around and take a closer look.  
We drove down the road maybe 100 feet before making a U-Turn.  When we returned to the spot where we had seen the craft, the return was less than a minute, we saw no sign of the craft.  It was there one minute and gone the next.  
We even drove further down the road in hopes of seeing it again or maybe even a sign that it was still there.  However there was no sign of the craft we had seen.

summary: UFO flying around, and then stopping in mid-air- bright flashing lights.
description:
The sighting happened on 7/22/2014, ((sic.  07/23/2014)) at around 1:30 am.  I walked out a bar and to a car. When I sat in the car, I noticed something was gliding in the air.  I assumed it was a plane, so I didn't stare at it too long.  
About 5 or 10 minutes went by, and then I saw my friends coming out from the bar and in front of the car I was in.  I looked up, and the craft was still up in the air, just sitting there.  It wasn't moving at all, and at that moment I realized what its shape was and how close it was.  No noises came from it, even though it was fairly large.  
I got out of the car, and walked to where my friends were.  I still didn't hear anything.  It was flashing these bright lights, mostly red.  It was in a big long strip around the hemisphere of the craft, and it seemed like it was a lot of smaller lights making it look like a red strip. Inside the red strip were little bright red dots, so I assume that means those were individual lights.  Sometimes it flashed green on one side, and sometimes blue on the other side.  The red was almost always on.  I think i might have seen another color, but all I can remember is red, green, and blue. 
The craft flashed the…

summary: Black Orb flying incredibly low and fast at night in South East Aurora, CO on July 22, 2014
description:
On Tuesday, 7/22/2014, around midnight, my wife and I were driving south bound on Himalaya (in Aurora, Colorado) and just as we approached the intersection of Chenago, a dark shadowy object went east to west approximately 100' in front of us and 100' above.
The object was flying incredibly fast, had no lights nor made any sound. The whole thing lasted only a second. description: I was taking my dog out for a walk and I noticed about 5 really bright orange lights moving accross the sky in an east southeast direction.  They were silent.  The lights were brighter than any plane I've seen in the sky.  Then the lights just faded quickly away in a random order.

summary: Large fireball falling slowly, stayed bright till I lost sight.
description: Very large fireball falling slowly and stayed bright till I lost sight behind house.

summary: UFO SIGHTED ABOVE MY LAKE IN OAKLAND PARK, FL, JULY 20.
description:
Bright green light, hovering over our lake.  Once noticed 5 bright white flood lights appeared, then the disc turned dark red, then the lights disappeared and the disc had a slight glow around it.  
One tiny red blinking light appeared below it then instantly disappeared.  
Coolest thing i evet saw.

summary: One round bright white/blueish light appeared, faded, appeared dimmer then left with a bit of a tail.
description:
One large round  bright white/blueish light appeared and faded slowly.  
Seconds later it appeared dimmer and flew quickly out of sight with a bit of a tail.

summary: A lit object hovered over wildwood boardwalk.  Only slight movements back and forth not indicative of any man made flight craft I've ever seen.
description:
Multi-colored lights flashed in sequence red, blue, and green. The lights were bright and definitive in their color.  
The object remained in the same section if the nighttime sky for just over 1/2 hour.  It was easily visible.  It was well above any if the lit rides that are stationed on the boardwalk. 
As I got home and attempted to capture the object on video from my balcony, it disappeared.  It was difficult to ascertain the shape of the craft but it did seem to be circular or sphere shaped.

summary: 2 orange lights that go out and 2 saucers appear
description:
Saw 2 big orange/amber lights coming from the south of Milan.  Could not tell what they where because no noice, or sound of propellers, went over my house, lights went out 2 saucer shaped objects appear flying toward ann arbor or north watched them disappeared into horizon.
Me and my grandson where out in the deck drinking beer and watching the airplanes going and coming from Detroit metro.  The light was like I never seen before, I swear we saw the saucer  shape objects flying, no sound, but we could see saucer shape, could not get pics.

summary: Three orange/ white orbs seen over outer banks.
description:
Sitting on the deck at approximately 930 pm, we witnessed two orange/white strobing orbs appear to the south of our position in Kitty Hawk.  The first appeared and remained stationary for about 10 minutes.  It strobed orange to white and at some times looked red.  It eventually move at a slight angle becoming very dim, until it disappeared.  
Shortly after, the second orb with the same coloration appeared in the same area of the sky.  It drifted slightly from East to West, then remained stationary for about 8 minutes.  It then rose straight upwards.  As it rose a small white orb seemed to drop out of the orange orb.  The small white orb disappeared immediately and the orange orb faded until it was completely out of sight.  
After about 10 minutes, a third orange orb came into view directly to the north of Kitty Hawk, lower on the horizon than the previous two, but strobing orange/ white.  It appeared to be moving towards our position, becoming increasingly more visible.  Then it began to fade until it was no longer visible.

summary: Bright light in sky over ocean moving up and down rapidly...
description:
We were sitting on our third floor patio which faces Newport Coast Drive in Newport Coast, California, and this bright light appeared to shoot up into the sky over the ocean (we guessed Laguna Beach area) and it would drop rapidly down.  
Saw red colors on it, and got binoculars and saw many colors like a prism.  The light would shoot straight up and then travel a little and shoot down rapidly again.  
Guessed airplane, helicopter, but it was too quick to be either..

summary: Bright orange fireball moved from NE to SW made no noise.  Same speed as an aircraft then disappeared .
description:
Orange fireball travelled from NE to SW.  No sound.  Moved at approx. speed of an aircraft.  Then it just vanished.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: bright red light
description:
A family member and I we're returning home and, noticed there was a bright red (very red) light in the sky.  The light was hovering over a neighbors yard, it was big enough to be seen and, super bright!  
I pulled into my drive way and,told them to stay in the car, I am going to get the camera!  I opened my car door turned around and, looked at the light and, it it disappeared!!   It disappeared so quick that I have no idea what direction or where it went.  I could tell it looked as if it was a small object, but the light was so bright that it was hard to make out shape! 
I  have never seen anything like this before and, the brightness of this red light was almost overwhelming.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 3  White lights looked like star moving 3-5 mins apart in sky over Pleasant Hill, LA
description:
My wife and I were at a friend of ours house I was looking up at the stars and noticed what looked like a star moving.  
At first I thought it was an airplane but noticed it had no flashing lights like an airplane.  I also noticed it was moving to fast to be an airplane. 
I pointed out to my friend and my wife we continued to watch it move across the sky hen after a few seconds it disappeared.  
We saw 2 more pas by on the same path each on was about 3-5 mins apart.  
Was very strange.  The lights appeared to be traveling south.

summary: slow moving orb of light over Grand Junction
description:
I am a night shift custodian, and I was standing outside the office after checkout, chatting with two of my coworkers.  As we were talking I looked up at the sky, which was cloudless and had no other obstructions to my field of vision.  
As I'm looking I see a very slow moving orb of light barely moving.  I live in a high air traffic area, so I'm very used to seeing airplanes.  This was definitely not one, as it had no flashing indicator lights, and was far too slow.  
My coworkers all looked to see what had caught my attention.  We looked at each other briefly, as if making sure none of us were crazy, then looked back.  
The orb had vanished.  We only looked at each other for roughly 2-3 seconds, and based off of rate of travel, there is no way it could have escaped our field of vision.  
I have heard two other confirmed reports, one from a friend, who I never shared my story with, and the other is a complete stranger, who caught it on film.

summary: At a high point in town, Hillside Avenue, UFO spotted flying very slowly and low to the ground in the middle of the night.
description:
Driving home at a high point in town, Hillside Avenue, and saw an aircraft flying several yards over a 2 story house on the right side of the road.  I saw it fly very slowly from my right, cross over the road, and fly to the left and onward, in the direction of East toward downtown and Sayreville.
It was smoothly flying no more than 25 MPH very low to the ground.  I saw a slight shadow of the outline of the aircraft and it appeared to be disk shaped with red, white, and blue (do not remember the order of the colors) lights stacked on top of each other at each end of the aircraft that did NOT blink at all, unlike every other aircraft I have seen in the sky.  
It was definitely not a plane nor helicopter.  It was unlike anything I have ever seen before.

summary: Unordinary orange light in the sky faded away after about 3 minutes
description:
Strange orange light in the sky  that stood in the same place and then faded  after a couple minutes.
We wonder whether the date indicated above is correct.  PD

summary: Deep bright red glowing oval craft in the sky.
description:
We look up after being on the beach for some time and decided to leave.  When we turned around for one final look there was a deep bright red oval hovering over the ocean.  It appeared to be getting closer and brighter.  There were  occasional lights that flickered underneath the craft.  We did not stay to see how long it was there but when we went out about 5 minutes later, it was no longer there.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Observed many lights in sky, appearing and disappearing at random.
description: Observed many lights in the sky, appearing and disappearing and then reappearing at odd intervals. Observed for 10+ minutes.

summary: Strange orange ball hovered near military base.
description:
About 11:15 on July 19, 2014, I saw a orange ball just above the tree line. 
I watched it for about 2 mins and it dropped down slowly behind the tree line towards Fort Picket military base.  
About two miles away there is a small access rd that runs along side the base around where we saw the object descend.  
As we were parked along side the rd with our lights off, the sky started to pulsate just beyond the tree line, and a few mins later, the fireball flew parallel to the tree line really fast, and shot up on a very sharp angle and was out of sight.
((
We attempted to contact the source of the report, in order to clarify the time of the sighting, but could not reach him via the contact information he provided to NUFORC.  We suspect that the sighting occurred at night, and we have amended the time above.

summary: During our camping trip we saw an aircraft with red and blue lights hovering in the sky.  It would move in one direction very quickly make a sudden stop...hover and the take off in a different…
Fireball like shooting star makes 90 degree turn.
description:
Fireball looked like shooting star, except it "pulsed" on and off at a regular interval:  ~3 seconds off, 1 second on.
Traveled east at high altitude, stayed in area for 4 "pulses".  
Traveled in same direction for 3 pulses, then on 4th pulse we noticed it had turned 90 degrees and traveled south.  
Lost sight of object after that.

summary: Bright  white circular light seen speeding across night sky in mountains near Pigeon Forge, TN.
description:
On 7/19/14, while vacationing in a cabin in the mountains just outside of Pigeon Forge, TN, I saw an unidentified object in the night sky.  
My niece and I were outside, on the balcony, it was overcast from the rain earlier in the day but was starting to clear.  Suddenly, I saw a very bright white circular light behind the clouds, crossing the night sky at a very high rate of speed.  It only took  2-3 seconds for the object to cross over from the ENE to the WSW.  
Because my niece was composing a text to her boyfriend at that moment, she didn’t see it.

summary: Green light traveling southwest @ high rate of speed.
description:
I was heading south on Volunteer Parkway, when I noticed an object traveling in a southwest direction that was illuminated green in color moving very fast.  
I only saw it for about 2 to 3 seconds and at first thought it was a meteor entering the Earth's atmosphere, but afterwards I realized it didn't have a trail or light tail like most meteors one sees.

summary: yellow white light over Kennett Square pa.
description:
I was out having on my deck and I looked up in the sky saw nothing but stars.  A few second later, out of the corner of my eye I see what I first thought was a plane.  {I see a lot of planes living in the flight path of Philadelphia airport.}  
I looked for the blinking lights did not see any.  Then it grew brighter and brighter, then it suddenly went dim, but still seeing it for a few more seconds as grew dimmer and dimmer.  
I have never seen what looked like whatever it was left the atmosphere.
I was looking east and saw the object to the north east .

summary: On Saturday, I went to sit on my front porch in Grand Rapids Mi at about 10:30 p.m.  I was only out for a little while, when I spotted two distinct orange orbs coming from the southwest and traveling…
description:
July 25, (2014) (sic.  Corrected by witness to July 23rd, 2014) I was about five minutes from home, when again, I saw some of the same type of lights.  I pulled into a parking lot, and counted 7 of them.  They were at a fairly low altitude, coming out of the northwest heading southeast.  I almost couldn’t believe what I was seeing.  But there they were.  So, I came home, went out in my backyard with my Brother, and they were still there, moving fairly slow.
We counted about 9 this time.  The last one that appeared was bright red, then changed to orange.  About that time, we  saw an aircraft coming from North to South.  It was probably at about 35,000 feet.  It looked quite distant relative to the strange lights.  After that I did a little research online, and saw similar accounts of the same type of lights.  I would not make something like this up.  I  have nothing to gain from it.  I just wanted to report it, and would like to know if there were any other accounts on the objects I saw.
((ADDENDUM FROM SAME ANONYMOUS SOURCE))
My second sighting occurred on the Wednesday the 24,  Sorry for the error.  (sic.  July 23rd)  Wednesday of this week was July 23rd, 2014.  We are totally…

summary: Orange sphere traveling through Berks County PA
description:
Four of us were relaxing on the patio when one person said, “Is that a fireball?”  
Everyone looked through the trees (to the south) to see an orange object in the sky, and at first we all thought it was a fireball.  However, this object was moving much more slowly than any fireball we’ve ever seen.  It was travelling towards the northwest.
Everyone left their seats and moved to an area where it would be easier to see, and I was able to get some video with my cell phone camera.  This object was moving about as fast as most aircraft, but it didn’t have the blinking lights that we always see on planes and helicopters; just a very orange glow that kept getting bigger, then smaller, over and over.  We heard no noise coming from the object.
Eventually the object moved out of our range of vision, and that was the end of the event for us.

summary: While out side I looked up in the sky noticed 4 black speck like objects in sky then I saw some lights go on them red in color to more objets joined in all moving very randum .
description: called my wife to see these to conferm what I was seeing .  these objects were the same as reports filed in 2010 looks the same as what we saw.

summary: Five orange lights over Carmel Indiana
description:
It was the end of a long work day, when a co-worker and I were walking out to the parking lot, joking about how he was going to be picked up by a helicopter.  
As I looked to the Eastern sky I saw a large orange light hovering about 800 feet, or so, above the ground.  I pointed at it and my co-worker, laughed, and said, "There it is now" 
As I watched the object for a few seconds, I saw another orange light fade into view near the original, so I start walking in their direction.  While I'm walking, I see another appear the very same way the second did, then another, then another (5 in total).  
At this point, I've passed up my car and started jogging down 129th Street from Gray Road, towards Hazel Dell Road, where the lights seemed to be hovering.  
Just as I moved past the tree line and into a clearing, I saw the bright orange lights very clear as they all started to move east in unison as if they were many parts of a whole.  
They stayed on that course for another 10! seconds or so when they faded back into the dark night sky.

summary: I was walking my dog when I noticed a red light in the sky moving slowly from south to north around the mid-town area.  I knew it wasn't a plane as it was low enough, below the clouds that I would…
description:
I stopped and listened thinking it might be a helicopter, but again, no noise and no blinking lights.   As it disappeared, I shrugged it off.  
A few minutes later, there were six more red lights, all traveling together slowly and quietly below the clouds, but spaced erratically and at different altitudes.  Again, they were low enough that I would have heard engine noise.  
They flew in the same direction and eventually disappeared out of sight.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Palm Springs lights
description:
My son and I were sitting by the pool at our apartment in Palm Springs, CA, at  approximately 1940 hours on 07/19/2014.  We saw reddish orange teardrop objects in the Southern sky towards Indian Canyon.  
They appeared to rise from the bottom of the hills and rise to the top.  
At first they appeared to be moving towards us as they were rising and then they just kind of disappeared.  
The first ones we saw there were about 5 of them and then we saw 3 more of them and then 2 more and no more after that.  
They just seemed to move in a almost straight up and then disappear.  
The first five we saw rose up really high and then disappeared.

summary: Slow orangish-red orb appearing to emit other object, as it dimmed.
description:
Saw orangish-red orb moving slowly in northward direction.  No sound with the sighting.  
Appeared to emit or drop something that was the same color of the orb.  The orb started to dim before going completely dark.

summary: Two round balls of fire moving slowly.
description:
Two orange/reddish fireballs passing slowly, maybe 40 miles per hour at 400-500 feet up above our neighborhood.  No noise just moving at a steady pace one 75 yards ahead of the other.
Latitude - Longitude: 32.73XXXX,-96.46XXXX  
Forney, TX.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  We have amended the time above, to reflect an evening sighting.  We have no way of contacting the witness to confirm.  PD

summary: I was driving Mass Pike 90 westbound 1 min before exit 5 at 9:36 pm, I saw several what appeared to be helicopter like at first objects taking off or coming into view in the distance. I thought not…
description:
I was with my kids and talking on the phone so i kept driving.  Then, after looking back up the lights had become small orange/yellowish contained orb like objects and had organized themselves into a near arch looking patten but not perfect symmetry.  There were lined up directly with the highway.  I was swearing into the phone(which I DON'T DO) Because I couldn't believe what I was seeing. People on the highway were all honking their horns so i know others were seeing this.
As is approached me I eventually was under and going past it.  As they were close to me, I would describe the orange/yellowish objects almost as if they were perfect self contained fireballs.  I looked to the left as I passed and there was an object, very very dark black following just behind to the left.  I can't tell you how eerie it is to see something appear that black against an already night sky.  It was strange to say the least.  I tried in every way to rationalize it I could not.  I pulled over off the exit and got out of my car to look up and process what I just saw.
We DO live very close to the military base.  I have lived here my whole life and I can say to you not one person familiar with military…

summary: Fireball over state highway 318 NY.
description:
I was driving my buddy home last night and we were traveling on state rt. 318 heading eastward.  We happened to look up in the sky ahead of the car and we noticed what looked like an airplane on fire.  
As we drew closer to it, it appeared to be an orange glowing ball.  
I slowed down to about 20 mph and neither of us heard anything other than my car's engine and the sound of the tires on the road.  It just seemed to hover over that spot and was about 200-300 yards up from the ground, which would've made it a very low-flying plane.  
No noise, no exhaust could be seen or heard.  My buddy continued to look out the windows as we passed it.  He explained to me that it looked like it was following us.  
He no sooner got that out of his mouth and then said that it had grown dim and then suddenly, it flashed out like a light switch.  
There were other cars on the road at the time, so I imagine others had to have seen this too!

summary: Three red and orange fireballs in formation about Yarmouth Port Village area.
description:
Driving west down 6A in Yarmouth Port, just before the green, I saw one, then two, fireball objects in the sky in front of us.  
I shouted, "What is that?" He said, "A plane." I said, "That's no plane I've ever seen." 
He said, "Look, there's a third one!"  
I turned down a side street so we would be driving but they disappeared into the clouds.

summary: Observed in sky over Pungo.  Moving in the same direction.  First was set of two and one 'dropped' something illuminated.
description:
Following, they kept appearing in increments.  Appearing bright orange, with no navigation lights and emitting no sound.  
As I write this, we just saw two move overhead.

summary: Block of extremely bright pure white lights similar to baseball stadium/flood lights
description:
Sighted a block of pure white extremely bright lights.  The object was very high in the air maybe just below the clouds.  
The object looked to be far away but still came across as very large (maybe the size of 3 single-family homes)  
It sat stationary in the sky and the lights gave a large bright white star shape luminance.  
The object looked almost exactly like baseball stadium lights except much bigger and much higher.  
I lost sight of it when I went behind the tree line and when I drive by again it was gone.

summary: Orange red light.
description:
I was night swimming with a friend, when my friend saw a red-orange object in the sky.  It then glided across the sky for a few miles, and then faded away.  
We saw another, and it did the same thing then it followed a pattern of having two, one following the other, and then it had one, resulting in seeing 9 crafts.

summary: Large green light moving incredibly fast
description:
Leaving Wichita Falls on 82 and saw a large, bright green ball streak across the sky along my left side so incredibly fast it could not be anything I have knowledge of.  Too fast to be a plane.  
Seemed so large that it had to be in our atmosphere and not a comet or shooting star.  
It left a green tail of light that was smokey in appearance as if it was on fire but it could have just been behind some clouds.  
Couldn't tell because it was too dark, but it had been cloudy that day.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Witnessed a large glowing orb that was about 50 meters above the distant hills during a late work shift that disappeared in 30 seconds.
description:
During a night shift at work, my partner and I witnessed a large glowing orb moving steadily in a straight line heading towards Great Falls from Vaughn.  The craft was quite low (it appeared to be no higher than the distant hills) and was a bright orange type of color.  It was flying approximately 50 meters above the hills, ruling out any aircraft or satellite. 
We observed it heading back towards the city until it disappeared entirely.  The duration was under a minute (approximately 30-40 seconds).  
I asked my partner if he was seeing this light orb as well, and he confirmed that he was.
Witness provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 10 bright lights moving in formation through Lancaster County Pa.
description:
July 19, 2014, 10 bright lights moving in formation through Lancaster County.
Around 8:30 pm Saturday night these lights caught our attention moving just above the horizon looking northeast towards Gap, Pa from Willow Street, Pa.  We first thought they were some type of military exercise since they started out flying in formation side by side.
We first counted 3 distinct lights that were a Yellow/white in color moving in formation in a southwestern direction.  Three of them moved into a triangle formation.  Next to the triangle at this time 7 more lights appeared in groups of twos and threes and created a formation of 7 side by side.
In the foreground, a plane flew by in front of these lights with a distinct flashing red light. You could distinctly tell these lights were not planes.
The lights one by one began move upward and seemed to disappear one at a time, like when a plane flies into a cloud.
My wife and I observed the lights for about twenty minutes before they disappeared.
The perspective of how big or far away they were was difficult to judge because it was dark and beginning to get cloudy.  From their distance we could not hear any sounds coming from them.

summary: We saw a grayish streak going up into the sky and then a large glowing orange circle appeared and quickly disappeared.
3 craft executing otherworldly maneuvers
description:
I was in my car driving along the highway when suddenly a few lights in the sky doing unusual maneuvers appeared seemingly out of nowhere.  
I parked along the side of the road and got out. It turned out there were three (3) diamond shaped craft doing maneuvers that I have never seen completed in any aircraft.  
After about watching for 10 minutes, the craft suddenly entered into a perfect formation and dashed away at very high speeds.

summary: I was flying from niagara falls ny to myrtle beach, sc and snapped a picture of the engine. .with duct tape covering/used for repair.
description:
In the background and unseen at the time, were three(3)objects that when zoomed in are unexplainable.
We suspect that the three small lights in the photo probably are reflections of cabin lights in an overhead console.  PD

summary: On July 19th, 2014, we saw a triangle in the sky made up of redish fire balls.  They formulated into another triangle.
description: I took pictures and blew them up and the fire balls are shaped like saucers.  I've been seeing them all week since then.

summary: 2 green fire balls, side by side, in Redbush, KY.
description:
We were fishing.  Noticed a loud noise.  Looked at the sky for several seconds (sounded like thunder).  
Then, 2 big green balls of fire, side by side, shoot across the sky then vanished half way across the sky. 
Then a couple minutes later we heard another big thud like noise.
We suspect that the date may be flawed, and have amended it above, in order to reflect a sighting on July 19, 2014.  We have sent a note to the witness, requesting clarification on the issue.  PD

summary: Fireball in the sky over Topeka, Kansas.
description:
Single fireball moving North over Forbes Field.  Made no noise, could see the fire glowing like you would see while viewing a distance camp fire.  
No visible marker lights which could be seen on the plane landing at Forbes Field.

summary: Driving to work and stopped at the gas station.
description: The red lights were in the shape of a triangle and just hovering.

summary: Another ufo in rural northen California.
description:
Well, I was playing music with one of my close friends.  The night was winding down it was about 3am.  
I step outside of my trailer...  I look up and noticed something not right in the sky.  To my first glance, it looked like the stars were moving.  Not like shooting stars, but in strange patterns.  Nothing like I had ever seen before.
I run inside to get my friend and he notices it to.  We observe that the “stars” we see respond to this cloaked ship of ever-changing size and shape.  My friend, not as freaked out about this, went to bed because he had work in the morning.  I stay out there for 3 more hours watching.  Some came very close to me.  
The three hours I was out there, it felt like 15 minutes.  
Nothing like I have ever seen.

summary: Very bright cluster of 3 lights moving slowly across the sky, flickering and changing colors
description:
Saturday Morning, 2:45am central time, Sugar Land Texas, just outside Houston TX.  I had some work to do late, and had just finished when I decided I would go outside and see how the weather looked.  There were low, broken clouds, moon partially obscured by the clouds. Clam winds.
I saw what I thought was a life flight helicopter flying just above the tree line, but I noticed that the lights were solid red, no green, so as I continued to watch it, the light stopped.  It made a quick vertical circle, stopped again, and then started to flicker, then changed from bright red to bright blue, and continued to flicker at a high rate of speed.  There appeared to be 2 small white dots of light flickering in and out of the clouds near the red/blue light, but they would dart in and out of the clouds so quickly, it was hard to be sure.
After the light hovered in the same spot for about 10 seconds, still flickering, still changing from red to blue and back, it changed to red and moved off slowly.  The entire sequence of events lasted about 1 minute and 20 seconds. I ran back inside to get my phone to take a video, but I could not get the video to play on the phone.  Kept giving an error code.…

summary: Not sure
description:
Walked out side of my door and seen some lighting up in the sky.  I've work at a airport, and can tell and plane when I see one.  This object had crazy movement.  Also, to be a plane moving an a circler motion flashing four different colors different ways floating in the sky up and DOWNNN UUUUPPP KINDA DOWN SIDE TO SIDE CHAINGING COLORS BLUE GREEN RED AND A DIFFERENT COLOR (the color of the street lights) 
I have a video it's not a good picture and you can barely see the lights changing, but you can see the lights flashing ...  Good luck trying to get a hold of me ... Just want to info someone that this info might be use full to someone

summary: Slow moving, soundless, smokeless fireball in the early am sky.
description:
My husband and I were in the front porch @ 2:00 am.  I was the first to see this fireball thing, it was going straight up and then was gone.  
I thought my eyes were playing tricks on me because hadn't got a lot of sleep and was really tired.  I asked him if he saw it and he looked at me like I was crazy.  
I ran out into the yard to see if I could spot it again so he followed me still saying I was crazy.  All the sudden the look on his face changed and I knew he had spotted it.  Out of nowhere the fireball was back moving slowly and soundless above the tree in our yard.  It kept in a straight line moving across the sky and away from us.  
Within a matter of minutes it disappeared into the clouds.  It seemed to be only 50 maybe 60 feet above us and we both got a very clear look at it.  It had a clear like see through center and covered in fire, no sound, no smoke, no hurry just a steady pace. 
I never believed the things I heard about UFOs until now, still go outside in the early part of the mornings just in hopes to see it again!!!  
Strangest thing I've ever seen and yet beautiful in a way.
((

summary: I glanced up to see 3 dim white lights in a perfect triangle shape move in a gliding motion a couple hundred feet above the tree line.
description:
I was outside smoking and drinking on Friday Night, just after midnight.  
I look up at the stars often and this time I glanced up to see three dim white lights in a perfect triangle shape move in a gliding motion a couple hundred feet above the tree line.  It was fairly quick and way to low to be a satellite which was my first guess.  
No sound what-so-ever even though I can hear airplanes passing by way above the altitude of what this "ufo" was flying. 
The moon was fairly bright but the body of the craft was still pitch black, even though it was flying so low.  
Very odd experience.  Floated across my view in about 10 seconds, no rotation.

summary: Orangish glowing object rose above shore to high altitude and then sped away
description:
I am a US citizen but reside currently most of the year in São Paulo, Brazil.  My wife and I are in New York State visiting my family and have been vacationing several days by the beach in Montauk, NY, out near the tip of Long Island.
This is a pretty clear and starry night so after the kids went to sleep we went out on the patio of the room we are renting and did some stargazing.  At approximately 11:20pm or so (we did not look at the time so this estimate is give or take 5-10 mins.), just as we were turning to go inside my wife shouted for me to look.  Looking to the SW we saw what appeared to be a bright orangish fireball rising slowly up into the sky.  There was no sound from the object that we could detect although it seemed to be close, perhaps a couple of hundred yards away at the most. summary: UFO Sighting Report  16-July-2014 23:17 (Eastern time zone)  North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
description:
3rd incident:  Observed six orange colored spherical shaped objects moving along the beach above the water.
Occurred over a ten or fifteen minute period with one, then two and finally three objects being visible at a single time.  They all appeared to originate from near the water line about a half mile or so down the beach.  They would climb while slowly moving and seemed to pulsate.

summary: 4 bright fixed lights by Initial Point/Kuna, ID.
description:
3 lights by initial point on Swan Falls Rd, appeared to be on tall poles just past Initial Point Butte.  
They faded off then came back on within 10 seconds several times, no airplane/red lights on top. 
They stayed to the left of us going towards the falls (south).  We never caught up our passed them.
After getting to Dedication Point there was 4 lights, then they faded off and never came back on.  
We went on down to the falls (5 miles) for an hour, never saw them again on the way back or on any other trip out there.  
Our 1 dog was very restless the whole time and has acted very sedated since.

summary: Six flashing lights raced across the sky, clustered at the horizon, and went out of view.
description:
My husband and I came home from work and noticed flashes of light just below the Big Dipper.  There were about six of these objects which resembled stars, but they were independently flashing and moving off to the right one behind the other at a fantastic rate of speed, much too fast for a man-made object, arcing down to the horizon.  
As they reached the horizon they got closer together and began to cluster; then they went out of view.
My husband and I work in the education field.  I teach, and he recruits.  We are frequently on the road late into the night all across the nation, and this display in the sky was mind-boggling.  We have never seen anything like this before.  It would help if anyone else saw this.

summary: Moving lights in the sky form a line, flash brightly, and chase planes.
description:
While night swimming with my wife i was floating on my back looking at the stars when i noticed one of them moving.  it began in a straight line but the a plane flew by and the moving light dis a sort of s move and followed the plane for just a few seconds and then stopped moving and changed direction entirely.  i pointed it out to my wife who said it had to be a plane.  i insisted that it had just done things planes can't do and i saw it follow an actual plane for a moment.  
She rolled her eyes and said right, cause you're an expert on planes.  i was still watching the light when suddenly i noticed the others beging appearing. the same small star like light. they began moving into a diagonal line formation. when they locked into the formation of a perfect diagonal line, 
the lights began to flash very brightly, alternating from one to the other. then one by one the flashes synchronized until they were all flashing together simultaneously. my wife saw all of that happen too.  even she admitted that what we were looking at was something unique. 
the lights stopped flashing after about 30 seconds of standing still and flashing in place. then they dimmed back down the the original…

summary: Line of bright white, flashing lights. No sound, despite seemingly low altitude.
description:
At approximately 10:30 PM EST, on 7/16/2014, I looked up to witness a 'line' of flashing lights in the sky.  My view was not obscured by any trees or other objects, and the sky was clear.  
The lights were not flashing in a synchronized fashion, but seemed to be blinking on and off independently of one another, with each doing so at fairly regular intervals of every two seconds or so.  The lights seemed to be close to the ground, but - sans a point of reference to judge distance by - I only say that because of how large and bright they were.  There were perhaps eight to ten lights that I could see all at once, stretching from a point directly overhead, from north to south, until the roof of my apartment building blocked my view.  
I watched this go on for around fifteen seconds, then realized that the number of lights seemed to be decreasing; it did not look as if they were ascending, or flying away outside of my field of vision, but rather that every few 'blinks', one of the lights would not light up again. At that point I ran inside to get my fiance.  
When we got back outside, we went directly to the rear (south) of our apartment building. Since the 'line' stretched in that…

summary: There was only one.  It was shaped like a jet/plane in the front and spherical on the back.
description:
It had blinking yellow, blue, and red flashing lights on the back of it. 
It was flying over a kids summer camp about 200 feet high and going very slow, about 15 to 25 mph. 
Lastly, it was flying straight.

summary: Series of lights moving in a straight line across the sky.
description:
There were 6 equally spaced lights flashing in sequence in the southern sky.  
At a glance they appeared to be stars until further examination showed them to be flashing in sequence and in a straight line.  
They covered an area (depending on their distance away) of 2 miles to 50 mi.  
We heard no sound and then they moved slowly from east to west.   
We observed this for about ten minutes.
I questioned others who live south of us and no one had heard any helicopters or anything else around this time.

summary: Light across the sky
description:
I was sitting outside, enjoying the cool weather, smoking a cigar.
I look up out over the trees, and see 3 or 4 lights in a long straight Diagonal line.  At 1st I think they are planes, but they are blinking Faster than I've ever seen, almost like strobe lights they were Blinking so fast. Each light was just 1 dot.  White.  Maybe a little Reddish in the light.  I also noticed they were blinking in a pattern In unison.  They were moving perfectly in synch so I believe it was 1 large craft.  It was moving steadily below the tree line and further away.  
Took about 5 minutes before it was out of site.

summary: flashing lights moving with no sound in unison.
description:
We witness 3 flashing lights moving in unison to the south west.  
This display was very shocking as my wife and I both tried to justfy and ratinalize what we were gazing  at.  We both are professionals and I really tried to capture the event  on my tablet.   But, its very dark.  Mostley audio.  Im just reporting what we witnessed.  
My wife and I have been married for 30 years and this is the most explainable thing we have ever witness together.

summary: Five lights blinking in unison in line formation across NC sky.
description:
First and foremost, I don't believe in outer space aliens or UFOs.  There is a logical explaination for what I saw.  Problem is, I can't explain it so I'm in search of an explanation. Last night, Wednesday, July 16, 2014 around 21:30 I was smoking on my back deck when is saw an aircraft come over the tree line from the north east headed in a southwesterly direction, about 220 degrees.  The aircraft was soon followed by a second, a third, forth and finally a fifth.  All five aircrafts were traveling in the same direction in a straight line formation and at the same distance apart.  What caught my eye was that all 5 aircrafts each admitted one flashing beacon light and all five beacon lights were flashing in unison.
Before having children, I spent 5 years working at Charlotte Douglas International Airport.  I've spent enough time around airplanes that I can identify them in the sky.  Even at night I can recognise the navigation lights on the tail and wings and even see the lights coming from the passenger cabin. I know that the five aircrafts I saw were flying too close to be passenger commercial aircraft so the could have been mitary.  Only problem is, even military aircrafts have…

summary: UFO Sighting Report  16-July-2014 21:28 Eastern  North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina     1st incident:  Observed a single orange colored orb moving slowly in a south to north direction.
description:
Object was sighted about 10 degrees in front of the hotels moving parallel with the strip  Appeared to be at about 75-100 feet above the buildings. I was able to get a good view through binoculars before the object disappeared.  I moved to street level to try to locate the object as it came across the buildings but it never reappeared.
