An additional 5th object appeared in line with the other four and they moved in sync that gave the feeling or illusion of a single large object.  They began to intermittently blink in and out of view and finally all vanished.
Duration: 5 minutes

summary: 6 lights in sky over my house very loud humming sound
description:
I just saw 6 lights flying in a straight line high up in the sky directly overhead.
I heard a very loud humming sound and it got so loud it was shaking the house.  
They were in a perfectly straight line moving either in sequence unless it was one object.  
From the height in the sky I would estimate it was at least a mile or more in length from the front light to the tail.

summary: Loud humming with flashing lights
description: Heard a loud humming that varied from low to high in bass sounds...looked up and seen a cigar shaped craft with 4-5 pulsing lights

summary: White smoke leaving a flying object, in which the object then disappears.
description:
It is July 16, 2014, 9:25 pm, the reason I know what time it was because my father and law stated to my sister in-laws that he timed them out of the yard chore that had been done at 9:25 pm July 16, 2014.
During this initial conversation, I looked up into the sky saw a plane coming from the south and the plane was clear enough for me to have stated sitting in front of the wing and the rear of the wing a few times in my life.  
While looking up at the air plane, reminiscing about old times, I noticed a oval shaped faintly lit orange object in the sky heading west moving about the same speed as the airplane I spoke of earlier. 
I watched this object about the size of a head of a 5/32 drill bit down to a 1/8 drill bit, then all of sudden I seen about 3/4 of an inch of white smoke behind the 1/8 inch drill bit size object disappeared.  (Shapes and sizes are my point of view of the flying object from where I was standing in Grand Rapids, Michigan, while looking up into a clear blue sky the plane was about an 1 inch long in the sky. ) 
Keep in mind the plane was heading northeast, and the object was heading west.

summary: Hovering line of lights in formation.
description:
At 9:10PM on July 16th of 2014, a son, his mother, and fiancé sat down to eat a quiet dinner in their suburban home.  Approximately five minutes later, his fiancé heard a faint sound and asked what it was.  They muted the TV and everyone stopped in their tracks.  The two family dogs had their ears perked up and  started growling.  He went outside and not a moment sooner he came rushing in frantically telling them to come outside.
	It was reaching dusk and as they went outside in the middle of the street they looked in the sky and instantly brought out their phones to capture a once in a lifetime moment.  In the sky, six to eight lights were blinking randomly in a straight line over their street.  The lights never moved, staying over the small suburban neighborhood hovering.  His mother was quick to point out that whatever was in the sky had blocked the clouds near it.  A few seconds later a small airplane was taking flight and was headed in their direction.
	The plane went under the unidentifiable flying object missing it.  At around 9:25PM the object had flown west and never seen after that.  The family stayed outside after to try and see if it would come back and to further…

summary: Me and my friend were sitting on lawn chairs looking at stars when we seen a "ufo" type object fly over.  It had 4 lights.
description:
Me and my friend were sitting on lawn chairs looking at stars when we seen a "ufo" type object fly over.  It had 4 lights.  It was in a rectangular shape.  It flew over my house in Rogersville.  It took approximately 10-15 seconds to get out of site.

summary: 7 fireballs hovering high over Woodbridge, VA.
description:
My friend and I had been skateboarding out front of my house when I had noticed 7 stationary fireballs in the sky, with no particular formation, behind the treeline. 
I asked him what he thought they were and he laughed it off saying "Huh, maybe it's a UFO, man" and continued skating. 
I ignored his comment and kept my gaze locked on them for about 5 minutes, watching them disappear one by one.
I have also had people tell me of abduction experiences involving my back yard, with them having no prior knowledge of the abduction phenomena, coinciding totally with public accounts.

summary: Multiple sightings
description:
During the middle of June, my roommate and I had witnessed a rather bright star over Ormond beach on beach side.  We live on the intercostal and work nights so often like to hang out and talk on the balcony after work anywhere between 2-5 am.  
On one night we witnessed this really bright star which then grew into a thin crescent shape.  Assuming we were crazy and seeing the moon behind clouds, we searched to finde the moon which we then realized at the time was behind us. 
At this point the bright light turned crescent went back to a bright light with a tail as if the crescent got cut in half,  (at this time I called my boyfriend in hysterics trying to explain the sighting but he doesn't believe) soon after it then fade to just a star then disappeared into thin air.  It didn't appear for the rest of the night.  
Later on in the week, it appeared again, this time a little more south and didn't change into a crescent shape, but did grow a tail of light like a shooting star.  Then the tail of light slowly faded, but the light grew bigger as if it was closer then ended up fading out and disappearing. 
We witnessed it two more times the last time being tonight the 16th.  Tonight my…

summary: Bright Light boomerang/stealth/triangular object.
description:
I saw a bright light through the trees while sitting on the back porch of our home at roughly 0500 this morning (07/16/14).  It was as bright as the moon.  At first, I had assumed it was the moon, although it would have been in an unusual position/location.  It disappeared due to the leaves blocking my view.  
Then I saw it again in a clearing of leaves.  Again, it disappeared.  I stood up and watched it above the tree lines.  I wanted to see the shape before I woke my husband.  Already I was thinking “this is a UFO” due to its apparent shape and size and brightness.  When I saw the shape, I knew.  
So ran in the house and woke my husband.  I told him he had to get up, because he would never believe me.  He did, and we watched it fly over the house together.  
I ran into the front yard to continue watching it.  I was a little frightened and hid under some trees in case it was watching me.  I cannot tell you its size, maybe 1/6 size of the moon and later the size of a large star.  It was solid white, almost blinding light.  It was either a chevron shape or boomerang shape, similar to a stealth shape, but not a complete triangle. 
It did not change directions, but instead flew in…

summary: Shiny disk shaped object broad daylight clear sky.  2 witnesses.
description:
Was watching a jet fly at a high altitude talking about how the jet stream drops giving the appearance that the jet is gaining altitude.  Blue sky with a few clouds.  
Many feet below the jet moving the opposite direction a disc shaped object appeared traveling what looked to be faster than the jet.  Appeared for about 5 to 10 sec then dissapeared.  Not behind a cloud or anything.  
Afterward,s not really believing what we saw, we watched the jet making the observation that we could clearly see the body and wings of the plane at such a high altitude, but this object had no wings just round disc shaped.  
The sun did reflect off the disc if that is worth mentioning.   Wish I would have taken a pic but was a little shocked.

summary: Couple noted a black, triangular shape object hovering above her house.
description:
Witnesses were lounging in the grass of the backyard with their dogs when the lady noted a black, triangular shape object hovering above her house.  They were both laying on their backs and it was directly above them in the sky.  
She looked at it for at least a minute before pointing it out to her boyfriend, who then also studied it...he confirmed that it was black (or at least dark) and triangular shaped.  It seemed to be pointing in an easterly direction...as they lay there discussing it for at least another minute.  They watched the object slowly rotate (as if on an axis) in the completely opposite direction (west) - making no noise and showing no fuel trails- and then it was just gone.  (MUFON 59404)

summary: Very bright light slowly moved around in a circle, then streaked and faded--not a plane or star.
description: My son and I were outside looking at the stars at our cabin near Mt. Baker in WA.  The sky was very dark and we could see a patch of the sky through the trees.  We were setting up a small telescope and talking when the super bright light appeared.  It was right next to what we thought was a planet (as it was very bright).  I did not notice the moving light before but now it was brighter than the planet.  It was moving slowly in a circular motion and definitely was not an airplane.  It was going back and forth and then started to fade and went in a line away from the planet and we lost it in the trees.  I was still going when we lost it.  We did not see it with the telescope and we could not get a picture of it, as it was too far away.

summary: I was outside having a smoke when I was looking at the stars I saw a round saucer like craft flashing red blue white lights and flashing and after watching for 30 mins went back to white light and…
Light moving though sky leaving faint trail.
description:
My family and I were having a bonfire and I was just looking up at the stars and after 15 mins or so, I noticed something that looked like a star but it was moving.  
I watched it for a while, no strobe light just a star moving through the sky then the light after about 2 mins going southeast.  
The light just  dimmed out and came back on then just dimmed out again for a final time and there was a faint trail me and my family noticed.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: At least one craft with very bright lights very low in the sky seen by 2 people in Tulsa.
description:
My friend and I were driving east and we saw an extremely bright light in the sky.  It did not appear to be moving and it did appear to be twinkling so I assumed it was a star.  
I got out my stargazing app to see what star looked so large and close and there was no major star in that particular spot.  
We drove for about 3 more miles and eventually it seemed to make a triangular shape. 
For a few minutes it looked as if there were 2 but we aren't sure.  
It started to get much clearer and it appeared to look like a craft flying extremely close to the ground but not landing or taking off. 
It also at this point appeared to move a little bit and then stop again.  Then we turned north and to our surprise the light seemed to reappear to our left and it continued to move with us.  
Then we turned east and it appeared behind us, then disappeared.

summary: "Star looking" orb moved across the night sky from left to right for about 5 seconds before vanishing.
description:
It was a normal, fairly warm night.  My mother had just gone to bed and i was outside in my front yard, listening to some music coming from my room, waiting for some of my friends to arrive.  
I was looking up at the stars as i tend to do to clear my head, making up constellations and watching for "shooting stars", when all of a sudden i saw what appeared to be a star moving!  There was no trail of light, there were no flashing lights like there are on planes, it just looked like a star got bored and went for a walk across the sky!  
It was going faster than any normal cargo plane I've seen at night, but slow enough for my eyes to easily keep up with it.  It was flying in a straight line, from left to right, no arc at all.  
I continued to watch it until it suddenly vanished.  It didn't speed up or flash away, it just disappeared like a magic trick.  
I even looked around to see if i could find any other planes in the sky, and when i did, the obvious plane was moving considerably slower than the object and you could see the flashing lights clearly.  
I know it was not a plane, and i know it was not a "shooting star".
I honestly have no idea what exactly I was looking at, but I do…

summary: Flash of green crossing lines
description:
While driving to our home, my wife and I saw a florescent green "grid" appear covering everything in sight.  It only lasted about the duration of a camera flash and did not originate from any object seen by us however, it did seem to come from above us.  
We both immediately stopped conversing and confirmed with each other what we just observed.  
Additionally, we tried to research what could have caused it and cannot find anything.  Very unusual indeed.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

summary: Bright white light races west to east over Portland, OR.
description:
Tuesday night, at about 9:45 PM, July 15, 2014, in Southeast Portland, Oregon, as stars and satellites began twinkling, I saw a bright white light race across the sky from west to east. The brightness was like an Iridium flare from a satellite, only it was much larger in radius that a satellite appears to our eyes. 
I do not think it was a satellite because it was moving so fast and because the glow was so much larger than satellite.  I do not think it was an airplane or helicopter either, because the speed was way too fast, there were no other lights besides the consistent glow, and the single white light was larger than any light I've seen on an airplane at night.  
Also there was no sound. If it had been in aircraft and if it had been flying that fast and presumably low enough to produce a light that large, then I expect I would've heard some noise but there was none.  
The flight path was west to east over highway 26 in Southeast Portland (Powell Blvd.)  Many local aircraft fly this route but none fly it as fast as this: approximately 8 seconds from west horizon to east horizon.  
I can think of no category to fit the proper description of this light. I do not know what it is,…

summary: UFO over FAA center in Hampton, Ga.
description:
I was at work and I heard a helicopter (I live near and airport and am familiar with the sounds of helicopters).
This was like a military helicopter, it had a turbo or jet sound not normal for this area.
After approximately 45 seconds of hearing it, the helicopter came into view almost directly overhead.
It was heading ESE bearing approximately 122 degrees.  After it passed me, a small, solid, bright white lit; was ahead, slightly above, and a little to the south of the helicopter.
I focused on the light, and all the sudden at 3 o'clock a red strobe light came on.  About 2 seconds after that at 10 o'clock, a second red strobe light came on.
None of these lights were comparable to the helicopter, which had several white and red strobe lights that cycle much fast than the other lights.  Even though the helicopter was closer, the size of the three lights were about 10 times larger (assuming it was one object). I could not tell the distance between the object.
The reason I feel like it was one craft is because after the red strobe lights came on, they never wavered in distance from the solid white light and the orientation around the center never changed.  I would estimate the visual…

summary: 15-25 light orbs over Southwestern Denver
description:
I was in my backyard, when I took a quick glance at the sky and noticed there were 15 to 25 light orbs in the sky.  These orbs were white/blue and were flying together in a weird pattern. 
I stopped and stared at them for about 20 seconds because I had never seen anything like that before.  I then ran inside my home to let my brother, cousin and mom know what I was seeing and we quickly ran outside to our backyard to see what was going on.
These light orbs were flying toward Northeast Denver and were very silent.  As they were heading Northeast, I noticed another orb light flying at a higher rate of speed and caught up to the rest of the orbs.  We continued observing them as they flew through the clouds. 
We noticed that three of them stopped and we lost site rest of the rest.  These three orbs were stationary for about 5-10 minutes and then disappeared.

summary: At least 50 Solid white lights traveling maybe more.
description:
Through the cloudy evening clouds, I saw a herd of white led looking lights, extremely high in the sky grouped together and some that were very close together and some off in the distance.  
The first group was about 25 then saw even more following behind.  At least another 25 plus even more that were hard to count.  
There seemed to be more spread out all over but the clouds made it difficult to see.  
This cluster appeared southeast of Denver and continued north then they continued in a northeast direction until they were no longer viewable.  
Some of the lights looked as if they were staying still then would continue once the other moved.  
There was no noise produced by these objects.

summary: Basketball sized craft spotted at night in Cadiz KY
description:
In the eastern sky, 3 stationary blinking lights from white to red, 5 times faster than the lightening bugs.  No sound.  
One accelerates upward, disappears.  The other two exhibit drastic turns and moves for a moment and then start downward at a fast clip.  
They stay perfectly aligned side-by-side at a 45 degree angle all thru this, making me think they were a larger craft with 2 sets of lights.  
When they reach the level of the house top across the road, one splits off and soars upward and disappears.  
The other hovers about 20 ft above the street and I can see that it is a ball-shaped craft.  
It stays in place with the white and red lights alternating, as I watch it for almost 45 seconds and then it soars upward towards its original place in the eastern sky, then disappears.  
Not the first time I've seen them in that exact place, and there is usually a variety of sizes and shapes there.

summary: I have never believed in this sort of thing but I have caught on my camera something unbelievable.
description:
I was outside my home taking pictures of our new home, I didn't see or hear anything out of the ordinary.
Later I was looking at the pictures that I had taken and I seen what looked to be a strange figure standing in front of my car.
I really couldn't tell what it was.
I sent the picture to my daughters and asked them what they thought about it.
A few days passed and my daughter sent me the picture back, she had enlarged it and made her best attempt to make it a little more clear.
When I seen it I completely freaked out, I was in a panic, crying, just scared to death There is no doubt that it was some sort of alien creature.
It is a light color with a slight greenish tent , it has large almond shaped eyes that are black and a large head.
I called a alien research to seek answers. He told me I would be ok not to worry.
So, anyways that same creature I think, came in my room in the middle of the night too, it didn't do anything to me, but,, I started really looking at all the photos that I had taken that day and I don't know what to even think..
There are several more of them in that picture that wasn't noticed the first time I looked at them.
I also caught a object in the air above…

summary: Disk that was about 200-3000 ft above the bridge.
description: I was driving with my wife on bandera rd when she pointed out something in the sky. I looked up to see a black disk shaped object with black mist all around it. I saw a window with what seemed to be multiple figures in the window. As soon as I saw that the disk shot up within less than a second and was gone. My wife said she saw the disk at first slowing descending. It seems as if they were observing us, and when I made eye contact it left.

summary: Reflective chrome shiny metallic cylinder shaped thing floating from Paducah off toward the Brookport area.
description:
This happened years ago...forgive me it was 2013-2015 in the summer.  I am not for sure the exact month but it was nice out...summer time.  I walked out the back door of my work and looked up to the west and saw a completely shiny (shiny chrome) long cylinder or I guess you could say cigar shaped.  It was probably 1,500-2,500 feet up...it was clear as day...but not if you didn't have a fix on it...but when I did pick it out in the sky I could see the shape and color perfectly.  
It was moving north west above the mall area moving out the direction of Brookport, Illinois...that direction.  It just kept moving off that direction.  
A coworker was there and I told him look...but he couldn't see it and I didn't want to sound dumb but I have always wondered what that was. I can still remember it clear as day.  The coworker looked but could not see it and walked back in.  Are our weather balloons shaped that way?  It made no sound and had defined cylinder shape.. reflective chrome.  I would say it was 20-30 feet long is my guess.  Ya see, the wind here blows in a north east direction,..it wasn't blowing in the wind...it was headed northwest.  
I am submitting this because I noticed…

summary: Black cigar shaped object spotted over Morocco
description:
This incident happened an afternoon during the summer of 2014.
I was playing soccer at a holiday residence near the town of M'Diq, in northern Morocco. While I was having a quick break, I spotted a black spot about 10 nautical miles away from my position, at an altitude of approx. 5000 feet and below the horizon. I was an aviation enthusiast at the time and it was clear to me that it wasn't a common aircraft. I also knew that the airspace where I spotted the object was restricted due to the King's property below it (T-VFR AREA E) and no aircraft were allowed to fly through it (except the Moroccan Air Force I believe).
 While I was trying to make myself believe what my eyes were registering, a bunch of guys spotted it as well, confirming that it wasn't just my imagination. The black cigar-shaped object moved steadily on an eastbound direction towards the Mediterranean Sea and with no signs of acceleration or abrupt movement disappeared. It felt like a very well done fade out filming transition. Nobody said nothing and we kept playing soccer like it never happened.
 I'm currently a commercial pilot and I can, even more, confirm than the shape and directional movement of the craft…

summary: Sound of large jet airliner performing touch and goes nearby, 5 seconds apart but no aircraft visible.
description:
Hesitated posting this as unique category of ‘sighting’.  July 2014, Los Colinas, TX, (Irving area) apartment complex 30 mi. east of DFW airport, weather clear appx. 3PM.  Heard loud sound of jet aircraft approaching from the north ¼ mi. west of my location.  No runway.  Flat land near Trinity River.  Did apparent ‘touch and go’ in front of me, then gained altitude, sound dissipating in southerly direction.  
Five seconds later loud sound of jet aircraft approaching from south, touch and go, gaining altitude with noise dissipating in northerly direction.  Six such passes.  There was no airplane.  At least 20 other tenants were also on their balconies looking for the phantom airplane.  Went outside where man is pointing his cell camera toward the sky.  When asked if he had seen anything, he said he hadn't.  Sent to Linda Howe at the time who replied as puzzled as was I.

summary: While sky whatchin I was looking at orions belt I saw two lights come from the middle star , not sure if in front or behind , but two fast moving lights going opposite directions . This was around…
Silver sphere comes out of a cloud and shoots upward.
description:
I was at a lake near my house in new jersey, near Al capon's  summer home (that is my understanding).  I was there for 3 hours, from 4:30 AM to 7:45 AM to get pictures of a sunrise.  
Not long before I was ready to leave the area and go home, I saw a small silver sphere fly out of a cloud, it moved up then left very quickly before it shot upward out of my view.  I don't know if it was a UFO as many would or would not call it, but never the less it was very strange.  
I've seen more things like it before on camping trips but had always brushed it off as a lack of sleep.  Yet i had gotten a full nights rest before going out to the lake in question. (there was a air liner flying ahead of it just seconds before i had seen said sphere).
Witness indicates that the date is approximate.  PD

summary: Quiet metallic metal disk.
description: I am reporting this in 2020. However, the event happened in 2014. It was a warmer night with clear skies. I arrived at work about 4:30am. As I was outside setting up traffic signs getting ready to open up shop; I looked up at the sky admiring the calm of the morning and the stars. As I was looking up a metallic metal disk with no lights briefly but steadily moved from right to left across the sky. I could make out the material and shape because the moonlight reflected off of it.  It was silent and must have been lower than an airplane because I could make out the shape, texture, and type  material from where I was standing.

summary: Late at night my friends and I were laying in the grass looking at the stars and chatting.  One of us looked to the treetops to our left.  We all described the same sight.  We saw maybe 3 or four…
description:
We watched them for awhile but then lost track of them.  It was absolutely quiet and an unreal experience to see.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate.  PD

summary: 3 lights heading north and one flashing light in the north
description:
7/14/14 @ 10:40pm, 11:05pm and 11:18pm. 
An object that is bright white like a star, moving north.  It fades out to a brunt red color. Then it would get bright white again and fade to red then out and repeat. 
All 3 of the objects acted the same and all three had a flight path that took them by the first star of the handle of the Big Dipper. 
The 4th object seen was to the north at about 11:22pm. It was simply a flashing light. 
It alternated between 21 seconds and 10 seconds between flashes. 
I never saw it move.  The flash was always in the same place.  Then it just quit flashing.

summary: Brilliant white orbs moving slowly across sky in north Georgia.
description:
I was out smoking a cigarette before bed.  I was looking up ar the sky seeing flashes from fire flies and noticed a few stars.  
About half way through my smoke, I noticed the star has moved from where I was sitting from directly above a tree to the right.  I continued to watch this "star" move from east to west.  It was a bright brilliant white circle/orb.  It moved from a complete stationary position to moving slower than a plane a high altitude.  It moved across the sky for about 25 seconds before vanishing into a clear sky.  
This is the third time I have seen this.  Im always looking to the sky and use my Mobile Observatory by Wolfgang Zima (Kreapp) and I'm very familiar with astronomical events.  
I can say this was NOT a plane, ISS, a meteor or an asteroid.  I've seen one with my girl friend that pulsed like magnesium burning in the sky moving from east to west also but this one slowed down and shot off like a laser at a 90° angle and disappeared.  I'm curious to see if anyone else in north Georgia has seen these brilliant white orbs treating the sky like a playground. 
I believe hands down without a doubt that physics does not lie and what I have seen are truly something…

summary: Three erratic large orange lights off the coast of Garden City , SC
description:
My wife, kids, and I were walking on the beach and noticed 3 large orange lights appear off the coast of Garden City, SC in the air.  The lights were not in motion at the time.  
All of the sudden they turned off one by one.  Right after this they came back on at the same time and were in motion at a very rapid pace.  
They came to a stop again and remained in place for over a minute.  Eventually faded away in a way I've never seen an aircraft do.  
There wasn't anything normal about it, it's something none of us have ever seen.  
I'm not sure what it was but I also heard other people talking about it as we walked along the beach that also found it bizarre. 
The next day I looked at google earth to see if there was any land in the direction and there was clearly not.  
It's my guess that the object were around 2 miles away and 500 yards above the sea.  
The event lasted around 3 min.  It was pretty cool to see.

summary: 3 orange spheres moving at erratic speeds of South Carolina coast.
description:
Facing the ocean from hotel balcony.  
Reddish orange spheres appeared to be floating and moving from left to right erratically. 
Appearing the vanish almost instantly on and off for about 15 seconds.  3 witnesses .

summary: lights appeared in the sky for short periods 3 to the cell 3 to the north eventually they came together at 6 followed by individual lashes for periods of 15 seconds at most the light would come on…
5 minutes of loud sound, also with the sound of rushing air, then stopped.
description:
On July 14th, approx. 9:30 pm, my dogs started barking like i have never heard them bark,  
I turned off the radio, and opened the window, which then I heard a sound that i have never heard, at first i thought it was a very large aircraft flying very low, but the sound was different, 
so i went outside to look for it,i saw nothing, but the sound persisted, it also sounded like the rushing of a lot of air, with a droning very loud sound, then it just stopped. 
i saw nothing ,i mentioned it to a friend across the valley to the east over by the Mission Mountains, at first she thought the same thing as me but saw nothing.

summary: Red circle flew by my home and was seen by me and my son
description:
A circle flew about 20 feet in air. It came across from the right of me and my son.  
It flashed a red light then flashed a second red light and then flew up and was gone.  
It was close to trees and I could see it over tree tops at my home.

summary: Bright light came into sight in a dark sky and quickly exited 180 degrees without stopping or turning--rapidly!
description:
I finally saw something in a pitch black sky that made the wife and me both say, "What the hell did we just see"? 	 								 
Coming into sight over the tree line, heading due west, in a dark sky (about 9:15 pm, Monday July 14th), with no other cars in sight, was a bright light looking like it might have been a plane heading for the air force base.  
We were traveling North on hwy 41, between Palmetto, Fl, and Ruskin, Fl.  Being the only lit object in sight, about 1 mile up, we were both looking right at the light, when it changed direction 180 degrees and was gone in less than a second.  It never stopped or made a turn. 
I saw a bright whiteish light.  
Since the wife wasn’t driving, she spent more time checking it out and said she saw a red light at the bottom of the object.
				The whole sighting was only 5 seconds long.  Watched it coming into view for about 4 seconds, and then right back out the way it came in, less than a second later.
We spoke via telephone with the witness, and he sounded to us to be quite sober-minded and serious.  PD

summary: We're sitting on porch at 9 pm when a total of six orange glowing objects appeared/disappeared for an hour.  Each sighting 10 min apart
description:
We were sitting outside Looking out on beach horizon at 9 pm and initially we noticed two glowing orange balls in the sky.  They glowed and then like a light went out.  
The next time another orange glow appeared over to the right of the horizon, still over the ocean. It too glowed for five seconds and went out.  
About ten minutes later, to the left of the ocean horizon, another blinked on that orange glow and then subsequently went off. 
After that point,about 10 minutes later right in front of the beach house,another orange glow appeared and then turned off.  
Here is where all 7 of our mouths fell open.  Back to the the left of the ocean horizon six orange glows appeared in a diagonal line.  
Each came on separately stayed lit and then one by one it turned each orange glow off.  It was truly the most unbelievable event I have ever seen.  One last glow was seen again directly in front of the beach house.
We suspect the correct date is July 14, not June 14, and we have changed the date above.  We are awaiting confirmation on the date from the source.  PD

summary: Very bright light near sundown.
description:
My wife and I were traveling home around 8:45 that evening when I spotted a very bright light in the northwest sky.  As it was still fairly light out this object really caught my attention.  It seemed to be moving in a southeasterly direction, but the speed was hard to judge since it was moving toward us.
After about 20 seconds I pointed it out to my wife, and she said she had just noticed it as well.  I asked her what she thought it might be, and neither of us had any idea.  About 1 minute after I had first seen it, the object just disappeared.  It didn't seem to have turned or changed altitude, it was just suddenly gone.
I was not able to see any auxiliary lights or blinking lights either when the light was visible OR in the area it had been after it disappeared, leading me to believe it was not an aircraft of any kind.  There was also enough daylight left that if it were a helicopter they would have no use for a spotlight as it wouldn't illuminate the ground any more than the ambient light was, especially from the height it was at.
About 5 minutes after the object disappeared, I noticed that some stars were starting to be barely visible, so I'm positive that what we saw wasn't…

summary: Glowing Red-Orange Sphere sighted in Greenwich, Ct.
description:
My friend & I were walking our 3 dogs in a baseball field next to the Western Junior High School in Greenwich, Ct.
I often like to look at star formations and on this particular night when I looked upwards I saw a glowing, bright red-orange sphere.  My friend noticed it too.  My friend thought it looked more orange-red (minor matter).
The sphere was approximately 90' in the air from the top of the hill where we were waking and about 100' away.  The sphere moved very slowly across the sky in a straight line.  It proceeded to move behind a large tree that was on the hill and I was curious to keep the thing in my view for as long as possible.
When I ran to the other side of the tree the object vanished into thin air.  Poof!  Gone!  To have seen it so clearly from where we were standing I estimated it to be about 2.5' to 3' around.  It made no sound.  It was not a light projection - it was a solid glowing object.
We had 3 dogs with us and they made no indication of having seen or felt anything untoward.  There were no other people around - no children, no adults it was a totally clear and quiet evening.
I was NEVER a believer in all the UFO stories I heard people talking about,…

summary: Single light appearing before dusk appears to be multiple objects before disappearing
description:
This evening my wife and I were with our 20 month old daughter in our backyard so my daughter could play in her baby pool.  I looked up to see any aircraft visable as we are about 100 miles west of ATL and we usually have good air traffic overhead.
I noticed a light that would be similar to the brightness of Venus directly overhead, but at about 85 degrees, slightly to the west.  I asked my wife if she could see it and she said that she did.  No other lights were visable in the sky and 30 minutes later in the same spot where we witnessed this, there are still no other lights in the sky, including and stars or planets.
The light was stationary as far as we could tell.  At one point I picked up my daughter and leaned her back and asked her if she could see it.  She pointed to the light.  
After 10 minutes, the sun had set over the horizon or behind clouds to the northwest.  The light was no longer there but my wife said that she could still see it.  I could not but as I tried, two aircraft in the area allowed my eyes to focus back on the object.  
At that moment my wife said that there were now 3 objects.  I noticed that the main object appeared doughnut shaped and the other two…

description:

It was nearing dusk when we witnessed them and could not stop on the turnpike.  
When we reached the next exit we turned around and in that time they disappeared.  
There were no visible wires, nor did they move like a drone or some r/c.

summary: Bright orange ball seen rising over Damascus tree-line morning after storm.
description:
Saw a bright orange ball several miles out (about the size of a star), just over the tree line.  I wouldn't have given it much thought it except that it was unusually bright -- a very warm orange.  Then I noticed it was rising.  
After a minute of rising it started to drift to my left what might've been several hundred feet (about an inch from my perspective on the ground).  I was hoping it would dart around but its movement was slow, almost lethargic, albeit not like any aircraft I've seen.  
After what looked like some more swaying about it started to drift up again (about an inch every 5 seconds) before fading out behind a storm cloud.
I've never seen a UFO before.  I was on my front steps having an early morning cigarette.  The sky was a bleak grey patched with left over storm clouds.
I did a few minutes of reading online about Chinese lanterns immediately after seeing the orb and almost didn't write this report.  
Then I realized that we just had a decent storm last night, with very strong lightning that lasted until midnight.  Any Chinese lanterns anyone might've lit for the 4th of July had to have been very durable, or very lucky to survive last night's storm.

summary: 4 glowing red orbs over north central ohio, first one, then a pair in formation, followed by one again.
description:
I was sitting on my back porch, using my tablet, when I saw a single glowing (red) orb cross the sky, traveling from the north west heading south east.  I have seen red orbs like this once before, and suspected it might be a ufo, but was unprepared the first time.  
When the first orb appeared, I watched it dumbfounded for a minute, to see the same object again, then got my wits and went into the house to get my digital camera.  I only caught a smidgen of the first object.  
Then a few minutes later, TWO identical orbs, both glowing red, followed the EXACT same flight path, in the EXACT same direction, at the EXACT same speed.  I got the two in formation recorded, only the first few seconds of it were in focus but they are discerable.  I didn't have the foresight to have the camera on manual focus and as I zoomed in, it drifted out of focus.  
Not long after the pair of orbs vanished, a FOURTH came into view, once again, EXACT same flight path as the previous 3.  I have a much better video of the last orb.  In it, I have the entire flight, from where it first became visible, to when it went beyond where I could see.  
I have both close zoom and I also pulled back to include the…

summary: Light appeared over Lake Norman hovering, moved up and hovered again, headed left at fast speeds and we lost sight of it.
description:
My friend and I were going on a walk and noticed a strange, bright, light hovering over the area of Lake Norman.  The light appeared white in color and extremely bright for the distance it appeared away from us.  Upon further examination, the light seemed to be made of four smaller lights clumped together shining bright enough to appear as one. 
The light hovered in its location for roughly 30 seconds until it moved up about 20 degrees from our PoV and began hovering again.  Note, at this point it was thought that the light was a plane due to its movement speed and the way it moved.  The object, after hovering for roughly another 30 seconds slowly crept left and then began accelerating to a very fast speed which caused us to run across the road to continue seeing it.  We then lost sight of it after it went behind a line of trees that spans roughly 30 feet and then didn't appear from the other side.  I would normally be inclined to say this was a helicopter but if the lights were this bright, then it would be much closer and there would be a sound (there was no sound but the bugs at the time).
Background:  I'm a pretty regular gu,y although I do suffer from pretty intense paranoia…

summary: Bright orange fireball circles around house five times on same, slow path for 15 minutes.
description:
At around 10:50 PM I saw from my second story bedroom windows a bright orange fireball like object moving in a slow, steady path from the West to the East.  I often see various lights from airplanes that are much smaller and moving at a much faster pace, so I paid closer attention and watched it until I lost sight of it.  
I continued to look out my window and then about a couple of minutes later it came around following the same steady path again.  At first glance it appeared to look almost like a chinese lantern, but at a closer look it appeared to be too bright as it emitted beams of light.  
It also had a small bright light trailing behind it.  It made no sound. 
I waited and it went around a third time before I went downstairs to show my mom. Because our house has many windows, we could easily see it for a long expanse.  
When it disappeared from our view, we’d wait a couple of minutes and then we saw it come around twice more.  We witnessed it circling a total of five times and then did not see it again.  The total duration of the sighting was approximately fifteen minutes.

summary: Large white light dipped down toward us, then suddenly and very quickly headed out into space.
description:
Bright white light traveling very slowly at high altitude from north to south.  Directly over head.  
My wife was walking our dog and I was taking out the trash when she pointed directly upward, bringing my attention to a bright light.  The light dipped down toward us, getting bigger in size.  
Then, suddenly, and very quickly, it headed out into space.  My wife and I are both armature ((amateur??)) astronomers and are very familiar with all known aircraft and satellites.   
We're out looking at the sky every clear night.  
The size appeared huge, particularly when it dipped down toward us.  
It was shocking to see it head outward into space.

summary: Meteor/Fireball looking object seen.
description:
Standing outside in Richmond, looking towards the North Shore Mountains, and saw a "fire-ball" looking light.  
At first we thought that it might be an meteor or a plane on fire that was about to crash into the mountain.  
As it moved, a long tail trailed the large "fire-ball" east and suddenly stopped moving for a few seconds and dispersed into two "fire-ball" objects.  
They then started going back west and stopped again and looked to have disappeared.  
The "fire-ball" light had gone and now they started to flicker with a blue and white light. 
They had turned again and traveled east fast and upwards.  It was very strange how it had gone from a large "fire-ball" looking object to a smaller flickering object.  
The whole experience and now knowing that there is something out there is very unsettling.

summary: Five bright orange/red lights, followed by a black object.

summary: Redish/orange sphere seen over Des Plaines Il.
description:
On July 13th, 2014, I took my dog outside for him to do his business, while waiting for him I was looking at the big dipper and saw a red object appeared from the west sky.  It was moving at a steady pace heading in an easterly direction.  It got larger as it passed much like the space station would (witch I’ve seen many time’s) and vanished as the space station would. 
The object was an orange red color with yellow around the outside of it.  After the object passed a second object the same as the first appeared from the west a little further north of the first and traveling in the same manor.  Both object’s made no noise of any kind, I could hear the sound of an airplane traveling northbound due west leaving O’Hare airport, but that was the only sound I could hear.  Both object
’s took about 10 to 12 second’s each from the time I seen them to pass over head. 
I’ve lived in my house since 1987 just north of O’Hare airport and know the difference between an airplane,  Helicopters, and the space station going over our home.  
I have never seen anything like this in my 58 years on this earth.

summary: UFO over Lake Havasu City, Arizona at around 19:57 Pacific time.
description:
We were filming a magnificent rainbow, and shortly afterward, a "craft" appeared.  I saw a red light, which then transferred into a clear larger round shape.  It was as it the object was moving forword towards me. 
I heard the neighbors talking about it too, each of us wondering what it could be (Military? Drone?) --we are, afterall in Arizona's desert where a lot of military goes unnoticed. At any rate, the craft hung there, not moving at all.

summary: We are not alone, neither should we fear.
description:
My mom and I went to eat outside, in front of ((name deleted)) supermarket.  When all of a sudden at a distance (west) approx 15 small orange lights appeared slowly heading towards the clouds.

I had to walk further in the water to keep it in sight so the trees weren't blocking my view. 
Within a few seconds it was no longer visible at all.  I found this strange because of how slowly it was descending. 
This was the strangest thing I have ever witnessed in my life.

summary: Orange and red circular fireball object traveling north about Interstate US Route 26.
description:
I was driving south on US Route 26, nearing exit 19, when I noticed a circular orange ball in the sky, traveling northeast.  It flew directly over me while I was traveling on the interstate.  
At first I was not concerned about the sitting, but a truck was pulled off onto the right median and they were looking up and over there shoulder and pointing at the object.  
I veered off the interstate and started driving north on North Roan Street.  The object appeared to flash red at times, but this was not the same red light that flashes on an airplane.  It seemed to be circling back south.  
I proceeded to my destination, and watched as the fireball moved out of site to the north.  I probably wouldn't have posted this if it wasn't for the truck that was parked on the median also looking at the same object.  
I would estimate that it was two to five thousand feet in the air and had no sound at all.

1 set moved from the southwest toward the northwest.  This set was only visible for about 15 seconds before being blocked by the tree line.
All 4 moved at the same speed and were visible for the entire time.  They did not make a sound and were visible at orange / red spheres the entire time.
There was no visible trail behind any of them.

The direction was strange because there are no planes or anything that I’ve ever saw travel in that direction.  
It was very high up, but I don’t believe it was in space, because the light was rather large, and a little bigger and definitely much brighter than any airplane. 
When the light/object was almost directly over my head, the light suddenly went out.  I didn’t see anything anymore.  
It was a clear night tonight, so I should have been able to see something moving, but nothing – it just vanished! 	I do see strange stuff out here in the desert once in a while, when I go out at night, but most of it I never report.

We thought it was a comet or shooting star but it was too low for that.  Also no trail or smoke and it appeared to maintain a constant speed.  Imagine an object going from one end of the sky to the other in 3-4 seconds!  
Also as it moved past I noticed a slights green and blue hue.  
I've seen plenty of shooting stars and this was not a shooting star or a satelite (it was low).

At first I thought it might be a plane, the lights being one on the wing and the other on the tail, but that got dismissed based on the speed and height at which they were both traveling.  Much too low to be an aircraft.  Then it struck me that neither one made any noise at all despite how low and fast they went.  Next thing I knew they disappeared altogether.
I may have thought I was crazy, but I looked over and the old man loading his groceries next to me turned white, jaw dropped and he quickly got into his car and sped away.  He looked terrified.

Quickly, we saw a second bright light behind the first light.  
When it passed by the tree tops near our deck, we saw an entire structure.  It was a long cylinder, as long as a large jet.  It was silver in color and we could see no windows.  
The bright lights were on both ends of structure.  
As my husband put his binoculars up for a better look, it turned up and moved north-west and disappeared.  
For a structure as large as what we saw, to move upward that quickly, seemed impossible.

When it was passing in front of me, it split into 2  of these.  As I watched fly by, it suddenly disappeared.

Suddenly, I spotted an object at my 1030 position, traveling from east to west.  It was about twenty degrees above the horizon.  It was emitting a very bright white light.

As it moved to my 1 o’clock position it split into two bright lights.  The objects began to separate from each other and then they immediately disappeared.  The first object appeared to be the size of a tack head, if held at arm's length.  Then when they separated, they appeared to be the size of a pin.
