summary: Two adjacent red lights hovering and slowly rising and descending over Fort Rock Farm in Exeter NH
description:
Three adults and one teen were at the fireworks in Exeter, tonight (I was one of the adults). The fireworks were over the river.  We were by the car parked across the street from the river, in front of Fort Rock Farm.  Fort Rock Farm was behind us, as we were facing the river. Fort Rock Farm has been abandoned for years, without any lights on at all tonight.  
One of the adults, my son, pointed behind me and said, "What's THAT?"  The other three of us turned completely around and looked.  Hovering over the back of the field of Fort Rock Farm, were two red lights positioned opposite one another, like car headlights, but closer together.  The lights hovered up high (possibly rising a bit) and then the lights began to very slowly descend until they disappeared.  They made no sound at all.  It was too dark to see anything.  
Although there are R. R. tracks behind the farm, there was no train going by.  There was no reflection of any fireworks.  I kept checking back, when the fireworks were going off, and there was no reflection at all behind us of the fireworks. 
During the event, I had a camera in my hand, but was so shocked by what I was seeing and by trying to make sense of it,…

summary: Two large, bright lights traveling east to west extremely fast and just disappeared.
description:
I was sitting on my front porch and looking to the South, two very bright "circles", one on top of the other about 3 feet apart, came from the East and were traveling extremely fast to the West.  The two "circles" were traveling parallel to the ground.  
They were about the size of a volleyball, and were a very bright white/light.  They weren't flashing or blinking at all, there wasn't a sound, then the one on top accelerated, the one on bottom appeared smaller, then the one on bottom "caught up" with the one on top and they seemed to touch, the one on top appeared to travel "up" slightly then it vanished, at the same time the one on the bottom just disappeared.

summary: Two bluefish greenish lights traveling very low, no sound at all, very high speed observed near La Centera mall in Katy, TX.
description:
As I was leaving a restaurant in the La Centera shopping area in Katy, I noticed two greenish bluish lights.  The lights appeared to be traveling unusually low to the ground at a speed which seemed in excess of what any plane or jet could achieve.  
Couldn't tell if it was one or two crafts. 
Two other persons (daughter and father perhaps, I did not know them) walking in the parking lot also saw same lights and also thought the lights were very strange; they remarked how it could not be a shooting star. 
The way it was traveling low and fast with no sound was somewhat unsettling, particularly in contrast to the airplanes and jets which frequently fly through this area.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Fast moving lights moving from E to N.
description:
Solid white light moving fast from E towards NE and then N.  Moving much faster than an airplane, with no noise.  Somewhere in the middle (around NE), one light turned into two, and then later on both disappeared.
Travelled from due E to due N in about 30 seconds.  Too fast for airplane, and too horizontal to be a meteor.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Intense bright white light.
description: A bright light like HD flighing at a very high speed from south to north for about 30 seconds and suddenly disappear in front of my eyes at a high speed.

summary: lights made no sound and were close enough to see the details/shape
description:
One bright light dropped out of the sky like a falling star then it stopped for a second, then began flying from east to west. 
After a few seconds it appeared to change shape and split into two then within 1-2 seconds the lite craft disappeared into thin air.
We believe a correct time for this event is 21:05 hrs., and we have amended the time above.  PD

summary: Bright red, yellow and white round light, hazy, long yellow tail, high rate of speed, observed by Police Officer, S of Houston, TX..
description:
Date: 07/12/2014 Time:2105 hrs Duration: 5-8 seconds Sighting city: Pearland Sighting state: Texas Zip: 77581 County: Brazoria County Witness: 1 Shape: Round and hazy, possibly a cluster.
Number: 1 or 3 grouped together.
Description: Round, hazy, red, white and yellow, bright lights with a long tail, extremely high rate of speed.
I reside in a suburb located about 20 miles south of Houston, Texas.  There is quite a bit of light pollution in my area, coming from Houston to the north, and a small baseball field to the east, so star gazing is minimal.  There is a small, private airport, about 3/4 mile SW of my location.  Approximately 5 miles NE is Ellington Field, a former AFB, and still a current NASA facility.  My neighborhood is full of trees, which partially obscured my vision of what I have just seen.
At 2105 hrs, I was in my front yard, speaking with a family member on my phone, facing north.  Out of the corner of my eye I saw movement in the sky, and turned to see what it was.  
I observed a multi-colored, red, yellow and white, brightly lit object, moving at a ridiculously high rate of speed, coming from the SE, and traveling almost due NW, or right to left for me.  This…

summary: Brilliant, fast yellowish white light split into 2 lights (red and yellowish-white) over Austin, then both vanished.
description:
Was watching planes land from porch around sunset, and saw a bright white/yellow light going SW over Austin (towards me and going slightly right to left).
Was going faster than an airplane, but much, much brighter.  And silent.
It suddently split into 2 bright lights--one red and one light.  ((sic.  "white light"))   About 1 second later, both lights disappeared into thin air.
We believe a more accurate time would be 21:05 hrs., if the witness saw the same object seen by many others in Texas.  We have amended the time above.  PD

summary: Two white round objects flying at a high rate over Lake Conroe, Texas.
description:
Two white objects, like white round lights, flying at a very high rate of speed from one side of the sky to the other side, over Lake Conroe Texas in a matter of two to three seconds.  
The two white objects were close together, but not always parallel with each other so they appeared to be independent objects.  There was no noise, like we would experience if a plane was flying overhead.  And they were much faster than a plane.
They did not have a trail like a meteor or a shooting star.

summary: A bottle rocket type look that shot across the sky and then split and into 2.  Each were neon green in color
description:
It looked like a bottle rocket at first.  It maintained the same fast speed at the same height above the earth's surface. 
It was about 220 feet above the tree tops.  It then split in half and made 2 of a green ball of some sort.

summary: bright circle light spiraling across the entire skyline took about 10 seconds didn't resemble a shooting star
description:
My wife and I were returning home on Saturday night as I noticed a round light in the sky.  The light seemed to be rotating in spiral form while crossing the sky.  It appeared to be going south to north.  
I stared in disbelief not sure if I wanted to say anything my wife said, "Did you see that?!". 
Glad she saw it as well we laughed and giggled the rest of the way home wondering what it was.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Ufo?
description:
I was outside talking on the phone, when at the time 21:00 hrs I seen this blue fireball looking craft with white tail stream.  
It did not have any sound it looked as if it were flying straight over the river to Monkey Island.  
At that point the craft zoomed away and faded out of sight over Monkey Island.  
This craft was traveling very fast and was below the clouds.

summary: Light sped across the night sky.
description:
Too fast to be a standard passenger airplane.  Had to have been military (if it was of this planet).  
But did not make any jet/plane noises.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: The object was sighted west of Bastrop, Texas, and was: metallic in color, aerodynamic in shape, about 20 or 25 feet in length, had a light at each end, made no sound at all, and was flying about…
description:
This cylinder was flying so fast it was over the horizon in less than 10 seconds.  I have never seen anything fly this fast as it ascended and gained altitude.  I presume it had landed and was taking off.  
There were no propellors, rotors, wings, or jet pods.  
Although the sighting was only seconds long, I got a good look at it, and another man in a white suv was  staring with his mouth open in apparent near shock.  
This is what I saw, and I'm going back out tonight and observe the area again which is cow and horse pasture land.  
This is all for now.
Date not indicated by the source, but we believe he is addressing the dramatic event of July 12, 2014.  We have amended the date.  PD

summary: 2 EXTREMELY fast flying objects over Wylie, Texas.
description:
Headed south on 78 before Brown St. in Wylie, Texas.
Saw 2 extremely fast, low flying objects with lights, no sounds.
Eventually dissipated.  Objects were on a very level flight plan.
A commercial plane was flying in the background of them moving at the pace of a slug compared to these objects.

summary: 2 white triangles appeared on the sky heading east to West.
description:
Flying low and very fast. 
Disappeared I'm cloud cover.  
Lots of jet activity following sighting.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 7/12/2014 at 9:00pm Two Flashing white lights with round shape sphere UFOS  traveling fast.
description:
I saw two flying UFOS with bright white lights flashing traveling very fast.  Their shape was round with a sphere across it.  Both UFOS were traveling parallel to each other.  
They both flew in front of my house they traveled diagonally going towards of the side of the neighborhood roads.  They were traveling about 15 ft to 25 ft above the height of the houses.  
This is my second time seeing a UFO.

summary: A light streaked across the sky fast from east to west.
description: On July 12, 2014, I was fishing on Cypress Lake in Benton, LA.  Around sunset, approximately 2100, a light streaked across the sky from one end of the lake to the other.  It was very fast white light.  I think the direction was east to west.

summary: Red&white fast moving lights over Bryan, Texas
description:
Sitting in back yard, looked up and  thought it was a low flying plane or helicopter but there was no sound.  Moving very fast from east to west.  Bright red and white lights.  
Stood up from chair to follow it over my roof, then it split into two parts, one going north and other going south, then lights went out and could no longer see them.  
Somebody else had to have seen this.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Two bright lights moving east to west at an extremely fast rate of speed across Austin, TX, sky at around 9pm, 7/12/14.
description:
We were on our deck to observe the Super Moon and then we saw out of the east (looking north) a light that at first appeared to be an airplane heading from east to west.  
But then we noticed it was traveling extremely fast, no sound.  It covered a very long distance in a very short period of time.  
It then split into two lights and they appeared to head in slightly different directions. Then they were gone.  Have never seen anything like it. It did not have a tail. No sound.
I saw a report from someone in Paris, Texas, who saw the same thing, but they noted they were looking south.  We were looking north.  
Perhaps this event happened between Austin and Paris, TX.

summary: Fiery Orange Hovering Object.
description:
My husband and I were sitting in our back yard, just before dusk.  Some bright fiery light caught my eye in the sky to the east.  I watched this object move very slowly move from east to west.  It was hovering just below the clouds.  It was a very odd cylinder shape and extremely bright orange lights or fiery flames.  
As the flames died down, the object moved to a northern direction.  It hovered high in the sky for approximately 3 or 4 minutes and then it slowly moved straight up, vertically, out of our view with no lights.  The whole event was truly shocking, and lasted about 7-10 minutes.  The object would have been approximately over Route 11 north.

summary: I stepped outside to smoke a cigarette when I noticed a large, metallic/white, cigar shaped craft with no wings and no chemtrail.
description:
I ran inside and told my friend to come look.  He stepped out with me and in a matter of seconds we watched it leave Earth.  
Moments after, we saw a real airplane with wings and chemtrail.  
It happened to fast for us to get images or video.
We have corrected the time originally indicated by the witness.  We spoke via telephone with him, and he indicated that the sighting occurred during the evening.  PD

summary: Garland Texas 7-13-2014 Ufo spotted near laprada and 635
description:
At 8:30, my son and I were walking near Laprada and 635 this craft was only a 100 feet off the ground.  It was triangular shaped with 3 white lights, and a green light in the middle.  It cloaked itself and took off at a very high speed and disappeared.  A neighbor that was near saw it also.  
So we were not losing our minds at what we saw.  My name ((male's name deleted))  I don't care if you know my name.  
I did not believe they existed, but oh yeah they are here people.  
And my question is why they hide like that.  Anyone  else seen the same thing contact me at ((address deleted)).  
Thanx

summary: brightest fastest thing i have ever seen in the sky, around lafayette, la area.
description:
the sky was grey just after sunset. was heading back to Lake Charles from baton rouge after taking a state test. was on the phone with a friend and I saw it.  It was so bright and so fast it was unreal.  
There was a thin cloud horizontally it was maybe 6" thick in my view but probably quite large in reality.  I saw it for about one second going so fast into the cloud and a split second later was on the other side of the cloud and within 2 to 3 seconds later it was out of the atmosphere.  I could tell that it wasnt following the curvature of the earth.  Instead, it faded into the atmosphere.  
I really cannot stress how fast and how bright this thing was.

summary: Round red/orange flashing lights hovering over the Gulf near the shoreline then started moving upward on a straight line and suddenly disappeared.
description: The sky was clear and the flashing lights were vivid.

summary: White light pulsed bright and then faded away rather quickly.
description:
Saw a white light heading South in the Eastern sky.  
It pulsed bright and then faded away rather quickly.
Possible flare from Iridium satellite??  PD

summary: Silver circular-shaped flying saucer hovering Chesapeake Bay
description:
I was driving over the Chesapeake Bay Bridge, paying attention to traffic ahead of me, of course.  But as I was approaching the end of the bridge, something silver and bright nearly blinded me to the right just over the bay.  I was unsure of what it was at first.  
As I focused on it a little harder I couldn't believe what I was seeing.  Of course no one else was in the vehicle with me except my 1 yr old daughter who probably couldn't see it, yet remember what she was seeing.  I took my eyes on and off to pay attention to cars in front of me but I am 100% sure of what I saw.  
It was a circular-shaped silver flying saucer hovering over the bay water.  It had a clear center sort of shaped like a bubble.  
It hovered over the water about 1-2 minutes until changing its direction, then disappearing behind a building.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Fast orange light pulsating and then disappearing in Tacoma.
description:
Scatterings of clouds on relatively warm night.  Facing the water in Waterfront in Tacoma. Facing west.  Looking up in sky and see an orange light.  
Tell 1 other person, and note that the light doesn't seem like a airplane.  The other 2 people are told by the person I told first.  
Watched it go fairly quickly as diagonally across sky towards a thin cloud.  
The light stops in middle of the very thin cloud and pulsates twice before disappearing.
Witness corrected date of July 12, 2014.  We have altered it above.  PD

summary: Objects flew straight up made a loop and then straight up and gone.
description:
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
The object in question was like a bright fireball. My wife and daughter saw it as well and could not identify the object. As it moved further away it looked as if sparkles of bright lights fell from it. This happened twice this morning an hour apart.
((END ADDENDUM))
We have amended the date to July 12th, 2014.  PD

summary: Odd light twinkle
description:
It was about midnight and I wanted to see the supermoon at its fullest and needed to water my garden, I went to turn on the outside water and something felt a little eerie, I looked up and to the North and I saw what I describe as a twinkle like the end a meteror but as soon as I focused on it, it went black.  
I didn't feel excited or happy, it made me feel scared.  I watered my plants in a hurry and still felt uneasy about it.  It was probably less than 50 yards above me.

summary: Eye-catching white light making strange circles in sky appearing as if it were flying behind clouds
description:
Saw a white light that caught my eye flying in a big circle.  
It was odd so I texted my sister and when she walked out the light was flying in another circle a little farther back from where it was previously circling. 
We couldn't find any solid info or facts about what it could be but have seen evidence of others seeing the same light or lights making the same weird circle(s).

summary: Large fiery orange ball/cylinder of light hovering for 4-5 minutes near Lake Erie on the west side of Cleveland Ohio
description:
I was out looking at the moon because I had heard tomorrow was supposed to be a super moon.  
Out of nowhere, the bright orange light appeared.  Small at first, but I thought maybe it was a planet (saturn, venus)and that the clouds moved away.  But the orange light grew bigger, then hung in the sky right in front of my house, above some pine trees.  If I had to estimate the distance, it was probably about where a helicopter would fly.  
The orange light was like a fireball so I thought maybe it was a meteor but it didn't move.   It also looked like it had an orange light beam coming from it.  Its shape was almost like that of a flood light, like square cylinder shape but fiery orange. 
I ran to get my camera, and of course, just like on tv shows, my camera froze.  It gave me a creepy feeling, like it was observing me.  
I then noticed it started to shrink, but then realized it wasn't shrinking, it was heading west. It had to have been moving quickly to shrink out of site! that fast.  
I am about 4 blocks from Lake Erie and it was heading west.  I just didn't feel right, didn't seem like a natural phenomenon.  Very strange and uneasy feeling..

summary: Bright Fireball in the night sky.
description: I was sitting outside with a friend and my 7 year old daughter when my friend pointed out something in the sky moving at a slower speed it looked as if it was on fire could have been a plane on fire but there were other planes in the distance that it could not be it went right over us and continued until it just hovered then disappeared my daughter was so afraid she was crying as she nor i nor my friend could make it out never seen anything like it in my whole life was pretty scary I'm am really upset that i didn't get it on video or get a picture all devices were in the house i didn't want to miss one second because i just couldn't believe my eyes.

summary: I was standing on my portch takeing pictures of the moon.  I was useing my camera on my phone.  I have a Samsung Galaxy S 3 phone.
description: I zoomed in to get a closer look, and noticed two to three planet like objects around the moon.  One was a redish color, one was a greenish color, and the one I could not make out the color.  They moved around the moon.

summary: Several orangish orb-like lights appeared in succession and flew a distance and then turned off their lights one by one.
description:
Several orangish orb-like lights (6-7) appeared in succession and flew a distance and then turned off their lights one by one as they progressed, often by becoming dimmer and flicking.  No sounds were made.  
This is the second potential ufo sighting that I have seen, though the former was much different, with lights engaging in a sort of triangle-like formation with an additional barrel/molecule-like item.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Three people dumbfounded!!!!!!!!!!!!
description:
Flying Very fast, under the moon.  Was seen three times by three people.  the third sighting the fireball was .75 of the way gone went black looked like a rock still going.  
Each time seen it came from the same flight path.  North to the south east.  
We all saw other planes flying and could be seen crystal clear and they all had strobes.  
The sky is clear and a full moon.

summary: Black triangular object with red/ blue small lights, and a large spotlight-like light. Motionless and soundless.
description:
Driving home on Westbound 69 and saw triangular shape above treeline.  The object did not move like a normal aircraft would.  
Phones froze when we tried to take pictures (iPhone 5s).  
There were blue and red lights on the side as well as a large white light. 
When directly under the unidentified object, we noticed the object was large and hovering without any noise. 
The object remained in rear view mirror until we went around a curve.

summary: Orange silent fireball.
description:
Orange fire ball, some red twinkling, SE to NW, one came and then a minute later, a second one appeared following exact same path.  
Disappeared into distance, completely silent.  Estimate 5000 ft. altitude.   
Maintained level altitude, and each followed exact same path.  Moved fast.

summary: Orange fireball going up and across sky - no sound.
description:
Orange fireball moved upward and across sky then fizzled and went out in heavy clouds.  
No sound was observed, was definitely NOT an airplane or helicopter

summary: I saw 2 groups of white dots in formation across the night sky and they faded and disappeared in the exact same spot.
description:
I was with my friend enjoying a night sitting outside.  We saw 2 separate groups of UFO' s that both traveled in the same pattern.  
There were 7 in the first group.  They appeared in perfect consistent formation traveling  across the sky.  They were dots of light.  No blinking and they were not airplanes.  
They then faded and disappeared.  The second group had 4, moved exactly like the first and disappeared in the same spot as the first.  
I took a photo and my preview showed that I captured it, but when I went to retrieve it it was solid black.   No images at all.

summary: 2 objects appeared dim in the sky, movements and color patterns occurred within the span of 2 hrs.
description:
Two objects appeared dim into the sky.  One object dimmed out and disappeared and later made an appearance closer to the other object. 
The two objects moved farther away from each other and soon started blinking yellow, green, blue and red as they were moving farther and farther away as they disappeared in the span of about 2 hours.

summary: 8 orange lights hovering, then taking off straight up one at a time.
description:
3 orange lights were seen in a wide triangular position, then one headed east, then took off straight up and disappeared, then the next, then the next.  
Soon, we saw another coming and it did the same thing... then another.  There were 8 in all.  It lasted about 20 minutes.  
It was directly above the golf course on Muddy Creek Road in Bridgetown, which is a suburb of Cincinnati, Ohio.  
There were teens playing at the adjoining tennis court that were talking about it too but we did not get their names.

summary: Bright blue and red object flying forward and backward, side to side and making huge circles.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Red glowing balls of light moving quickly from north to south
description:
Three orange balls moving from north to south moving very quickly.  At one point the first hovered in the same spot for approximately 30 seconds before moving again.
This was followed by at least two others that followed the same path.

summary: I was sitting outside in the yard and I spotted a bright light in the sky, and the light appeared to be very low to the ground.  It was not a shooting star because it would have burned out quickly.
description:
The bright light was silent as it passed over, I continued to watch for any signs of a crash.  To me it appeared as an airplane entering back into the atmosphere.
We wonder whether the sighting occurred on Saturday, July 12th, 2014, but we have no means of contacting the witness, who elects to remain totally anonymous, and who provides no contact information.  PD

summary: blinking red green and led white light hovering moving slow and extremely fast when leaving and large.
description:
My friends and I were coming home from a camping trip.  As we were driving, I happened to notice an interesting air craft.  It was blinking red and greenish lights, it had appeared to disappear quite quickly.  For fear of my friends thinking I was crazy I kept it to myself.  
As we were pulling into the parking lot of our complexes, it had returned to my sight this time it was close and slow moving.  My friends in the car happened to see it at that point it was quite large bit at this point was shining an led square shaped like light and hovered in one spot for a good min or so. 
Later that night, I went to Wegmans with a friend.  As we were driving, I told her about what had just happened, and coincidentaly there it was.  
We followed it not about a half an hour we noticed that it was circling around Liverpool.  It would make these sharp right turns that are physically impossible for a human made craft such as a plane. 
This experience is extremely life changing and to me it's a blessing to have seen something of this intelegance!  I hope to see this craft again so I can possibly get a picture to share with you! 
Stay safe out there!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous;…

summary: 5 Bright orange lights that disappeared out of nowhere in Carlton/Cloquet MN
description:
I was driving to work, when I saw what appeared to be 4 bright orange lights appear out of no where.  
Being curious, I drove to a nearby side road and recorded on video 3 bright orange lights.  Though my camera sucked at the video and doesn't show them nearly as bright as they were in person, you clearly see 3 bright orange lights, two of them disappear out of no where, and then a 4th and 5th light come from a set of trees.  
As the video rolls on, you can really only see 4 as the 5th one was kind of far from the camera and can't really see it.  
When I stopped recording because only one light was left, I took off in my car and drove to a nearby soccer field.  I got out and looked every where for even a glimpse of an aircraft and saw nothing.

summary: Red and green lights and spinning quick movements in a crowded place.
description:
We were at a carnival and I looked up and I saw a diamond/rectangle shaped aircraft.  It was about 10,000 feet in the air and it had about 4 lights that flickered (in no pattern or sequence) red and green.
The aircraft hovered and then made very fast movements back and forth, it also made spinning movements.  The spinning, quickness, spontaneity of the lights and closeness to the ground ruled out any possibility of this being a plane or helicopter.
Not many people saw it because no one made a big deal but I alerted my friend and she also agreed that it was like nothing she had ever seen before.
After about 10 minutes of scoping the 1 mile radius, the aircraft seemed to just disappear.

summary: Bright star-like light in daylight, like Jupiter but much brighter.  Viewed by me for 10 seconds.  Not moving, faded into nothing.
description:
Hello,  
In the sky to the south west while driving home I saw a light, like a star but much brighter.  It was a clear evening, very few clouds and being around 7.30 to 8 pm, it was still very much light.  The "star" was white and seemed to be at least double the size of how Venus or Jupiter would look on a clear winters night, yet this was in daylight.
I'm an educated man and have an interest in astronomy.  I said to my partner who was sitting in the car next to me, I think Betelgeuse has gone supernova.  I was so excited and couldn't believe it.  I tried to show her where but she didn't see, I viewed it for what seemed like 10 seconds and then over a period of around 1 second it faded to nothing.  I knew then that if a star like Betelgeuse had indeed exploded it should be visible for weeks or months.  I rushed home and put on the news in case there were any reports of such things, there were not.
I mulled this around in my mind that night.  The light was not moving, when it faded there was nothing, no object at all left in the sky.  I found this website and thought I should report it.  I would like to add that I am in my 30 s and have never seen anything like this before.…

summary: Orb appears out of thin air, turns into UFO in San Diego.
description:
To Whom It May Concern, A friend and I were driving towards the beach in San Diego on Friday the 11th of July, 2014.
I was driving over a bridge when I saw something strange in the sky about 1 to 2 miles away towards the beach.  I looked at it for about 30 seconds, while trying to show my friend what I was looking at.  He couldn't see what I was seeing:  a round orb flouting in the sky.  It wasn't anything recognizable, i.e. plane, helicopter or drone.
I told my friend to take some pictures with his I-phone but he couldn't see what I was talking about so I told him to steer the car while I took the pictures.  I was able to get two pictures through my windshield and one with the window on the driver's side rolled down.
There wasn't a place to pull over and when I finally could pull over the object had disappeared.

summary: Palomar Airport; near collision of object with plane.
description:
I work in a warehouse located in Southern California.  Standard cloudless, blue sky.  
I was looking out of my office window and watched a plane taking off from Palomar Airport, about 5 miles away.  
In that plane's line of trajectory, I observed an object that appeared to fly directly into the path of that plane, but make a sudden 180 degree change in direction before impact. 
As I watched, it disappeared in the blink of an eye. 
The object was silver in color and larger than the plane in my field of view. 
It appeared to turn, hover, then disappear.
Witness provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Looking in the western sky there was a bright silver egg shaped object that was nearly stationary.
description:
After spotting it and watching for 20 seconds, it disappeared.  
Three of us witnessed it.  
No contrails were seen.  
We looked for signs of it after it disappeared but could see none

summary: Extremely fast extremely high flying circle.
description:
Looked up at the blue sky seen a circular thing approximately 60-80000 feet flying a extreme speeds in straight line from east to west.  No vapor trail no sound.  White in colour.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Black red striped organic shape shifting craft
description:
Hello, I'd like to share what I saw today for science.  I live in an apartment where cars are subject to tow so I always need to get up early in the morning to move my car.  I got up and walk to my car to move it which is about 300 feet from my apartment.  
As I was getting in to my car I happened to look up and saw a black object in the sky.  I am used to seeing helicopters and military aircraft in the area since this is north san diego.  But I knew right away something was different about this object.  It was far away enough that it just looked like a baloon.  Luckily enough I had my binoculors in my car which they said 10 x 30 on them.  
As I observed the craft it had an irregular flight pattern.. (going up and down left and right). As I focused in with my binoculors I could tell right away what it was.  There first thing I noticed every now and then on it was it had what appeared to be a set up lights on what appeared to be fins on the craft. 
As I observed it spin, it appeared to be shape shifting and spinning its mass as it was moving with some lights visible.  Once I saw that I started to get excited and look for any other person in the area to point out what I was seeing.…

The light continued from that location for as long as it took to drive to Santa Clara.

summary: 2 Orange Balls hovering over Higgins Lake, MI
description:
I was camping at South Higgins Lake State Park with my family.  Around 12:45am I noticed a bright orange light over the water that wasn’t there a moment ago.  I went to the beach to go look at it with my Mom.  
When we got to the beach, we could see that the object was hovering in the air above the tree line.  It appeared to be the same size and similar shape to a hot air ballon.  The light was so bright and high in the sky that it had a reflection on the water.  
As we watched it, a second one appeared.  They would hover, then combine into one glowing object, and then one would reappear again next to it.  
As we were watching, two other campers joined to stare at the orange fire balls.  I did not know these campers.  We stood there in awe for about 10 minutes as we watched these two balls of light fade in and re appear in the sky.  
Then the two lights sunk below the tree line and left a orange glow for about 30 seconds till the lights faded out.  
There is a military base near by, and there were about 5 to 8 boats on the water that night at 1am.  Those boats were still on the water at 2am, when I finally decided to go to bed.

summary: My companion and I were individually rendered physically and mentally paralyzed at the same time with a similar voice in our minds.
description:
While sitting on a park bench at the campsite off Summit Road in the Ochoco National Forest my companion and I were visited by unknown beings that were talking inside of our minds about performing a brain cavity search.  This event occurred whilst we were in the middle of a conversation and both of us immediately went silent as an unknown voice spoke silently in our minds about receiving access to our mind.
The entire event lasted roughly five minutes, started at the same time, and ended at the same time.  Without any verbal communication we both looked at one another and stated the same confusion as to what just happened while complete paralysis consumed us.
Almost immediately after the event we experienced a large increase in the light being reflected off of the moon that disturbed both of our corneas when attempting to better understand what was happening.
For several hours after the event I kept feeling as though I needed to ground myself electrically as if there was a current running through my body with a heightened attention on my feet.  Sleep was not possible.

summary: At least 100 "moving stars" moving behind unusual cloud cover with unsual Earth vibrations that set the neighborhood dogs howling.
description:
Three family members and three neighbors, none of us acquainted with each other, saw the “moving stars” traveling from NW to E behind unusual cloud cover.  At least a hundred that would alternate between brightening and dimming.  Some moved past each other faster than others, some in formation and some not.  
Lasted for almost two hours.  About an hour into the event a high altitude airplane flew very quickly under the moon on the opposite side of the sky, so we know these lights where not airplanes.  None of the lights made a sound, but the Earth had a strange vibration.  None of the sounds were from a train, a/c unit, or from highway traffic; there is a difference between these vibrations.  Even some of the backyard dogs started barking and howling without any seeming provocation.

summary: Fast moving white light
description:
A bright light flying towards the mound center, close to the ground, moving faster than anything that I've ever seen in the sky before. 
Then it disappeared in mid air.  
It wasn't making any noise.  
It was kind of an ovalish light orb thing.

summary: 3 witnesses and we are not crazy.

The cousin screamed and i ran to the door she was standing on the side porch in rural sc.  As i got to the door, it was approaching fast and stopped about 60 feet away and 80 feet up.  It hovered as clear as day silent as a smooth wind .my wife screams as i have to see what was the commtion.  We watched it watch us for 10minutes solid at least.  I stood dumbfounded and afraid.  Upon the final minute or so it pulls off circular in shape, with light blue lights rounding the edges with a red light emitting from the bottom.  As it left it seemed to grow wings as pass as silently as it pulled up.

What was most notable was that there was “drippings” or embers of fire or what have you from the bottom of the object.  The object then slowed down considerably and continued on its northerly path with the fireball decreasing in size until it completely dissipated.
The second object moved in a relatively similar direction but instead of continuing the same directional course as the first fireball, the second moved upwards in the sky until it slowed to a halt and dissipated.
It should be noted, that there was no noise, smoke, or trails associated with these objects.  To the best of the observers knowledge fireworks were not at play nor could the objects be attributed to flares.

It was not a meteorite because it was way too large, didn't have a tail and didn't burn out.  It was not a plane because it didn't not have blinking lights and there was a plane flying overhead shortly afterwards.  It made a sound like a low thrum.  It made the dogs nervous and they started growling.
The second one came, heading in a different direction, less than a minute after the first one disappeared over the horizon.  It flew overhead and then disappeared, but we could still see the shape blocking out the light of the stars overhead as it moved across the sky.  It was not quite shimmery, but kind of like it looked reflective or see through.  It made the same sound until it went "see through".  Then it was silent.
Very strange!  We tried to film it.  It should have shown on the video as it was so large, but we have no video footage, even though our voices were heard.  The sound did get picked up, however.  We would like to know if any satellite or space debris has been reported breaking up in the atmosphere.  We've never seen anything like it and we…

Very bright in the night sky and was basically on the horizon.  It covered half the sky in about a minute and seemed as though it was reaching orbit.  
I have witnessed many sattallites and this was not one.  My only explanation would be a rocket reaching orbit but there was no sound what so ever.

summary: Me and friends was having a gathering after a funeral and we were all sitting on the front porch when a ufo hovered over our heads

When there was a large moving shadow block the little light we was receiving from the sun it became instantly dark and you can hear the sound of something like a loud generator. The sudden change in light made everyone look up and we all witnessed colorful lights glowing red, blue, then green. It was like what ever it was it was on the other side of the clouds we couldn’t see exactly what it was but there was this generator sound. I was in shock when I was able to pull myself together I reached for my phone to record as it hovered over our heads then it sped off with the sound of like a jet and took the shadow with it and there was light again but immediately the lights of the homes of the residential block including street lights flickered then power was gone then restored minutes later on their own… I made a post on Facebook about my sighting at that moment. but never mentioned it again but I always think about that day

When it went behind the roof tops, we immediately ran towards the Main Street to see where it went and it darted west and it was all but out of sight in a split second. 
This was not a plane or anything that we have ever seen before.

The "on" cycle was about twice as long as the off.  When I first looked up I was facing nearly due west.  If you make west 12 o'clock, I first noticed what I believe a fireball, about a point (the width of a closed fist across the knuckles) above and west of the 3/4 waxing moon.  The object was traveling roughly the same path the moon will follow as it drops towards the western horizon.  
The object was not streaking like a shooting star and there as no tail. It was moving slow enough that when it passed behind the neighboring house to the south of mine I was able to take 3.steps to my right to see more of the trajectory as it cleared the neighbors.  The flashing…

summary: 1 round orange fireball! HUGE, no noise. Over winooski VT 10:17pm 7/9/2014, 2 witnesses.

Object looked like a giant fireball.

1 object, No noise coming from flying object. Looked exactly like an orange fireball about 1/4 the size of the almost full moon.

It lasted 2-3 minutes and then just disappeared. 2 people saw this. Appeared out of nowhere and disappeared the same way.
It was low to the ground, not as high in the sky as an airplane or jet and had NO noise at all. Not even a little bit.
I'm scared to death! I never believed in aliens before but now I'm wondering..I already know we sound crazy!  I just hope more people report this sighting.

summary: Car headlight like lights lit us up from the sky.
description: My grandmother and I were sitting on the tailgate of her truck in the front yard. We were watching the dogs play before bed. It was summer and the sky’s were clear. It was a generally peaceful night. There was no noise or warning of the lights, but out of nowhere we are lit up by headlight like lights in the sky. They were generally close to the ground close enough for us and the ground around us to be lit up. It was 2 lights side by side shining down on us as if it was headlights, but they were above us. The lights turned off within 10 seconds and it was over. I can remember my grandmothers dogs acting strange and running to the door after the phenomenon. We went inside and have never experienced this again. We live in the country and are surrounded by cow pastures and no neighbors. There are no major highways around us only dirt roads, but at that time of night we have no one coming down the roads.

summary: I was on my deck looking at the stars.. Saw a "star" moving rapidly and in a right to left motion.  I thought it was a plane..

I was on my deck looking at the stars..  Saw a "star" moving rapidly and in a right to left motion.  I thought it was a plane.  Though, thought It is VERY high for a plane..  
Watched for at least 30 minutes as a very bright light seemed to jig jag across the sky in a forward motion.  Moving left to right and then rejoining at points with a "mass" of light,  and then separating as if it was "Refueled" by the white mass accompanying it.   It then continued to move forward in a jig jag motion., like a fish might swim.
At one point a red object/light seemed to rush passed the white light mass, at which time the white light stopped moving completely as the red mass moved passed it (rocket?).  I was judging movement against a tree limb hanging above my head.
I am not nuts, drunk or otherwise incapacitated. With what is going on in this world,  I thought- it is important to report.
I can be reached.
This was really odd..  Definitely not a star or a plane and the masses were symbiotic.

summary: flashing white and red light in the sky over williston VT
description:
At 9:15 pm on the east coast, i stepped outback onto my porch in Williston Vermont.  As i looked ahead just above the tree line i noticed a flashing light. it was white, then red, then back to white, back to red, so on and so forth.  
At first i thought it was a plane far away because of the flashing lights, but after a second i noticed that it wasn't flying in a line, it was changing its direction very radically, it went from the right side of me towards the left, then went up, back towards the right, and then it was just gone. 
I sat and watched the part of the sky i had seen it in for about a minute more, thinking maybe it had just gotten blocked from sight by the clouds in the sky.  but i never saw it again.

from the distance i was at it seemed to only move a few inches in the sky. the entire time i saw it was no more then fifteen seco! nds.

I pointed it out to my cousin, and we both watched it. After about 10 seconds, another one approached very quickly and aligned itself beside what I believed was a satellite. Once the second object arrived, they both started moving very slowly, which was unusual. They maintained the same speed for around 5 seconds. About a month ago (this is 8/11/14), I saw an object in the sky that caught my attention.  We live in Santa Rosa, CA, and about 3 miles from the airport.  It was about 9:00 pm, the sky was dark, no fog.

I laughed at myself, thinking ‘oh sure, you just want to see a ufo.  I got my husband to look at it.  I kept track of it for about 20 minutes- it’s possible that it moved a tiny bit, but when you are staring at something like that you can be fooled, so I don’t know. 
It also seemed to maybe have some periodic flickering colors on the right side. For those 20 minutes it did not change course.  When I went to bed it was still there, same place.
It was south from here, very small.  San Francisco is 50 miles from here, and I supposed it could be in that direction.  I don’t know if I could actually see that far, but it was a dark cloudless night and the object, although very small, was bright.  
I figured the angle was about 50…

description:

We knew it wasn’t a plane as it had none of the regular blinking lights and we could see two planes in the sky to compare it to.  I currently live just a few miles from an airport and see and hear planes up close at night on a regular basis and I have never seen any that looked like this.
As it got closer we could clearly see one very large round dull white light on the bottom front and two more of the same but half the size next to each other behind the large one.  Next to the smaller round lights were two super small dull white blinking lights.

summary: Flickering orange object moving slowly and steadily like a plane

It was very steady as well. Much like a plane.  
It was orange and it flickered.  It would alternately look larger and smaller as the orange glow flickered and it looked just like a fire.  
It continued to move slowly and flicker for well over a minute, maybe two minutes.  I watched it for a while and even tried to take pictures and video the resolution is poor on my phone’s camera.  
Then, after a while, it just winked “out” (quick but not instantly) and then I could barely see it. It now looked like a tiny white dot like a plane that’s very far away. 
The white dot could possibly be a star directly behind where the orange object had been, but it looked like a plane in the distance.

summary: Stationary white light observed by two people for several minutes
description:
Bright, non-flickering white object in sky before any stars were visible. "Star Walk" iPhone program located it in roughly the location of star Dubhe (end of bowl in "Big Dipper").  
Appeared to be stationary during several minutes of observation (we didn't see it appear--it was already visible when we went out on our deck), though there were no nearby visible reference objects for confirmation.  Brightness roughly that of Jupiter, but way too far from the ecliptic to be a planet.  
My wife & I looked away for a few seconds while discussing where our binoculars might be, and when we looked back it had completely vanished,  So, unfortunately, we did not see if it flickered out or vanished in an instant.  
Thought it might be a meteor headed directly towards us, but the brightness seemed too steady for that. We sometimes observe rocket launches from Wallops that appear as stationary spots when headed away from us, but there were none scheduled toda! y that we know of.  
Definitely too little motion over the period of the observation for it to be an ordinary aircraft. Seemed too bright (and stationary) to be a satellite.

The objects hovered perfectly still, I stopped my boat and I could not believe what I seeing, I saw one of these crafts make a maneuver  in a hook type move half way around the other objects at a speed that no man made craft could of possibly do, the objects remained absolutely still for another few seconds then they all started moving very very slow and suddenly dissapeared, the dark cloud was still present but with in mins was totally faded and gone the cloud was not black but almost like a dark storm cloud,

summary: UFO made of lights photographed in Hollywood
description:
I was at Hollywood Forever cemetery in L. A. sightseeing with my husband, when I felt strange and had the sensation that maybe an earthquake was going to take place, and also noticed birds stopped singing.  The trees in the area, which was an empty part of the cemetery with no people and many palms, started to move strangely and bend from the tops as if pulled.  
I felt odd.  I took a picture of the palms and then applied a simple vignette filter to the photo in-camera (Canon EOS 60D) and saved it, not noticing the object at all at the time.
Afterwards, we went to our car, which was a ten-minute walk away, and found the battery completely dead, to the point we had to buy a new one from AAA to start the engine, and the alarm was going off only when switched off/battery removed, which was impossible. 
We went home, and when I downloaded the photo we saw the object.  When we returned home I had severe red sunburn even under my clothes.  Since this day I have had severe sunburn even if I go in mild sun, whereas before I could sunbathe without sun protection.
We now live in Spain but I would like to know what happened.

It moved rather fast across the sky heading from south to north.  I stood watching it for a few minutes trying to figure out its shape.  The shape seemed to be changing.  After about five minutes of traveling across the sky it stopped and appeared to be getting smaller.  
I went inside and grabbed some binoculars.  I was able to get a better look at the shape.  It was a semi circle with two prongs coming out the front.  It seemed to be tumbling but every once in a while it would stop tumbling and you get a clear look at the shape.  It was definitely getting smaller-heading away I can only assume. 
At one point a jetliner passed in front of my binocular view, and the object was way farther than that.
Anybody else see this thing?!?

He put the four ways on and the truck into park. Another vehicle came up behind us, my husband motioned the guy to go around.  The guy stopped, my husband and I got out of our truck, and said to the guy, "What is that?"  He looked out his passenger window, and said, "I don't know man, could be a firework."  Then he drove off.
Several vehicles came and went, while my husband and I observed.  I grabbed the binoculars and looked, the "thing" was cone shaped with what looked liked fire spinning around it...very slow moving, very orange and very bright.  Resembled the search light of a helicopter, it's the only example I can…

My son stepped into the house to tell my wife what we were seeing and as he did a third object appeared.  As he returned to the deck the fouth appeared and we proceeded to watch a fifth and six object arrive. 
All six objects appeared to be on an identical trajectory.  They all seemed to slow at a point when we were looking at them towards the east.  Having been in the Navy they had more of an appearance of missles inflight.  
No noise, no vapor trails.  One did appear to eject a lighted objected at the end of it's run and another appear to be somewhat elongated with lights down the side.  
From time spotted in the southern sky to their burn out or disappearnce to the north took about two minutes each. 
I have seen objects from my deck for the past several years and one similiar sighting just about four or five days before this one.…

Orange glowing fireball over central Alabama.
description:
Was outside when over the horizon appeared an orange glowing object that looked to be on fire.  Moved incredibly fast over the sky.  It looked triangular in shape at first.  Made absolutely no sound.  Looked to be climbing higher and higher before flickering out in the sky.  
Called my wife out to see.  After some research, I don't think this is a chinese sky lantern, which was my first thought.  The speed of the object was incredible.  Eerily consistent with the recent reports on your website.
I have no experience in aircraft or any military experience but I have traveled tens of thousands of miles across the country and have not seen anything remotely like this.  
After doing some quick research it seems a lot of these reports come around July 4th.  Not just this year, but in every year before this.  Again, very strange!

summary: A spherical object, approximately 60' in diameter, moving with jet-like speed and precision.
description:
July 6th around 4pm, I was in the backyard manning the bbq.  During this time of day in Central Florida, the cumulus clouds build and bloom up into the sky.  
So as I flipped burgers I also kept an eye to the sky to watch the building cloud activity.  I noticed a group of black crows flying about as high as I have ever seen them fly, so I was just watching the black crows riding the updrafts I caught sight of what I thought was a dark jet aircraft flying horizontally above the cloud tops.  However, the jet was not what I expected.  Once I started to get a good look at it I became confused.  It was a perfect sphere shape.  A metallic sheen like polished LEAD.  I could not see any wings, just a round sphere object moving like a jet aircraft, straight on a path, then it slowed to nearly a full stop and took an unexpected turn downward tracing the outline of the cloud as it descended thousands of feet.
I was wearing my polarized prescription sun glasses, and again I could not see any indications of wings. There was no noise at all, not a whisper and I was well within distance to hear a prop engine or jet.  When this craft took the downward turn it was diving at a faster speed, then it…

summary: 5 objects in "V" pattern on I-195 East in Massachusetts.
description:
I was a passenger in a car driving on I195 East in (I believe) Seekonk, MA, & what caught my eye were 2 straight white bands across the sky, typically made by airplane fuel.  
All of a sudden, in between those bands & at a great distance, I saw 5 objects in a "V" pattern, then for about 5 seconds (size of the objects looked like "dots" in the sky) glowed briefly (few seconds) as if they were hit by the sunlight & just as I was watching this the 5 objects suddenly disappeared.  
I looked around for about 10-15 minutes to see if I could spot them again, but did not.  
I am not sure what I saw, not sure if any military bases in that area, as objects were at an extremely high altitude, 
I did not hear any sounds or noise from objects either.

summary: 1 big one 9 small ones.
description:
It was partly cloudy.  High clouds and clear sky.  My daughter was at the far end of my gravel pit 1 quarter mile  from my house.  She called me and screamed at me to go outside and look at he sky.  
I went out my back door to the road and saw 6 maybe 7 pinpoint very bright lights in a type of formation.  What got most of my attention was a larger very fast moving "thing" it changed color rapidly and seemed to have lines coming out of the center.  It moved so fast that it was hard to keep track of.  
The other smaller ones held my focus.  They moved very slow.  They did not change color like the larger one but they moved together at the same slow speed spreading slowly away and up into the clouds.  
I waited and watched for about 8 min.  They dropped down out of the clouds again.  All going the same slow speed.  They spread apart again and disappeared.  
SCARY!!

summary: Clarkesville, GA 3 lights flashing red and green float and seem to bounce in the sky
description:
On July 4th, my husband pointed out what seemed to be a very bright star that was flashing intermittently red and green lights.  The object hovered in the sky and seemed to bounce.  It would move up and down and then sideways with no pattern to it and then it darted off. 
After about 20 mins it returned with 2 more that were exactly like it and bounced around some more.  The objects floated in a triangle pattern.  
I took video with my phone but it is not the best quality although you can see the objects flashing of colors.
On July 5th the objects returned only this time they were floating over our house and this time in a straight line.  Two of them darted off after about ten mins which left one bouncing alone.  He vanished after 5 more mins.

summary: Object moving slowly and then becoming stationary in eastern sky in Shelby County, Ky, then speeding away.
description:
Early in the morning of July 6, 2014, an object hovered in the eastern sky over Shelby County, Ky.  It was very bright, glowing almost to a white color and partially turning red at times.  
It would move slowly east and west and then bounce around and become still again.  Once it seemed to break apart and join back together.  It made no sound.
I know where Venus appears in the morning sky and this was not Venus.  Venus appeared at the appropriate time.  From my observation in my back yard it could have been several thousand feet up.  
I viewed it through binoculars, and when it left, it shot across the sky at an incredible speed and was gone.

To its left there were two smaller white lights that we could tell were not stars because they were too big. None of the lights moved, they were all still.
	After maintaining constant eye contact with the object for approximately two minutes, the yellow light began to shrink and in about ten seconds it looked exactly like the other white lights in shape and color.  Still none of the lights moved.  Within one minute, the previously yellow light (now a small white light) disappeared from the sky in one second.  The other two remained at their positions.  About three minutes later, all of the lights disappeared.  The area of the sky where the lights had been seen remained lit up, for no apparent reason, while the rest of the sky was cloudy and dark.

summary: On July 5 at 11:45 p.m., I was with my dogs in the backyard during their potty break because one is scared of fireworks.  I enjoy stargazing & frequently look up while outside at night (my back door…
description:
Moving southwest to northeast in a straight line I was surprised to see what appeared to be a bright red rectangular shaped object with a bright white light in the middle.  The shape was something like a sport skydiver might use, except this rectangular object was moving lengthwise.  I know it wasn't a helicopter (saw & heard the police chopper flying earlier before & after the fireworks show), it didn't look like a plane and I never heard any sounds.  
I moved to the front yard to get a longer view of it and saw my neighbor (retired military, worked on helicopters) so I called him over to look at it.  He was as surprised and puzzled as I was.  He didn't hear anything and saw the same rectangular shape and colors as it was moving away from us.  The object eventually grew dim and disappeared from out sight, the entire episode lasting 1 to 1-1/2 minutes.
I checked the ISS schedule, but knew I wouldn't find it listed as flying by.  I've seen the ISS before & this object was larger/lower in the sky and I could make out a shape vs. the ISS's large all white light image.

summary: Cluster of bright lights moving erratically in San DIego County.
description:
Driving south on the I-15 Freeway just south of Temecula and Fallbrook, CA, approaching the Highway 76 exit.  My husband and I had just entered unincorporated San Diego County when from the car we saw an unidentifiable object in the low sky on the east side of the freeway.
We saw a cluster of between three to five very bright white lights.  The cluster formed a sort of circle, but it changed formation.  The cluster flew erratically over an area relatively low to the ground—this was an area of undeveloped land for the most part.  It would move around, dip down towards the ground, then move upward very fast, then move around again in a formation, kind of dipping and shooting up and making sudden turns, all fairly low to the ground in ways that no plane or helicopter or other flying thing I know of could do.  Certainly nothing of this size.
The lights on this were incredibly bright.  My husband asked if we should turn around at the 76 exit and go back to try and see it again once we passed it.  I didn’t think I could take a picture of it since it was moving so fast and erratically.  My husband said it must be a drone.  I went home and read about drones and none were described like…

This went on for about 20 minutes.  Sometimes it would fly in a straight line and other times it would be flying in a curve.  When it would accelerate from a non-moving position, it would slowly start moving and quickly gain speed, as well as quickly come to a stop.

description:
It happened in July 2014 right after the 4th of July in Olympia, WA.  My girlfriend and I were star gazing in a football field.  She had the sudden urge to leave and then I felt the urge to leave that she did.  We started to head out towards the gate and had to go through the field to get out.  Once we got in the middle of the football field, we were surrounded by figures that kept fading in and out of our vision.  I couldn’t make out any faces, but they were a dark tannish dirt color.  Some were tall and some were short and a bit fatter.  The shorter ones were still taller than me and I’m 5’5.  
We kind of stood in the center of them like we couldn’t move for about 5 seconds and then we bolted toward the gate (It was the only area that the aliens weren’t covering).  We didn’t stop running until we got to the street.  My girlfriend first told me what she saw and it is exactly what I saw.  I also completely forgot about the entire experience for a few years, until I had a dream about those aliens.  Can you give me any closure at all?  
At the time, I believed but wasn’t educated in it, so I didn’t take note of losing time or anything.  Closure would be amazing…

summary: 10 - 15 very bright lights, stationary and some moving very slowly, up, down, right and left.
description:
We went out on our patio, which faces west.  We looked to the south and there were very bright lights against the mountains, which are about 20-30 miles away.  There are only 2 very small towns in that area and we normally see no lights from there. The lights in the center of the group were in a narrow pyramid shape.  There were several lights on each side, outside of the pyramid. 
At first, we thought they were all stationary, but as we watched, some of them would move to the right, left, up or down VERY slowly.  There was no color and no sound.  There was a cloud above and off to the right of the lights and they, one or two at a time, moved up and to the right until they disappeared behind the cloud.

summary: Unidentified flying objects seen from the lake shore at Bay Village, Ohio, July 5, 2014, at approx. 10:30 p.m.
description:
At approx. 10:30-11pm. while looking out of my 4th floor large bay window & skylight that overlooks Lake Erie, I suddenly saw reddish glowing circular objects approaching from the west in pairs of twos and fours.  They appeared to fly around in unison, in a geometric formation of sorts.  
During the twenty minutes I watched as though an entire linear formation cruised by the lake front and seemed to be flying somewhere between as low as 1,000 feet above the lake, to as high as 3,000 feet as they departed moving Northward out over the lake.  
I opened my window to see if I could hear an engine or any sound and there was absolute silence in the sky during the time the objects were visible. 
FYI, I'm a college graduate, the daughter of a retired Neurosurgeon and a 58-year-old mother of of two grown children.  My observations are simply an objective report of my experience.

summary: Amber-red diamond swarm of 4 succsessive sightings, each with infant trailing lights, seen over Lexington, KY.

Four identical and unrecognized lights, amber-red in color and roughly diamond shaped, with the weight of the diamond pointing downward, appeared from the east, on a low approach, less than 90 seconds apart.
These light configurations, shape, and behaviors were unlike anything either of the observers had previously seen.  The lights were at least three times the height of typical commercial air liner lights relative to the apparent altitude and distance, were only made up of one color, amber-red, and did not have any obvious flashing patterns.  We live less than 3 miles from LEX airport and are very familiar with mundane commercial aircraft, helicopter, and private general aviation light patterns, color, and flight paths in this area.
All four diamond lights followed the same flight path.  The flight path approached Lexington from the east-south east and at a low angle over the tree line. summary: Bright orange fireball passing over Central Islip travelling in an East South Easterly direction at approximately 10:30 PM
description:
My friend and I were standing in the street in East Islip, NY, at approximately 10:30 PM last night (July 5th)when he pointed over my head towards the Northern sky and said, Look at that!  What the heck is that?  
I turned around to see what he was pointing at and saw what looked like a single, large orange glowing fireball traveling horizontally across the sky.  We both are very familiar with the appearance of all types of air traffic at night, as he lives a few miles from McArthur Airport and I live right under the approach path for La Guardia Airport.  
We agreed that this was no aircraft that we had ever seen before.  There were no blinking marker lights or any engine sound whatsoever.  It appeared to be a ball of orange colored fire.  
Although we were unable to determine the object's exact altitude, I would estimate it to be around 2500 feet and, for it to travel the distance that it did in 2-3 minutes, it must have been traveling at a speed equal to or greater than large commercial aircraft that I have observed approaching JFK or La Guardia.  
The object continued to glow a bright orange and moved rapidly in an Easterly direction, growing smaller, until it disappeared from…

summary: Slow blue/whte flash at random intervals and random meandering trajectory. heading generally North.
description:
The initial flash was noted in the constellation Orphicus roughly on the celestial equator (that line that appears when you bring up an astronomy program.) on the left side of the constellation.  I was facing generally south, the flash was bluish white similar to an aircraft strobe- only slow to rise to full intensity as each flash varied in intensity and timing after the initial bright flash and most were about 2 seconds in duration.  
Initially I thought it might be Nova (it was almost that bright), but the second flash eliminated that as a possibility.  It was headed generally North on a meandering trajectory after heading West a few degrees that took about 7 to 10 minutes to cover about 30 degrees of the sky overhead.  It was eventually lost in the high thin clouds blowing off an approaching storm North of my location.  
Not a conventional aircraft, no other lighting was visible other than the slow strobe and far too small to be a stray weather balloon.  It is possible it "may" have been a satellite that just lost control, but the meandering path, which did head due west for a few degrees early in it's trajectory suggests otherwise.  
No noise, no contrail.  No aircraft in…

summary: 2 very fast moving soundless bright red lights heading SE over quebec city at 22:15 saturday july 5th.
description:
Im reporting this sighting for a neighbor who lives just up my road, she is French and that's why I'm posting the report for her.  
Saturday night she and her friend were sitting out in the terasse behind her house and at 22:15 two bright red lights were coming very fast from the northeast.  Both objects flew over her terasse and zipped away towards the southeast over quebec city.

The other odd thing was they were flying in ABSOLUTE silence.  No engine noise, no propeller noise, NOTHING.
Things became especially odd when the "middle" light seemed to "fade" out into nothingness despite nearly no cloud cover during the evening.  
Quickly thereafter, the front "light" faded out in a similar fashion while the other light continued to move over our house in an easterly direction.  Very odd.  
Only thoughts could be they were military aircraft flying towards Otis Air National Guard Base on Cape Cod, which is only about 20 miles away from our house.
