To get a better view, I got out of my chair and moved away from the over-hanging tree branch.  Just as suddenly as it appeared, it disappeared into the blue.  Total viewing time was 15 to 20 seconds.  
What made this sighting a little bit weird was that a large jet airliner flew ! directly into the same area where the UFO had been less than a minute before bringing with it a long, wide contrail.

summary: Saw what appeared to be a shooting star that just continuously kept moving through the sky slowly,  twice.
description:
We witnessed a very clear sky tonight after fireworks and saw (twice) what appeared to come out of nowhere circle in the sky - very similar in size and brightness to that of a star. 
This same occurrence happened twice, one not too long after the other, though we did not see both dots moving through the sky in synchrony.  
Each glowing circle moved across the sky in curved and non-linear formations, both at separate occurring times.  
We debated for a while if either could be a plane, but they were not blinking at rather very strong fixed light sources moving in ways quite adverse to what I've witnessed as regular flight patterns.  
Each circle would move through the sky appearing out of nowhere/we just noticed it? /seeming like a shooting star, however, it did not burn out and would continuously move across the sky until we were straining our eyes to try and watch it and then it would disappear.
We did feel we saw a significantly larger number of planes tonight as well, though I'm quite sure that just happened to be a separate weird thing.

summary: Red light hovering in circles at high speed
Red oval ships moving West to East over Old Town Road slowly arching up then moving like lightening away.
description: Took 2 videos of these oval red lights patrolling from West to East over fireworks.  One red oval stayed hovered above the moon for nearly an hour.  The red ovals when I would film and talk about it, one slowed down over me than moved lightening fast to the east.  There were also about 5 fast moving white UFO's that were NOT planes or drones.  My friend works as a flight control tower at Islip Airport in NY and knows about them.  My camera battery went dead after it zoomed away and it was fully charged.

summary: 8-10 orange orb sighted on RT 41 near Turkey Run State Park; most likely Chinese lanterns.
description:
I did some research on the area and found out that they have evening hot air balloon rides in the area and they also released 100 Chinese lanterns for the 4th of July.  Probably Chinese lanterns.  
They didn't move, no sound, they just hovered in the night sky.  It caused us to slow our car down considerably which was lucky because we were about to hit a few deer.  
When we slowed down they ran in the opposite direction.  
My son took a few photos but they didn't come out well because we were in the car and he isn't used to his cell phone yet.  Only one of the photos showed 2 of the 'orbs'.  They just look like orange lights...I suppose that's what Chinese lanterns look like though. 
Then next time we drive home on RT 41 from Turkey Run State Park, we'll be sure to look for them.  I'll bet they'll be there next year at the same time/same place!  :)
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Two lights sighted over N Raleigh, 1 Red and 1 white  that appears to join together then separate at random intervals.
description:
Sighted two lights, 1 red and 1 white that appear to join together then separate at random intervals. Sighted over North Raleigh from Garner on July 5th, 2014 at 2:11am.
Have also seen the same lights occasionally the past few nights, at different times.
The lights are still currently in sight at 02:15am on July 5th, 2014.

summary: Viewed 2 glowing spheres that traveled at a constant speed going at around 30 mph heading east
description:
My wife and I were coming back home after a night out, before entering our homes we noticed a round sphere in the sky it was traveling in a trajectory South West heading East.  If I were to take a guess I would say the object was traveling at around 30 miles per hour. 
After viewing the object for about 30 seconds, another object of the same shape and size was viewed, it followed the same trajectory as the first object.  Inside the sphere looked what seemed to be like a glowing torch.  
This was not a balloon, it had a constant speed and was traveling at a constant straight line trajectory maintaining constant height.  
There was no sound coming from the objects.  
Both objects disappeared out of sight after about 2 minutes.

summary: Huge moon shaped object appears during or before and during power outage
description:
On July 5th, the power went out, and I just happened to look out at the sky.  There were no lights as far as I could see, no street lights either.  
Saw what I thought was the moon but it seemed 3 to four times larger than normal and had a much more yellow tint.  Thought it was odd. Went out 20 or so minutes later and what I thought had been the moon had changed position drastically and in my perspective was now behind the tree line.  This really confused me.  
About 30 minutes later I looked for the object again and it was completely gone.  The object looked like a full moon and upon checking i found it was only a quarter moon on the 5th and i have never seen the moon so large or to change place in the sky so quickly and drastically and then disappear.  
I checked several more times that night and it never re appeared. I also wonder if whatever it was caused the power outage for there were no storms or even any rain that night here.

summary: A few hours after first sighting the same or similar craft appeared again in same area. Entering into sight from treeline and hovering over known field  and stream of property next to my own home.
description:
This time we could see the shape better and it was "arrowhead" shaped.  The point changed directions multiple times and drifted back into treeline.  
Poor quality video attached.  Taped on a Samsung galaxy s3 phone.  The red orange dot can barely be seen but was very bright to naked eye.
The white dot in video is a star or planet, while zooming in to focus on craft the white dot appears to move.  It is not.  This is just the result of zooming in and out to focus on orange craft.
Time recorded~00:45 july 5 2014 Hand held resting on patio chair for stability

summary: Erratic moving orange ball of light across the sky that completely stopped then disappeared.
description:
I was sitting on the back of my friend’s truck just talking when we saw a glowing orange ball of light directly above us heading south west.  This object was traveling very quickly and moving in an erratic pattern.  It was almost as if it was vibrating quite viciously.
It continued to travel south west and would look as if it was slowing and speeding up.  The ball of light also started to dim a little as it traveled.  Once the object was about 35 degrees from the horizon, it slowed very rapidly and stopped completely.  It then started to dim at a more rapid pace as if it was moving away and then suddenly disappeared.
We initially thought that it may be an airplane or a shooting star or a meteor but I’ve never seen any of those move in a pattern as this light was and then miraculously just stop for around 30 – 45 seconds.  We also thought about maybe a cloud got in the way but the sky was completely clear.

summary: Two of my acquaintances were on their way back into Harrington from a trip we were on.  I at this point was in another vehicle then the people that I mentioned before.  We were several miles behind…
description:
As we went back on highway 28 towards Davenport to see for ourselves; we turned off onto the beginning of Scott road just barely out of Harrington.  Off to the southwest we saw a yellow light in the sky which appeared to me to be a circle at the time.  It was definitely not a farm light because of its great height in reference to the hills.  
As we sat there staring at the light we saw, without warning, it expanded in size by a massive amount in under three seconds.  We couldn't accurately tell how large it was since we had not point of reference to base it upon.  The mood was frantic as everyone was trying to figure out what this possibly could have been.  Could it have been a firework?  No it couldn't as it was a solid color and last there for nearly twenty seconds in the sky.  Was it a lunar eclipse that was momentarily obscured from cloud coverage.  No; there was no eclipse that night.  And then the light started to shrink very slowly.   
We headed onto the Odessa highway to see if w! e could get a better look, but the hills were obscuring our view on both sides.  We couldn't see it at all now. We called in a night at that point and headed home.
	One thing I know for sure is…

summary: Sighting appeared airborne as bright red/orange object, possibly circular, with bright white center and glowing flame similar to hot air balloon.  However, there was no balloon visible.
description:
Object moved at steady, linear pace, traveling horizontally across sky northward towards Annapolis Harbor Center.  
There was no audible sound from object.  I was not able to view the object in my cell phone to capture a photo.

summary: Circular orbs making no sound, flying low and moving up in speed and altitude.
description:
Red/Orange shaped orbs began flying northward, coming from the south.  Objects made no noise while flying over, gradually began to pick up speed and altitude.  I was outside smoking while i looked up to see the first orb flying about 500ft overhead when I looked farther south and saw another one coming to me, headed north.  
I hurry inside to get my father to witness the event.  By the time we got back outside, 4 more of the strange circular orbs were nearing us.  
The circular balls of light were picking up speed very fast and also gradually moved higher in altitude.

summary: Me and my family we're talking in the back yard on my deck when we saw these reddish, orangey lights.  They were just flying in a formation over my house.
description:
These lights stood over my house for  a good 15 seconds then they simply vanished.  
In my sighting I saw a tiny yellow ball then following it was a medium redish, orangey bright light riding next to the same exact object.. 
Then there was a big reddish orangey ball of light at the end with a tiny yellowish ball at the end of the whole thing.

summary: Multiple UFOs over 1 hour period of time.
description: During the fireworks display over Lake Oakland,  My sister niece and nephew witnessed Numerous balls of red lights in the sky.  All coming from east to west, but within a 10 to 15 mile radius of my house.  Consistently red glowing not blinking.  No sound moving in straight trajectories, in different directions.  Craziest thing I've ever seen in my life.  I have never been so excited before.  Absolutely not stars planes helicopters or balloons.  No sound whatsoever...absolutely amazing.  There has to be other people who saw these things. counted over 20 plus.  I recorded some with my cell phone but obviously those aren't great... with binoculars the lights were extremely intense with no variation.  I know what we saw was not from here.  One of the best nights of my life!

summary: 1/2 mile straight east of McConnel AFB Wichita.  Round SILENT solid dark, round, red object moved straight north from straight south  no variations in direction.
description:
Wind was 20 mph out of southeast any firework debris such as Chinese lantern would have moved SE.  Altitude about 15000 feet.  
Object size was about the size of a dime.  Cleared view in 2 minutes.  AFB only has KC135 tankers and no fighters.  Speed hard to estimate.  
AFB had no comments.  
I am retired Boeing and I know aircraft.  This was NOT fireworks, space station or satellite.

summary: Possible UFO sighting East sky of North York (GTA) Ontario.
description:
At 23:38, I was walking home from work in North York (Greater Toronto Area) Ontario.  
I thought it was a satellite going across the sky.  It was fading in and out towards the East.  
It was white, then turned orange as it faded. 
I was a circle shape. 
It was travelling straight then it went sideways and jolted north and vanished! 
I've never seen a satellite do that.

summary: the 4 of us saw a silent glowing ball of light cross sky.  was bigger/brighter than plane.
description: We have amended the date above, to reflect a sighting on July 4th, 2014.  PD

summary: Unknown object displaying unusual flight characteristics.
description:
At approximately 23:35 PST, I observed a small object at a relatively long distance, estimated at 3-5 miles, over the eastern section of Portland, OR.   This area is roughly due east of the major airport in the area.
The object accelerated at an unusual rate and performed maneuvers inconsistent with any aircraft design I am aware of.  At times, it hovered in place, then proceeded to accelerate at a high rate in an east to west direction, then doing the same in reverse.  In addition, it also appeared to descend rapidly, then ascend again over the treeline into view in the same location.
There was no change in the lighting that you would expect with a turning aircraft, as the object appeared to maintain the same aspect at all times.  At approximately 23:37 PST, it sank below the treeline and left my field of view.  Unknown if this was due to a descent in altitude or acceleration away from my position, as both would produce a similar effect.

summary: Formation of 4. Greenish white;  Flying V & pyramid shape displayed.
description: We were watching the fireworks of course, then between the show in Westminster & Denver 4 greenish white lights appeared.  They circled with each other, dancing, then formed a very articulate V shape pointing to earth, somewhere near Lafayette.  They descended toward the horizon, broke formation & regrouped in a perfect equilateral triangle, with one in the middle.  I assume it was a pyramid in the air.  They descended further toward the ground & then disappeared.

summary: Two crafts, bright lights, and no sound. 3 witnesses.
description:
The first encounter happened at 23:30 driving down I-90/George Bush Toll Road heading North Bound.  We were in the Rowlett portion of I-90. The first craft glowed a bright orange/red color and was heading South Bound towards Mesquite, Texas. The craft was moving slowly directly above us and lasted for about 30 seconds.
The second encounter happened at 23:35 driving down the same stretch of road driving in the same direction.  We were in the Sachse\Garland portion of I-90.  
This might have been the first craft that decided to change course or a second craft, I am not sure.  The craft was moving slowly and came from directly above us heading North Bound towards Sachse, Texas.  The craft moved slowly until it reached the edge of the horizon, when it disappeared from sight.  The second sighting lasted for about a minute.

summary: Red light in oregon sky's
description:
Me and my wife saw this bright red light moving at high altitude, seemingly moving slow. 
At its altitude, I had to be moving very fast.  Similar to a satellite but satellites aren't bright red.  The light was moving in a south south east as our house fades exactly north.  
We don't know what it was but I know it was not and airplane or helicopter but resembled a slow falling satellite until it went behind the trees.
We suspect a flawed time.  We have corrected the time to reflect an evening sighting.  PD

summary: On 4th of July, 2014, 1130 ish pm a friend and I we're playing a night game of disc golf.  On one of the holes at the course there's a good hole to view fireworks from.  During the fireworks we…
description:
Then they all started to move.  From the bottom to the top they slowly started to fade away as they look like they were descending.  
About 15 to 20 minutes later we noticed one of the orange lights appearing in the horizon .  Shortly after another orange light and then shortly after another. the lights proceed into the sky and slowly faded away. 
after seeing this I looked up UFO sightings on youtube and literally found a video of exactly what I saw, formation and all.  After looking up many UFO sighting I've noticed that the ones that are similar to the ones I saw are mostly sited by schools.  My sighting was over Paredes middle school in Austin, Texas.  I just thought it was a very weird coincidence.

summary: Dominating red light seen twice, then 8 more white, yellow, and orange colored lights were moving in formations, then each disappeared.
description:
Late around 11:00pm after the fireworks show at the nearby lake had finished, I started looking at the sky and remaining fireworks, but what caught my attention right away was a red light whizzing around in figure eights at the left side of the road beside the lake, which at first I thought was a drone.  It was in the direction southwest.
Then I met two friends which I was telling about the red light, and some underground knowledge and they then pointed out in the same direction, lights in the sky that look like UFO’s.  I walked up a slope and the two friends followed to get a better view, and they appeared to be coming from the right, so that we could be more able to see them from the trees in front of us.  There were 9 glowing lights, colored white, light yellow, light orange, and then the one red one I saw earlier, the red being the brightest and largest looking.
The red one was the farthest behind coming into view after the white, yellow, orange lights started moving into formations.  Then came the red light from the right, from the tree line, moving more towards the formatting lights.  Once the red one was getting into view and looked more like a V, one by one did the lights…

summary: 4 horizontal lights orange moved slowly but clearly all apart of one "craft" 3 quarter in.
description:
line in the sky bigger than a plane about 3 quarters of an inch long moved slower than a plane about 10 mph seemed like there was 4 horizontal orange lights seemed to "flicker" as if on fire.  
Only lasted 45 seconds because it moved behind tress blocking our view..  
me and 3 other people saw it and verified it was like nothing we had seen before and one person even made the comment "Idk maybe it's a ufo" almost ironically. -Gunbarrel City, Texas 11:25 pm

summary: We were on the deck and all the fireworks had stopped.  Beautiful, clear evening.  Someone said look and we thought this perfectly symmetrical fireball was going to hit our house.
description:
It was moving slowly - almost like a flame that could have broken away from a firework, but was moving at a moderate steady rate.  It came right over us and then kept going.  It made no noise and had no movement except slow and maintaining altitude.  
It was bizarre as we watched it for 3-5 minutes and it never moved course.
We suspect a flawed time.  We have corrected the time to reflect an evening sighting.  PD

summary: 5 unusual round objects in the air lasting about 10 minutes.
description:
Watching fireworks show.  Noticed 5 unusual lights (well above where the fireworks were at) lasted about 5 minutes.  
The lights were red/yellowish in color.  
Lights were in the air for 10 minutes and then went into one.

summary: Moving blinking bright to dim object heading towards mountains, seen from Baldwin Park, CA
description:
Went outside to see if I can watch some last minute fireworks throughout the city so I was scanning the sky. From my location looking towards Mount Wilson which is north of me in Baldwin Park, CA, what caught my eye was a bright light I thought it was a shooting star at first but it just got bright almost near the brightest star and it dimmed down.  I thought no that's not a shooting star, then I thought was it a satellite?  no I continued tracking it it was headed in a straight line towards north east.  
It got really dim especially cause the light pollution and the smoke from the fireworks but i could still make it out that it was going in a straight line.  What happened that it grew bright again and dimmed, when I continued watching it it continued to go bright and get dimmed, so it would go bright like a star then dim to almost unseen, I even lost it for a bit, but since it continued in a line I could just make out where it should be, but I also noticed that it seems to go farther in the distance.  It just was really weird never seen anything like that. what it did was go bright then dim right away then travel maybe 3 or 4 sec then repeat about 3 times then I lost it then it…

summary: 13 Red firelike objects in the sky in a staggered formation above Cottleville, Missouri.
description:
I saw a weird light in the sky at about 10 pm on 7/4/14.  It was like a small fire in the sky.  It was not a firework.  It just hovered there above the tree line about a mile away.  I dismissed it because we had just watched the firework display in Kirkwood Park.  
I drove home to Cottleville, Missouri, and walked out to my back yard around 11:15 and I saw 13 objects in the sky exactly like the one I saw in Kirkwood except these were moving slowly West at about the speed of a hot air balloon.  There was no noise.  They were all in a staggered formation at the same speed and remained equidistant from each other the entire time.  A single object lagged behind the main group but didn't seem desperate to "catch up".  
Then 3 more appeared in a perfect triangle formation when they passed by and stayed that way until they disappeared.  It looked clear in the middle of the triangle...so I'm confident it was 3 individual lights not connected to each other in any way.  
I looked for an outline around each object such as a parachute or balloon but I couldn't see any thing attached.  The objects' altitude remained constant until they disappeared in the distance.  It seemed like they slowly…

summary: An orange glowing, fiery light, large or close, flying in a south easterly direction.
description:
We saw a bright orange glowing orb, similar to fire, fly overhead and out of site in about 90 seconds.  
A similar occurrence happened last year, 7/29/13, involving two identical objects which were exact matches to this evening's sighting. Last year I thought they may have been Hot Air Balloons. 
They seemed to travel too fast o be Hot Air Balloons.

summary: Slow-moving orangish-red lights over Whatcom County, Washington
description:
Independence Day 2014 about 12 miles north of Bellingham, Washington.  Around 10:00 p.m. my sister and I watched an orangish-red light in the SW sky move slowly away from us in an upward trajectory.  It had no blinking strobes that would have identified it as an aircraft. We forgot about it and around 11:00 p.m.  
I went outside to watch and listen to fireworks, and a live rock concert taking place across a neighboring field when I noticed a semi-bright white light low in the southern sky over the Bellingham Bay - Lummi Island area.  I was thinking that it looked like the moon behind clouds... the sky was about 95% overcast with small open holes where I could see some stars.  
The light slowly turned in a westerly direction changing from white to the bright orangish-red color.  I got my binoculars and my sister and when we looked for it again it was behind a clump of trees but we could still see it intermittently.  
When it completely re-emerged there were two of them! moving slowly and appearing to be connected in some way.  One appeared to be following and catching up to the other light -- or they were two lights connected to a moving craft, that appeared to get closer together…

summary: Initially saw five orange ball-shaped objects in a straight line, low in the sky.
description:
Each one continued to travel in a straight line, then disappeared, each one, right after the other, at the same point in the sky. 
After the five in a line disappeared another appeared on the horizon.  
All orbs were moving from the north-western part of the sky. 
Again, another orb appeared.  
There were nine total.  Each one proceeded to the same point in the sky and then suddenly winked out and were gone.  
They were not planes and they made absolutely no noise at all.

summary: Elliptical shaped fireball.
description:
at 3 after 2300 i noticed what i thought was an ember floating behind the trees as it cleared the trees its shape was eliptical it looked like it was burning and at times it looked translucent it flew slower than the lifeflight heli and at about the same height and it was a little longer than the heli 
i shined the flashlight at it but it kept goingthere was no sound at that distance i would have heard the heli. within 5 min after the object passed two commercial jets came from the nw heading east.   the object came from s.e. of bolivar heading n.w. aprox 5 miles n. 
of town the color was orange to amber that is what made it look like fire burning

summary: Gliding at fixed pace/position, small point of light gradually grew brighter causing object to appear significantly larger than stars,
description: At 11:01, I witnessed a small point of white light traveling smoothly across the night sky at a fixed rate of speed and direction.  After a few seconds, the object's brightness gradually increased until it appeared as a white oval larger than the surrounding stars.  After that, the object dimmed to its original appearance and subsequently disappeared.  Sighting ended at roughly 11:03.

summary: Bright red-orange light seen moving slowly, silently, first south, then east, no gain/loss in altitude. 4 witnesses. 2-3min observation
description:
On July 4th, 2014, at approximately 11pm Pacific Time, a single bright round red-orange object was seen in the clear skies over Creswell, OR, by 4 people – myself, my wife, and another couple standing nearby – but also by many others having done some research online.  
It happened just as a fireworks event was about to kick off at the Creswell High School.  My wife and I were in the back of my pickup facing east on Nieblock Lane, when I noticed a bright red-orange object, drifting silently towards the south.  It moved extremely slowly towards the south, then turned away towards the east and eventually disappeared.  
It was just a large round bright object, not a Chinese lantern, not a firework, not a drone, not a flare, not a helicopter, not a plane, not a balloon, and I’m not crazy.  
From the distance it was at, it was too big to be a simple Chinese lantern.  And it never drifted up, it just appeared out of nowhere and flew along a level altitude, not gaining or losing altitude for the entire 2-3 minutes we all watched it.  
I spent several years in the Army as a Combat Medic and I’ve seen all sorts of aircraft, weaponry, flares and such to know that what my wife and I saw,…

summary: Bright red and orange, traveling in line, silent, able to hover and went straight up and disappeared.
description:
Traveling from the northeast, these objects were red and orange, rather small, one right after the other, but not directly behind each other.  I saw one hover over head.  But no noise whatsoever.  
Then, when they reached a certain point, they went upward and disappeared quickly.

summary: Red lights in sky for 10 min.
description:
My husband and I went to our backyard to watch fireworks.  To the north of us there was someone setting off a lot of fireworks.  I saw these two red lights that I assumed were a plane.  They would flash green for a few seconds then back to red.  The only thing that made me think it was not a  plane was that it stood still.  I asked my husband if he saw it.   He assumed as well it was a plane because it started to move, but then stopped and hovered.  
Once the object started moving the lights stopped flashing to green and stayed a constant red.  We stood there and watched it for 10 min just hovering in the sky.  
I realize this could have been a helicopter, it moved and hovered like one, but the lights didn't flash.  They stayed a consistent red.  After ten min it moved to the east and out of site.

summary: Red glowing sphere in night sky of our backyard
description:
First of let it be known, we live near a coast guard base and a large airport and see all types of aircraft, helicopters you name it this wasn't anything like we have ever seen before! 
After fireworks died down, on the Fourth of July, I saw a bright red sphere in the sky moving closer it made no noise and we thought at first it was a very large flare.  
I saw it at first and as it started moving closer with no noise it caught my husbands attention.  We followed it and my husband shown a flashlight at it.  
When he did the sphere made a weird whistle noise then turned and sped up.  
Fireworks don't hover and them speed up.

summary: Rogers, AR, July 4, 2014 , Orange sphere traveling at in excess of 3000 mph from south to north over Beaver Lake
description:
Orange object about the size of a pencil erasure held a arm's length.  Flew rapidly from due south to due north over Beaver Lake (it was not fire works).  Made no sound.  Flew below cloud cover, coud see reflection of clouds above. Did not have tail.  Clear night, limit of sight was 30 mile to south and 30 miles to north, therefore, 60 mile total, the object flew it in 1/2 minute therefore it was fying at approx. 7000 mph.  
Was not jet on afterburner since orange glow was continual from south to north.  Don't believe it ws a meteorite since it had no tail and made no noise at this apparent low altitude. at end of trajectory the object appears to go upward into space, however this may have been an illusion due to curvature/rotation of the earth.

summary: ORANGE CYLINDER OVER EUGENE ON THE 4th
description:
IT WAS A CLERR NIGHT.  I FIRST OBSERVED A CIGAR SHAPED OBJECT COMING FROM THE SOUTH AND HEADING DUE NORTH.  IT SEEMED TO ME TO BE GOING 250+ MPH AND BETWEEN 500 TO 750 FEET UP.  
IF I AM CORRECT IT HAD TO BE 150' LONG AND 30+' ROUND. I LIVE ON A LANDING PATH 4 MILES FROM THE AIRPORT NORTH OF ME.  THE LIGHT EMITTED WAS ORANGE AND CONSTANT. 
AT FIRST, FOR THE FIRST 5 SECONDS, I THOUGHT WAS A FLAMES, BUT RULED THAT OUT BECAUSE THE SHAPE SEEMED TO BE SHARP. IT HEADED ALMOST STRAIGHT FOR MY POSITION, BUT STARTED TO VEER TO THE EAST WHEN IT GOT ABOUT 1/2 MILE AWAY AND BEGAN TO CLIMB AND HEAD DUE EAST.  I LOST SIGHT OF IT AS IT CLIMBED IN THE EAST. 
IT WAS ABOUT AS ROUND AS AS THE MOON, YET AS LONG AS 7 MOONS.  
THE WIND WAS FROM THE NNE. 
IT SCARED ME WHEN FIRST OBSERVED.  I THOUGHT IT WAS A MISSLE OR METEOR.  
MY FRIEND AND I AGREE THAT IT WAS CONTROLLED. no sound

summary: A red flashing object seen by by 3 people in Fort Wayne.
description:
I was inside and looked out my window- into the front yard, and saw a red flashing thing and at fist we thought it was a plane but we found out it wasn't!!!  
i told my parent but they didn't believe me. so we all went outside- to the backyard to watch fireworks when we saw a red flashing ball it light up really bright once and then turned back to red, it headed towards the moon.Then it dissappered.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  We have changed the time and date of the report.  PD

summary: I saw a glowing Red and Yellow Sphere at the inner sections of La Mirada Blvd and Rosecrans, La Mirada CA. on 4th of July 2014
description:
On 4th of July, 2014, we were driving through La Mirada, CA, between 10:30 & 11:00 PM and on the enter section of La Mirada Blvd and Rosecrans I notice a Police officer pointing his exterior spot light directly up into the sky as we drove closer to the enter section I looked up and there it was red and yellow glowing Sphere above us I'm guessing around a 1000 ft above us, 
my wife was driving and our niece was in the back seat I told her to look up and she also saw the Sphere, my wife couldn't see it cause she was driving but noticed the officer shinning his light upward.  I only looked up because of the expression of the officer's face in disbelief as too what he was seeing.  
That's what caught my attention.  we did not pull over but I stuck my head out the window and saw that the Sphere began to go straight up and disappeared

summary: Reddish Orange low altitude crafts in uniform flight pattern
description:
I saw a bright red light which apeared to be a low altitude plane.  Through my window the solid reddish orange light seemed to have a 5 pointed star shape.  The craft traveled a steady speed.  There were no blinking lights, just a solid color.  It wasn't a normal light so I watched it travel from the NW to the SE but as it approached the SE horizon the lights turned off and the craft went dark.
I then witnessed three other identical crafts traveling the same speed and flight path aprox 20 second to 40 seconds apart.  As one would come close to the SE horizon and go dark the next would appear in the NW horizon.  It was difficult to judge altitude, but I would say they were traveling higher than typical helicopters but much lower than commercial jets.  We are close to a small airport where single prop planes are constantly in the sky and we are also in the flight path of a regular helicopter.
These was no noise to suggest either of these types of crafts.  Along with the lack of noise, the coloration, speed, flight path, and number of craft ruled out these possibilities.

summary: Fireball slowly moving across south sky from east to west, slowly descending, until fades out of view.
description: While my son and I were watching fireworks in the area, looking out a window facing south, we saw a fireball that looked almost like an airplane on fire, slowly moving horizontally across the sky in an east to west direction, slowly descending, until it faded out of sight.

summary: Multiple satellite-like craft with light beams over Elk Grove/Sacramento.
description:
Was watching what I thought was a satellite, but shortly after I noticed it, it flashed a very bright flash (very eye catching if looking even slightly up).  
I called three other adults on the patio to watch.  We watched it slowly cross above and it flashed a very bright flash again.  It did this only twice and began to fade away into the big dipper (south to north).  
Suddenly, there was another trailing behind it.  Again it looked like a satellite on a straight course.  While watching this one it suddenly JUMPED ahead and caught up with the other one covering a vast space in the blink of an eye.  
Then there was a third, then a fourth, then a fifth, then a sixth, in succession, spread out with many miles beteween them and all traveling south to north in the same line.  At times they stopped and displayed a bright "light" ray coming out of them in a search-like mode.  The light moved around.  It didn't just flash once.

summary: 7 red lights
description:
This occurred on 4th of July, coming home from watching fireworks. I know because of this, what we witnessed could be easily dismissed.  But the sightings were spread over the Hillsboro area, and uniform in appearance.
We saw red lights stationary in the sky.  There was no distinguishable form other than the lights.  I first saw three of these lights in the north, each at different altitudes from our perspective.  
They faded from view, only to have two more float up from above the horizon (tree line and surrounding rooftops) into the sky.  
These lights quickly blinked out. I thought these probably were lanterns, the kind with little candles in them.  But then I observed two more lights in the south, already very high in the sky.  
The color was a vibrant ruby color, not likely candle lit.  They had a slow pulsating light that very in intensity.  These lights were only visible for a few minutes before they faded out.
There were no noise.  The moved like they were floating.  If it were two or three objects like these I would dismiss them.  But there were seven that I witnessed in two different directions, roughly five miles from where I viewed them.  Really unusual.  
I have never…

summary: 3 Bright Orange balls of light keeping the same path
description:
My husband and I were out for a walk and we just saw 3 orange balls of light coming in from the east and moving to the west.  
They were separate from each other but seemed to follow the same path as the other.  The were very orange.  They did not flash.  
They started off low to the sky then as they went further to the west they seemed to get higher before completely disappearing.  
They did not make any sound as they passed like a helicopter or a private plane would have.  
We live in a city with an airport and are very familiar with what a plane looks like. These were NOT planes.  
I understand that this is the forth of July, however, we do know the difference between something flying in the sky versus a firework.

summary: 2 Fire Orange Crafts fly over Hubbard, Ohio.
description: It’s the 4th of July, and I was in my backyard watching fireworks from a nearby city. The evening was a very clear sky (no Chem Trails) and a half moon was just rising above the horizon.  The temperature was about 75 degrees and slowly dropping- as it does out in the township.  I happened to glance to the east, seeing a bright light in the sky. At first, I thought it was a firework display.  The object was at least 200 feet above the tree line that is 200 yards away from where I was standing, was fire orange/red, very large, and held a definite course.  The object moved faster than any aircraft I have ever seen as well as being the largest I have ever seen within a short distance to the tree line.  It appeared to be oval, but because of its brightness, I could not discern a distinct shape.  The first object appeared at about 11:00 pm while the neighbors were lighting off small fireworks (like bottle rockets and Roman candles). It seems everyone noticed the craft and all fireworks in the area ceased. The craft came from the west and moved towards the east. My speculation is that is it came from Cleveland towards Pittsburgh. The craft was moving faster than an airplane but slower…

summary: Red orbs in sky, brighter than planes, moving from Boeing area in Everett toward eastern horizon.
description:
I was home alone and happened to look outside the window at the dark sky.  Fireworks had been going for two days, so I did not notice the lights at first.  
Then I realized these lights were brighter than an airplane and there were three of them moving horizontally across the sky.  These three appeared to be in a triangle formation to each other.  
Then, over the hill from where they appeared, two more red orbs appeared.  They moved slowly like a plane but appeared much brighter than a plane.  Typically planes come from much further away and the flight pattern from Paine Field is towards the house, perpendicular to these light's pattern.  I kept trying to adjust my eyes and decide if it was the smoke from the fireworks that made them appear so close and bright.  Also, more lights continued to rise up from behind the hill, two more and finally one last one.  
That was when I began to video record with my phone.  
They moved across the same path as the previous lights and eventually faded into the horizon.  I did not assert that they were UFO's until I saw the reports on this website.

summary: No sound, two circular orbs following eachother then disapeared.

They glowing red, with no other visible lights and not flashing.  There was no sound. 
Then they just disappeared. 
The time is approximate, we were not looking at our watches, we were watching the sky.

summary: UFO's watch Kelso, Washington fireworks
description:
We were on our front porch watching fireworks in the city looking south.  We noticed two "airplanes" in the distance flying in formation, we thought they were watching the fireworks.  
Then we noticed they didn't fly like planes and they were glowing orange instead of red/green.  
About then there were three more coming out of the southwest.  The first two gained altitude and headed south and disappeared in the overcast.  We noticed them at about 600 to 1000 ft altitude they appeared to our best estimate 50 to 60ft in diameter.  My estimate of distance was about a mile to 2 miles out from the house. 
We got out binoculars and a camera.  The video is pathetic but, captured.  We had one then come out of the west towards the house at about 500ft up.  I then took the binoculars and got a pretty good view of the saucer shape with an orange light of varying brightness on one side rotating on the axis of it.  
After it joined up with the others to the south and disappea! red, either two came back or two more showed up at the south end of town.  
The lights dimmed and disappeared.  Two strangers from the neighborhood walked by stated they had seen them also.

summary: Bright Blue Orb seen during 4th of July Fireworks display.
description:
UFO Sighting:  Tarrytown, July 4, 2014.   
On the evening of July 4, 2014, I was watching the fireworks display over the Hudson River from a friend’s balcony in Tarrytown, just north of the Tappan Zee Bridge.  The river was to my left, and the town was to my right.  There were many fireworks displays up and down the river and many planes over the river, both large commercial jets at higher altitudes as well as many small private planes at lower altitudes.  There were 8 people in our group, including small kids, and as many as 100 people lining the streets near the building where I was watching from.  The Tarrytown Fire Department had many members present.
At 10:51 pm, as there was a pause in the show in preparation for the “Grand Finale,” I happened to glance at the sky to my right, away from the river.  I saw a bright blue light streaking across the sky at low altitude, perhaps a few hundred feet up.  It seemed destined to streak into the river until it skidded to a halt and jumped back away from the river, taking a stationary position near the shoreline.  The movement of the object instantly struck me as bizarre, as it covered an incredible amount of distance in a few seconds…

summary: Bright orange “jelly bean” shaped craft near Oxbow Lake.
description:
One very bright orange “jelly bean” shaped object was witnessed hovering low in sky near Oxbow Lake off of M-59 and Teggerdine Roads.  Saw object in sky after leaving shopping plaza in my car, with one other passenger.
We were unable to photograph while driving, and pulled over at the intersection of M-59 and Teggerdine Roads into the parking lot of a local CVS drugstore.  The craft had since lifted much higher in sky and the orange color around it was gone.  There were white, red, and either blue or green lights flashing from underneath the craft which had ascended high into the sky.  
The sky was clear, and fireworks being displayed all around the lake that night by homeowners had just begun.
I did manage to get a video of the craft, but it is so high that it may not prove useful.

summary: Small orange/yellow light moving slowly for 30 secs, but no satellites shown to be in the area at time.

We knew it wasn't an airplane because there were no flashing lights, but there was a bit of a "twinkle" to it (probably because of the atmosphere).  
It moved South very slowly for about 30 seconds and then slowly "went out".  
We thought it was the ISS or a satellite, but I just went on all of the websites to see what is in our area and I don't see anything showing up on any of the Satellite tracking websites.

description:
July 4th, 2014 @22:45(Eastern)  
I, my family, and several other witnesses were out in the parking lot shooting off fireworks when we noticed 3 brightly glowing orange lights suddenly appear out of nowhere.  They were moving at a rate of about 20 mph in a triangular formation.   There was no sound.  
As they moved higher up in the sky, they began to form a straight line when, just as quickly as they appeared, they disappeared.
These orange lights just appeared out of nowhere, almost like they just rose up from the neighbor’s backyard.  It was the craziest thing I have ever seen in my life!!!!  
I’ve watched TV with people on there with their footage talking about the experience, but to actually experience it on my own is on a completely different level.  
My son took footage on his cell phone.  I will try to include it.

summary: Bright red lights in the sky moving from west to east then fading away
description:
My wife and I were watching the fireworks from our second story roof top.
My wife first saw a red steady light out in the distance to the north.  I thought it was a helicopter taking photos of the fireworks in the area as it seemed to stop and hover in one location in the sky then move around.  Did this a couple of times and it seem to just get faint in brightness and it vanished.  No more than 8 minutes or so later two bright red lights were slowly traveling from west to east overhead side by side in formation. One slowed some but stayed up with the other.  This lasted for three or so minutes overhead then they changed direction toward the northeast and faded into nothing.  No sound as I tried hard to listen, nothing. Weather - High clouds, no open sky of stars and good visibility.  Faint light from the setting sun in the west. Winds around 5-6 mph.  I'm a 20 so year pilot so I know what helicopters and fixed wing look and perform like.

Then the main light which exploded 2 times like C4 before fading out.

summary: 15-20 supposed aircraft seen flying in sky traveling from East to Southwest with several red/orange lights (not blinking) and no noise.
description:
On July 4th, 2014, at approximately 9:30 to 10:00 p.m., my husband and I walked the dog down the driveway to the street in front of our house to show her some fireworks which the neighbors all around us were setting off.   We did this in order to ease her panic about the noise.

We did not hear any aircraft noise, as we were familiar with small aircraft noise due to my neighbor building and flying his own planes – sometimes coming over our houses in the neighborhood.  
After these two emerged, they traveled southwest and went behind another tree.  They appeared to be flying fairly low, at about the same height and speed of a small aircraft.  Then two more emerged, flying in the same direction.  
I would say that at least 8 appeared (in pairs) coming from behind the trees and flew in the same direction as the others, but as they flew on, they appeared to rise some and disappeared before our eyes.  
At that time, we looked back at the first tree, and they were still…

summary: Two, reddish orange balls appeared in the northern sky over St. Petersburg,  FL.
description:
My family was setting off fireworks.  At around 10:30pm two reddish/orange spheres appeared in the northern sky.  
My husband and I noticed the glowing balls above the treeline.  They were moving at a slow pace, almost seemed to hover moving from west to east.  They appeared hazy. At first I thought thet were fireworks, but they hung there for a couple of minutes then moved slowly to the east, just above the treeline.  After about five minutes, they just disappear.  We (my husband and I) did not say anything to each other. Aproximately a half hour later my husband said to me, "What about those glowing balls?"  
At the time, I had no idea anyone else had noticed them.  So when he said that, I felt varified. 
We started to tell each other what we had witnessed.  We saw the same thing. I noticed that others, in Florida, as well as neighboring states, had  witnessed the same sightings.  
The same reddish/orange glowing hazy balls in the night sky.

summary: Orange lights over Mooresville, NC
description:
My wife and I were watching the fireworks in our neighborhood. I noticed an orange light in the distance off and on between the houses.   Approx 10 minutes later it appeared moving in the sky again, this time my wife noticed it as well.
We were in our pool about 15 minutes later and noticed 2 orange lights coming directly towards us and went directly overhead.  They were orange, kind of oval to tear drop shaped, one right behind the other (maybe 200- 300 feet behind the other)  No other lights, they were not pulsating (not Chinese lanterns) and most importantly NO sound whatsoever.
Approx 5 minutes later a third light went directly over us the same as before.
After that I saw two more objects off in the distance.  That was the last we saw of these objects.
I’m new to the area so I’m guessing the came from the Northeast heading to the Southwest, moving quickly but not extremely fast.  
Visible each time for a minute to a minute and a half before we lost sight of them.

summary: Orange orb spotted in Ridgway, Pa with color change due to nearby fireworks.
description:

Orb moved smoothly at quick but not fast pace for a couple minutes.  Orb was orange in color, the same as the one seen by me a few days earlier.  
As orb passed through neighborhood 4th of July celebrations, fireworks went off in the sky from a house down the street.  
Right after this happened, the orb changed color from orange to dark red.  At this time, also saw a tiny white orb accompanying it, but not attached.  
Tiny white orb was flying erratically and close to main (orange to dark red) orb.  
Lost sight after a tree blocked our view.

summary: Bright yellow with amber center seen over Port Orchard,Wa.

The light had no source meaning it seemed to be glowing. 
I made a split decision to get my camera.  I was able to get a photo but as it headed southerly its light lessened and the photo didn't really come out.  I have a photo if you want me to send it?  
This is exactly the same UFO I saw back in early June.  It was located about 2-5 miles east of our home, altitude 2,500 to 5,000 agl.  Its speed was similiar to a airliner on downwind.  Like my other sighting there was no normal lights like position lights, anti-collision lights, etc.  
As it turned south, the light diminished.

summary: 5 circular orange objects observed from west shore of Loon lake, WA
description:
At  approximately 1030 local PDT at least 5 orange objects were observed from the western shore of Loon Lake, Washington 99148. The first appeared in the south eastern sky.  It appeared to be traveling northwest, and then turned to the north, and then appeared to have stopped. It then traveled northeast and appeared to climb and disappeared. The second and third objects appeared from the east, heading west. Both turned north and appeared to head northeast toward Deer lake.  
Two of these objects appeared to be  passing in front of Loon lake mountain, just east of Loon lake. Both appeared to have landed just east of the lake approximately where Meyers farm is located.  All of this occurred while the fireworks display was in progress at Loon lake.  Perhaps these were some kind of drone observing the display.  This was observed by 4  adults.

summary: Orange /Yellow lights over SE Michigan
description:
40 miles south of Detroit. was photographing fireworks to the west of my location when a orange light I took for another rocket arched up from the horizon.  When it reached the altitude that it would have exploded at it did no do so.  As I observed it progressed from W NW to SE, at about a 60 - 70 deg. angle from my vantage point, across the southern sky. 
When it reached a point approx. "half-way" between the western and eastern skies it turned due south and at which point I was viewing it from the rear,and continued on until it faded from view.  The speed at which it covered the distance from the western horizon to the point of its turning south was about 40 seconds, which is why I thought it was perhaps a military jet on afterburner.  However, that seemed odd as there was no sound, even after it had made the turn to the south. 
The other odd part was that a jet, which I assume had taken of from Detroit Metro, was heading south and made a slight heading alteration to the southwest so as to not cross the flight path of the object I was viewing.  I DID hear the sound from the passenger jet, though it was faint. I would guess the altitude of the passenger jet at about 20,000 ft…

summary: strange triangle of lights in the sky
description:
Last night on July 4th,2014 my 11 yo daughter was at the back door calling in her puppy when she saw a triangular shaped object with a red long light and three smaller white lights on each corner traveling low over our home from south to north.  
The object traveled over the field by our house and then disappeared.  She came running into my bedroom to find me looking out the window towards the field due to feeling a strange energy and "wubbawubba" noise having passed over the house unlike a plane.  
The object had moved much faster than any plane or jet that would pass over our house headed to fort drum.  
We then noticed three red, yellow, and white lights in a triangular shape hovering over the east corner of the field.  The lights seemed to be spinning and moving closer and further apart together at the same speed.  
Then a fourth light appeared to the west of the triangle of lights with similar appearance. 
The lights seemed to fade away into the sky after about 30 minutes.  
These were NOT fireworks!

As I focused on the red object, I noticed a smaller, white object positioned at three o’clock to the red, presumably a star.  The white object appeared constant and did not flicker as a star would.  
The white object than moved to a twelve o’clock position to the red, as if the red object was the pivot point.  
Once the white object stopped at twelve o’clock, it stayed visible for about 2-3 seconds and then abruptly vanished.  
The red star stayed visible for five seconds and then appeared to fade in a way that I would describe as waves rippling on water. 
I stood for 2-3 minutes hoping it would reappear but no luck.  Due to the number of large, ma! ture trees in my neighborhood I couldn’t tell if there were more objects or if the object(s) reappeared in a different part of the sky.
My location is in northwest Livonia near Seven Mile Road & Newburg.  There…

summary: A white/red flashing circular object flying on a highly irregular trajectory.
description:
About 10:30pm EST I saw a white/red light flashing flying in a very irregular pattern.  It fly straight, veer from side to side, stop completely, and then resume flying (as described).  It didn't appear to have any problems with acceleration.  
After stopping dead in its tracks, it would resume it's previous speed, without the need to accelerate and gradually maintain momentum.  I followed it's trajectory (north east) until I lost sight of it.
About 10 minutes later, I searched the sky in the direction I had last seen it.  I saw a white/red flashing object, that appeared to be circling one area small area of the sky. 
Again, it would stop suddenly, and continue circling without needing to gradually accelerate.  Unclear if it is the same object from earlier.

description:
12 red objects moving slowly all in a single line formation from south to northwest.   At the same point in the sky all would disappear one after the other.   
One object stopped and waited for another in the middle of the formation, then proceeded itself to fly to the same point in the sky and vanished.

summary: Orange triangular object flying around Lynchburg
description:
While driving home from seeing fireworks we noticed two bright lights hovering to our left one of them then vanished.  
After seeing that I starting looking around to see if there was anything else and to the right I saw a large triangular object that was orange.  
Since I was driving I was not able to look to closely, but my boyfriend watched it and said it was moving in zig zags almost. 
It then went straight up and was gone.  
When we got home, another man who lives with us said that he was outside with the dog and that he saw the triangular craft as well. 
He that it flew directly over our house and it was making a humming sound. 
He also said that the dog didn't seem to like it at all, he bristled up and growled until the object was gone.

summary: Two High balls of Orange light southwest of Seattle on 4th of July about 10:30pm
description:
Letting  off fireworks in the neighborhood I noticed 2 balls of orange light high in the sky....roughly southwest of downtown Seattle.  They were  a decent size, not moving very fast. I kept glancing up thinking they would sooner or later get closer but then 1 disappeared.  They were too high to be a lantern and probably 5 or 6 times larger than a planet.  
I sort of discounted it and didn't even mention it to friends/neighbors.  I just assumed it was a helicopter or something.  But....very consistent glow and shape without a lot of movement.  After 15 minutes or so, they were both gone.

summary: Bright red glowing sphere over louisville on the 4th of July - 2014
description:
I was outside watching the fireworks on the 4th, and I looked up at the sky to my right to see a extremely bright red light.  The light was so bright that it surrounded the entire craft.  I was not able to see any shape of the craft because the light was so bright so I am going to say it was a sphere.  It did not flash, it was a static light.  
The craft was relatively high up in the sky, but still below the cloud line.  It flew straight across from the right all the way past our front yard and off to the left.  Because of the height I did not hear any sound, but I still found that a bit odd because other craft around that altitude usually make some sort of noise.  
The craft would pivot slightly to the left and right.  Sort of like a boat in rough seas.  Do not mistake this for the normal "zipping across the sky"  this looked more like wind was effecting it because it was moving at a relatively slow speed.
There were no other lights other than the red.  No white lights, no strobes, etc...
Having said that, I have to take an educated approach to this sighting.  Even though I might belive in something like this, there is always a possibility that there is a simple explination to…

summary: Red orange circular light seen drifing across sky that changed directions multiple times from left to right in a large s pattern.  It then hovered low  over trees and then increased brightness and…
Orange, pulsating object zooming across Chicago sky
description:
On July 4, 2014, I was with my girlfriend in my backyard, sitting on the bench, watching the neighborhood fireworks. I turned to my left and saw a round, glowing, orange/red object in the sky.  It was west of us, and low enough to the ground that I could make out the shape, but still far enough away that much detail was yet to be seen.  I immediately begin to think of what it could be, but the shape, color, and behavior was nothing I have ever seen on any flying object that I witnessed.  
The object began to pulsate more rapidly and moving at a high rate of speed, faster than any plane I have witnessed. The object began to move south, and suddenly it stopped in mid air for a good half a minute or so.  
Suddenly, it began to speed away, going southwest, and disappearing within a few seconds. I could not believe what I just saw; I am a paranormal investigator with a background in Sociology, and consider myself open minded but very skeptical.  I have read about alien ! and UFO encounters, but never witnessed anything of the sort, so I always wondered about the legitimacy of such claims.  But after tonight, I am a bit more a believer, especially after digging online and finding that…

summary: Saw orange light move erratically in the night sky
description:
I saw a bright orange light appear suddenly in the night sky while watching fireworks.  At first I thought it was a firework or an airplane, but it moved oddly.  
It moved gradually upward in the night sky and at one point it got very bright.  
It then moved to the right and then it moved erratically some more.  I called my mom over to see its erratic movements. 
It faded out and then came back, and then faded out completely.

One object disappeared, shortly after the other object disappeared.  This happened several more times, with the objects disappearing in approximately the same place.  They appeared to fly into a small, light cloud, but never reappeared.  It was a pretty clear night and we could see the moon and stars clearly.  One of objects seemed to burst, with a bright flash of light and sparks above the clouds.  They were not evenly spaced, but we're taking the same flight path.  They were most definitely not fireworks or planes.  They were reddish orange in color.

summary: Orange-red flaming orb travelling constant speed, direction and altitude.
description:
At apx. 10:15 pm on July 4, my wife and I were sitting out back of the house watching fireworks from around the neighborhood.  My wife, who is far more observant than me, was also watching behind us and pointed out the object to me, and asked me what it was. 
Initially, I thought it was an aircraft in distress as it appeared to be on fire.  However, after watching it for a time, I dismissed that notion, for several reasons:  1) it maintained its’ altitude;  2) it had no aircraft lighting;  3) it made no sound.  
The object was flying roughly northeast to southwest.  It was, at its nearest position, apx. ½ away and had only 1000-2000 ft. of altitude.  It was orange-red with roughly a circular to elliptical shape.  
The flames gave it almost a teardrop, or hershey’s kiss, shape at times, as they rose above and mostly centered about the object.  The underside of the object appeared to be flatter and only glowing, while the flame appearance was around and about the sides or! middle of the object.  
Even though the object was moving at a constant speed the flames did not trail the object. 
I’ve observed many night sky objects including Sputnik I or II, numerous satellites, manned NASA…

summary: Glowing Pumpkin-Colored Oval Craft Stationary in Sky at Dublin, Ohio July 4th Fireworks
description:
I was with a group of family friends attending the Dublin, Ohio July 4th fireworks display.  We were seated on the grassy area outside Dublin Coffman High School stadium.  The fireworks began about 10PM.  I was in a lawn chair beside a mother and her adult daughter who was sitting on a blanket in front of us.  The night was cool, clear, with just enough breeze to move the smoke from the fireworks away.  The moon was out and between 1/4 to 1/2 full.
Midway through the fireworks, I heard the mother beside me saying "What IS that?"  She directed my attention behind me.  I had to turn around in my seat, so the object was almost due West, beneath the moon but well above roof and treetop level.  The dimension from our vantage point would be roughly in the aspirin-size range, maybe a little larger.  It was a length-wise oval (wider than it was high), apparently solid object.  It was absolutely stationary--no perceptible movement at all.  There were no blinking lights or color changing occurring.  The entire object was glowing an orange shade that to me, was pumpkin-colored.  There was, however, smoke residue of the fireworks in the air, so that may have affected correct perception of the…

summary: Single bright orange light moving in a straight line across the sky for about 3 minutes.
description:
Observed a bright orange light, appearing to be at height of normal airlines operation, probably in the 15-30,000 feet range, but difficult to be sure.  It was traveling in a straight line, eastward, for about 3 minutes starting from where I first saw it to the West, until disappearing in the East, but not as far as the horizon.
It was flame-like, much brighter than any aircraft lighting, steady, non-flashing, and no white, red, or green lights seen.  This was unlike anything I've seen in 50 years of studying the skies, both as one having a keen interest in astronomy, and in the 2300 hrs of flying US C-141 transport planes all over the world.  I was wondering at the time if it was an aircraft on fire, but if so, it would have crashed, but there have been no reports of anything like that.

description:

Light was unblinking, steady, very dark, rich, ruby red, different from any aircraft light I've ever seen.  Had irregularly flashing green light which seemed towards the backside of the object, at about the 10 or 11 o'clock position.  
Mostly stationary and noiseless, although the fireworks were loud, yet nothing heard during short lulls.  It seemed to drift slowly towards the South and towards the horizon, although total distance was only a few degrees.  Motion only noticed over time, it was too slow to actually see it moving.  On a clock face, motion was in the 4 o'clock direction.  Faded slightly during sighting.  
I kept watching it, then the fireworks, sad I didn't have binoculars.  
Fireworks finale began and I watched that.  When that was over, I looked again and the object was completely gone.

Object travelled in a straight line from the west southwest to the east northeast.  Object did not appear to change color, speed, brightness, size or direction. summary: 4th of July 2014 - Lighted spherical object in the sky over Forest Lake, Minnesota

Saw object high in the sky moving slowly, sometimes nearly stationary and then in multiple non linear directions returning closely to its original position.  
It was very clear in the sky and we could see color light (blue and red) moving continuously around the edge.  It was to the south of the Lake.  
After approximately 5 minutes it turned to the NE, climbed higher into the sky and moved fairly quick to the North towards Duluth.  
It disappeared completely within minutes.  
It was an incredible experience.

description: I saw 3 reddish orange lights in the shape of a triangle. They were all moving together very slowly across the sky.  The UFO seemed very large or close to the ground. I heard fireworks off in the distance but nothing from the craft itself.  The lights did not blink like on a plane. I sat on the roadside and watched it slowly fade off into the night.  Its almost as if it was comfortable to be there because of all the other lights in the sky that night!  Like it was camouflaged.

summary: My wife and I were sitting on the front porch when I noticed a really intense orange light.
description:
At first I thought it was fireworks but it never fell.  
I got up and walked out in the yard to get a better look and called to my wife to come look.  
The light  contuied to get closer and in a few seconds was over our neighbors house.  
I had to run to the back yard the keep it in sight.  It was gone within 10 seconds.
The whole thing lasted no more than 45 seconds. Hard to guess the speed but from where it appeared to where I lost sight was probably about 3 miles. It was traveling south.

summary: 3 red orbs over Lake Union before Fireworks
description:
On the 4th of July, I walked to Lakeview Blvd E on Capitol Hill to watch the fireworks that would be going on at Gas Works Park that night.  I got there a little before 10pm.
There were several planes flying around and most of them had red and white lights.  I saw 3 small red orbs slowing moving from the west to the east.  They were flying over the Fremont bridge and Aurora bridge.  They were flying in a triangular formation.  
They rounded Queen Anne Hill and started flying south.  It was partly cloudy that night.  They flew under a dark cloud.  Then the first one disappeared into the cloud and then the second and then the third.
It was before the fireworks started and I hadn’t been drinking or using drugs.

summary: Red, fire like ball seen over Edinboro, Pa.
description:
Our town did not have fireworks this evening (Fourth of July) so many in our area were having their own.  
Myself and two others went out to check the town out but as we approached the car I noticed a red "ball" in the sky, sort of hanging there high up and then it moved erratically across the sky in a jagged, forward motion.  
My friends agreed that it was moving strangely and appeared to be engulfed in fire (?).  
A father and son stopped their vehicle and saw the object as well.  We watched it until it seemed to either fade out or move away from us. Incredible to see. Any others see this!?!?

summary: 2 moving lights, floating around in yard,slowly moved back and were flashing, like a strobe, also cluster of lights in trees above

There were 2 moving lights, floating around in yard,slowly moved by the window then moved back and were flashing, opposite me, like they took a picture. At first I thought they were fireworks, but they were NOT fire works.  They stayed in the exact spot for an hour.This is not the first time I have seen these.  A few days ago, I saw 2 fireballs behind my house. (I looked out the window when I noticed lights in the woods)  They quickly came into view above the trees at a very high speed, leaving a contrail like a comet.  They then appeared to play and moved around in the back yard, and I noticed at the same time there was the cluster in the tree in a similar spot, and height as last night.  The small balls of light also came by the window and flashed.  It seemed as though they were watching and observing me.  Then they just disappeared, orbs and cluster in trees.

summary: Three distinct orange lights moving silently very near to the Lake Union fireworks display.

After seeing the HUGE number of reports of objects similar to what I saw I felt I needed to report this.
I was at Gas Works Park for the fireworks display last year and I had my iPhone out to try and take pictures of the Chinook helicopter that carries the American flag on a lap around Lake Union before the fireworks start.  As I was looking around the sky I noticed three bright orange lights moving around slowly making no noticeable noise.  I took three photos of the lights over the course of 1 or 2 minutes while I was pointing them out to my friends.
There were aircraft in the air and skydivers coming down from them as part of the show, but I am convinced these lights were something different altogether.  I have gone skydiving and live next to a small airport and I know the sound of those small planes fairly well. As bright as these objects were they would have been making some kind of sound if they…

We joked their on a field trip to observe our bizarre rituals lol boyfiend went out to the front of our building to see if they went over.

Best 4th ever.  Wish there would be a legit reason for them though.

We noticed lights in the distance, that at first seemed like the type of lights on a cell phone tower and then realized they were moving and were in a formation. 
We counted 10 distinct lights that looked like red/orange embers moving together in a southern direction.  
The perspective- how big or far away they were - was difficult to put together because it was dark and they seemed to disappear one at a time, like when a plane flies into a cloud.

It was around 10 o'clock when I saw this what appeared to be an Orange (I believe it was Orange, maybe orange and white) light drifting in the sky, it didn't appear to be very high, and it made no sound at all.  I know it wasn't a firework, or airplane, or helicopter.
Whatever it was it was flying relatively slow and seemed to be following the river toward Forest Lake (heading North) very smoothly, I kept watching it drift off into the distance until it seemed to disappear.  I couldn't tell if it just got out of sight or if it took off rapidly.  
My girlfriend was on the boat with me and she saw it too.

While watching fireworks, my husband and I had seen what we thought was a satellite with a blue, unblinking light going from the south to the north.  
We watched it for a moment, then continued to watch more fireworks. 
Then there was another light, and another, and another, they just kept coming!!!!  
Then about 30 minutes after the first light appeared, one had appeared going from the north to the south... The OPPOSITE direction of the others!!!!! 
It got really bright for about 3 seconds, as if it entered the earth's atmosphere, then went back up and disappeared. 
All of them were blue, and ALL of them moved very slowly... 
Much slower than any airplane or satellite I have ever seen.

July 4, 2014  Denver, Co

They also had a luminescence not typical for the usual aircraft I might see in the sky.  I had seen several helicopters overhead so I suspected I could be mistaking this hovering craft.  Once zoomed in through my binoculars it did not look like a helicopter.  I could see the outline of the helicopters when zoomed in on them.  I was not able to see any detail aside from the lights on this craft.  I ran to grab my camera and zoomed in to capture it as the light turned southward and vanished instantly.
The following morning my thirteen year old son returned home from spending the night with friends and wanted to show me some unusual photos he had taken while situated to watch the fireworks.  He had been on the west side of the city, on top of a hillside looking down toward the lake, and had…

summary: During 4th of July event, we saw four orange lights moving very slow and smoothly in the sky appearing and disappearing one at a time.

The other lights then reappeared one at a time until all four lights appeared. Once again, they all appeared to be moving slow and steady from side to side in perfect sink. After about another minute the lights began to disappear one at a time until one light remained. The remaining light continu! ed movement but seemed to dip downward a bit before completely disappearing from site.
