Finale ending, object darted south and slightly east then hovered again only to disappear 2 minutes later into night sky.  
Observers were company vice president and family, and a couple, and a family, next to us on blankets watching fireworks.  
Object diverted many people's attention away from fireworks finale, which is always the best part.  The way it hovered without sound or movement, then purposefully darted away , was way too fast for a plane or helicopter.  All were stunned.  
Can't believe WE saw this in person or wouldnt believe it.

summary: 13 flaming objects floated over house in no formation coming from the southeast to the northwest.
description: All 13 objects moved by from 1 to 4 at a time with no noise.  They looked like they were on fire.

summary: Small round orange flying object just north of Frankfort on Rt. 127.
description:
Small round orange object appeared to hover to the west of Rt. 127 on the north side of Frankfort.  We stopped our car to get a better look and within about 30 seconds, it began moving south with no apparent sound.  We got back in the car to follow it.  Within a few seconds, it was gone.  It seemed to disappear on us.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Three orange orbs in triangle shape hover then move across sky in a line.
description:
It was around 10 pm on July 4, 2014, and I was out in the front yard of a friend on Queen Anne Hill in Seattle, waiting for the fireworks over Lake Union when seemingly out of nowhere three orange orbs appeared in the eastern sky; looked like they could have been over South Lake Union or Beacon Hill.  They weren’t very big but clearly visible.  
They hovered in a triangular shape for about 10-15 seconds -- one object above and two below that.  I told my friend, those are UFOs!  But he laughed and said, "No they’re not."   And I said, then what are they?  He had no answer.  The triangle moved slowly and in unison to the right (S) and moved behind a tree, so we ran over to the edge of the yard to see if we could track them.  I could see the orange lights through the branches.  (These objects were high in the sky; I don’t mean they were behind this tree across the street.)  
When they emerged, the orbs spread out into a line and the one farthest to the right turned and dropped a bit below the others.  Again, they just hovered for about 10 seconds.  I was slapping my friend on the back and saying, see, see, those are UFOs!  Then the one to the far right disappeared.  It was just gone.…

summary: 2 fireball looking orange balls, perfectly aligned moved across the sky
description: Two perfectly aligned orange fireballs moved slowly across the sky for about 2 minutes and then faded behind a cloud.

summary: Seven ORBS passed overhead on 7/4/14 in a perfect orbit!
description:
My sister and I witnessed 7 orbs traveling in a defined arc orbit overhead on 7/4/14.  They were approx 10,000 ft high and were sighted in groups of 2-1-2-2 floating by headed southeast.  
Friends later told me they had sighted similar glowing shapes at Carolina Beach by midnight.

summary: Fireballs and disk shaped object…….
description: While watching my neighbors fireworks display, from my fence line, i noticed a burning ball of orange light coming from the north east.  i alerted my neighbors and their guests and they also saw the object, however, they were too busy either enjoying the fireworks, or putting on the display. i ,however, followed the object through the sky, as it made itself southwestward and faded out in the night sky.  after seeing this, i went and told my brother, who was watching t.v. and then walked back outside. right after returning back outside, i saw another one, so i ran in to get my brother, who then came out to see what i was talking about. after he came outside we witnessed another 5 to 6 of these objects.  some appeared to turn themselves on and off as they were moving and some were moving faster than the others and at different altitudes.  the one, that at appeared to be lowest in the sky appeared to turn whatever was illuminating the object completely off, as it w! ent pretty much directly over us.  as it was moving, my neighbors fireworks were going off in the sky under it illuminating the sky enough to see the underside of the object.  me and my brother both witnessed what…

summary: Seattle, east shore of Lake Union.
description:
Two fiery objects high in the sky before fireworks display.
Neighbors gathered to see the fireworks display saw a fiery object high in the southwest sky and streaking toward the north.  First we thought it was a flare but it was much higher than a marine flare would be.  Some one speculated it could be space debris.  As it streaked downward 2 fiery tails came straight down and appeared to burn out before reaching the ground.
A few minutes later we noted a fiery orange object high in the sky sky to the west.  It hovered at the same height for 1-2 minutes and then flew to the south at a constant height. 
It no longer appeared fiery as it disappeared from view.
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
Hello, Peter,
I listened to your appearance on the Jeff Rense program when you had guests on who saw the events before the Seattle fireworks on July 4, 2014.  My report is the one above.  I live in the Eastlake neighborhood, of Seattle, 1-1/2 blocks from Lake Union, in a condo.  We have a roof deck above the 3rd floor of the condo where we watch the fireworks every 4th of July.
One of your guests seemed to think there was something ominous about the military helicopter carrying the American flag.…

summary: Red lights over southern Illinois.
description:
After the towns fire works my wife and friends where waiting for the croud to clear and my friend noticed a red ball in the distance traveling from the east to south west. It was moving slow and seemed to stay still for about 30 sec then moved again in the same direction and then just went out!  
And then we noticed another one from the same direction moving more west and like the first one just went out.  
After that my wife and I went to a gas station and on our way back home we seen another one this was much lower than the other 2 and was above our town I was on a bridge and was driving so I couldn't keep an eye on it. It was also moving east to west.  
This all occured in about 30 mins of each other.  
I've never seen anything like this all 3 where a reddish color and did not flash or flicker and no sound!    
Thank you!

summary: 3 red lights 1 bright white one and 1 dim white one.
description:
It was 10:00pm and I was called outside and when I went outside I saw 3 orange/red cylinders floating through the sky in a triangle formation.  
I thought it was Chinese lanterns but it was not windy at all, also it couldn't have stayed in that formation that long. I walked down a pathway and saw one bright white light floating through the sky very fast.  It couldn't have been in the sky more than 30 seconds. about a minute later at home I saw one very dim light floating slower than the white light but aster than the 3 red lights. it floated through the sky before disappearing into the sky. What were these?

summary: Orange lighted objects flying in the sky
description: I was outside watching fireworks, when I noticed 2 small orange objects floating in the sky.  They were like the report in Goshen IN.  These objects were quiet and small looking from where I was,

summary: Strange craft in sky above puget sound.
description:
Upon taking pictures of the fireworks from across the island to everett my phone picked up an object in the sky, i looked with the naked eye and it looked to me as a Car with two headlights coming towards me over the puget sound, i took a couple of pictures. 
As i had the object in target per phone the neighbors shot up a red firework and object disappeared, i looked around and nothing it was gone...

summary: Orange Glowing ball traveling silently approximately 1500 feet along interstate.
description:
While viewing neighborhood fireworks my wife and I observed a Glowing Orange ball of light heading towards our location.  As there was a lull in the fireworks ,We had noticed the absence of noise from the ball.  
Coincidently a Cessna had taken off from our local airport nearer to us than the object but was oblivious to the glowing object.  It was apparent that the ball was further from us than the plane and the ball was making a sweeping turn to the north following Interstate 95.  
We continued to observe the object as it faded out of view due to tall trees and low clouds obscuring our view. My wife captured the object on her IPhone and our narrative.

summary: cigar shaped to triangle shape to a star
description: It was on 4th of july in troy ohio when they was lettin off town fire works, it was at first cigar shape with a flashing red light it went around perfectly around the area of fireworks circled around 3 times still flashing its red light lasted bout 20 to 30 min. constantly moving but stayed same height and same place it retraced its steps very very perfectly and once the fireworks were done it got above the trees where i was at at the time me n my friends n family moved to find out where it was n then it stopped dead in the sky turned to a triangle then solid blue light came on the back part of the triangle then it just went off in its own way after bout a min. of watching it it just turned into a star it was pretty damn weird im sure others had seen it also but it looks as though im the only 1 reporting it tried to record it but the cell my friend had wasn't good enough to pick it up perfectly but that makes the 4th ufo iv seen myself just in troy Ohio alone I got other 1s too report but this was the latest 1 I got..

summary: On July 4th I was at Gasworks Park in Seattle.
description:
Three lights forming a triangle before the fireworks appeared to be helicopters to me.
Two or three of them would be where the skydivers came from, using parasails or whatever they are called, they landed in Gasworks Park.
Part of the show.  Thought you should know.
We question whether this is an accurate, or serious, report.  The source of the report elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact information.  It may be the result of ano appearance by Peter Davenport's on a radio program at 22:15 hrs. (PDT) on Friday, July 11, 2014.  PD

summary: Seven red-orange lantern-like orbs, 5 initially in V-formation, hovered over O'Fallon MO after 10:00 p.m. July 4, 2014.
description:
At about 10:00 p.m. on July 4, 2014, I stepped outside, facing west in general, to observe the small fireworks my neighbors were setting off.  When I looked up, though, what I saw was far more interesting than any fireworks.  
I am 50 years old, college educated, and a former UFO skeptic.  
I called my 85 year-old mother to witness as well; we both watched over the course of about 20 minutes.  Initially, we saw 5 orange-red objects arranged in a V-configuration in the area of the sky as we looked toward the Big Dipper.  
They hovered and moved very slowly, moving independent of each other.  They maintained a steady orange-red circular glow at the bottom of the objects, and the objects themselves were dark but their base and outline seemed almost lantern-like in shape and appearance.  
I chose the description "teardrop" to most closely describe what I saw, but again, they seemed somewhat lantern-like, tapering more narrow toward the top.  These objects seemed to be observing the activities below them.  
After about 5 minutes, they moved off from each other, first very slowly and almost imperceptibly, then one by one ascended toward the northwest horizon and eventually disappeared…

summary: Three orange lights, triangle formation over Seattle.
description:
The event I witnessed occurred on the evening of July 4th, 2014 at 10:00pm + or – a few minutes.
I was waiting for the Seattle 4th of July, 2014, fireworks to begin.  I was facing north, standing to the west side of the Museum of History and Industry at the South end of Lake Union.  I noticed one orange, non-blinking light appear high over the North end of the lake. More likely the light was over the Puget Sound.  The light moved slowly south and did not change size, color or brightness.  
The first light was then followed by a second and a third at equal spacing, single file moving south.  
When the lights were directly due west from me (over Queen Anne Hill) the lead light turned west and then disappeared but not behind the high cloud cover.  The second and third light followed the same route.
Once the three lights were gone, a single orange none blinking light appeared at the same point of origin as the first three.  This single light stayed stationary.  At about the same time this single light appeared, 3 or 4 Helicopters moved to the West and could have been below the light.
The sky was full of multiple aircraft and helicopters that night.  The marker and anti-collision…

summary: My brother and I had been walking outside of our apartment.  Overhead, he and I picked up on at least 4 red/gold (perhaps orange) lit-up anomalies in the sky.  They all appeared to be traveling in…
description:
I jokingly said that perhaps it was North Korean/Chinese/USSR airplanes; a scouting party... to prepare for an invasion.  He came up with something a little more realistic, perhaps they were memorial balloons, adrift in the night sky, honoring veterans or otherwise on Independence Day.  
Regardless, they appeared alien.  We see airplanes in the sky at night, most a lot higher than others.  However, you know they're US planes with their red/blue lights... these were wholly different and there was a few of them.  Worthy of alarm, at least in my opinion.  I'm near-sighted, so, needless to say I couldn't see them as well as my brother, but, they were assuredly lit up and in red/gold or yellow-orange.

summary: Orange shape moving slowly across the sky in a straight direction at the treeline.
description: After watching fireworks, we were swimming when we noticed a strange orange object slowly moving across the sky.  It was close to the horizon, and eventually disappeared into the treeline.  A few minutes later, we noticed the exact same thing happen again in the same location in the sky.  The objects were a solid orange color roughly in the shape of a horizontal oval and maintained a straight trajectory, not jumping around.  The time was 10:00 PM, and it was a clear night.

summary: S/E moving N/W one bigger dropping smaller lighted objects, 2nd higher up, stopped changed directions & then went south and vanished in an instant, clear sky.
description:
Appeared again, approx 1hr later N/W low in sky like hanging fireball, moving S/E & disappeared South. 
No blinking lights, steady state red/orange ball moved in unusual slow then very fast pattern.

summary: Bright yellow object moving horizontally.
description:
During the 4th of July fireworks, we saw a bright yellow object move horizontally across the sky.  Although we couldn't gauge the distance, we got the impression that it moved very quickly -- faster than a commercial jet.  It stayed in the sky far too long to be a firework, and showed no signs of rising or falling, as fireworks normally do.  We saw the object appear, then disappear, three times.  Each time, it was visible for 5-10 minutes.  
We couldn't hear any sound from the object, although of course it was difficult to tell with the fireworks going off.  The object did not appear to have any blinking lights of the kind that planes have.  
Three of the four witnesses report that the same object has been seen in three previous summers from this same location.
On this particular instance, we also saw a translucent bubble shape moving across the sky, near the yellow light.  That shape seemed closer, however, and it may have been associated with the fireworks.

summary: We were watching the fireworks, when we noticed this thing in the sky flashing green & red lights.
description:
At first I thought it was just a helicopter.  Then people around us started to take notice of it, because the movements of it were so strange.  
At one point, it hovered downward real slow, then shot back up really fast, then shot forward, and then backwards. 
We couldn't take our eyes off it.  It actually was there for about 20 mins, until it just disappeared in the blink of an eye. 
I am 100% certain that this was not a helicopter or any type of man-made aircraft.  
I've never experienced something like this in my life.

summary: July 4th 2014 circular flying objects with 6 to 8 flashing lights!
description:
On the fourth of July, 2014, my family and I were in the middle of lighting off fireworks, when all of someone notices this object with 6 to 8 red lights in what seemed to be the shape of a circle.
This object headed in a straight direction.  At first all the lights were on, then they began to start flashing in a random sequence (still the color red).  We continued to watch it go in a straight line until it disappeared!!

summary: It was dark and they just started shooting the fireworks, when to the right of the sky they was a circular ball of fire appeared to be floating up and as it went up, the smaller it was becoming,…
Multiple objects ascending from mountain range and disappearing as being cloaked
description:
This evening at approximately 9:55PM in Waynesboro,PA, we witnessed multiple sightings of what appeared to be an unidentified craft ascending from the East at the near top of South Mountain.
When the object first appeared, you could see what looked like the launching of a space rocket with a fiery base as it ascended straight up into the night sky in a SLOW ascension.
The object would move slowly and go directly to the skies and then take what looked like a ‘slight wiggle pattern’ to the right before beginning to do what I can only describe as ‘cloaking’ itself.
These objects (5 total witnessed) all followed the same pattern and did the same things. The appearance of each would take about 5 minutes before disappearing into thin air. Some were bright orange (4), only the second one was red.  No sounds were heard in the night skies.  At one point, several flashes of white light appeared across the horizon.  The lights came from the north and looked like wide beams of strobe-like beams that you would only see in a rock concert setting.
My friend and I tried to capture these objects ascending to the skies while holding our iPhones. Although the videos have shake errors, you can see…

summary: Friday night July 4th time of sighting 9:55 PM est. Downingtown, PA.  Location Downingtown West High school.
description:
While waiting for the usual yearly 9 PM fireworks show to start there was an unexplained delay and as the crowd eyes and mind wandered the sky wondering why the delay.  We and many others were getting ready to leave thinking the show may have be cancelled.  We started to get up out of our lawn chairs and in the sky behind us we noticed 4 slowly moving orange craft that were circular moving very slowly pulsating and drifting west to east.  Clearly not normal aircraft my daughter started taking pictures with her IPhone and my wife used her camera. Then the craft had an additional 14 to 18 craft drifting by the field with several families noticing and joking about being UFO’s.
We had seen 5 last year at the same place however they did not float by in the same way.  However they just disappeared last year and so did there just go by and then they went into a straight line and disappeared.  They did not shoot away in a flash just simply turned into nothing.  On the way home which was only a 10 minute ride we stopped at a gas station near our home to get some creamer for coffee and my wife went in my daughter and I both could not wait to look at the pictures, What we say gave us chills…

summary: july 4th nightsky, circular red / glowing object capable of flying side to side with fluid motion,wow
description:
i was on the phone talking to my brother and all of a sudden my fiance see something and ask  what is that?,  i looked up and said what the hell is that?, i told my brother , i said man there is a real ufo in the sky., it appeared to hover and then move side to side with lightning speed , it was definitley a ufo, 
i have never believed in such , but i am  a firm believer now,it was crazy, 
then about 20 mins later there were two of them and they flew side to side and up and down instantly, then they disappeared

summary: Circular fast moving solid object.
description: Not a firework at all!!!

summary: Orange fireball/sphere 3 in all.
description:
Orange fireball traveled from west to east traveling faster than a plane, no sound.  Then 5 min later another one taking same path went over then disappeared.  
Then a couple minutes later another went over in same spot. 
Got out my binoculars but still couldn't make it out. 
There was 3 in all that me and my wife saw.

summary: Amazing sightings on Fourth of July!!
description:
The UFO's that we saw were circular.  Two had an orange glow & one had a red glow all of which had a foggy circular fog around them.  
They all seemed to move very fast & in the same flight pattern!!  Exactly the same flight pattern!!  
They flew sideway in the sky & contained to move upward until they disappeared in the sky.  
They were two fast to be an airplane or helicopter & DEFINITLEY not anything to do with fireworks!!  
The fact that they could move side to side extremely fast was crazy!!  It was AMAZING!!!!

summary: Bright orange light.
description:
Just north of the Parkville area a very bright orange light hovered motionless in the sky for about 30 seconds.  
It turned a dimmer light color as it began to move in a strange and unpredictable way.  It swerved around for about 10 seconds.  
It briefly stopped still again and strobed between bright orange and the fainter (yellow/green?), before jetting off northward and dipped below the tree line of my neighbor's backyard.

summary: Hovering lights seen in the sky from the top of Ancient Palms trail
description:
My friends and I walked to the top of Ancient Palms trail in Golden to see the fireworks shows of the surrounding areas.  At around 9PM the closest fireworks display in Golden began and most of us were turned in that direction watching.
About 10 minutes later my friend tapped me on the shoulder and pointed in the opposite direction of the fireworks (east) and said "What is that?"  I turned and looked where he was pointing and saw 3 lights hovering in the sky.  They were completely stationary for about 15 seconds.  Then a fourth light appeared and they started moving slowly left to right in a perfect line.
At this point my 4 friends and I were all watching and making a bit of a scene pointing and yelling in confusion and at least 10 other people had turned around and were looking too.  There were at least 30 people on top of the trail we were on, I can't say for sure how many people witnessed this object but there were several.
The 4 lights appeared to be absorbed into one, and then would re appear as 4.  Then, all 4 disappeared suddenly, reappeared for a few moments, moved upwards slowly, and then disappeared again.  This all happened in less than 2 minutes.
I heard one man ask…

summary: Red sphere over 410 in San Antonio 7/4/14.
description:
While traveling eastbound on 410, directly before NW Military Drive, I saw a reddish orange sphere floating about 200ft in the air.  
No movement, no flashing lights, no shadows as if it were a commercial craft.

summary: red orb in night sky quickly disappeared
description:
One solid orb of red seen in the night sky.  Didn't strobe like a typical aircraft. Appears in the sky for about a minute and then rapidly disappeared over the course of 3to 4 seconds. 
Initially headed north stand then turned south very quickly.

summary: The objects looked controlled--but no engine sound.
description:
We were sitting on our 5th floor patio-looking at the ocean, when the first object appeared travelling from south to north--offshore-yet following the shoreline.
We spoke via telephone with the witness, and we found him to be a credible witness.  At last contact, he reported that a person had informed him that the objects were "Chinese" lanterns, and that he was going to go with that explanation.  We suspect that the objects were not lanterns, but we cannot prove it.  Please see other reports from Florida for this date.  PD

summary: Sighting of a large number of red circles in the sky over North Tonawanda on the evening of July 4th, 2014.
description:
My friend and I who live in Buffalo, NY, drove out to North Tonawanda on July 4th to stroll around the Gateway Harbor and view the fireworks.
While we were waiting on the bridge for the fireworks to begin there were a number of individual fireworks being set off by various people.
As we watched the sky we noticed distinct red circles coming from two separate areas one after another.  One in particular turned very black against the night sky hovered for almost a minute and then vanished in front of our eyes.  All of the others were red and glowing.  They seemed to have a slight aura as they passed overhead.  
One stream of objects were coming from the north and the other were coming from the southwest.  Although they were coming from different directions they were going towards the southeast.  
They passed over us before and during the firework display.  Other people were commenting on them too.  
We have no explanation for them, they were silent, and there were several planes in the air that must have seen them.

summary: Three lights seen flying above Seattle in perfect equilateral triangle shape, then one by one disappeared.
description:
At approximately 945 pm, I observed three objects moving across the NW sky.
They were bright like stars but flew in the triangular pattern with almost equal distance between them, making it seen like an equilateral triangle.
They were moving slower than a plane but definitely moving nonetheless.
After about 1 min of viewing them, the light that was towards the bottom left corner disappeared, and the same thing occurred to the other lights with 10-15 seconds intervals between them.  
Two other witnesses saw this as well.

summary: Bright red circular object traveling silently from the northwest to the southeast.  It moved in a straight line at a constant speed.  It appeared to be several thousand feet in elevation.
description: It was a clear night and as the object proceeded to the southeast past our location it suddenly disappeared.

summary: Orange circles of lights over Holden Beach, NC.
description:
While we were watching 4th of July fireworks we saw 3 orange circles in a triangular formation move away from the fireworks into the northern sky.  
The lights moved in the same formation for approximately 2 minutes, then began to break formation and were joined by 2 additional orange circles.  
The group of 5 moved together, slowly, for another minute or so before disappearing.

summary: Me and a friend of mine were lighting off fireworks, when we noticed in the SW sky, two red/orange or fireballs objects slowly moving to the SW, both were traveling in the same path slowly.
description:
They traveled for around 5 minutes and were approximately 1/2 mile apart from each other. 
They both disappeared (vanished) one after the other. 
I live pretty close to a major airport, and this was no airplane or Chinese lantern.
And this is not the first time I've seen these out here.  Last summer, July 14th, to be exact, I saw the same thing, but there was only one of them.

summary: Two groups of UFO's over the Denver metro during 4th of July fireworks.
description:
Watching fireworks from the eastern slope of Green Mountain in Lakewood, CO with a group with 4 adults and 3 kids.  Other larger groups in the vicinity also reported seeing the objects.
There were to distinct groups.  The first and most suspicious group of 4 appeared from our vantage point to be over DIA.  This group changed formation repeatedly but would return to a group of 3 in line with one that moved randomly around them.  These objects moved laterally and up and down. No man made aircraft that I have ever seen moves in this manner. I was in an ait squadron in the Navy and have seen all sorts of planes, helicopters, etc.  These objects did not move in a manner I have witnessed in man-made aircraft.
The second group appeared to be a bit north and ~5 miles west of the first group.  This was a group of 5.  It is possible that this 2nd group could have been parachutists that I have heard were working a fireworks show.  They did appear to descend.
This report was prompted by the fact that this was the 2nd time I have seen a similar event on the 4th of July.  Either last year or the year before we witnessed objects that moved like the eastern-most group reported last night.  They…

summary: Blue/red point low in atlanta floating silently .. not aircraft 9:40 pm, July 4th.
description: Floating low, purplish bright star, slowly moving left and right, then sinking behind tree when it became clear through leaves it had red and blue components.   I recorded on phone video.  Very strange total silence.

summary: Four bright orange lights dancing in sky after cherry hills country club fireworks
description:
After watching fireworks at cherry hills country club in englewood, co, I noticed my car alarm going off.  Upon returning from disarming it, I noticed 4 bright lights flying in irregular patterns, almost fluttering like a flag in the wind.  I was facing east from the hole closest to where Oxford lane becomes restricted.  
By no means am I a professional but I have never seen anything like it before.  
They disappeared below trees out of our view but lasted long enough for me to run to car, get mom, and show her. We're orangish in color, like a street light.

summary: RED AND GREEN LIGHT SEEN HOVERING OVER PETALUMA, CALIFORNIA
description: On the night of July 4, 2014, my husband and I went to the Petaluma Fairgrounds in Sonoma County, California, to watch the fireworks as we have done for several years.  A few minutes into the show, I saw what I thought was an airplane flying by in the distance, and I remarked to my husband how nice it was that the passengers got to see the fireworks.  As we continued to watch the fireworks with the aircraft in the distance behind the light display, I saw the craft suddenly change direction which immediately piqued my interest.  I again pointed out the craft to my husband to note its change in direction.  The craft that we were watching did not have any discernible form other than the light coming from it, which would change from bright, flashing red, to a bright flashing green, and would also stay solidly colored in each tone as well (not flashing) with no discernible pattern to the change in color or flashing patterns.  We continued to watch this craft move from! side to side across the horizon, which at my best guestimation would be perhaps the distance of a few miles (again it was difficult to tell it’s height and true distance from us in relation to the horizon) but it was as…

summary: Getting ready for work, I was looking out of my 3rd floor apartment window.
description:
An orange type fireball craft was moving slowly across the city from one end of the sky to the other.  It was growing brighter and dimmer as it went.  It eventually appeared to move up through the clouds to my left.  
I suppose it could have been a Chinese lantern, but hearing so much about these orange craft on Coast, I decided to report it.

summary: Two hundred plus, fast flying, green and some blue light
description:
We were out on the deck waiting for the fire works to start at 21:00 hours, facing south about 6,000 Ft. elev. on the North side of Lake, in Lake Arrowhead, CA.  We started counting satellites for about ten minutes at this time we notice some faster flying green one, then the fire work begin and during the show I was still seeing these fast flying green lights.  Just after the fire works ended, I point out two of these green light were flying in a straight line at 21:30 hours.  
At 21:31 hours we saw 15 of them in a group heading in the same Northern direction over the clouds.  At 21:36 hours there were fifty or more flying over the Western side of the deck that I counted and some of the other witnesses on the Eastern side of the deck was seeing a bunch more looking to the Eastern sky.  At 21:45 hours another group filled the sky, blue in color now, some were about ten thousand feet and some up around thirty-thousand feet, there may have been a hundred of them.  They were not all the same shape, but flying fast and in a Northern direction.

summary: 4 Bright Orange Lights/Spheres. Not planes or fireworks. Flying objects that were silent
description:
As I went out in to my driveway, I looked up to see some fireworks going off when I saw an Orange light just hanging there. I thought at first it was a firework, due to its firey orange color, that had reached its peak height and was ready to explode. Instead of explode though I noticed it was moving south, towards me, at a slow pace maybe 30-40mph.   
After I realized it was flying I watched it for a minute then ran in and grabbed my video camera and got the wife.  As we watched it fly overhead and right past us the orange glow just faded out.  
At that time we both looked back north and noticed another one coming.  This one did the exact same thing.  It flew south then slowly faded out.  This happened two more times.  
These objects seemed to be following each other at a distance.  One every 2-3 mins apart.  The great thing about the night of the 4th was that it was a clear night and even after the lights faded we should have still been able to see the shape of the objects due to the fact the sky was so clear and we could see the stars.  
I'm not sure what they were but as I said the were a bright firey orange color and were roughly 2000 feet high and completely silent.  They…

summary: Cluster of approxmitely 5 to 6 orange fireballs flying to the east and heading northeast over the ocean appearing to parallel the coast
description: I observed a cluster of approxmitely 5 to 6 orange fireballs flying to the east and heading northeast appearing to parallel the coast.  They were far enough away that they would have been over the ocean from this direction.  This occurred at approxmitely 9:30 PM.  This was the 4th of July and there were fireworks in the area; however, these were extrodinarly high.  It would have been higher than most airliners fly.  I live very close to the northeast corridor that the airlines and military use frequently.  I am very familar with sky watching and frequently use a telescope. He retrieved my phone and it would not capture the light either because of the distance.  I switched to movie mode and I thought I did not capture anything but once reviewed I was able to capture the triangle formation for a second and have the picture as proof.

It was moving from southeast to northwest and stayed visible until it was gone beyond a treeline on the horizon.  It never changed course.  I've seen planes fly that high before, and they always look like they are in slow motion being so far away, but this was moving much faster. 
It had only the one star sized white light and no other lights that might indicate a plane or helicopter.  There was no sound either.  
Our friend from the couple we were with is a veteran of the Navy, and he even stated that it wasn't possible to be any known aircraft, and also confirmed that at the elevation it appeared at, it should look as if it were moving much much slower than the object we saw.  
He said it was a "UFO" but added that that didn't mean "aliens" (which I acknowledge as well).  
There is an airport nearby, but from the southeast of us, not from the direction the object came, or was heading.  We did see planes in the sky from the airport, they were much slower, and the light…

Soon an object showed up close to the fireworks and hoovering  there, seems like it was observing the fireworks.  The object has red and green light.  Red light was always on, green light was blinking.  
It was hovering still there most of time.  It made some adjustment according to where fireworks explode sometime.  
It is hard to judge the height go the object in the dark, but seems to me it was at about a little higher than the fireworks can reach.  There were thousands of people there.  People near my family saw it too.

summary: Points of blue-white light, some with red, intermittently flashing on and off and streaking against the backdrop of mountains

Over a period of approximately 40 minutes, against the mountains immediately north of Tucson several episodes of flashing lights were seen.  Most were blue white, some had red with them.  Intermittently the lights flashed on and off.  Some streaked across the mountains and disappeared.  Some remained stationary and could be seen for several seconds.  Often there was nothing and then a series of lights flashed on.  Sometimes they were stationary but flashed on and off in the same position.
Never have I seen anything like this.  My wife has more acute vision than I and said she saw that some lights flashing were dome shaped.  She also saw what she described as rays emanating from the red part of the light.
The streaking lights moved very quickly across the mountains.  The view I had covered several miles.  When I called 911 to report this, I was told that earlier similar lights were seen on mountains slightly west of me called Putsch Ridge.  That area is not visible from my balcony.

We were at Bradley Park in San Marcos, CA with many other people, for the 4th of July fireworks show.  Everyone was watching the sky in front of us (they were shooting the fireworks off slightly to the south) and there were two sets of these lights above us and to the right (west) and left (east) of us.  They seemed to be cruising along normally and then changed directions.  They changed directions,zig zagging randomly, and hovered seemingly perfectly still for a long time.  The moon was about half and it was bright. At one point they both were hovering, and then the one to our right moved, I couldn't see due to some smoke in the sky, and then when the smoke cleared it was gone from sight.  Since it was only smoky for a few quick seconds, it seemed odd to me that the lights were gone from my sight completely.  Then the one to our right started moving away from us, toward the west.
It could have been some type of military aircraft since there is Navy and Marines here. But the movements were not…

summary: Two unknown objects with solid blue lights, moving rapidly, without sound.
description:
On July 4, 2014, at approximately 8:55 pm my husband, two friends and myself were waiting for the fireworks to begin.  
We were looking at the sky when we saw a solid blue light moving at a very high rate of speed and noticed another following very close directly behind it.  There was no change in speed or trajectory. 
The craft had no navigation lights or anti-collision lights as required on commercial, private, or military aircraft.  Altitude, shape and size were not able to be determined.  
They were moving from South to North, on the East side of Sombrero Peak.  They flew directly over our house and made no sound what so ever. 
There were no other air craft in the area.  
We lost all internet WIFI connection for approximately an hour afterwards.  
My husband and his friend have at least 40 years of aircraft experience between them and neither had ever seen anything like this.

When we went outside to go look at them before she left, we saw the fireworks briefly stop for a minute and A HUGE red pulsating light a "few" thousand feet up near the area of my house, popped up out of nowhere and slowly moved around almost like an observing pattern.  Then immediately stops on a dime, slowly moves again, stops on a dime, but when it finally moved again, it vanishes.

Then, as it reached the treeline, the lights shut off.  Because it was dusk, I could not see the shape of the object.

There was no helicopter sound whatsoever in the relatively quiet night…

Last night, July 3rd, 2014, my wife and six other adults saw a light that looked like a faint star rise past the north side of the moon on the western horizon.  It then sailed across the sky in a straight line, passing directly overhead only slightly south of the Zenith until if faded from view on the eastern horizon.  There was not sound.  
Of the eight adults present, we all agreed that it was not blinking, and was traveling much faster than a plane or satellite, but slower than a meteor.  Our best guess was that the total time that it took to go from one horizon to the other was about 20 seconds.

I looked up and plain as day all I could see were 2 baby blue lights moving in a circular formation.  The lights were opposite from each other.  The object did not move it appeared to be stationary.  As time went on the lights began to fade.  The fading duration lasted abot 10 minutes.  
A little after this my sister and I began to see light "pillars" but the pillars did not reach the ground. We have cows in our pasture and we heard a sound that we've never heard before, it was like a huffing grunting sound nothing like a cow.  Then everything was gone like it had never been there.

summary: Floating disk with red, yellow, green, and white lights appeared and then vanished with a small white flash but NO noise.
description:
I was sitting on my porch in my backyard hanging out with friends when I looked up at the sky and I saw a round dick looking object floating in the sky.  
Some neighbors were setting off fire crackers a few yards down so I originally thought what I was seeing was a fire cracker, however that wasn't the case.  
This object was floating in one place in the sky and was making no noise whatsoever.  It had alternating green, yellow, white, and red lights circling around the exterior of the object, this was how I observed the shape - round disk/saucer.  
It stayed there for maybe a total of 10 seconds and then it just disappeared with a small white flash, but no noise coinciding with its departure.  
My neighbors continued to set off fire crackers for the rest of the night but I never saw anything again like what I had seen for that brief 10 seconds.

summary: Two silent glowing orange/red spheres traveling south to north over Lake Michigan at about ten minute interval.

At approximately 22:47 on June 27, 2014, while sitting on our screened-in porch overlooking Lake Michigan three of us observed an Orange/red sphere moving basically south to north.  It was too bright to be an aircraft, and didn't have flashing marker lights. 
Our view is from the eastern shore facing west - so it couldn't have been light reflecting off of an aircraft.  This was a fairly calm night and we couldn't hear any noise from the object. It covered the distance from south to north in a minute or two.  
It is hard to judge the altitude maybe several hundred to a thousand feet from the lakes surface.  
The cottage porch is about 30 yards from the surf line and 80 feet above the water.  While we were wondering what it could have been at 22:57 ish another object the same as previously described glided by along a slightly more east/north track from south to north like the first one.

On this particular night is was quiet and the skies were crystal clear when I caught a small moving blue light out of the corner of my eye.  My first thought was a satellite (which are a fairly common sights on clear nights at 3am) but the instant my eyes fully focused it was obviously not a satellite.  It was a small glowing blue orb and it couldn't have been more than 2-3000 ft off the ground.  It came from the west and was flying due east & moving fast but it wasn't making a sound...it was flying in total silence.
As I watched it pass over my house, I no more got the words, ((profanity deleted)) out of my mouth, when I heard a loud jet engine, followed by a second loud jet engine.  
I turned my focus back to the west, and that's when I saw the beacon lights of two fighter jets flying in formation, and they were on the same heading, and altitude, as the blue orb.  I suppose the fighters were trying to chase it, but the orb was flying twice as fast as they were.  I then turned my attention back at the orb, and watched…

Sometimes the line would move, tilt, or the lights would get bigger, as if the object(s) were moving closer.  At one point, three sets of lights could be seen in three different areas, as if there were three separate rotating objects.
We then saw three white, smaller, blinking objects the size of stars that flashed rapidly in a series of three, that appeared in the direction of the previous phenomena and then moved quickly to the southwest in a line across the sky.
Nothing appeared after this.  The same phenomena happened last night around the same time and lasted approximately the same duration.

summary: Saw two lights moving together and upward in the sky then disappearing, followed by one that disappeared, followed by another two.
description:
Was on the phone outside when I saw two lights off in the distance in the sky, not blinking like a plane's lights do.  They were flying next to each other so immediately I thought they were military aircraft in a training exercise.  They seemed to be coming toward me, but after second thought I think they were going up.  They started moving away from each other, and then one disappeared, followed by the other disappearing about twenty seconds later.
Then, from the horizon, a similar light went up and disappeared, this time by itself.
Next, two more lights came from the horizon, just like in the first description, and disappeared after parting ways.
The sky was a bit cloudy but not enough to block out stars, etc.  I'm sure it wasn't a commercial aircraft because I saw commercial aircraft flying when I saw the lights. The object did not move up and down at all, nor did it appear to move toward or away from me.

After about 20 minutes the oject tilted to the right, maybe a 20-30 degree angle, then stayed in that position for the duration of my ability to view it.  
The lights continued to glitter, change color and move mostly from the left to the right of the object, but sometimes the colored lights moved more up and down.  
Nearing 0330, the fog began to roll in and the object seemed to sink very slowly, over about a 5–10 minute time frame, until I was no longer able to see it at all.

I thought maybe it may be the ISS so I went into my house and grabbed my binoculars.  
I went back outside and got the object into view with my binoculars. It still looked like a star as it was moving.  
Then suddenly it stopped and went beck to the west for about 2 seconds.  Then it started to go east once again for a second or two.  It then stopped and went back to the west once again. It did this four times before it suddenly accelerated very fast toward east.  It was out of my sight in a matter of about 8 seconds. 
Note:  Each time it stopped to go in the opposite direction it was with out hesitation.

summary: We were outside giving my child a ride on my dads tractor.  Afterwards, we stood and were talking, when i became fixed on a ball of light moving in the sky behind him.  At first i thought it was a…
Glowing baby blue disk ascending from the clouds, witnessed by 3-4 and photographed
description:
On june 24th, 2014, I witnessed a craft ascending within a cloud formation. This movement created what looked like a cloud table on which the UFO sat atop.
The UFO was glowing a solid baby blue color, much like a florescent bulb.
The craft was not flashing, but remained illuminated at all times.
As the craft ascended, the cloud formation below it grew in size.
The craft was also illuminating the clouds above it, proving that it was resting in-between the clouds.
After about 3 minutes, the craft slid sideways from the cloud table, exposing itself for about a 30-60 seconds and then disappeared in a blink.
I was able to take 2 decent photos of the incident, although the color does not appear in the photos as it did in person.
 I am a non drinking, non drugging, 44 year old medical college student and business owner.
Also witnessed by 2-3 valet/parking attendants who were trying to talk themselves out of what they had seen.

summary: Aircraft was a shiny metallic cigar shape and slowly moved across a city league softball game.
description:
Aircraft was a shiny smooth metallic cigar shape and slowly moved across a city league softball game.  No sound was heard from the craft and no lights blinking like a normal plane.  Also there were no wings on this craft.  This happened during the clear weather and no clouds.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

description: Movement was faster than a typical aircraft but it circled around the sky for approximately 20 minutes then disappeared behind some trees;I was driving at the time.

summary: Black Vertical rapidly developed smoke not showing wind shear, followed by contrail in another direction.
description:
There was a dark almost particle and fairly quickly fading (over 3 minutes) vertical smoke cloud from the sky to the ground very straight up and down (and there was shear wind...I am a pilot so it was very unusual) then moments later a while contrail of smoke that had the shape of a spinning object in the same sight line to the west of observed viewpoint which flew by for a few minutes then suddenly stopped the contrail.  
Perhaps a meteor breaking up?  
It was accompanied by low pitched non-engine noise....also something I have not heard before from aviation flying.
We have requested that the witness submit more, and more detailed, information about the sighting.  PD

summary: Cloud ships over Bethune Beach
description:
While walking on Bethune Beach, I noticed a smallish cloud.  I wondered if it was a cloud-ship because of its odd shape and that it wasn’t moving.  
As I sat at the picnic tables I noticed that 2 larger clouds moved from the west to east and layered themselves above the smaller cloud.  Each progressively larger.  Once in that position they absolutely did not move for over 2 hours. They were situated directly above the shoreline.
Also, a helicopter came from the north and once it got just south of these “clouds” it hovered in place for at least 2 minutes.  It is not unusual for helicopters to travel from the Coast Guard Station (at the inlet) to Patrick Air Force Base, however this was a very different helicopter, it was flying much slower than they usually do and in all my years I have never seen one stop and hover.
People took note of the helicopter, but I honestly don’t believe anyone else took note of the “clouds.”  They were still in place when I left at 14:00 (2 p.m.).
There were 2 other anomalies in the sky at the same time, but I will keep this limited to the UFOs.

Initially thought it was a jet as I seen jet streams so I took random picture in the direction I seen it going and captured some type of orb of light or something I have multiple pictures.

summary: Large oval object in red top mountains.
description:
At 06:12, I was opening the gate to the facility I work at.  After opening the gate, I spotted three other people who was at the park that is located in front of the facility, staring out eat at the mountain  line.  
When I went to see what they were staring at the pointed out a large bright oval disk.  It seem to have stood still.  
Through closer inspection, it appeared to be metallic and glowing in a yellow tint. 
After 10 min of observation it faded behind the clouds and was gone out of sight.

summary: Seamingly intelligent glowing pink cylinder.
description:
Having a cigarette outside, I noticed a pink glowing cylinder about the size of a nunchuk handle.  It did a slow twisting spin, while moving left to right, shifting those movments within a foot or two in the air.
It was as if this object knew I could see it, like a person doing a dance when no one was around and then being startled when caught.  
It stopped its spinning twist, froze, then made a very rapid arch and flew behind my neighboring townhouse.  
There was nobody on the roof of the town house, and diffenitly not a quadcopter as I own a few.  
That night there was a large thunderstorm and there were trees taller than the townhouse giving foreground or a back drop if you will too lend me a very sharp view of this unknow object.

summary: Fireball over Manhattan

It was moving as fast as the planes around it, but was distinctly NOT a plane. 
We were in lower manhattan and the light disappeared over midtown.

summary: The hour of incident may not be accurate but between the hours of 9:30 & 10:30 pm on 23June14, I was on patrol in a Murrels Inlet resort (which will remain anonymous) and was watching over the…
description:
I saw this occurrence happen again and asked a guest in the pool area where I was standing to look over the direction I was pointing.  I told him what I saw but he said he saw nothing. 
This "object" remained in a constant position over the horizon.  
On my next glance, I saw the light glow red and appear to split off to the left in the northern direction.  The red glowing light never came back into view.  
My first thought was a meteor but the duration of the constant light, the lack of movement from its location, and the sudden departure from view, made me question that. 
I saw no other reports of this, but would like it documented.

description:
Bright orange lights in a circle shape that seemed to flash in a small, straight line and then disappear.  
At first it was just two orange lights and then nothing for a minute or so and then there seemed to be more, probably no more than three or four clusters at a time. 
It was over the ocean up with the stars and the whole thing must have lasted about 10 minutes, from around 10:55 to 11:05 as I remember looking at my phone at one point and seeing 11:00pm.

summary: Bright yellow lights appeared and faded over and over again.
description:
Yellow objects would appear and fade across the sky for several minutes.  
Finally, at the end of the event, about 1 mile off the coast, a bright yellow light appeared. 
As it faded, a second bright yellow light appeared directly next to it. 
As it faded, a third one did the same, and then a fourth, and then a fifth. 
The pattern continued for about 30 seconds, the all lit up, began to spread out, and faded out.

description: 2 round orange circles an equal distance apart in the sky parallel to each other.  They appeared to be in the direction of Carolina Beach, NC, possibly over the ocean.  The first light flashed and slowly faded.  The second light flashed and slowly faded.  Then the first light flashed and faded again.  This all lasted about 1 minute total.

summary: Strange lights over ocean in Surfside Beach, SC
description:
At approximately 22:37 on June-23-2014, I had observed 2 orange lights over the ocean. I was standing on the beach at near the pier.  
The lights were glowing bright for 10-15 seconds and then went out.  
They reappeared 5 seconds later and started to break apart into several smaller lights. 
They formed a perfectly straight line across the water until they came back together 10 seconds later. 
The lights went off a couple seconds later. 
After 7 seconds the lights reappeared  and broke off into 8 eight smaller lights. 
They got brighter after they totally separated and then went out. 
I did not see them after that. 2 other people on the beach saw the same thing at the same time. 
This was the most incredible thing I have ever seen. I am going back out tonight to see if I can catch it on film.
We spoke via telephonw with the witness, and he sounded to us to be serious and sober-minded.  He will have another witness submit a report, as well.  PD

summary: Silver cylinder flying object with no wings, flying west, moving in a straight line, with no sound.
description:
Saw a silver cylinder flying object with no wings, flying west over town of Summersville, WV.  No sound and traveling faster than an airliner.  Did not glow.  Must have been about 10-20 thousand feet.  
It flew in a straight line with no exhaust.  But I saw it fly into a light cloud and I could see exhaust but when it exited it into the blue sky, there was no exhaust. 
Thought it was a gov. drone but did not see any wings.
I saw the same silver flying type craft over Summersville Lake a few years ago but at a lot lower altitude. It also had no sound or wings.
Don't know what this thing is but I would like to know.
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
I just submitted a report but, because of the use of military time, I reported the time incorrectly.  I reported it as 8pm local but it was 10pm-11pm local (I guess 22:00-23:00).  Please correct.
((END ADDENDUM))

One would fade out as another showed up appearing in a line. at other times there were several red/ orange lights in no particular arrangement. Same size and shape.  At other times one would appear to split from another and create two lights.  Continued for 30 min.

summary: My family is vacationing at Garden City.
description:
Last night I walked onto balcony of condo and saw three large orange lights come on, one two three in a row.  We had seen this phenomena three years ago here.  
I called to my family to come see the lights.  Within a few minutes successive large red/orange fireballs would illuminate and extinguish.  
Then we noticed small blinking lights, numerous, up to ten at a time moving all over the sky in the area of the big orange lights.  All of this activity seemed to be from Garden City pier to Myrtle Beach State Park and mostly over ocean.  Any number of arrangement of lights were seen up to a large perfectly shaped chevron shape formed by eight of the big fireballs.  
The fireballs appeared as groups of three and four tightly spaced as well.  At some intervals between fireball appearances there were as much as 5 to 10 solid minutes of small sparkling lights moving for miles up and down the coast.  
I am employed in aviation and I am! reasonably convinced that no aircraft were seen.  The appearance as well as the silence had more of a ghostly feel than of nuts and bolts aircraft. 
Many people were on beach so im sure others witnessed.

summary: Large rectangular object with blue lights in 2 triangle patterns on the outsides flying slowly
description:
Fairly quiet with 7-9 blue lights in the pattern of 2 triangles facing each other on the points. Rectangular..passed over my house in a rural area. 
Headed to the 13K ft peaks curved left towards Taos and disappeared out of sight. 
All in less than 90 seconds…
We spoke via telephone with the source of the report, and he sounded to us to be quite eloqent in his description of the event, and quite passionate about the dramatic nature of the sighting.  PD

I feel that if it was moving that they would fade out but these went out like a light blub.

summary: Three orange lights seen by 4 people south of Gila Bend AZ
description:
All objects were orange bright lights.  We were driving eastbound on I-8 around Gila Bend, AZ when we noticed a single orange light to the south.  It appeared to be about 5-10 miles away and approx. 2-3000 feet up.  At times we could see the background of the mountains silhouetting from the orange glow of the light and it also appeared to have a smoke trail coming from the light.  The single light stayed up for a few minutes, then disappeared. within seconds, it reappeared, then a second orange light appeared at the same altitude. It also appeared to have a light smoke trail coming from it.  Then about 5 tracer lights shot from the second light and disappeared.  Then within  a few seconds another round of tracer lights appeared  but came the sky towards the light.  Then the two lights faded and a single light appeared and then  second light and then a third light.  Within a few minutes they all disappeared.  My nephew said he could make out a shadowy figure aroun! d the orange lights, but I was driving and wasn't able to stare at it long enough to make it out.  Observers were Me and my wife ages 53, my wife's sister and her son, ages 43 and 15.  All of sound mind and body.
Witness…

summary: Circular craft flying low with one steady green light and two alternating red lights.
description:
Made a noise inconsistent with a plane flying at that altitude.  There were flashing lights similar to those of a plane, but unusual: one steady green light, and two alternating red lights all in a line.  
The object passed directly over me, and the lights revealed the shape of the craft - looking circular--no wing shapes, just a circle.  
It continued in the line and turned left out of sight.  
Multiple aircraft were nearby, though none seemed to respond.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Orange lights appeared over ocean off Litchfield Beach, SC
description:
Witnessed several groups of orange lights in sky over ocean at Litchfield Beach of Pawleys Island, SC.  
At first, a group of orange lights appeared, flared then disappeared.  Next, a second group of 3-4 orange lights appeared, flared, then disappeared.  
Next, two groups of several orange lights appeared close to each other in the same general area as the other two groups of lights.  The orange lights in the left group began to rotate in a line to its right (our left) and disappearing to the right (our left) as if the lights were rotating around a circular object and disappearing behind it.  
Then these two groups of lights disappeared.  
Next, two groups of orange lights appeared to our right what had to be several miles from where the original orange lights had appeared.  The timing and location of these groups of orange lights indicated that there was no humanly way that they could be the same orange lights as we had seen to our left.  These also flared and disappeared.  
There were a couple more of sets of orange lights that appeared, flared, and disappeared in the same general area and to our right of where the last groups appeared before the event ended.

summary: White elongated pill shaped thing with rounded ends spotted on a beautiful sunny morning
description:
The sky was blue with puffy white clouds.  I glanced out the kitchen window and spotted some type of skycraft.  I realized it was not a plane, so I grabbed my binoculars and ran out to the driveway to get a better look.
What I observed was shaped like an elongated pill, rounded at both ends, white in color with odd charcoal grey markings on the bottom 1/3 of it.  No wings, no tailfin, no landing gear, no windows, no blinking lights, no numbers, no trail behind it.
It tracked in a steady speed in a north-westerly direction, silent.
I only got to see it for a short time, during those precious seconds I was observing as much detail as I could.
Has anyone seen this? I'd like to know, because I am a little unnerved by it.

summary: Black cross drone buzzing from possibly LA to Newport, at SE 45 degree angle to Springdale Ave. possibly headed for Newport
description:
Black cross shaped drone with four propellers buzzing at 45 degree angle to Springdale Ave. as if it came from Los Angeles and was flying to Google?  Irvine/Newport.  
Did not seem to have a package or anything attached below.  Was traveling South/East at about 40 mph, over homes north of 405 fwy between Springdale and Edwards, headed seemingly towards Newport direction.  
I was in the garden.  
I was not aware they are allowed to fly around town like this whether it is for commercial or law enforcement/traffic use.

summary: Unexplained Triangular Flying Craft With Bright Lights At Myrtle Beach.
description:
Around 9:30 on June 23rd my family and I decided to take a walk on the beach near pier 14 in Myrtle Beach.  
As we were walking my husband first noticed one really bright light.  
Then as we watched for over a period of 2 hours yellowish orange lights would appear in different formations then would disappear.   
Finally the craft or flying object appeared and was very close to the shore. Two bright lights appeared and seemed to be about half a mile apart.  
Then a third light and the craft seemed to be rotating in a circle.  This is how we could tell the shape of the ufo.  It had 3 distinct points.  
I'm not sure what we watched for over two hours but have never seen that color of lights in the sky and the form andquickness of it.  
I would love to get feedback or know if anyone knows for sure what it is.  
We were able to record a few seconds of the lights…

summary: Large triangle-shaped, pitch black silhouette, silent running craft seen gliding over Lake Ontario near the Toronto Islands.
description:
June 23rd, 2014, just past midnight of a very beautiful clear night, I was sitting out on the terrace of my 13th floor waterfront condo enjoying the night sky out over Lake Ontario.
It was near 1:00 am when three round disk shaped objects floating through the sky caught my attention.  The disks were dark grey in colour, but visible enough to be seen in contrast to the black sky beyond.
While startled by the objects, I was able to quickly focus and observed the 3-disks were located at the vertices of a very large triangle-shaped pitch black silhouette craft, silent running and gliding over Lake Ontario near the Toronto Islands and the Eastern Channel.
I observed the craft for only about 5 seconds as it moved west to east parallel to the waterfront in a relatively slow gradual descent from a position of about 15-20 degrees above the horizon covering approximately 200m or so before disappearing into the night sky.
I would like to know if anyone else had a similar sighting on this night or any other.

I only saw it for about 5 seconds before it went beyond the tree line.  It was a cloudy overcast night so the sky behind was light gray and made it very easy to see. It made no sound at all.

summary: Saw three orange orbs moving steadily, hovering, and then traveling vast distances within seconds, over Brooklyn, NY.
description:
On June 22, 2014, I was sitting on my private outdoor rooftop in Brooklyn, NY, (Williamsburg) with a friend of mine.  I watch the sky every night - I can usually find Mars if it is visible, can identify numerous constellations, know the difference between a satellite and an airplane, and just love to stare out into space.  
At about 10:17 PM, I was looking at the sky as I always do, but it wasn't a very clear night and very few stars were visible due to the massive light pollution created by the New York City lights.  
Out of the corner of my eye I noticed an orange glowing orb of light.  After doing a quick double-take, I saw there were actually three orbs of light moving across the sky in a way I have NEVER seen any craft or airplane or satellite move - ever.  It was completely silent and seemed to float through the air.  I instantly knew I was seeing a UFO; I had absolutely no doubt in my mind.
In the midst of my excitement/awe/disbelief, I grabbed my iPhone and tried to record as much as I could (I knew that if I didn't capture this experience no one would ever believe me).  The orbs of light moved across the sky and I took my first video but to the blind eye and without the…

summary: 3 reddish lights hovering in side-triangle formation - split apart 2 off to the east like lighting one remained hovering over tree line
description: Northeast sky 3 reddish color lights hovered in a side-triangle formation.   Two eventually "flew" toward the east in a sideways manner (very fast) and the 3rd one streaked downward and then hovered over a tree line - eventually lifted up and we thought possibly towards us, then slowly remained going upward and then away from us until out of sight.   They did not get close enough for us to see any shape, other than 3 round lights - and they may have "pulsed" very slightly.   My 1st time ever witnessing anything like this!!   Objects may have been too far away to get picture with cell phone...

summary: At approximately 10 pm on June 22, 2014, I saw what appeared to be a star - (I thought it was venus for a moment)  The star was moving extremely fast across the sky; way too fast to be an aircraft.…
Bright white light in night sky gliding quickly and then fading.
description:
A coworker and I observed a bright white light moving swiftly as if gliding from west to east.  
The light was bright enough to create a halo or star beam type effects.  
We never took our focus off of it, then it dimmed until no more light was visible.  Its range seemed as though the light turned off with a fade, and not due to being out of range.  
It had no other lights, just a solid bright white light.  
There were no stars visible at this hour, just pitch black night sky.
Possible sighting of the ISS?  PD

summary: Orbs over Deming, NM, nightly!!
description:
Every night , beginning at dark,spherical objects appear, flying south and north, sometimes in pairs.  Some flash brightly....and vanish, others drift along correcting course, all vanish over the Floridas mountains.  
Ive seen shooting stars come down in front of them, they simply change course, ive seen them fly directly over aircraft.  In one night i counted 22 traveling back and forth from north to south,  Ive showed them to many people and they never fail to appear we cant stop looking up now, ((what)) are they.

summary: Police helicopter and a low flying, very brightly lite object, flying close together on 22 June over La Mirada, California.
description: I was visiting La Mirada, California.  I saw a bright light traveling north to south and it also traveled directly above me.  This sighting was for 4 minutes from 9:03-907 pm Sunday night on 22 June 2014.  I first noticed the bright light in the northern sky over La Mirada Regional Park.  It was bright and low. It flew directly overhead and continued towards Fullerton.  The light did not change in intensity as it was coming towards me or when it traveled away from me.  There were no flashing collision lights.  I was standing about one block south of the park.  I am guessing that around the border of La Mirada and Fullerton, less than a mile south of me, the brightly lite object slowly faded out.  For a few seconds, I could see the city lights reflect off the very dark, black object.  Just for a second I looked at the helicopter and when I tried to relocate the unlike black object, I could not find it.  This sighting was unusual in that there was a police helicopter! traveling with the UFO and at about the same speed.  The helicopter and the brightly lite object were only a few hundred feet apart.  The helicopter was not directly under it, but was slightly west of it.  After both…

summary: Triangle with three lights flew over, very low and completely silently.
description:
Family was outside after my cousin's graduation party. It was dark but we hadn't turned any lights on to avoid the June-bugs.  We were looking up because my uncle had an application on his phone that showed the various constellations.  Then, from one side of the sky I thought I saw movement, but it was hard to focus on what was going on (whatever it was blended perfectly with the light-polluted sky).  I pointed at it and told everyone to look. It flew directly over us.  No sound.  I wouldn't have been able to see it had it not been for the lights that appeared on the corners.  What was strange is that the lights appeared to be facing inward towards the center of the aircraft itself.  As it flew over I was become annoyed by the fact that nobody was saying anything, so I asked, "Is anybody seeing this!?"  Two of my cousins replied exuberantly, with a hint of horror (which I understand completely, because this was really a strangely terrifying experience).  It disappeared a few seconds later into the light pollution coming up off the horizon.
The people who saw it were myself (a 16 year old high school student), my cousin (an 18 year old who just graduated), my second-cousin (also a…

summary: Red glowing light under a disk shape
description:
At 20:30 I went out to my backyard to get fresh air and called a friend.  At 20:35 I was facing north while conversing when I spotted 2 objects coming from the north and glowing red.  
I could not take a video at the moment while on the phone, so I ended the call but as they flew overhead I saw a round disk shape and a glowing red light underneath.
I took two videos of 2 separate objects.  There was actually 4 objects but the first 2 were flying together the next one came about 1 minute after and the next was about 30 seconds after the 3rd one.  I looked for more but did not spot anymore in the sky.  
Hard to tell the elevation but I believe they were maybe about 1,500 to 2,000 feet, and the objects' elevation did not change they stayed at the same level.

summary: Reddish-purple fireball seen above Fillmore, Ca. on a Sunday night.
description:
Was driving back home in Fillmore from work around 8:40 pm on Sunday night.  I parked my car on the side of the street when i saw a strange purple/red light high in the sky.  The color was unlike any I have seen before, it was almost glistening slightly like a star would and it also emitted with its colors like a fireball, with what i believe to be blue and red, (giving it the purple color maybe?) and it was moving too slow be to a plane.  Actually, my brother told me that he and his friends also saw the same object but from a different part of town but they were much closer and he said that it was reddish-purple and round like a circle.
While I was parked watching this object it got behind a tree that was blocking my view of it, even though i was still able to see some of it through the tree leaves.  After a few minutes i got out of my car and walked in front of the tree because i hadn't seen the object move past it.  By the time i got there it was gone. I never saw it "leave," it just vanished even though I had kept my eyes glued to see through the leaves and the empty space around the tree.

summary: A red fire-ball shot across, low in the sky and then disappeared instantly.
description:
Very large and clear, low in the sky, but too high to be fireworks, too low and quiet to be a plane. 
Too low to have been a falling star.  
Glowing, red fire ball shot across the sky and then faded out instantly.
We confirmed with the witness that the sighting was in the evening, and we have amended the time to reflect that fact.  PD

They appeared to be between 500 to 1,000 feet above me moving at about the speed a small, single engine private airplane might be at cruise.
They made no sound that I could hear, and that area is relatively quiet at that time on a Saturday night.  They were not equadistant from each other, and some would fall back, then catch up with the one in front again.  Gaps in the line of objects were not constant, and there were even some stragglers way in back of the main 7 or 8 objects.  I watched untill I could no longer see them because of the buildings and trees nearby.
The weather was very clear and cool, I would say near 70 degrees.  Maybe a light breeze.

summary: Six oval-like objections seen flying in formation.
description:
I was up on the roof of my apartment complex, lying on my back and taking the night sky in.  I saw what I thought to be a shooting star in the sky to the east.  As I looked through my binoculars, I discovered 6 oval-like shapes moving in formation.  
They emitted no light nor made any sound, and were dark brown in appearance.  The shape of the objects reminded me of the cap of a mushroom, and they moved slightly from side to side while in formation.  
They moved westward through the sky, at an apparent high rate of speed, similar to that of a satellite.  As they headed toward the western horizon, the two objects on the flanks shifted away from the group and quickly fell back in formation.  
This event lasted approximately one minute.

summary: Triangle black in color, three white lights, 100-200 feet per side of triangle, loss of time, and events.
description:
On 6/21/2014 at 22:54, I was smoking a cigarette outside my house facing my garage.  Out of no wear, I herd a horrific sound coming from behind me.  I turned around a seen a huge ship moving very slow coming towards me.  I froze at first, it was in the shape of a triangle. I garbed my cell phone (Galexcy S5) and recorded a 45-second video.
After I lost site with it reviewed the video.  To my amazement it recorded first 3 sec and last 10 sec of video.  It had three white lights on each corner of the ship.  The only color of the ship was black and looked very smooth.  The size of it was….
Huge.  I don’t know how to put it size.  If I had to guess I would say 100-200 ft per side of triangle.  It was heading south in direction.  
I got a overwhelming sense of fear; went to grab my .45 handgun that was sitting on the table a few feet from me.  What really creep me out was that one of the bullets on my gun was sitting out side of the gun next to it on table.  
Sorry just out of words at this point.

summary: Bright, white light in Buffalo sky.
description:

While observing the stars, I noticed a bright light in the SW part of the sky moving.  I first thought it was a typical airplane or helicopter, but there weren't any red/green lights or any sound. 
Then I thought it may be a meteor, but it was moving way to slow.  While it was travelling roughly the same speed as a typical aircraft, I knew that it couldn't be one.  (Growing up in the area near the Buffalo/Niagara airport, I am very aware of all the aircraft coming in and out of the airspace in the area)  
This was no typical aircraft.  The light moved from the WSW to ENE night sky for about 3 mins before it simply vanished.  
Very strange.

summary: White bright light ascending at immense rate.
description:

No navigational lights were observed-extremely bright light larger than the North Star.

It had appeared to ascend sharply in to the sky like a "J" shape hooking in to space with very great speed.  A small very faint light trail of it's trajectory was left for a fraction of a second during these last moments.
The speed was the most fantastic characteristic of the observation.
