summary: Three orange fire-ball lights seen streaming across the overhead sky.
description:
On 6/21/14, 4 adults were watching the western horizon to observe an ISS flyby..
(ISS is the International Space Station.) It was visible in our area (Whidbey Island) at 9:49pm for 4 minutes.  It became visible in the WSW at 11 degrees above the horizon and departed at 11 degrees S.  We could see it fly over the Olympics.
We were on the west side of Whidbey Island, on a bluff overlooking the water on the south end of the island.  It is about 30 miles from the Naval Air Station.
Three objects appeared, consecutively, about a minute or so after we watched the ISS, but they were overhead.  
As soon as one disappeared in the southern tree line, another appeared from the north.  The objects were oval shaped.  
From below, we didn't see them as 3 dimensional.  They were orange, reddish, almost flame colored with no contrail or flame trail.  Seemed to be like a low flying aircraft.  
We fully expected the first one, when noticed, to be a "search" helicopter with spotlight.  However, it was shortly followed by a second and then a third object.  
All three appeared to have the same overhead trajectory and followed each other at ~30 sec intervals.  Too close to have been the same object…

summary: Four lights were observed over Minooka, IL exhibiting abnormal flight characteristics and lack of standard navigation illumination.
description:
From a patio in a suburban neighborhood, the primary witness observed a small, bright red light rising from the horizon in the WSW direction.  The direction corresponded approximately with that regularly observed for commercial airlines/cargo aircraft on approach to MDW or ORD.  The light approached from WSW, heading NE at an apparent velocity at least 4-5 times the apparent velocity of a typical commercial aircraft seen on approach from that direction.  At first, the primary witness considered that the light was a low aircraft without standard landing or navigational illumination.  There seemed to be a faint hiss from the light as it approached.  As it reached between 30 and 45 degrees in elevation above the horizon, the light instantly decreased in apparent velocity and changed heading N.  The light then continued on at the reduced velocity until it reached a position to the NW of the observation position (still at similar angle of elevation) and appeared ! to hover.
As the light began to hover, the witness observed two more identical lights in close formation with each other follow the same approach and pattern at similar velocity.  The faint hissing sound also seemed to…

summary: Glowing orbs in ocean surf during thunderstorm.
description:
This sighting may not technically be classified as "UFO", since the objects were not actually flying, but it came on the heels of (1) a sighting of the typical orange orbs and flashing white lights frequently seen over the ocean, and (2) a sighting of a strange aircraft which I believe was a military drone.  I am reporting those sightings separately.
On the night of June 20, my husband and I were vacationing with his family at an ocean-front home on Oak Island about 1/2 mile east of Ocean Crest Pier.  At about 10:30 a thunderstorm began to roll in, and by about 11:00 the storm was in full force.  My husband, his brother, my daughter and I were out on the porch facing the ocean, watching the lightning.  My daughter, who is 22 years old, suddenly said "what is THAT?" and pointed to the right (west) toward the beach.
We saw a glowing, blue ball.  At first we assumed someone was walking on the beach with a light, although it was a torrential downpour and there was lighting flashing every 10 seconds or so.  However, when the lightning would flash we could clearly see that the ball was floating in the surf, probably in about 4 feet of water, and it was moving in a straight, steady line…

This red light was never blinking or changing in any way except for the disappearance.  To all of us watching it seemed that the object was moving in a slightly fluctuating speed although keeping a steady path.  The overall speed was that of a helicopter. At approximately 9:35 this evening I observed 4 glowing objects coming from S, moving N/NE, traveling at between 70-200-mph at about 600-800 feet in altitude and climbing over Murrells Inlet South Carolina.  (Highway 707 at around Tournament Blvd.  
The objects were flying in pairs of two.  They appeared to be parasails with lights around them, but they were moving too fast and climbing too fast to be a parachute.  They were arc shaped and looked to be 40-50 across. 
When I first observed they were slow, then within a matter of 15 seconds sped up and flew into a cloud later at a high rate of speed.  There was no sound associated with these objects.  Zero sound.  
I thought they were flares initially but I’ve never seen flares slow down, speed up and accelerate as these did.  
The lights associated with these craft was a yellowish haze with stronger lights in the center trailing edge. No blinking lights observed.  
This is one of the strangest sightings I have ever seen.  I am a pilot and flew military aircraft in the 70’s.  I also fly radio control aircraft and sailplanes.

summary: This was not any type of Aircraft, it had a orange steady glow, and never faded out as do most meteors.

At or around 21:30 HRS. on 06/20/2014, while outside in my backyard with my dog, I observed a round brightly glowing object, flying at a high rate of speed from the east heading west.  
I kept my attention on the object, thinking it could be a meteor entering the atmospehere.  Then I noticed that it was not fading out as most do, and had no tail.  
As it streak over, there was no noise or blinking such as you would see with a plane with its navigational lights on.  
It was large in size from where I stood; it was at least two to three inches in diameter and at a very great altitude.  
I also observed how smooth and even its flight trajectory appeared to be. 
I live in El Paso Texas on the eastside of the Franklin Mountains. 
I watched the object until it was out of sight. 
Very Amazing!

I stopped in my tracks and observed the object, wondering if it was some kind of climate phenomenon or unusual lighting, but quickly understood this was most likely not the case.
The triangle was flat, with clear borders, and its inside looked like a very shiny, almost fiery, orange hologram (I could see the tree located behind through it).  
It was a bit taller than a small van.  The center was pinkish, as well as its corners.  
Whereas usually at this time of day there are many birds flying around, there were eerily none to be seen near the area at that time.
I wanted to make sure I was truly witnessing what I was seeing so I approached the window and started screaming and calling to other family members to come and see. summary: Multiple light formation seen at 9pm Friday, June 20th, over the Potomac river in VA, from tallest hill in Washington, DC.

I live on the top of a big hill in DC that overlooks the Potomac river.  I was looking out my window towards the South East and over Virginia or the river, I saw a slow moving formation of lights.  Not unlike what I've seen of the "Phoenix Lights."  I watched them for a little while 15-30 mins.  I took some photographs, which I will submit.  
This view also encompasses the takeoff/landing path for Reagan National airport in Alexandria, VA, but I have been watching the planes come and go for a couple of years, and have never ever seen something like this.  
The lights in the formation moved in inconsistent ways.  Some moving up and down some left (south) some right (north).  I went out to the street and could see them there as well.  I went in to get something to eat and when I returned they were gone.  
Also to note, the lights were orange, not yellow or white.  I did see aircraft take off from the airport while the event was occurring and it appears the the lights were further off than the aircraft.

I stuck my head out the window as it flew directly over my head, about 10 seconds from first sight, and at the hwy DD/Winghaven exit and I look up at it.  As it was coming towards me as well as when it was directly over me it appeared to be an orange fireball with a black center.  It was flying very low.
As I was driving at the time, I could only look up at it for a second or two, looked back at the road, then looked back at it out my driver side window.  I did not see the orange fire from behind, but only the shadow of a craft before I had to look away again.  
I have heard of the orange fireballs on C2Cam, or else I would have thought this was a plane on fire.  I looked a again for it behind me and saw nothing.  From first sight to end do sighting was about 20 secs.

It was larger than any kite I have seen and showed no response to the wind.
It was rush hour and I am surprised not to see hundreds of reports on the net from this observation.

It was possible within 100 feet above my car.  I did not see any lights or markings on the craft.  At first I thought it was an airplane.  
After it moved in front of my vehicle, I saw it was not a plane.  Just as I went to take a photo of it with my phone, it shot straight up into the sky at a tremendous speed.  I did not see it any longer.

summary: Object dropped out of a cloud, remained stationary for 15 seconds, moved west, then in an instant was gone.

Then I noticed a smaller cloud more to the south west but still high in the sky. 
The sun was still pretty high over the mountains to the west and was shining brightly. 
While looking at this cloud an oval shaped disk dropped out of the cloud and hung motionless in the air for about 15 seconds. 
I couldn't believe my eyes. 
Then it started to move westward and in an instant was gone.

summary: East on route 30, noticed an oval shaped silverish mirror appearance object in sky.  Very still in the sky and then disappeared.
description:
Driving East on route 30 reaching a light.  I noticed a sparkle and or reflection of sun in the sky and started to stare and noticed an oval shaped (zeppelin shape in comparison) silverish mirror like material hovering or floating in the sky.
The object was very still.  Then it seemed or started to turn in a different direction.  Because I noticed the shape changing.  
Then it just seemed to vanish like magic.  All this in about 2-3 minutes.

summary: Two orange spheres one ejected a ball of white light
description:
At 2 am, I went out to my second floor balcony to smoke.  
Coming from the east 2 orange balls what I thought were probably airplanes moving slowly to the west.  I couldn't see any of the typical red light on one side green on the other.  I thought perhaps they were headed to the airport a few miles away.  
Their distance apart remained about the same.  The one behind appeared to stop for a few moments but they were traveling slowly so I wasn't sure.  
While this was going on  a helicopter began circling the downtown area with its strobe light on.  It made about three passes.  
Not unusual, there are helicopters out every night.  I thought the helicopter would report anything unusual and I would read about it in the morning.  
The forward one then turned south.  As it almost went out of sight, I swear a small ball of light was ejected from the bottom.  The one behind that seemed to hover for moments turned south and very slowly disappeared in the distance.  
I went ! back in my room to watch Highway patrol and noted it was around 02:10 and I hadn't missed too much of the tv show.

summary: White light observed traversing sky SW to NE then descending in a fallen leaf motion.
description:
The object was first observed sometime between 1am and 2am on Friday June 20th, 2014, (I know this was the time because we were waiting on the moonrise which I knew should be shortly) from campsite #4 in Bald Eagle State Forest by both myself and my girlfriend.  The object was a constantly illuminated white-colored orb (spherical), which was about the brightness and size of the planet Jupiter when viewed in the night sky with the naked eye, and which traversed the sky from southwest to northeast at about the same pace as a commercial airliner would be moving, possibly faster.  It was initially moving in a straight line, but then began to disappear beneath the visible horizon while making a zigzagging motion, much like a falling leaf.  The object made no sound.
The object then reappeared in the north about ten minutes after the initial sighting in the exact same or approximate location as the North Star.  We did not realize at the time that this object was sighted in that particular location until the following days when a stationary star was spotted in the same locale, which was obviously the North Star.  Our best guess is that either we did not see the North Star during…

summary: It was green with some red lights.
description:
It was moving at high speeds moving east and then would stop and turn sharply heading west. 
It moved very fast again and reapeted the same movements. 
It then seemed to float low and then out of sight.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 3 Orangish-red orbs in a triangle with a 4th of the same color "behind" and to the right of triangle formation.
description:
3 Orangish-red orbs in a triangle with a 4th orb of the same color "behind" and to the right of the triangle formation.  Moving slowly, if at all, more like hovering still.  Then vanished.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: bright white craft skipped across sky
description:
Dim circle craft skipped across the night sky. 
Would get bright white then dim again multiple times.

summary: I was on my deck and noticed two bright lights emerging above some trees at the house next door.
description:
Detroit Metro is that direction, so I thought nothing of it.
The two objects passed over my head slowly, no blinking lights, at the same speed and kept the same distance from each other.
About two minutes later another appeared from the same direction, this one I got phone footage of.
After thinking I saw some weird shit, I saw another emerging from the same direction through the trees.  This one moved slower and didnt seem to keep a steady direction. It didnt pass over head like the others then what seemed like only two blocks away it seemed to somewhat implode, then  turn to dust and slowly just disappear.  I got footage of this also but the lighting totally sucks.
I ran inside and awoke my girlfriend who thought I was just crazy, and sure as shit he comes another, it also passed over our house and out of site as we watched through a window.
I sat outside for another hour waiting for something else to occur but nothing happened.

summary: Looked a bright light that was moving in zig-zag and circular motions.
description:
We were outside sitting in my driveway looking at the stars and we all looked up and saw a very bright, almost flashing, light.  
It was there for about 10 minutes and then we looked away for about 2 minutes and when we looked back it was completely gone. 
Just a couple of minutes ago we looked and it was back and then gone again.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: While sitting on my front porch, my attention was drawn to this airplane that kept circling in the sky around the area where I have seen multiple odd things come shooting out of the sky.
description:
After about an hour of watching this plane circle, it flew off heading North.   
Approximately five minutes after it exited the area, this large,circular object reddish/orange in color, appeared in the Western sky and headed SE and then stopped.  
I then witnessed what appeared to be red colored lightning and then smoke or a cloud began forming around it, 
I ran inside grabbed my phone and climbed onto my roof to record the event.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: UFO emitting bright blue and white light traveling East to West right over the overpass (10 ft) on Garrison at a fast pace (~15 s)
description:
We were driving down Garrison, and right before the overpass, an object passed going from east to west. 
It was bright and something my friend and I had never seen before. It was really bright with white and blue lights. 
There is no way to describe the shape. A bunch of parallel lines emitting bright lights.

summary: Reddy/orange rectangle slow moving slow flashing light.
description:
Reddy/orange slow flashing light moving south slowly & changing direction in a step formation.  Then it disappeared.
This was not a Chinese lantern.

summary: red,blue,green cylinder or egg-shaped craft directly over central Austin, Texas
description:
twice now, my apartment mate and i have seen an egg/cylinder-like craft flying at an unknown height and moving silently and swiftly coming to a full stop without slowing down, making crisp right angles and ascending and descending with tremendous acceleration.  
The first sighting occurred at 23:00hrs (CST) on Thursday, 06/19/14, and the second sighting occurred an hour later on Saturday, 06/21/14.  
The object displayed  red, blue and green colored lights that would slowly dim and brighten.  At first we thought it may have been a police helicopter but it had no beacon, no searchlight nor any sign of a forward light and it moved so effortlessly, guickly and silently through the sky. on both occasions it flew over central Austin, heading south and then north finally descending east of Interstate 35 resulting in its disappearance behind our nearest treeline.

twice now, my apartment mate and i have seen an egg/cylinder-like craft flying at an unknown height and moving silently and swiftly coming to a full stop without slowing down, making crisp right angles and ascending and descending with tremendous acceleration.

summary: Five reddish lights moving in an x formation traveling south west over Rochester.
description:
Five reddish orange lights over Rochester NY .Two at the top one centrally below and two more below.  
They were moving south west together at great speed before fading out of sight.  
Noticed when bringing out the trash.

summary: Two lighted objects were moving very fast across the night sky when one caught up with the other and it fell from the sky.
description:
On June 19, 2014, from 10:45 pm-11:00pm, my husband and I witnessed two lighted objects in the sky that were very close together.  The objects caught our attention because they were very close to each other, had lights that resembled airplanes, and were moving very fast.  
They were moving from east to west in the sky.  The first lighted object, which was in front, had white lights.  The second lighted object had red, green, and white lights, that were bright and constantly blinking.
The second lighted object caught up to the first and for a couple of seconds they appeared to be one lighted object. 
 Then, the white-lighted object appeared to fall from the sky and we lost sight of it behind the trees.
The brighter blinking object immediately reversed its direction and headed away to the northwest.  We watched this object until we could no longer see it.
This was the most unusual thing we have ever witnessed and I am compelled to report the event.
My husband is a surgeon and I am a homemaker.  We are in our mid 50’s.

summary: 2 orbs caught on local news live broadcast
description:
On Thursday evening my wife and I turned on our local news station in San Antonio.  Prior to the weather announcements they always show a live screenshot of the city in the background.  
What we saw looked like 2 orbs fly into the picture.  The anomaly on top comes into the screen in a downwards motion and then begins to zig zag and then flies off and disappears.  
The anomaly that is on the lower area of the screen continues in almost a straightforward pattern and then disappears.  I've shown this video to several family and friends and they've all been astonished.  
I am submitting the video to you in hopes that you can shed some expertise on what you think I have on video.  
The recording you are viewing is from my Samsung S4 phone and it is a short clip but you can easily see these anomalies come into the picture. 
Please contact me if you have any further questions. 
Thanks

summary: Two bright lights with smaller blinking light in center hovered silently then moved left faster than a plane.
description:
Two large lights and one smaller light in between that blinked at about once a second. 
Hovered above a large field by a smaller road then after we watched it for 10 minutes or so it went behind the clouds and changed direction moving towards our left very fast (faster than any plane we've ever seen) without any noise.

summary: small orange ball of light flying from West 2 south east.  Very slow moving, then simply disappearing.
Bright light hovering then moving with no sound.
description:
I'm 34 and live out in the country in Patterson.  
My mother was over and we went outside to check on my animals and I looked up and noticed a yellow bright object in the south.  It was hovering and made no sound.  
I began to record it using my cell phone.  
My sheep, chickens and dogs became agitated.  The object became brighter and then began to move upwards.  
At this moment a helicopter flew over the top of it.  It didn't budge.  Then it began moving towards the north east and the closer it came the more we could make out that it now had 3 lights, and a dark oval outline.  
The main light was yellow and the other two were blue.  It still made no sound.  It was dead silent and flew at the attitude of a police helicopter and flew right overhead but, silence. 
During the time we watched it, my cell phone kept shutting down.  We watched it until it disappeared behind the orchard.

My family and myself are vacationing in a four story condo overlooking the ocean at north Carolina beach.  
On our third night we were out on the balcony relaxing watching the waves crash on the beach when a strange red orb appeared in the sky over the ocean what appeared to be several miles out when my step son said did you see that I at first replied did you see lighting.  
He said I dont think so then it appeared again it lingered for several minutes this time and then faded away to reappear again in the same location some times as three light close together.  
At times there would be up to three groupings of these lights in spread out locations at the same time they would linger for a minute then fade away to reappear in up to five mins latter. We called for the rest of the family to watch. 
This went on for over an hour with the time in between each appearance getting longer.  It was too high in the sky to be from a boat and didn't behave like any aircraft I have ever saw.
On the fourth night 06/20/14 around 22:30 we were on the private board walk for the condo we were staying in when we saw the light again this time I pointed it out to a man that was staying next door to us…

summary: 2 big orange lights in parallel formation with 5 other white ones far behind in a different formation as number 5 in a dice.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: bright floating object brighter then all the stars floating about from south to northeast lasted about 10 min then just blinked and vanished.
description: We assume a nighttime sighting, and have amended the time above.  The source of the report elects to remain totally anonymous, and provides no contact information, so we are unable to verify the time.  PD

summary: Glowing green ball of light moving across the sky near Lake Lanier.
description: I was sitting outside of the lake house on Lake Lanier just off of Nix Rd.  I was looking up at the sky when out of nowhere I saw a (one) green glowing ball that just appeared and it was moving slowly but steadily across the sky until my view was blocked by tree lines.  It was not leaving any trails but I could definitely see a solid green ball in the middle and it was glowing green all around it.

summary: Red round object with naked eye, disk shape with flames through scope in southwest  sky
description:
At approximately 9:20 PM, my husband told me to view a red round object in the southwest sky at about 2:00 in our Leica spotting scope.  
It appeared with the naked eye smaller than a full moon and larger than a planet.  Viewing it through the scope it appeared to be more of a disk that was tipping slightly up and down and from side to side with white and blue flames exiting the top. 
It quickly got smaller as it moved to the south very rapidly in a straight line.
We spoke via telephone with the source of this report, and she sounded to us to be both eloquent, and sober-minded.  We suspect her report is quite reliable.  PD

summary: Round, firey red, stationary object in the sky.
description:
In the southern sky saw a round red object stationary at about two o’clock in the sky.  It did not seem to move but flickered as if on fire.  I did not have any field glasses so this was with normal vision.  
The object appeared to be about the size of a pencil erasure held at arm's length.  
The object grew smaller as it appeared to travel away from me at great speed.

summary: High Triangular Object?
description:
A few minutes past nine in the evening I was in the yard and noticed, to the west-northwest (over the Gulf of Mexico) several thunderheads.  
Behind them there was still some light and the sky was not quite dark, though nearly so.  One only of these thunderheads, at about 340 degrees, was lit with a particularly brilliant sequence of lightning bolts, coming repeatedly every few seconds.  
As I watched it, I saw a plane (with its anticollision lights blinking) pass below between the thunderclouds and myself.  And then, high up, seemingly at or a little above the tops of the thunderheads,  I saw a white light moving towards the northeast.  I thought it might be a satellite or very high jet, but then the single light resolved into three separate white lights, in a tight triangular formation.  
The object then slowed, reversed direction, then slowed, proceeded northeast again and went behind another high cloud.  I waited for it to reappear on the far side of the cloud, bu! t it never did so.  
The object(s) must have been at a very high altitude, and it occurred to me that to see the three lights distinctly separate at such height must indicate large size.

summary: Yellowish/orange object that darted in multiple directions quickly.
description:
I first thought it was an airplane but it was too high in the sky.  It was flashing orange/yellow colors.  
It took off quickly and stopped just as quickly as it started, hovered for a few seconds and then took off quickly and stopped again, but in a different direction. 
It continued to travel on in a zig zag form like that until I could no longer see it.
((

summary: 2 Glowing circular crafts high in sky, not satellite or plane by deductive logic, disappeared in a flash.
description:
I looked up and, as in my past sightings, saw a round flying/gliding (such smooth fluid movement) objects that looked small enough to be a star but again it was moving, it was too high to be a plane and it didn't have blinking lights like all the other planes clearly overhead, again it was up sooo high way past where planes fly.  It didn't fly straight enough and I have to assume it was traveling too fast to be a satellite (how high it was and how quick it went across sky was way too quick considering every inch it traveled was probably a ridiculous amount of miles.  Made planes look like slow pokes) I followed until it disappeared, which means it zipped off or went too high in altitude, as the sky was very clear no clouds.  That one disappeared and a minute or two later I saw another in a different area of the sky, same as the other, traveling around way too high to be a plane, glowing as bright as a star.  
All together it was 10-15 minutes of observation

summary: 4 objects, appeared to be flame of some type, in formation.  Changed course and disappear.
description: There were 4 same distance apart in rough v-shaped formation.  Heading north west. Unable to determine altitude.  However, movement was slow.  Eventually all 4 altered course 90 degrees towards south west.  Each disappeared one at a time after course change.  Appeared to have flame associated with them (visual distortion).  Thought may be hot air balloon at first .

summary: One fireball falling straight down, actually saw the flame flaring up.
description:
I saw one fireball falling in the sky. Went and grabbed another person and by the time I showed her there were 4 more.  
You could see trails coming from the objects, they wen't down and slowly disappeared.
Possible meteor??  PD

summary: Object with orange lights appeared and disappeared 3 times.
description:
I was standing on the pier when an object appeared in the sky.  I knew it wasn't an airplane by its shape and movement.  It had 5-7 orange lights in the shape of a circle that moved forward and disappeared.  
Then, it appeared again a good ways behind where it had disappeared, moved forward again, and disappeared.  I stood on the pier waiting for it to reappear for a while, but it didn't show itself again.  
I continued to go off the pier and on to the beach where I could play my flute that evening.  
As I was playing, I looked back at the ocean to see the object again near the same spot.  It disappeared as soon as I saw it.

summary: Spherical white [pearl-like] object WITHIN OUR ATMOSPHERE,  motionless, appeared to be nailed to the sky.
description:
Sighting 6-19-2014  from 6:17 to 6:22  PM PST pm Wilsonville, Oregon,  small-appearing, spherical white, pearl-like object WITHIN OUR ATMOSPHERE,  very high up, I am gut-guessing  that it was at over 2o,ooo feet but difficult to say without anything to compare it to.  It was at most 5% to 10% the size of a full moon when the moon is at it highest point in the sky.
Fixed, not moving at all, appeared to be NAILED TO THE SKY, impervious to any wind whatsoever.  Had it moved at all during the observation we would have assumed that it was a child's balloon.
Difficult to spot in the first place,  my wife only saw it because we were on our backs sky-gazing, even when she pointed to it, it took me a good ten seconds to lock onto it myself.  Binoculars failed to reveal any detail.  No camera that we have access to would have been worthy of capturing it.
While I was fumbling for a better pair of binocs, object virtually winked out of existence while my wife had her eyes locked onto it.
We spoke via telephone with the witness, and he sounded to us to be a very capable, and sober-minded, individual.  We suspect that he is a very good witness.  PD

summary: Square UFO, thin on edge. Travelling along freeway, then took off. I have photos
description:
UFO while heading north on I-275, (Plymouth to Northville) it is flattened rhomboid shape that was matching our northbound speed, turning from time to time, on edge it was extremely thin relative to the broad side.  It was light gray, totally devoid of any markings on broad side. It was not a blimp, not a balloon, not a helicopter, not a plane.
This thing was at LEAST 200 ft to 300 ft long on all 4 sides and was just a little more than 1/2 mile away at the closest distance.  In person, you could see the distinct shape with 4 sharp corners.  Its shape was similar to a square with one side locked in place, and with the remaining sides pushed over maybe 10-20 degrees.  When it rotated, edge-wise, it couldn't have been more than 10-20 feet thick (very rough approximation).  Extremely unusual shape for anything in the air, sustained.  It remained at same speed (55mph) 4:45p as traffic was moving from Ann Arbor Rd until 7 mile Rd on I-275, then took off north fast & disappeared over the horizon northbound.  As we got closer it was extremely apparent it was nothing I’d ever seen or anything conventional and was at our 10 o’clock relative to travel north on the freeway, perhaps a half…

summary: Slow moving lights. two dem blue lights. two lights blinking, one red one white with no sound slow moving low in sky.
description:
Saw four triangle shaped flying objects in the dead of the night.  all had a triangle shape with two none blinking blue lights one flashing white bright star like light and a blinking equally bright red light.  no sound low in the sky all seemed to be going in the same direction at low speeds.  been becoming more coming.  
also saw a week ago a blue star moving at a good rate of speed no sound and high in the sky?
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Photo sent to Director.
description:
On our return trip to Yakima from Seattle, my wife was taking pictures of the mountains as we travelled over Snoqualmie Pass.  
That night at home she was reviewing her pictures and asked me what the V shaped object in her picture was.  
When I first looked at it, I told her she had the window up and she immediately said it was down.  I then put my reading glasses on and saw that there were clouds between the object and the camera.  
I then told her that is what is called a UFO.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 3 orange lights.
description:
seemed like they were launched into the Western sky.  
First one, with glowing orange lights (no sound) it moved a little to the right then started to move straight up into the sky.  
Then the second one appeared, then the third.  
They were all moving very slowly - straight up.   Then they disappeared one by one in the order they appeared.  
I'm not sure if there are any US bases located here in mid-florida.  
This is actually the second time I've seen this.  The first time was in April 2014 and there were about 20 lights, all behaving the same way.
Source of report indicates that the date is approximate.  PD

summary: Encounter with grey followed by picture of UFO same day in Tulum, Mexico
description:
First off, my incident happened in June 19, 2014, at approx. 4am, while visiting a resort in Puerto Aventuras, Mexico.  
My husband and I were asleep in our king size bed, we sleep very close together.  However, it felt like a dream.  I woke up on the far left side of the bed, with a grey type alien at the foot end of the bed, probing around my stomach area.  My body was very heavy, it took all I had to lift my arm towards my husband.  I didn’t feel any pain, but I remember being so scared and trying to scream and reach for my husband.  I couldn’t open my mouth to scream so I was screaming with my mouth closed and my husband was out of my reach, which is extremely unusual for us to be so far apart.  
That is all that I remember, but when I actually woke up, I opened my eyes and reached for my hubby and he was out of my reach and I was at the far side of the bed.  
Later that day, we went to Tulum, Mexico.  We were taking alot of pictures, as my camera shoots 7 frames per second.  
When we got home after reviewing our pictures closer, we realized that we believe we got a picture of the UFO.  It is only in one frame and it is almost in the middle of the frame.  I blew it off as a…

summary: Two orange circular lighta fading in and out that were neither parallel or perpendicular.
description:
June 6, 2014 around 11:15 p.m.
 	I witnessed two motionless circular orange lights in the sky.  Occasionally, one of the circular lights would disappear as if it was being dimmed out (as if someone was dimming a light in a house).  This event  lasted for what seemed 10-15 minutes.  
I was walking into my kitchen to get a drink of water when I noticed two orange lights in the sky through my sliding glass door (leading into my backyard) that overlooks the city I live in. I was facing south while viewing these lights and what made them so interesting to me was they were not moving, completely stationary the entire time the event occurred.  Initially, there were two orange lights and after a couple minutes one would fade out (again, as if being dimmed out).  
After about a minute, the light that originally faded out would reappear then the other light would fade out just like the first one did.  
The process of one of lights fading out and the other light reappearing happened three times.  Each time the light wou! ld come back it would appear in the same spot that it was in before.  This did not happen simultaneously, when the light would come back the other would stay from anywhere…

summary: It was bright ámbar big light over the homes, it last for one minute and then got brighter and then dimer and then  was gone!!
3 Round shaped white and bright lights.
description:

Dear Mr. Davenport,

summary: Last night I was getting ready for bed, locking all the doors and windows.
description:
When I looked out of the sliding glass door a saw a orange ball of light in the sky line.  I began to do a process of elimination in my head,  As the orb of light just hovered over this spot in the distance it occurred to me it clearly wasn't a plane.  I went outside to see if I could possibly hear helicopter noise....nothing.  
Then a second orb apeared and the first one was gone, vanished!  The second orange in color orb hovered for a bit and then as fast as it appeared it disappeared! I have never seen anything like it!  
After both orbs disappeared I heard and saw a military helicopter the helicopter was loud and gray in color and had no lights on it.

summary: Two orbs hovering over military base for an hour or more.
description:
I was leaving my moms house in Encinitas and saw 1 just hovering and I thought it was just a plane coming in to Palomar Airport.  
Then as I was driving I noticed that it wasn't moving. 
As I got closer to my home, it was still in the same position, which to me looked like it was about 500 ft high and over the beach in front of Camp Pendleton Marine Base and when I got home I began to film with my cellphone.  
About 5 minutes into filming, it started to pulsate or blink very faintly and after a few seconds another orb showed up.  They were both hovering there for awhile and then the first one faded away. 
After a couple minutes the second began to blink and the first one just appeared in its original position.  They repeated this a few times and after 17 minutes of filming they both slowly faded away.  
From the time I left my moms to the time they left was about an hour.  But they could have been doing that for hours because one of them was there when I looked in the sky while getting into my car at my moms.

summary: It was a white light flying SE to NW across the field of vision which I cannot identify.
description:
It may have been an Earth satellite, but I can't imagine why they would put lights on satellites.  It was a distant dim white light flying SE to NW, but was definitely not an airplane whereas I view airplanes frequently in the night sky and am familiar with their lights (most airplanes have white lights on the wings, a red and/or blue light in the front, and a strobe light with a very specific frequency).  
I do not think it was a comet because it was moving too fast across the field of vision, in line with the speed of most airplanes and it did not have a tail.  It was not a firefly because it did not flash.  It was not a star, also because it was moving too fast across the field of vision.  I also can rule out the possibility of a meteor, because it was a dim whereas I have seen "shooting stars" and they generally are bright white and flash somewhat quickly across the sky.  
This light was much dimmer, but still quite visible and moving quite quick! ly AND I was so certain about what I was seeing that I immediately came inside to find out what time it was.  It could have been a satellite, but it seems that satellites should remain stationary above the Earth's surface to serve…

summary: A bright light traveled across the sky at a slow rate and vanished.
description:
Bright light was high in the sky.  Going faster then a plane, but slower then a shooting star without any red light signals.  
Went across the sky and slowly dimmed and vanished. 
There was not a sound to be heard. 
My grandmother and I were sitting in the pool and were stunned.  
There was no possible way this object was a plane of any sort. 
The object had no shape; just a bright light.
We spoke via telephone with this witness, and he sounded to us to be eloquent and serious-minded.  We suspect that his report is a sincere one, and that it is accurate.  PD

For your reference, it  says uploaded by Justin Me., and there is a reference to utube at the top of his entry.  You can hear both the husband and the wife, as they are video taping this phenomena.

summary: Large, slowly moving orange fireball along RSM Blvd.
description:
I was driving home late from work (around 11:00 PM), when something caught my eye off to the right.  I had just crossed over the Alicia Parkway bridge that leads to Rancho Santa Margarita Blvd. to make a right turn, and there it was: a glowing orange ball of light.  It was moving at a steady pace, parallel with the road I was on, so I decided to follow it.  
The object was large- I estimate it must have been the size of a house.  I signaled it with my headlights. I pulled over to view it and kept following it as far as I could, until it passed over the hills and was out of sight.  I probably frightened the car in front of me, because I was following them and flashing my brights until they turned into a residential neighborhood. 
At that point, the UFO was out of sight, so I turned and drove home.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

It traveled off the water towards shore from east to west in a very straight line.  The line appeared to be perfectly parallel to the ground.  I think it flashed 4 times in the 3-5 seconds I saw it.  I estimate the speed at about 40 miles per hour, way too fast for a firefly.  It looked like it was shot out of a slingshot.  It looked like it was only about the size of a dime.  It was much brighter than a firefly, and the flashes were very consistent.  They went from dark to light almost immediately, like it was on a switch.
I said to my fishing partner “tell me you saw that” and he said “yes, I did.”  He agreed it was too big, too fast, and too bright to be a firefly.  There were many fireflies in the area so we had…

As I continue to record this object gets more intense in hits movements and at one point a large light goes off, like in a rectangle shape proximity above me and this object. I instantly thought it took a picture of me.  Not long after it slowly descends upwards slowly.  I sit there for a minute, I felt like I was froze for a few seconds and as soon as I can, I get up and run to the house.

summary: Triangle shaped objects with blinking yellow, red & blue/green round lights flying in almost a firefly type pattern.
description:
Several of them making very strange maneuvering patters & at times, also appear to be hovering beside each other. 
Can hear, what I describe as a "rushing river" like sound coming from the sky.

summary: Boomerang-shaped object with three lights flying over house.
description:
My boyfriend and I had been sitting out on our front porch, looking up at the sky I had seen an orange like color that appeared to be a larger star.  As we continued to sit and watch, it gradually got higher and closer.  
We continued down our front porch steps and it appeared larger, I ran into the house to get my phone to attempt to take a picture, the lights seemed to be too dim to be able to see.  
There were three lights on the object, one larger orange light, and two smaller red lights on the sides.  Just the two red lights were flashing.  
The sky was quite foggy around it.  It seemed to be "boomerang" shaped.  It was smaller than a plane, and not the correct shape, nor sound to be a helicopter.  
It was flying way too low to be a plane, which is what struck me.  It continued over near our house taking sharp turns, and out of sight within 30 seconds.
We spoke with one of the two witnesses, and he sounded to us to be quite sober-minded.  They are sure that the object was not the International Space Station.  PD

summary: Location of viewing southern Ukiah Valley, vineyards east of airport, south of ((deleted)) Brewing Company.
description:
About midnight.  Bright point of light (not blinking) just above hills to the west and at first presumed to be a helicopter due to often seeing helicopters at that low elevation coming from the west.  
Waited for it to continue on a horizontal path, seemingly towards the east or east/southeast, but that was not happening.  
This point of light was about five times the magnitude of brightest stars and appeared to be rising up.  At first perhaps at a 45 degree angle.  
Then that changed and it clearly was going up straight, steady and not too fast but it was getting dimmer and dimmer and obviously ascending straight into the atmosphere.  And, progressively dimmer and dimmer until it just disappeared.  
It didn't shoot straight up like a dart; it took about 15 to 20 seconds to disappear.  The dot of light easily seen getting dimmer and dimmer, and then just not there anymore.

summary: I saw a small circle of bright white light that kept disappearing and then reappearing approx. 10-20 feet from each point going from low to high in the trees.
description:
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
It's difficult to be specific with just one sentence to write.
Last night as I was going to bed I notice flashes of light outside.  It looked light lightning lighting up the sky but there was no thunder that followed.  It did rain within the next 30 minutes so I've dismissed it since as being heat lightning since that's what it looked like.
I have a raised berm in my backyard which is lined with trees and evergreens, with a solid wooden fence behind it so my yard is very dark at night.  I saw a solid white light that could be mistaken for a flashlight but I would say it was larger than that.  If you put your hands together and make a circle with your thumbs and fingers touching, that is about the size it appeared to be.  At first I thought someone may have been walking around my yard - My husband and I were just commenting about the neighbors installing a fence and now so there is no way to get into our yard except from the front of the house or through a neighbors yard so it's pretty private now.  So I thought it was a flashlight, but it didn't move like someone was walking with it.  It would appear and disappear, and then reappear many feet away.  I…

summary: Illuminated orange trianglular object moving with purpose.
description:
I took the dogs for a final stroll before bed.  Live in a rural area in the woods.  Walking back toward the house I noticed a movement in the sky above the tree tops & the roof, moving east to west.  Very much exactly east to west.  My initial glance looked like a red/orange ball moving steadily but tree tops made viewing somewhat unclear.  
I backed back down the driveway (it is on a hill), to get a better view.  Realized it was nothing familiar so ran into the house and told my sister to get onto the deck quickly to see this thing.  She has good distance vision, I am near sighted.
We moved to the deck on the lake side of the house where we could still see it as it moved away from us to the west over the lake.  My sister immediately said that it was triangular and that the orange lights almost looked like fluorescent tube lights around the edges.  It just continued moving at the same pace and with the same trajectory.  Not a sound was heard and it was a quiet, still night.
We have tried to estimate the altitude of whatever it was and can only say with certainty that it was low enough for her to be able to see some detail, no where near the altitude of the typical jets we…

summary: Formation of 30-45 blue lights.
description:
Me and my boyfriend went outside cause the dogs were barking when we got outside I immediately looked up and noticed 3 stars and to the right was another v-shape of 3 stars. 
Then we both noticed the lights were slightly moving, wobbling.  Then I looked to the left of the middle cluster and noticed light blue tiny lights, the top 2 we solid whete there was 2 more below it which sporadicly blunk very fast.  
I was pointing out some other odd looking lights to him, when we looked back and there was about 20 more lights that just appeared all around.  They way they moved in almost seemed like watching a storm cloud rolling in.
The formation would change almost like making diffetent shapes.  Or designs. as they wrre moving. 
As I realized just how many objects were in the sky, it kinda started freaking me out and I went inside.

summary: Small or high altitude chevrons in V pattern followed by ever lower or larger chevron over Depew NY
description:
I was going out for a walk with a friend and just after we left, I noticed three chevron shaped lights going over in a V formation.  
At first I thought they were meterors or something but they seemed to be holding a formation.  Shortly before disappearing out of sight, another came over at the same speed but larger or at a lower altitude.  It cruised over in the same direction and eventually disappeared as well.  All objects were riddish orange amd had no flashing lights or trails.  We also noticed no noise coming from the lights.  
I'm always watching the sky and have seen all kinds of aircraft and even some satelites.  These seemed a bit unique so I dicided to report it.  
Thank you for any info on these lights.
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
Yeah no hoax here.  I mean, I'm only telling exactly what I saw.  I'm just not sure exactly what they were.  Both sightings were weird in their own ways.  The first ones were traveling in somewhat straight lines but if you looked hard, you could see them almost zig zag.  Looking like a short wave medium frequency if it had left a trail.  If that makes sense.  The second night was really strange cuz the first sighting was still sorta fresh in…

summary: My wife and I saw 6 moving objects near spout of "Big Dipper;"
description: My wife and I saw 6 moving objects (one at a time over a period of about an hour) which start out looking like a bright star, then fade to red and finally disappear.  They do not have any strobe lights like planes do.  They are moving faster than what you see planes moving but not as fast as a shooting star.  Most were heading west to east, one north to south and one was traveling west to east but turned 90 degrees and went north.  Saw in the area close to the tip of the spout of the “Big Dipper”.

summary: 3 Big Red Lights in Triangle Formation - Silent.
description:
While walking to car, 3 huge red lights appeared in the sky traveling SE to NW.  There were 3 huge lights in a perfect equiangular formation that pulsated On and Off every 5 seconds.
The back 2 red lights had a row of 4 smaller red lights spaced equally between them.  These lights did not blink but remained lit.
It was too dark to see the body besides what blocked out stars. Its size would be estimated to a large commercial plane, which typically approach from the East.  It was approaching the airport at the angle helicopters and prop planes approach.
Its speed was very slow, only a bit faster than a helicopter.  There was no wind to cause a commercial plane to perform a crosswind landing (nor have ever seen a commercial plane with that many red lights and no green or white).
It was flying very low.  Low enough that it looked like it was maybe 30 feet above The Rims.
It made NO sound whatsoever.  Absolutely silent.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Bright white light seen over White Mountains
description:
Our group of five were camped near Big Pine, California.  At 22:36 Hours on June 16, 2014, my brother and I were looking north east towards the White Mountains.  We saw what at first appeared to be a satellite on a north to south orbit.  We realized this white light was brighter than any satellite we had ever seen and appeared to be within the atmosphere.  It followed the crest of the mountains.  During the approximate 20 seconds the light was visible it travelled from White Mountain in our north east to a position due east before blinking out.
We heard no noise signature coming from this light.  It had no aircraft navigation lights or strobes.
Witness elects to provide little contact information.  PD

summary: Multiple nights we have seen a circle shaped object fly from west to east in the northern sky, it is always after 22:00.
description:
As I go out to smoke my last cigarette of the night, I enjoy looking at the sky.  Lately, more nights than not, there is a circle light in the sky.  It moves rapidly across the sky in an easterly direction, it seems to come from south of Mt. Shasta and heads toward Lassen.  
Traditional aircraft have also been seen on every occasion, they head up from the south and just as they cross paths, (traditional plane at an obviously lower altitude) the circle craft begins to dim and then totally disappears.
This craft has only been seen (by our family) between 10 pm and 11:30 pm.  Once the craft is spotted I typically have time to alert the family and get them out there to watch for a couple of minutes so I think it lasts at three minutes each night that it is there.

summary: Orange Glow Thing.....
description:
Here is a report as seen by my neighbor who lives directly in back of my house.  
Posted at the bottom of this report are two other reports that occurred in September of last year and then in May of this year. 
Both have been reported on your site and witnessed by me.
----- Original Message ----- 
From: Neighbor To:  Me 
Sent: Monday, June 16, 2014. 10:27 PM 
Subject: Orange Glow Thing  I just saw the orange in the sky.
Not perfectly round but shaped like a hot air balloon.  Also seemed to have flame at one end like a balloon. It wasn't too high up in the air like a plane but it went over your house from south to north.  It was moving pretty fast.  By the time i went in to get binoculars by back door I couldn't find it but there are a lot of trees in the way.
What is it? It's a real object. I think it's a balloon of some sort.  Went overhead about 10:15 tonite.  I don't think it was high enough for a weather balloon.  It was moving fast and straight like it was being controlled and had power of its own.
If you find out or have any ideas let me know.
 …..MY RESPONSE TO THE E-MAIL…..
Thank you sooo much for this.  Finally someone else has seen it.  Since you are right in back of me,…

summary: Erratic Light Moves Across Sky and Stops Overhead.
description:
I saw a tiny white dot come across the sky from low on the horizon as it were a plane or a star.  It was silent and slowed to a stop a few degrees southeast of the field I was in and appeared to drift rapidly from side to side, speed up, and slow down moving rapidly in different directions at a very high altitude.  It continued moving from east to west in an erratic manner far above the clouds with no jet trails or sound.  The object would appear to stop and then dart rapidly as it were moving very fast but over a very small arc less than a tenth of a degree.  It gradually seemed to drift south of me from east to west but approached the area I was in more rapidly slowing almost to a stop.  It was partly cloudy and there were no stars in the sky.  The sun had set half an hour before. It was around 9:45 PM.
At one point it was moving so slowly I thought it might be moving in the opposite direction it came but there was definitely a subtle and rapid darting from side to side.  I noticed nothing else in the sky that seemed to reflect or emit light at the time.  The dot may have had a slightly yellowish tint.  What was unusual was that it seemed to approach the field I was in very…

summary: Green light raveling from East to West.
description:
My wife and I looking due south in East Tulsa seen a elongated greenish light traveling from the East to directly West.  Lasted approximately 5 seconds. 
We are normal folks just looking in the sky and bam!  
There it was, silent and seemingly losing altitude throughout its trajectory.  
At some point in western sky it vanished.

summary: Reddish/orange orbs floating in the air
description:
Two light  objects appearred side by side.  Reddish/orange orbs floating in the air.  
When we jumped out of the car to get better look, one disappeared, and the the other disappeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: 5 people at 9 pm saw blue green flash to white over Broken Arrow, OK.
description: 5 of us came out of work close to 91st and elm in broken arrow.  3 adults and 2 children saw a flash of green-blue light that went white.

summary: 5 neon glowing objects; appeared to have "arms."
description:
On a long stretch of mountainous highway where cell service is lost, my 27 year old daughter spotted a blue light moving toward us in the sky.  It was a glowing, neon type light. 
As we drove, it seemed to be very low in the sky and moving very slowly.  As we passed under it, we could see very clearly 5 different colored, neon glowing, straight arms, all connecting at a center point (red, blue, white, yellow...and green I think).  
There was a neon hue surrounding the 5 arms which created a circular shape, but the object had only 5 arms connecting only at the center. 
That was it.  It moved over us and disappeared.  
I have looked all over the internet for anything close to an explanation.  I can't find anything, so I am reporting it here.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: White bar at angle moving slowly across sky.
description: White or silver bar moving slowly at high odd angle and altitude for at most 10 minutes then disappeared.

summary: D d
description:
So I woke up and went outside to smoke a cigarette and there was this big huge yellow light in the sky northwest of me.  I watched it for twenty minutes.  
It got bigger and then dimmer and at one time I sware it turned into a v.  It moved up about two inches and stopped and then slowly went up.  
Then stopped.  Then turned off.  And I thought it was gone.  
Then bam it slowly came back on.  It looks like it's looking for something.  I sware at one point it shined its lights in my direction and it just seemed like headlights in the sky looking at me.  
Then turned away.  It was really really bright.  And wasn't a plane because it didn't move and when it did move it moved really fast in the sky.  And planes don't turn their lights off.   This is weird.  I watch the skies all the time.  
My dad is a pilot so I always just watch the skies.  I've never seen this.  This was different.  This was like a tiny sun.  That could move faster than fast turn off and then vear up.
We are uncertain as to whether this is a serious report.  PD

summary: I observed an oval, invisible-like object coming home from the park.
description:
Me and my dad were driving home from the park.  I started to see something fairly odd in the clouds, it was as if something was in front of the clouds.  I kept staring in the same place and it seemed as if something oval was moving steadily away.  The most craziest part is that it was like a chameleon.  A way to explain it in one word is that the craft was invisible.  It took the color of the clouds and everything around it and if you stared hard you can see that something is off from the area it was in then eventually making out the craft.  
I shouted out to my dad "A UFO! A UFO!" well he was driving and of course it would take a while to find it with the naked eye, and when we were turning away from the area from where I can see it, it started to zoom away.

summary: Black winged object with symmetrical midsection, far too large for a bird.
description:
The day before, on Father's day, I was over at my dad's house and we were cooking outside.  Above the house we spotted what looked like a VERY large bird hovering over his house.  It appeared to be roughly 100 meters up, based on comparisons to surrounding trees, and if that estimate was accurate I would guess that this bird had to have had a wingspan equivalent to a small single engine plane.  What was very odd was the way it flew, hovering, very small wing movements at the very tips, and when it did fly away it basically headed directly east and at a very high rate of speed.  There were 4 witnesses total for that sighting.  My dad mentioned he had seen something similar where he works, only when he spotted it previously it spiraled straight up until it was out of sight.  Apparently there have been other sightings of this thing in the area as well.
The next day I was laying out in my yard and I spotted the same thing, looked like it was flying at about the same height, very slowly passing from W/SW to the East.  I had my son run and grab my binoculars so I could get a better look at it.  I have good quality Bushnell binoculars and I was able to track it pretty easily.  Again, I…

summary: High flying, fast, large white object Eastern Washington
description:
I was waiting at the Hastings Park and Ride bus Terminal in North Spokane.  I was waiting for the 11:55 am bus headed north to my home in Deer Park.  I estimate the time to be about 11:30 am.  
I was facing north and I happen to look up at the sky to see a very large, white object heading east to west at height and with speed.  What surprised me was the speed it seemed to travel and the size it was.  Normally, when one sees a plane at that height the plane is small, hard to see, and moving at a speed that appears slow to our relative perspective.  
This white colored object, however, was 3 to 4 time larger that a plane would be at that height and is travel through a large cloud break at a very fast pace.  Much faster than any convention planes I’ve ever seen.  
Oddly enough it also left no condensation trail of any kind.  
I would normally discount this as the sun reflecting off an airplane but I can still not account for the size of this thing, the lack of any type of condensation trail, and the speed it was moving at.

summary: One large object  followed by several silver lights in no particular order. The lights were following the larger object
description:
I was parking my car on North Academy outside of the Dollar Tree when I saw a large object moving directly north towards me.  I could tell it was going way too slowly for a plane or a helicopter, and it took about 10 minutes to reach right above where I was standing and then veered off north west.  
I grabbed the binoculars out of my car and I could barely make out a huge bunch of what looked like balloons (hundreds of them), BUT what was really weird is it had been followed the entire way by an escort of 8 or so silver colored lights.  
They were up way higher than the large object and seemed to be following it.  I pointed them out to another lady who got out of her car and she said she could see them too.  
When I first saw them I honestly thought it was a squadron of jet fighters, tailing a plane of some sort but they were not jet fighters and they all disappeared into the clouds when I lost sight of them all.
We spoke via telephone with this witness, and she sounded to us to be quite eloquent, and serious-minded.  We suspect the the report is quite accurate.  PD

summary: Large gray object and 20 little ones floating in the sky
description:
Woodman and Academy 9:45 am.  Saw what looked like about 20 skydivers, only they weren't coming down.  
One large gray object with no lights floating slowly under the cloud and about 20 smaller black things floating around it.  
Stayed for about 15 minutes then the little things went above the clouds and the large object following shortly after.  
I have a photograph and video of the large object.
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
The date was June 16th 2014. I noticed it at 9:45 am and ended at 10:00
((END ADDENDUM))
Photo shows blurry, indistinct, gray object, below solid overcast.  PD

summary: Craft was only seen after picture was taken; taken while photographing storm clouds.
description:
There was a bad thunderstorm, and we drove into town to take pictures of the clouds.  Did not see anything but the clouds.  
Drove  back home and downloaded all photos from cellphone on laptop.  Laptop broke and did not fix until winter of 2016.  Went through to delete old photos and found the image.  
As you can see, it is greenish, rectangle shape with some white lines that could indicate fast movement and there is a shadow going to the ground.  
I put the copyright on the photo, but please do not publicize my name.  I would just like to know what it was.

summary: About 12 crafts with Lights changing from yellow to red, some traveled others were more stationary
description:
At around 2:00 a.m. I looked out the window from 8th floor apt. Building and noticed 4 lights similar to stars forming a diamond shape, to the right I saw a brighter light they appeared stationary. I informed my husband but he doesn’t believe they are UFO’s but believes there are other life forms out there, go figure.  He saw them and found it a strange formation.
I kept my sight on the brighter craft and could actually see the light changing from yellow to red, I could see it flicker and move.  I know it was very far but I kept my eyes on it.  They moved slowly, during the two and a half hours I watched them I was able to count at least 12 of them.  The diamond-shaped seemed to come together, but kept  the diamond shape while the brighter one on the right began to move in a dancing way from right to left.
The other 7 were not as bright but were the most active they did the same dancing movement but traveled and disappeared from sight in moderate speed, with the exception of one that confirmed my suspicion it “zoomed” and disappeared near the brightest of them.  They all had the flickering effect and change of color from yellow to red.
I no longer second guess UFO’s visiting us…

summary: Star like object traveling in straight line with consecutive burst of light then vanishes.
description:
What appeared to be a star (eastern sky/on very clear night) began to move incredibly fast, traveling south.  
Ufo had consecutive bursts of white light, one second apart, and traveled in a straight line and then disappeared. 
Object was so far that no shape or detail of the body was visible except for the extremely bright bursts of light. 
Half a second  after vanishing a bright burst of light appeared a fairly large distance away and beneath UFO.  The object may have jumped that entire distance within the time it took to flash another time.  (possible connection between the two objects or two completely different objects within fairly same distance and emiting same light in both color and intensity).
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: High, very bright steady light moving in a very strange square pattern then disappearing.
description:
Very bright, steady light appeared to be somewhat high.  
Moving east to west then did an abrupt 90 degree turn south, then proceeded to move in a kind of soft edged square pattern for maybe 1 minute, before just disappearing.

summary: I'm located on third floor balcony, across in the distance above the tree line I notice a white pulsing light, after 10 minutes I declared it be a star.
description:
It then raised up and proceeded towards me.  Within 1 minute it was 200 ft in front of me.  Small inner circle of light with a larger circle around that.  
This was not an airplane or helicopter.

summary: Driving from Anborton to Gilford and saw 4 luminous lights in sky merging together and then coming apart
description:
I was driving home from work in Sanbornton going to Gilford, NH, and saw 4 lights in the sky, 4 light formations, flying, hovering, merging together and then coming apart, seemed to be making some sort of pattern in the sky with its movements but it was not a 100% consistent pattern, it changed slightly each time they merged together and came apart.  
Not sure if these lights had something to do with the motorcycle Bike Week Event going on in town of Laconia, NH.  
Maybe they were just some light reflections of some sort, that I was seeing, coming from another source, I am not sure.
The description makes us wonder whether the witness might have been observing advertising lights.  No other reports PD

summary: There was a large saucer shaped object w/ white strobe lights going around it & a red flashing strobe light on the bottom in the sky
description:
I was happy to find this site, I see UFO’s by my home and above it in Butler, PA, regularly. Ones with multicolored to plain orb ufo’s.  At 11:37pm on June 15th 2014.  There was a large saucer shaped object with white strobe lights going around it and a red flashing strobe type light on the bottom.  
This is the second time in a week, I have seen this object fly over my house.  It seems to be going west to east or north west to south east.  The first time it was on a different time and day it was moving at a high rate of speed.  Yesterday on the 15th it was coming across my house in the sky.  I was standing on my deck watching it fly over, over by the tree line is a field.  I watched it moving across at a high speed the stop and just setting in the sky it sat there for a good 3 to 4 minutes, I quickly decided to grab my Canon T2i DSLR with 650-1300mm HD Lense  Just inside my french door.  I opened the door grabbed the camera turned around, it was gone, no trace in sight anywhere not a ! out of ordinary light anywhere in the sky to be seen other then stars..  
I am on the look out for this object again.  For the distance it was in the sky to the scale of a normal airplane at the…

summary: I live in Central Va, and saw something very strange in the sky about 11:30 is EST.
description:
While letting the dog out I saw what I thought was a falling star.  Excited, I watched for more.  
I found myself watching for about 20 minutes at something so bizarre.  Looked like 5 stars.  One I watched had 3 reddish lights come on but did not stay on.  
I watched them move left, right, up, and down.  With each move they made, I would see a flash of light.  
I then watched a plane flying in the direction they were in and watch what looked like a star make a U shape around it.  
I could see the plane it was much lower in the sky.  
I told my spouse about it this morning.  
I don't know what it was that I saw, but one thing is for sure...it was odd.

summary: A yellow light and a green light that hovered in the sky then shot all the way across the sky rapidly.
description: My friend and I were riding our bikes around town at night.  We were stopped at a grassy area when we noticed a yellow light in the sky.  The yellow light was stationary at first, then it rapidly shot all the way across the sky, much faster than an airplane or satellite.  At location the yellow light shot to, we noticed a green light, again not moving.  Shortly after, like the yellow light, it rapidly shot across the sky out of sight.

summary: i heard something walking outside i walked into my back yard when i saw to aircrafts triangular-shaped ships in the sky then when i looked down there was a 7ft skinny creature deadly starring at me.
description: it had red eyes and gills it was breathing out of i ran into my house and locked the doors and called my mom.

summary: Dull steady white light, high altitude, fast moving then faded (ascended) N to S in south Cook County IL sky
description:
I was observing the sky for a few minutes and noticed several aircraft going in different directions.  I spotted (and heard) a propeller driven and also several jet aircraft.  As they progressed across the sky I could hear them as well.  They were at varying altitudes as observed.  All these aircraft had typical blinking lights as commonly seen on commercial aircraft.  I spotted, then heard, a jet coming south, and it passed my location slightly to the east.  I could hear its engine sound and I estimate its altitude at approximately 5000 feet.  
Then I spotted another light object trailing behind the jet by several seconds and going in the same general direction.  It was a very steady non-blinking white light and seemed to be at a much higher altitude.  It was unusual.  The light was bright but not glaringly so.  No sound came from this object as it passed which added to the impression it was at very high altitude.  It proceeded across the sky in about the same time fram! e as the previous jet.  So I estimate its speed to be much faster than the jet in order for it to cover the same distance in the sky in that short amount of time.  Then it quickly faded out.  The visual…

summary: Multiple, stange flashing lights, changing formation.
description:
Daughter noticed strange strobing light pulses in the southern sky.  
Alerted myself and wife and we watched for 2-3 minutes as the lights spread out to the east and west of the original location then slowly faded until could no longer be seen.

summary: 4 round orange balls converged close to each then 3 shot off in different directions, while one continued to hover for at least 10 minutes
Bright white circle flying at a high rate of speed.
description:
Two friends and I were standing outside in the front yard having a smoke at this vacation rental property in Chatham (Cape Cod) at around 9:30 pm or 10:00 pm.  I glanced upward at one of the trees in the yard and through the branches; I noticed a bright white light flying in the sky at a fairly high rate of speed.
At first I didn’t think it was unusual because I could only see it partially through the branches and it didn’t seem like a big deal, but then it picked up speed and changed direction a bit and started flying towards us.  I told my friends to look at it and tell me what it was. Well, both of them immediately said, “Holy crap!”  We knew it wasn’t a plane, satellite, helicopter or anything else manmade because this thing was HUGE and it was moving faster than any aircraft known to us.  We were watching it for about 60 seconds with a very clear view of it when all the sudden, it disappeared right in front of our eyes.
My friends have never seen a UFO before and quite frankly, they think I might be a little crazy because I’ve seen so many of them over the years.  But all three of us knew that what we just saw didn’t have a reasonable explanation as it was definitely…

summary: Multiple bright objects in 3-5 craft intervals.
description:
Travled very fast headed south to north. 
No sound. 
We assume an evening sighting, and have amended the time above.  PD

summary: Orangish-Red UFO Disappears
description:
I was leaving a Father's Day party at my friend's house and we were saying our goodbyes out in the front lawn.  
Someone mentioned a plane departing from John Wayne Airport and we all looked up to look at it.  I then noticed that there was another "plane" but it was of an orangish-red color.  
I thought it was strange and told everyone to look at it and then it all of the sudden stopped; we all thought that was unusual, as planes don't just stop mid-air like helicopters.  
We were trying to figure out what it was, assuming it was a plane, but then it started to disappear.  It got more faint, but in a pulse-like fashion.  Then it was gone.  
As we were all looking at the sky wondering where it went, we then saw a little dot of the orangish-red color shoot straight up into the sky and we couldn't see anything anymore.

summary: I took my dog out for the night, and when I looked up, there was this bright red light did not think much about it.
description:
Keep watching it then it started going into this orange then white as it got bigger it was almost in the trees  in the NNW  and it looked very round  and it keep getting lower.  
When I called for people to look and tell me what it could be it got really small and then just looked like a red dot.  
This is not the first time I have seen this I seen it earlyer this year  not sure what it is.

summary: Black, morphing shape object sighted for almost ten minutes with my neighbor in plain sight.

It either had a bright white light or some sort of reflection of the sun, but it was slowly spinning so the light would come and go.
It was directly over me and in plain sight at low altitude.  Someone with terrible eyesight could have easily seen it.  I watched it for over five minutes, probably closer to ten.  It moved very slowly, gaining in altitude pretty steeply in regard to how quickly it became too difficult to see.  I recorded it from my phone, but it has no zoom.  By the time I decided to find my phone and record, it had floated quite a distance.  It was indistinguishable on the screen because of its altitude and the sun and lack of zooming ability.  
My neighbor walked out as I was filming.  He watched it with me.  By the time he saw it, the object was at a greater distance and higher altitude so he asked if maybe it was a weather balloon.  It was not, though.…

It was an overcast, hazy evening on Saturday, June 14, 2014, at 10:41 PM.  The full moon was barely visible, no stars either.  
I was driving west towards the Everglades in Parkland, Florida.  I looked up and  there was a cluster of bright white lights, perhaps a hundred.  They were moving very slowly, in unison from north to south.  
I stared at them for two to three minutes, wondering what it could possibly be.  
As I was making my turn they started to gradually disappear.

summary: This is the first I've seen a thing that looks this different from everything I've seen in the sky in 50 years.
description:
This was as an off white lite, much larger than any incoming airplanes I've watched, with a domed-shaped, very red, light about and over the top of it, from side to side, but no red cast of light on the bottom.  The red glow was more than twice the size of the off white area of light.  
It was directly overhead when I first saw it, moving at about the same rate as I have seen thousands of airliners overhead here at around 5000 foot altitude, but no position lights were flashing.  It moved from SE to NW.  
The sky was clear, I could see a full field of stars from horizon to horizon.  This object remained at the same rate of travel, then disappeared when it was 32 degrees from the horizon.  
Given the day and hour, it may have been the sun playing off an airliner, but I've been watching the sky for 45 years in Michigan, and have never seen anything anywhere near what I just saw.

The lights then started to move west again, farther away from me, and I could see that they were moving separately.  Their flight was quite low, and as I watched them move farther away to the west they started to fade and then disappeared altogether.
Then, around 10:40 p.m. EST I saw another, singular orange light come from the southwest direction.  It flew more slowly than the previous two, but seemed to follow their trajectory.
