Distance at that time, would be approximately 2 miles distant, and about 1500-2700 in elevation from my location!  It was moving at a slow rate of speed, but increasing in elevation.  
There were high thin clouds in the area, at about 4-6000 feet above! I watched it for a while, but was busy…

summary: Silent Grey Hovering Plane.
description:
It was a normal day like any other.  Sun was out and not much of a breeze. We were driving down a very busy street in boise by the mall.  I noticed what looked like a grey colored airplane flying low toward us but to the left and slowing down.  I commented to the driver that plane looks like its going to crash. 
Then as we drove down the 35 mph street the grey looking airplane came to what looked like a complete stop in the sky above some residental houses on a hill behind some big businesses.  We had hit a red light.  The airplane hovered over the tree line looking like it was decending.  I turned the radio down.  There was not a sound to be heard, other than the other traffic.  We stared at the grey, hovering too low and not moving, way to silent aircraft.  I noticed there were no propellers or moving parts of any kind.  The tail of the plane looked like it had a double fin, like a car spoiler.  
I am a very logical minded person who can find an explanation for almost anything.  This dumbfounded me. 
I talked with a good friend who works at a crop dusting outfit, and explained him this story.  I asked his opnion.  He said that sounds like a bona fide UFO.

I saw one small round white dot or light moving steadily through the sky in a line. It wasn’t moving very fast. It looked like it could have possibly been spinning or moving in small circles at times.
It seemed like it was very high up in the sky. Higher then a plane or bird would fly.
I asked my husband what it was. It took him a minute to spot it. Neither of us could identify what it was. I’ve never seen anything like it.
 I continued to watch it for about 5-7min. It went in a straight line, then seemed to  stop spin in place in small circles then turned and continued moving in a straight line again until I could no longer see it.
The object left no trail and made no sound.
I noticed someone else had posted something similar to what I saw on 4/3/2014 in Surprise AZ.  What they described sounded exactly like what we saw.

Seemed to be moving along side by side one a tiny bit further back from the other.  I went to get my camera to take a picture, but they were gone when I went back out.  Never seen anything like that before.  Not with orange lights like that.  It was only one bright orange light or a cluster not co! mpletely sure about that.  Just wanted to report what I saw.  No one I know could explain what it might have been.  
Because I am a teacher and like my privacy I prefer not to give my name at this time.
Witness…

summary: Bright blue and red lights shifting position as object re-oriented before changing direction; hovered, rose, dropped 100' to 1000'; moved suddenly in all directions; no sounds of rotors or other…
Two basket ball type orange/yellow sheres traveling east past a half moon.
description:
I was sitting out back on my porch smoking. I was looking straight ahead dragging on my cigarette when out of the corner of my eye in the direction of a half moon, light caught my eye, (sky lit up).  I looked up to the half moon and observed 2 basket ball sized objects flying on my side of the moon.
The objects were yellow/orange in color. I could not believe my eyes. I jumped off the chair and turned to run into my house to get my girlfriend, who just went to bed.  I stopped and told myself that it couldn't be.  Let me look again to verify.  I looked again and there they were traveling east.  I estimated the speed and thought I would have a few seconds to get ((girl's name deleted)).  I wanted her witness an event of a lifetime.
I ran about 20 feet from the porch to the bedroom and yelled get out here! I then ran back to hope it was still there.  They were gone.  I ran down to the driveway to look on the other side of the house,nothing.
I wish I would have stayed now. I was so excited.  The event was so unbelievable. The 2 objects were moving like they were floating effortlessly, but were travelling in an eastward direction at a good speed.  From my sight they were basket ball…

summary: Two V formations of faint orange lights
description:
Went out to enjoy the clear night sky...looked up and  noticed a V formation of very faint orange lights.  They would have been very easy to miss if I hadn’t gone out to specifically look at the night sky.  The brightness of the moon may have made them appear dim also...very bright night.
Two V formations. One formation of 7 circular looking lights, with an additional V formation at the side of 3 lights. No sound.  Moving probably as fast as a fighter jet?  I really couldn't tell what their altitude was… It seemed about the attitude of a commercial jet. Moving S/E to N/W.
They disappeared over the tree tops before I could get anyone else to come out of the house to look at them.

The one traveling north sped up, and then extinguished.  The two heading east traveled silently for a while then the one in the lead extinguished.  The last one continued on for just a few more minutes before it too went out.

Object was silver and was about the size of a 727 jet.  Reminded me of the machines in the Transformer movie, looked like a man with a jet pack on with a light on top (only way I can describe it) the object seemed to change shape as it turned.

Air traffic was delayed until the object was out of site, so there should be some record.  
Also looked on internet and found Shape Shifting UFO over Belgium video, this is what I saw, 500 ft from object when first observed.  
Also object made no sound. 
HVAC Tech and Electrician.

summary: One exceptionally large and bright light appeared, dimmed, then moved away to the south, passing an identical object heading north.
description:
I was laying on my back on my deck listening to music and not paying particular attention to the sky when something extremely bright caught my eye through the trees overhead.  Just as I got up to get a better look away from the tree, it appeared smaller and dimmer.  Originally it was white and round, the size and brightness of a 1/4th sized full moon, nearly but not quite directly overhead, maybe up 75 degrees looking towards the west.  
A moment later it looked like a dim star in the same spot in the sky, perhaps climbing straight up although the speed would have had to be exceptional.  Then immediately after dimming the object started moving exactly due south at a consistent speed.  I perceived it as being at an extremely high altitude and high rate of speed.  About half a second after I realized it was moving I saw another object identical to the first in fairly close proximity coming from the south and headed the exact opposite direction right by it at the same! speed and apparent altitude as the original object.  Both objects very gradually became dimmer as they moved away in opposite directions and maintained the same heading and velocity until I couldn't see either anymore.

summary: Green Object of Light falls out of the sky just outside of reaching distance but cannot be found.

A green "light-fireball-oval" dropped from above emanating a lime green hue.  This UFO object fell no farther than 50-100 feet from me.  I looked and looked for it but I do not think it even hit the ground.  I figured....shooting star that burnt out just before the ground, or roman candle.

summary: Sky sounds in Redmond, WA.
description:
5/9/2014 Redmond, WA  
I got up at 0300 to get ready for work.  I could hear what sounded like a large engine idling outside.  I closed the window and continued to get ready for work.  
At 0340 I went outside to leave and noticed that the sound was still happening.  It seemed to be coming from the sky, but I was unable to pinpoint any source, it was coming from everywhere.  It was very reminiscent of sounds I heard growing up by McCord Air Force Base when the planes would test their engines, unlike the planes I couldn’t feel any vibrations, there was just the loud sound. 
I was surprised at how well the windows had blocked it as it was very loud.  
Not a UFO but I felt it was strange enough to report somewhere.

Lived in the same apartment for 3 years and have only ever seen orange orbs, this was the first green one.

Saying goodbye to a friend in my driveway, and my neighbors were outside seeing off friends of theirs, as well.  
Turned around to go back in the house, facing south, happened to look up to see circles of light in the night sky, which appeared to be behind the clouds that could be seen with the moonlight.  
At first, there were only four, but then there seemed to be 6 to 8 of them, all the same size, and all moving in different directions and at different speeds!  Two would shoot out to the east and west, while the others moved around near the center.  Then, four seemed to form a square, because it sort of created arched beams of light between them.  They honestly looked like spotlights, only there was no trail of light going from the ground to the sky.  
Also, I don't think a person could move one of those giant spotlights that fast.  There were no big events in that vicinity that night.  
I shouted to my neighbors to please look with me, so I know I am not goi! ng crazy.  It was the strangest thing I have ever seen. 
After the lights moved around haphazardly behind the clouds for about 15 minutes, they just drifted off with them.  
Early that same day, helicopters were hovering…

Still seeing the whitish lights around it, but only for about 15 more seconds and then it was gone, appeared to move off in a westerly direction.  There was no sound during this time, however, just a few seconds after the lights were gone, there was a "humming type noise and the dogs in the area started howling and then all of sudden it was silent.  I reaffirmed with my husband, who is a HUGE skeptic, that he too in fact just witnessed the same thing that I h! ad.

They were moving in an unorganized pattern back and forth.  Sometimes they would stay completely still and then they would move and make sharp quick right and left turns.  Sometimes they would pair up and cross each other.  
They were very high up in the sky and at that altitude it is unlikely that jets can move in that formation.  
We watched as they moved back and forth then slowly disappeared.  
We tried to take a video but it didn't show them due to the bright sunlight.  It was a clear sunny day and they looked like white dots.  
At that altitude I don't know anything that can sit still for 5 minutes then move across the sky very fast then sit still again.

summary: Strange aircraft followed by 5 blackhawk helicopters.
description:
Family was awoke by the house violently shaking, looked outside and saw 5 objects flying in formation flying very very low, and heading north.
I quickly grabbed my Luna optics full color Night vision device with 20x zoom, and waited for anything else.
About 45 minutes later the objects came back over heading in a southern direction.  Now equipped with my color digital night vision, I was shocked to see a strange aircraft with normal aircraft lighting.  But its shape was unrecognizable, I have never seen a aircraft like it.  
Following far behind the first strange object was 5 blackhawk type helicopters.  Without night vision, they appeared to be just normal helicopters, but with the night vision, you could clearly see 100% BLACKHAWKS every edge, detail.
What they were doing is beyond me, but lots of others reported seeing and hearing helicopters that night flying over there house.
Reports were made to local news stations websites.

They moved very fast, one after the other, with several seconds in between, heading in the direction of the airport,  There were many many of them, maybe 100.  
They made almost no sound at all, to be distinguished from jet planes which go by all the time and are noisy.

At first I thought it might be some kind of flare, but after observing it for approximately one minute, I ruled that out as there was no light trail of any kind and it actually appeared to be traveling.

As it went above me, it reminded me somewhat of a jellyfish, like a ball with a light inside.  It was about 4 times larger than the brightest star in the sky.  It rose a bit higher and then flickered out and disappeared.

summary: Green, red & white alternating lights hovering and moving horizontally and vertically.
description:
We observed an object with oscillating green and red lights (similar to navigation lights but very different than anything we've ever seen) rising and falling vertically for a period of 5 minutes in a northeasterly direction from Holiday Marina at Lake Lanier, Buford, GA.
When we first noticed the object, it appeared very high in the sky and was a stationary red light.  It didn't appear to move for 20-30 seconds after we noted it.  The object then began to descend and alternated a couple of times between green and red light.  The object appeared to float in an unusual hover pattern and then randomly moved (very quickly horizontally before returning to its ascending and descending pattern.  The light would periodically switch from red-green and then to white.
The object climbed and descended a range of  20-30 degrees on our horizon at an indeterminate distance, but at least several miles away.  It appeared to be the ‘type’ of maneuvering a helicopter might make, however we have never seen a helicopter appear to move in that manner.  It was almost floating and then would go straight up/straight down very slow, then very fast.  Sideways also.  It finally disappeared below the horizon.

It looked like a sphere of white light, without actually illuminating anything. For size I'd have estimated you could fit a large GMC truck inside. It made no noise, I felt no air draft from it. It continued on a straight path heading south, and the girl and I ran further into the yard to watch it…

summary: Four, very bright orange spherical lights moving steadily in horizontal trail formation in night sky.
description:
Went outside in the back yard to let our dog out one more time for the night.  Dog started barking and running towards fence.  
Looked toward eastern sky and initially saw an extremly very bright orange, steady, spherical shaped light moving steadily from the south headed north-northeast and then immediately noticed a second, third and fourth identical bright orange light all moving above the back lot tree line.  
Sky was clear with good visibility. 
These objects were spaced apart fairly evenly in a horizontal trail configuration.  Objects were moving fairly slowly.  Estimate possibly ¼ mile between each light.  Hard to determine distance from myself, but possibly within one mile.  Altitude was medium, possibly 5,000', but difficult to determine due to lack of perspective or sky contrast.  
All four objects were identical and displayed no navigation lights, position lights, anti-collision lights, wing lights, or landing lights that are standard aircraft lighting.  
There was absolutely no sound associated with these objects prior, during or after their passage. 
I looked around the nearby houses to see if anyone was outside seeing what I was witnessing, but saw no one else.…

summary: 3 dim white lights in a triangle formation, crossed sky east to west, then moved apart.

This is from San Diego, Calif.  
I was outside after 8 PM doing a skywatch with night vision googles from my backyard in southeast ,san diego.  Observed a number of what I would say are standard satellite crossings in the sky.  Some small, very faint, some bright, and seen by the naked eye.  These are very common sightings in the sky on a nightly basis.  
Looked away from the goggles to speak to my wife, who was inside the house, to not let the cat out.  Upon looking throughout the goggles again, spotted a group of three dim lights, ( triangle in form) moving very quickly across my field of view, heading from the east, to the southwest.  I was looking south at the time.  It was very clearly three lights moving in a triangle formation.  At first , steady, as if it were a flat object flying level, and then the lights moved in relation to each other as if it banked to the side, and then, just before disappearing behind the small pepper tree in my yard, the lights started moving apart! from each other.  
I was very disappointed that  the tree cut off any more viewing of what these objects did. I estimate the time that I saw all of this is about 5 seconds.  
I have been a sky watcher…

summary: Low flying black shadow triangle in Queensland, Australia.

I was standing outside on a one storey high verandah at a motel. I was facing south about 1km from the Rockhampton QLD CBD.  Directly in front of me about 2-3 km away I noticed a dark (black) shape moving through the sky.  It was triangular and insubstantial, more like a shadow than an object.  It was approximately 100m above the buildings and was approximately the size of a city block 120m wide and 100 long at the point of the triangle.   I could see the stars through the object which seemed to shimmer like a heat haze behind it.  It was totally silent.
The object travelled in a shallow arc from directly ahead towards my location.  It passed by about 50m away (the other side of a four lane road) to my left.  I lost sight of the object due to the roof of the verandah above my head.
It travelled low in the sky no more than 200m high and travelled the distance in less than 1 minute although it appeared to be travelling very slowly.  Intermittently it separated into three separate smaller triangles with dull whitish, yellowish lights which switched places but still within the outline of the larger triangle shape.  It had reformed into one large triangle (still shadowy) when it passed…

Our dogs and cat did not move during this entire episode.
My wife believed the incident began at 03:30, however it began at 02:37, as the clock is closest to me and the numbers are large enough to see without wearing corrective lens.

Needless to say my nature makes me skeptical, but this experience was mind-boggling and frightening all at once.  The loss of time cannot be confirmed with any certainty.  There may have been aircraft in pursuit, but if…

As I was looking at the moon, I saw the same type of obstruction. I can try to describe it logically as much as I can, but the best way I can describe it was this: It looked very similar to the shadow of a hand covering the moon.  Not conducive with any other eclipse pattern I have ever heard of.

Approximately five minutes later, it returned at a lower altitude, and continued in a street easterly direction.the craft as mentioned before was above the size of a city block.  It was light blue with white dots on each side of its boomerang shape.  No blinking lights and and almost translucent.  The details of the craft were very defined and sharp. summary: Large Orange Oblong Light Travelling Slowing Across The Sky.
description:
At approximately 9:30 pm on Thursday, May 1st, my husband and I were sitting in our living room with our front door open.  It was a clear night, and our living room was dimly lit.  
I just happened to glance out the front door from where I was sitting and saw a large, deep orange oblong light slowly traveling across the sky from the South.  It had no trail and there was no sound.  It was quiet outside.  
My husband looked out and we just watched it. We turned our living room light off.  
The large, oblong light was at least 3 times the size of a street lamp.  The oblong shape did not change in shape nor size.  It was travelling North.  It seemed to hover so slowly and at one point we were looking directly up.  
Then, it started to move further upward and higher at a steep angle above our home.  It travel North East until it just disappeared.  
From the time we were looking at it up until the time it disappeared took approximately 2 minutes.
We spoke via telephone with this witness, and we found her to be exceptionally eloquent and sober-minded.  We suspect that both witnesses are highly reliable witnesses.  PD

 Most of my friends and family seem a little unsure of our story, but I was so relieved to see that another Ringgold, GA, resident reported the sighting as well.  I hope to see it again, and next time I will have my camera ready!  Truly a moment my husband and I will never forget!

I then thought it might be a police helicopter, because of the presence of red and blue lights and the fact that it wasn't moving, but again, it was so high and so far away,  I've never seen a helicopter that high up before.  If it was a police helicopter, it was extremely high and definitely over the ocean.

I only noticed this movement because I could tell that it was in a different position relative to the top of an electric pole than when I first started watching it. summary: My First UFO Sighting ?

Also, there was no engine or other noise in its wake.  Had it been a jet, I would have heard it.

It looked like a fireball at first, but without any fire, then more like just a big orange ball of light, but was too far away to see any detail at all.

summary: I witnessed two lights in formation moving in a straight line, far faster than any aircraft, and with no sound whatsoever.
description:
At 22:50 PST, on Sunday, April 20th, I stepped out onto my porch, and almost immediately, I saw two lights in very close formation moving from south to north in a straight line.  
They were moving far faster than any aircraft, and there was no sound whatsoever.  I was only able to see them for approximately 5 seconds before they were gone.  I estimate the altitude to be only a few thousand feet.
I see aircraft lining up for arrival at SeaTac airport every day and I am absolutely certain this was not an aircraft.  
This was also far too low to be a satellite.

His mother went outside first to look on the porch but did not see anything until she went to their driveway, and then saw a huge object.  She reported that something was coming across the sky, slowly, and was huge, white, and glowed very brightly.  It had blue lights on top and red on the bottom of it,  She called her son and his stepdad over and told them she had seen it.  They went over and saw it again and tried to get a picture,  It stayed in one place for a while, then spun around making a loud whizzing sound, then it went across the sky and was gone. summary: Large orange Carlos Diaz type craft  seen  along with  clusters  of  other  glowing  objects

These two lights merged into one giant light which materialized into a giant upside down funnel looking cone which next took on the shape of a domed disc which kept getting thicker on the sides and more rounded while I watched it.  It started drifting toward a nearby hill and turned into what I would have to say is the identical Carlos Diaz plasma type craft seen in Mexico.  
This object next took on the shape of an oval turtle shell looking object, kind of lumpy and rigid looking before finally turning into a long glowing orange object that looked like a croissant that you would get at a bakery.  It was a blinding fluorescent orange and slightly bent at the end and seemed to drift right into this hillside or go behind it and never reappear again.  Meanwhile I was seeing clusters of these orange lights appearing over this…

summary: Blinking red, blue, green light 251 degree West
description:
Sighting April 20, 2014.  9:41pm.  251 degree West  	
On this night I was out looking at Orion's Belt, or what I think it was.  There were only say 3 stars in a row on the horizon of the night sky in Lovettsville, VA.  I looked to the left of Orion's Belt, I saw a blinking red, blue, green light in the sky to the west around 250 to 275 degree.  
The object was clearly moving like a bee to a flower.  That is how it was moving I went ahead and recorded it on my phone.  The video was held steady and the object was still moving.  
I know it was part of the night sky cause I looked out about an hour later and it had stayed in the same place but moved with the night sky.  
I am just curious to know what it was on that night that I saw.  
Can anyone offer anything realistic of a solution?
Probable sighting of Sirius, we suspect.  Witness electst to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  Hence, we have no way of apprising him/her what it was being observed.  PD

summary: Four red glowing objects in the sky.
description:
My wife and I were on an after dinner walk and were looking at the lower north west sky when we noticed 4 glowing red objects.
The objects were either fixed in the sky or may have been moving extremely slowly but in tandem.
The objects were of equal distance from one another and formed a zig-zag line in the sky with the most westerly object being the lowest in the sky and the most easterly object the being highest in the sky.
We observed the objects for approximately 5 minutes.  The objects were not flashing but glowing with varying intensity.
The highest and most easterly eventually faded and disappeared followed by the next most easterly until all four had disappeared.
We continued to walk and watch the sky for another 30 minutes; expecting to see F18 scrambled to the area but it was uneventful and silent.
We decided to file the report wondering if others had observed the same thing.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Orange fireball spotted north west of Cleveland near Lake Erie.
description:

At a glance I thought it was mars but the object made me do a double take. Upon closer observation I found the object to be approximately three times the size of what Mars would be normally seen by the naked eye.  I would describe the object as being a pulsating fireball.  
After observing the object for approximately two minutes, it disappeared.  
I am a man of science and would expect there to be a logical explanation for the sighting.

summary: Mysterious bright orange ball of light glides across high desert sky Easter Sunday evening
description:
Easter night, clear skies, no wind. Noticed a bright orange light moving across the sky.  There were several planes visible during this time too that were much smaller dots in the sky with blinking lights as you'd expect to see on aircraft.  I'm also familiar with what satellites look like too. 
This orange light was a solid light that almost seemed to twinkle as it moved across the sky toward the south.  Much bigger in size than the surrounding aircraft flying in the vicinity, but still obviously distant in the clear sky.  After watching it move in awe trying to run to every rational checklist I could think of for about 3-4 minutes it just suddenly disappeared.  Like the bright orange light had been flicked off like a light switch.  
My son witnessed this first event with me.  I told my husband as we loaded our kids in our separate vehicles, after visiting family for Easter.  He had just missed the sight and blew me off when I told him I couldn't logically explain wh! at I had just seen.  
We drove around the corner approx 1/4 mi. to our home.  As we both pulled our vehicles in the driveway I noticed the bright orange light again!  It was back to the north of us again moving in…

The light didn't move for about 15 seconds then suddenly and rapidly went to the side and seemed to go behind a cloud and did not reappear.  About 20 minutes later I saw an identical light in the same general area moving rapidly in the opposite direction than previously (towards Elliot bay).  Light was solid not flashing.  I see planes and helicopters going and coming from seatac many times per hour and have not noticed anything with this type of appearance or movement pattern before.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

As I scanned the sky I saw 4 more in  no particular formation.  
The objects were not visible to the naked eye.  I was using 15x80 Steiner German Military binoculars. 
I moved to the side of my house where numerous neighbors were outside.  We all witnessed the objects through the binoculars.  For brief moments they were visible to one person with polarized glasses as if the sun reflected off the objects.  Some were stationary as others moved.  The number increased greatly to around 20 with some glowing green then disappeared.  They resembled rockets with colored lights on each end.

summary: Bluish/purple light moving horizontally and vertically over East Scottsdale.
description:
From Scottsdale (Shea and 101 area) facing east-a bluish / light purple light was hovering in the sky about 3 miles out - the light did not flicker, did not blink, did not get brighter or dimmer.
The light was moving in a right to left and left to right direction, occasionally moving up and down.  This movement CANNOT be created by an airplane, helicopter, a balloon or even a flare burning out.  This was moving at a casual pace which never really moved more than 5 degrees from my plane of sight.
It took about 45 seconds to finally fall behind a tree and then came out of the left side of the tree and started heading down again.  There was a plane heading towards it and you can see the planes lights flashing while the other light did not change.
It fell behind the treeline and disappeared.

summary: Light hovering in the eastern over Anthem, Arizona.
description: in the early morning sky, we noticed a satellite traveling across the earth's atmosphere. we waived int the event that someone was watching… approximately 05:20 hours, local time, a light was spotted, coming from the east.  it appeared to be creeping through trees, trying to get a clear view of us… as it was slowly moving closer to our location in a small neighborhood park,  i began taking video footage with my cell phone… the video wasn't really clear of the hovering light so pictures were obtained to document the craft's movements in thirty second exposures.  the light was observed for the duration of it's presence and it disappeared at sunrise… there was a quiet hum, mechanical in nature, like a fan blade, creating an airflow… it changed positions as we did, and continued to hover in an attempted sync with the natural rotation of the earth… the only evidence that would prove that it was a spy plane was my own observation, because camera settings were not re! configured in time to catch it winding down and flying directly overhead and to the north, where it was lost in the hazy gray of the dawn sky…

I saw the objects travel due east, above a thin, high cloud cover.  There seemed to be a rod between.  Speed was perhaps five times that of a jetliner at cruise.  No sound was heard.  No course deviation was observed.  Line of sight was broken by buildings.

When we first spotted it, it was moving about randomly low along the mountain slope in a weird, unpredictable circular pattern like it was pacing a bit before it started traveling across a greater distance and at a slightly faster speed.  The unknown object's bright white blinking light moved fast low on the mountains in almost a straight line after about a minute or two, still flashing.  The time posted is estimated.  
It moved far too low and too fast to be any sort of small aircraft or military aircraft, or even a vehicle which might have made the most sense, but even then the light was too bright and flashing too constantly at such a distance, and they generally don't flash that bright while moving either.  It covered a lot of ground and seemed to disappear closer to the Cook Inlet by where I live farther south along the mountains towards Girdwood.

summary: Star like object/ blue, green, red,and yellow/ stationary over Englewood Ohio
description:
I walked outside to smoke a cigarette, when I looked up into the western part of the sky about one and a half thumb lengths above the horizon when I noticed a bright star like object.  
At first I thought it was a plane because of the red and blue and green lights but it never moved.  It looked like a really bright star that blinked red, blue, green and yellow lights.  
I called my dad out to look and he was stumped as well.  
I got a small pair of binoculars to see it better and the red, green and blue colors really stood out…changing constantly.  The object never moved.  
We live only 4 or 5 miles from Dayton Airport so who knows.  
It was brilliant enough that I found this web site and I’m writing this.  I've never seen anything like it.  
The blue and green colors were very pronounced and crisp…the red as well.  
I hope someone else out there saw this.

summary: Two lights following in succession, one blue, one white.
description:
My cousin and I were outside talking and I was looking up at the sky, like I usually do at night, and I saw two lights.  
I pointed them out to her, and we watched as they flew in a south by south easterly direction.  The lights were traveling at the same speed and stayed in a line and were an equal distance apart.  
The leading light was a very bright white, like a LED flashlight white, and the following light was dimmer and a cobalt blue.  I believe they were on the same craft, but it is possible that they were two separate crafts.  
There was no distortion of the stars that it passed or an identifiable silhouette of the craft, which leads me to believe that it could have been two separate crafts.

summary: My wife and I were driving back home from a day of shopping at the Sommerset Mall in Troy, MI, when we were driving on 75 N bound at 934 pm, about a mile before the next exit E holly rd.

We are creeped out right now, and we have never been a believer until now, I know it couldnt of been anything normal.  This was out of this world.  
I called it in to the MI state police and he sounded like it wasn't the first time he heard this story.  I looked it up online and noticed more people are seeing the same thing.

summary: As a pilot of 10 years and owner of two aircraft, I am quite accustomed to seeing all sorts of lights in the sky, both on the ground and while operating aircraft.
description:
Viewing a map of the area, it seems to be approximately 7-10 miles northwest of the Kissimmee/International Gateway Airport.  The tower closed at 9:00pm local time.
I was on the ground, having just stepped out of a restaurant on west International Drive in a relatively dark area.  We saw what appeared to be traditional red/green navigation lights moving exceedingly fast across the sky, east to west, in a downward arc.  Thinking this was an aircraft in distress, I expected to see an explosion as it hit the ground.  Instead, it stopped behind a building in the distance and climbed in a completely vertical approximately 200-300 feet, then it stopped and made and IMMEDIATE right turn to the North/Northwest.
In my experience, there is no fixed wing or rotorcraft that can possibly move at the speeds this object moved or execute the maneuvers of this object.  The forces exerted on this aircraft would either rip the apart the airframe or cause severe damage to the pilot's internal organs.
There was no sound associated with this aircraft.

Shortly after that the lights turned off except the last light which was still far behind.  
As the last light approached the vicinity were the other lights had turned off, it as well turned off at that point.

summary: We saw a triangular craft with white lights in the sky traveling from Lexington, Kentucky home to Barbourville, Kentucky.
description:
On Saturday my sister her husband and my niece and nephew and I where taking a short trip from Barbourville, Kentucky to Lexington, Kentucky to check out the malls.  On the way back home going through Richmond I saw a white light in the sky in front of the car that went from bright to dull to bright again.  
Then as the highway made a turn I could see it out of the back passenger side window.  That was when I got a closer look at the thing.  It looked like it was closer to the car by then and I could clearly see a dark triangular craft with white lights on each of the three corners.  
The thing was low enough that if it was an airplane it would make noise but I didn't hear a sound from it.  
I watched it out the window for about ten seconds then all the sudden it disappears.  Absolutely no trace of the thing.  
For about a minute I kept my eyes glued to the window trying to find it but nothing.  My sister's husband saw it too.  I am baffled, airplanes have blue and red blinking lights I know I love airplanes very much.  
This was no airplane that I have ever seen in my life.  
The first thing I thought to do after our sighting was to report it to you Mr. Davenport.

summary: Streak of light across Mars.
description:
At approximately 8:30 pm (04/19/14), I was sighting my telescope in on the planet mars.  The sun had set behind me (to the west) but the sky was still to bright to see anything in that direction, thus I was looking easterly.  At the time I was looking through a 40 mm lenses and using an 80mm telescope which gives approximately 10X magnification.  At this magnification mars fills about ½ the visual field.
This is when something transited from right to left (south to north) through the field of view at what appears to be Mars’s equatorial region.  This is to say, it was observed in the field of view beyond Mars and passed somewhere between earth and Mars, exiting my field of view well past Mars.  Indicating it was NOT on Mars, but between Earth and Mars.  (Perhaps, this object was in Earth orbit?)  This pass lasted for only a fraction of a second and the object appeared white (I am color blind, but it appeared white to Mars’s red body with white polar caps as I see them.)  This object was tiny, almost appearing as a grain of sand. I immediately pulled my head back to see with my unaided eye, but saw only Mars.  (Note: no other planets nor stars were yet visible due to the fading…

It slowed and hovered (no sound)for about 30 seconds then turned to a dull green and changed direction to the east and traveled at a high rate of speed.  
As it got further away it appeared to get larger and very faint ghostly appearance.  
High haze in the atmosphere and it was above the haze.  
It came back following the exact same trajectory and same behaviour bright light to dull green just before heading east at a high speed.  
The initial brightness as it slowed to a hover was that like a fire ball (which I thought it was at first) as when it enters the atmosphere.  
The initial bright light shimmered and appeared rectangular in shape but changed to oval when it dimmed to green. 
Then faint triangular shape.

description:

As it turned I was looking for a strobe light like on a plane, there was nothing no noise either, then as it turned to the west holding its altitude of maybe 3-4 thousand feet,  the flickering fire looking light turned to a more solid appearing orange-yellow light.  I ran into the house to get my binoculars as quick as I could.
As I came out the the object was farther away still going west, then it appeared to just nose dive and went out of site, a few seconds later I saw a second orange flickering light object farther away to the southwest towards downtown phoenix flying level for a few seconds and it too nose dived out of sight.

description:
As it approached,  the craft moved to right for a second then headed due north.  It repeated this several times before slowing its speed down to a more fluent motion...  
There was no sound as the craft flew directly over Tulsa.  Flashes of red appeared as it  slowed tremendously from its initial speed.  Silently it continued north..  
The craft appeared to be cigar- like shape with yellow lights- one large in center with red small lights on either side and two smaller yellow lights on outer ends.  
It appeared to float at this speed like a blimp.  It appeared to float further over Tulsa going north to north east... 
Time recorded from 10:58 to 11:01 PM.

summary: Since my baffling sighting last year, the one I reported to MUFON in July 2013, I have quite often thought about my experience because it not only intrigued me but it was not the typical, "I saw a…
description:
What happened to me that night was definitely different from any typical ufo sighting I had ever heard of and it was almost unexplainable.   I hoped for another day where it would come again while I was not alone so I wouldn't feel so crazy when explaining a huge flying flame right over my head with black gases rolling around in it to people. lol  I honestly keep it a little hush because it is so bizarre.
Well tonight, at about 10:20 pm almost exactly a year later, finally, I saw it again and it was moving through the same exact area as I saw it last time, my sisters yard.  It was not nearly as close to me as the last one was, therefor it wasn't as large, but the plus side to tonights odd fireball sighting was that my sister and my niece both saw the flying orange flame right along side of me.  My skeptical side thought Chinese lantern at first due to its size BUT I quickly changed my mind.   We watched it travel through the yard at about the height of the tree line, moving west in a straight line, not up, not down, but mostly straight, much faster than the one I saw last year, it continued a good straight distance then up a little higher to avoid some trees then straight again…

summary: Lights following each other in SE direction.
description:
My girlfriend and I were out in my backyard enjoying a bonfire last night and a faint satellite heading in a SE direction caught my eye.  It was then followed by two more lights (the second being brighter than the first and last) about two thumbs width apart traveling in exactly the same speed and direction.  
I'm sure this was some sort of satellite array and just curious if anyone know what it might be for?  I've seen the triangular array the US Navy uses for it's subs and this was very similar, only all three were heading in a straight line.  If the weather clears tonight I will be going out around the same time to see if I can spot it again.  I highly doubt anything extraterrestrial, but cool to spot none the less…
Intl. Space Station and supply ship, flying in close formation, we suspect.  PD

summary: 9 Very brightly lit (red and yellow) saucer shaped crafts. Total time about 18 minutes.
description:
At approximately 10:01 pm in Chico, California, I first viewed a very bright red light with a yellow one in the center.  I had walked out on the back porch and was watching this thing move very rapidly through the sky.

There was NO way these were military flares because they were so bright but not only moving toward the North but were also rapidly moving upward until it blanked out of sight.  I would guess this object was between 10,000 and 15,000 feet up.
We thought the sight was over until about 15 seconds later a second one appeared and looked as if it was going a little faster but lower, then five to 8 seconds later a third appeared, then a fourth.  We tentatively watched these things wondering what they were.  I did call 911 and operator took the report and was teasing a little like we were seeing things until the 911 center started to light up.  I hung up with 911 and continued watching with my wife when in about 5 minutes went by and 911 called me back and gave me the number for the National UFO Reporting Center.  I didn’t know this even existed.

description:

summary: Report of Unusual Lights seen over Chico, California.

I first noticed two bright orange-colored lights moving across the night sky as I was driving Northeast on E. 1st Avenue in the city of Chico, CA.

We exited the car and immediately noticed that several other lights were appearing over the trees from the horizon.  We were facing the Southeast.
	The lights would appear over the horizon from the Southeast and travel Westward.  The lights appeared in pairs as if they were in a formation.  The lights had a steady, light-orange tint to them and were fairly large.  It was hard to judge their size, but I'm familiar with how bright and large Venus can appear, so I would approximate their size as if 5 or more Venuses were put together into a single object.  The objects would travel in a straight course, heading Westward and then…

summary: Two fast-moving, low altitude landing lights on nearly silent aircraft.
description:
It was about 21:00 on Friday evening, April 18th.  The sky was overcast. We were overflown by an aircraft with what appeared to be two white landing lights.  It looked to be flying low, maybe at about 500 to 1000 feet up.  It came roughly out of the north, flying towards the south.  We were in front of the Indian restaurant at the intersection of Wilson Mills Road and Richmond Road in Richmond Heights, Ohio.
Cuyahoga County airport is just a couple of miles north of that location between Richmond and Bishop Roads.  So  I just assumed it was a small plane or business jet taking off and gaining some altitude. But two things were unusual for me & my wife.  First it was really clipping along.  It seemed to be going really fast for as low as it was flying.  And secondly, the darn thing was nearly silent.
After it was a bit south of us and we lost the two lights in the clouds we thought we heard a low rumble of a jet.  My wife noted:  "Why do we hear it now and not when it was right over us?"  I live about 3-4 miles southwest of Cuyahoga Country airport and we are overflown by their small business jets.  They make a lot of noise.
This thing was just too fast and too quiet to seem right.…

summary: Formation of 8-10 lights suddenly disbursing in opposite directions

As four of us (my husband, my cousin and his wife, and myself - 4 four adults in our 30s) were driving on 427 we arrived at the traffic light on the intersection of 427 & Dock Track Rd, we immediately noticed a formation of bright lights glowing very brightly, much brighter than the stars.  
We almost assumed it was a constellation but they began to move, 2 of the lights simultaneously began pulling apart from the constellation, hovering further away from the other bright lights, and suddenly they shot upward and disappeared.  
As we turned left onto Dog Track Rd, we observed the other lights moving away, all in formation - they couldn't have been planes, these lights where amber/yellowish and super bright, they stood out from the sky and a lot of cars stopped to look, it was an amazing sight!

I was home alone with the exception of my 3 year old daughter. We have been experiencing some strange things around our home/property therefore installed 2 outdoor surveillance cameras a few weeks ago.  One points toward the street in front of our home.  
I put my daughter to bed then walked through the kitchen past camera monitor.  Something caught my eye.  I looked at the screen and saw what appeared to be a large white item with no particular shape flowing above the ground in the front yard.  
At first I thought it may be a trash bag, until I realized the wind wasn't blowing to that magnitude plus the object wasn't moving around- it was stagnant above the ground in a flowing motion.  
There was a "pole" or light beam coming from the top of the object- comparable to a flag on a pole upside down.  
As I tried to figure out what this was, it proceeded to fly up in the air, go above and over my horse trailer, back down a little and out of sight of the camera.  I sat there, staring for a moment when I saw something else moving around the horse trailer.  It was like a light beam- a thin beam of light yet there was no change in width.  It was the same width as far as I could see it…

We spoke via telephone with this witness, and he seemed to us to be quite eloquent and serious-minded.  We suspect that he is a very good witness.  He has provided a very high-quality video, that shows the objects he apparently witnessed.  PD

summary: Bright red firey light moving silently across the sky, then went up and dissapeared.
description:
Myself and two other people were working on a lawn tractor in a nice suburban neighborhood trying to get it started.  We are in the age range of late teen to early 20's. We do not drink. I had already gotten dark.   My one friend said, “woa, look at that!”. In the west/northwest sky we saw a very bright red light.  It came up over the houses, and then began to silently hover.
	We thought it was a parachute flare because it looked fairly low, however I know for a fact that most parachute flares only stay lit for 40 seconds.  It had that bright red fiery glow flares have!  They also make noise when being fired off when you’re at a close distance. This stayed lit for around 5 minutes.  It began to fade, but never came down.  In fact I believe it faded because it was going up!  Eventually it looked like it went up into the clouds.  It then disappeared.
	Well, it was very interesting.  That alone made us excited.  Then after around 10 minutes later, the same light came back down briefly!  It hovered again for maybe a minute, then went back up again and disappeared.  Nobody else saw it from what I know. I don’t understand how somebody else could not  have seen it!  It was too amazing to…

summary: Perfectly straight trajectory, circular, 10,000 mph at least, 10,000 feet up, silver, unlike anything I could comprehend
description:
Laying down looking up spotted what I thought was a bird at first, but then realized it was moving way too fast and realized it was thousands of feet up.  
I then thought it could be a jet but it was perfectly circular.  
There was also no jet stream and it was moving faster than any jet I've ever seen.  
I would guess it was moving at least 10,000 miles an hour or more.  
The object however had what looked to be a tail of some sort.  In fact it looked kind of like a balloon, because this "tail" was more underneath the object.  It was so far away that it was very small.  
I would think weather balloon, or possibly even satellite, but it was just moving way too fast, and I don't think satellite because it was only maybe 10,000 feet above ground, and not a balloon because again, the speed and trajectory.  
I had a very wide view it came out of the clouds but the sky was otherwise beautifully clear. It was about 3 or 4pm full daylight.   The trajectory was west to east and direction, speed, and height did not change.  
It was silver in color. I stared until I lost it in the treeline.
It's like nothing I've ever seen.

summary: White orb that was bright fading in and out slowly moving across the sky
description:
A white shimmering orb looking UFO was slowly going up and down across the Belmont and division area skies of se Portland.  I have a video of this orb I will post to youtube later. 
The orb ball seemed to lose light and then fade up in light periodically.  It was a ball of light, very bright and white/almost a light glimmering silver.  
This object was coming inside and out of various clouds, this lasted for 5 minutes.

summary: Glowing object flying over Thompson, MB.

Seen an black object with orange glowing at the back of object flying in our atmosphere about 1500 ft in the air flying over thompson, manitoba, Canada.  It was flying slowly and there was no sound.  Seen it for approx 30 seconds and then it disappeared.
After it disappeared we turned around and seen another object bright as a star flying in the air slow enough to see it moving and then it disappeared as well.  This is not the first time we have been experiencing these objects.  4 years ago we experienced a flying object 3 days in a row approx.  10 to 20 minute differences each night.  4 of us witnessed that one too.

summary: A yellowish round object caught in photos of jet trails.
description:
I was going for a shot of all the jet trails, particularly the three intersecting at the same spot. But when I looked at the images, I spotted a circular object I had not noticed when just looking at the sky.
It's in one place in the first image and in a much different place, to the right, in the second which was snapped just a fraction of a moment later.
I've enlarged it and included the edges of the nearby jet trails for perspective.
It was taken near the interchange of interstates 295 and 95, heading north on 95.  The window was down so it's not dirty glass or a reflection of the Sun.  It's not another jet since there's no jet trail behind it.  And I don't see how a morning star or planet would seem to move such a distance in pictures taken one after the other from virtually the same location.
((
Probably a sens flare, we believe.  PD)

summary: Red and white lights over Tampa, Fl.
description:
I was outside, on the phone with a friend, and saw an object in the sky.  
I initially thought it was a plane. It was slowly swaying across the sky in a pattern that was unlike a plane or helicopter.  
The night was cloudy.  I could barely see the moon, and no stars.  It was definitely beneath the cloud coverage.  
It had one red light and two white lights.  It moved from the east (from the furthest possible point I could see) to west, then hovered in the western sky.  
I looked at it though binoculars, but could see no definition or shape; the lights were clearer. 
I ran inside to wake my wife.  She came out and was unimpressed, until it turned a much brighter red (the white lights either turned off or were overshadowed by the red lights) and quickly descended, swaying downward.  
Due to trees blocking my vision, I'm not sure what happened after.

Also, we heard a very faint hum coming from the object.  Not soon after losing sight of the first object, we spotted a second object coming from a different area but displaying similar characteristics to the first.  And after the second passed out of sight, a third wa! s seen coming from a different location in the sky.
These objects have become regularly seen between 10 pm and midnight on clear nights.but

summary: Black helicopter following 2 orange lights (no sound except from helicopter)

I was sitting on my bed with my laptop when suddenly I heard the sound of a low flying helicopter.  Helicopters are common to fly in the area, and I like to check them out whenever I can.  
So I stepped outside and listened to the noise in the direction it was coming from.  I saw a blacked out helicopter with a red light on its tail and a strobe on its front.  Okay... that's strange for a helicopter.  I had this feeling it was trying to be incognito.
Then, I looked at a bright orange light ahead of the helicopter.  I immediately ran into the driveway to take a better look, then I noticed another orange light a great distance from the first orange light, except this one was more faint.  The lights moved at the same speed, same direction heading northwest, towards Faith, NC.  The lights never flashed.  Nor was there any sound.  Only the helicopter was making sound.  Planes fly around here all day and night, so I can detect aircraft real fast, but not these orange lights.  Something about them stumped me and I couldn't ever come to a conclusion what they were.  I have never seen anything like this before.
Seconds after the sighting I ran inside and explained to my mom what I saw, and…

summary: Red, green, and yellow object in the night sky.

summary: large, round, bright white light moving extremely fast at a low altitude
description:
I was driving from Raleigh, NC, to Wilmington, NC in the evening when it was dark out.  
A little over half way through the trip, I suddenly noticed something in the sky.  Out of the blue an immensely bright, very large white light appeared out of nowhere.  It was significant is size and was moving very quickly at a low altitude.  
It appeared to be very close - no more than a few hundred feet up.  It was moving extremely fast and then it suddenly turned in a complete u-turn and then a second later completely disappeared.  It was over with before I could blink.
I was with a friend and did not say anything because it happened so quickly.   I thought I might have imagined it but then my friend said "Did you see that?".  I was a little relieved that she saw it too.   
At first I thought it was a fireball but the more I think of it, the more I am convinced that it wasn't....  I do not think fireballs make u-turns.

I initially saw what looked like plane, as it was the most logical thought.  Note that I do live near Morristown Airport, so I just assumed it was a low flying plane.  But it wasn’t flying like a plane.  It was moving a slower and there was a change of speeds.  It seemed to be flying at a steady pace at first, but then slowed down and with that change of pace was a slight change in direction.  Seemed odd to me.  This is when I thought it was more than a plane.
After it flew for what seemed like  a minute, I had a hard time making it out and seemed to have disappeared from my view.   In regards to the object itself, I would say it was just 1 color.  It was an orange color of lights.  It appeared to be diamond shaped.  I even said to myself that it looks like a kite with lights around it.
In what might be a coincidence, after the object went out of view, there was a plane that seemed to be flying in that same direction.  
My thought on that was it saw what I saw and was going to…

The bison did not seem disturbed at first but with every 2 minutes the webcam changed they moved away and so did the orb.
I kept watching the orb as it continued to move positions every 2 minutes along with the bison.  When it moved further away from the position of the camera I began to see a wide light coming from it like the reflection of the moon.  It was then when I noticed way out in the distance in the rolling hills another part of an orb.
After awhile where the end of the orb light was shining it began to turn a light red until it was a very dark neon pink with two bright white rectangle lights... one on each side.  This light became more intense for about 4 minutes.  Then it all totally disappeared.
It came back and I did take a print screen this time so I do have a few pictures of the red neon light and gold with the orb.

I was now the passenger so I was able to observe but my nephew kept looking at the spray of light from behind the cloud and as a result he slowed down to 60 kilometers and was looking and asking questions.  
We were driving in a northeast direction and were at the top of a high point on the road which gave us a "BIG" view of the northern sky.  
Upon returning to his home and parking the vehicle, I proceeded to get out of my side of the vehicle which was on the north.  
As I got out I looked up at the cloud area and immediately seen an object appearing to be oval, bright yellow like a light bulb, moving from the north to the south in what seemed to be a slow to totally gone in a flash of 1 to 2 seconds.  It had what appeared to be a streak behind it at first site then just nothing.  
Initially I thought it was a "falling star" but second guessed what I said and what I just seen.  I have seen shooting stars, meteorite that light the sky up…

There was an audiology intern with him when I asked him.  He laughed and said 'no.'  But, after the intern left the room, he confided to me about witnessing over a dozen ufos, the size of a penny held at arm's length, silent, in the evening sky as he left the university and headed home.  He said they were clustered together at first, but as he watched them from his car he said they dispersed quickly in different directions while changing color.
My point here is that there are many more ufo witnesses out there who are not inclined to discuss their observations because of fear of ridicule.  Even as this observation/sighting left a lasting impression on the doctor he had kept it to himself until I coaxed it out of him.  He felt comfortable sharing with me as I initially shared a very close encounter with him that happened  not far from where he observed his.  I have also casually asked folks with whom I've come in contact…

summary: Half Moon object, that camouflaged itself to the night sky.
description:
This sighting happened in South Africa, Northriding, on the 15th of April at 19:00.
My friend and I was watching the Orion stars and we both noticed this object moving across the sky at a rapid speed.  The object’s shape was a half moon and was huge.  Its wing span was from the top star of Orion’s belt to the bottom star.  It was approximately 30000ft altitude.
We are situated in between two airports and constantly see planes flying over the night sky and this object was unlike any we have seen.  We have a full view of the night sky and this object moved from one end of the sky to the other in a matter of 20 seconds.
The object was not an orb or shiny or had any lights on, this is why it was not a plane. The object seemed to camouflage itself to the night sky.  It was like you could see through it but had some sort of structure to it because we could see the shape of a half moon.  
It looked like a cloud but there was no clouds at the time and it was to solid but clouds break up when they move and this object was really moving fast and clouds do not keep their structure like that when moving.  It was weird, like seeing something from a Star Trek movie were they have a cloaking…

summary: loud egg shaped aircraft
description:
Around 5:45 pm on Tuesday, April 15th, 2014, as I make dinner for my family we heard a loud jet sound pass.  I yelled out,"what was that"?  
My 10 yr old daughter went out on the front porch and came back in and told me she didn't see anything.  Less than a minute later the sound goes over us again.  I looked out the small window in our kitchen and saw the trees swaying and just assumed it was the wind picking up and echoing in the mountains.  
The 3rd time we hear it, I go out on the porch. It sounded like it was right above us but I saw nothing.  The sound was a deep rumbling and I couldn't tell what direction it was coming from.  The sound changed from a deep rumble to a higher pitch rumble. 
Then I saw the craft come over our house, at what seemed to be the same altitude as a normal aircraft.  This craft however, was wingless and a dark grayish color.  Also, it was sort of egg shaped.  Not exactly like an egg, but it wasn't round either.  This thing moved f! ast like a jet but left no jet stream.  Right when I saw it, I yelled out for my family to come see. In a matter of seconds it was already almost out of sight.  I know how this sounds, but I cannot deny what I saw. I don't…

summary: Observations interrupted by strange couple
description: I was in my house when I had a sudden urge to go outside to the front yard. Looking to the East, I saw 3 cigar shaped objects flying in close formation across the sky. They were flying too low, and too slow to be aircraft. I also noticed that their flight did not appear to be smooth as an aircraft would fly.  It was as if they were appearing in the next spot on the sky.  As I watched a younger couple approached me and asked if I was missing a dog, I pointed to the objects and asked if they saw it too, which the female replied, "Oh, that's nothing."   I looked at the couple and was struck by their odd appearance, which was too normal.  The male appeared to be Eurasian, and the female was caucasian, yet they were dressed in fancy Southwestern clothes that appeared crisp and new.It was as if someone who was unfamiliar with the area was trying to appear local.  I continued to watch the crafts until they disappeared behind the mountain, when I looked down the couple was gone. They had been on foot, and I had a clear view in both directions, but they were nowhere to be seen,and there was no dog.

summary: Extremely fast glowing object, flying very low to the ground, very close to us and very silent.
description:
This time driving west on 118 towards Simi Valley just past the Topanga Blvd off ramp we witnessed what appeared to be a fire ball flying parallel to the 118 heading East at an incredible rate of speed, at least a mile every 3-5 seconds. 
My wife and 6 year old were amazed as it flew towards and right by us.  My six year old called a shooting star.  My wife knew it was neither airplane nor helicopter it was so fast and silent. 
We pulled over and watched it cross the entire valley towards the 405 interchange in a matter of seconds and vanish as it blended with the lights of the city.  I saw an amber glow, my wife and son believed to have a more blue/white color.  I am color blind and may have a different perception of color.  
Simple math tells me this object was travelling at least 500 MPH maybe over a 1,000 MPH and no more than a 1,000 feet above the ground.

summary: Witnessed and photographed a low flying fireball heading northward at 4 am that did not apppear like any fly object I ever saw.
description:
At approximately a few minutes after 4 am, my alarm sounded.  I awoke and went to the bathroom.  I decided to reset my alarm on my phone for an additional 15 mins of sleep.  As I was doing this standing next to my bed a bright light caught my attention out the window next to the bed. 
 I pulled the shade further aside to get a better view and was struck by the odd apparently flaming object at a seemingly low altitude traveling from the south heading basically northward.  
Since I had my phone in my hand I quickly was able to turn on the camera and take 3 pictures.  The pictures are at quite a distance and the screen in the window added reticulation to the images but it is clear there are no red, green or landing lights like might be on a low flying plane (I work close to the regional airport and usually arrive at work in the dark and I am accustomed to what a plane leaving or arriving at a fairly low altitude looks like in many varying weather conditions) and it appeared elongated in the direction of travel and appeared to be emanating flames in all directions.  
Though we were experiencing a lunar eclipse atthis same time, the moon was in another direction and there were only…

summary: I suddenly got the thought to "look up..."
description:
I go to work very early in the morning.  On Tuesday, April 15, at around 3:40 A.M., as I was just about to open my car door and get in, I suddenly got the thought to "look up".  I did look up directly at a very bright light in the northwestern sky.  It was bigger and brighter than any star or planet I have ever seen.  As I watched, I noticed it was moving slowly due north.  It remained bright for only a few seconds and rapidly faded to a very small and dim dot that continued north.  I watched it for maybe ten seconds, and then got in my car and proceeded to work.  I have to admit I was a little shaken by the experience because of my sudden impulse and thought to look up.
This is not the first object I have seen and I have made quite a few reports here.  I seem to see things like this quite often, not really sure why.
I don't know what it was, but it was this single bright white light, MUCH larger and brighter than any star or planet I have ever seen.  I did not see any red or green directional lights as aircraft have.  I could not tell how high it was, but I got the impression it was very high up in the sky, maybe 30-40,000 feet or so.  It was difficult to judge the speed as well,…

summary: Stationary cylinder object lights up sky and rockets out of sight.

summary: Two smoothly flashing lights appear above sky before end of lunar eclipse.
description:
Shortly after the Moon began to leave the Earth's umbra, I noticed 2 star-like lights lying (seemingly) motionlessly to the left of the Big Dipper.  They began to flash back and forth, in a seemingly inconsistent pattern.
The flashing was not like that of a commercial aircraft's blinking, but rather a smooth transition from dim to bright.  They were exactly the same color as a bright blue star.  One light would make a short flash, and then another would a few seconds later, but the pattern was extremely irregular.
The object then began to move across the sky toward the right of the Big Dipper and increased and slowed in speed.  I tracked it with my telescope until it made a turn and headed over my roof, where it then disappeared.
Although it was too dark to make out a shape, I may have seen some thin wings. I couldn't make out the rest of the fuselage, however.  It was also completely silent.  I don't know whether or not the motionlessness was wind, true hovering or an optical illusion.

summary: Triangular, soundless UFO observed in Grants, NM during "blood moon" eclipse event.
description:
On April 16, I went to my back yard to observe the blood moon eclipse event.  ((sic.  April 15, 2014))  
While observing, I noticed a strange craft fly overhead moving slowly, blacked out with no sound at all, from south to north towards Mt Taylor.  It seemed to be about the size of a house, triangular In shape - altitude approx. 500 feet.  No lights except the moon reflecting somewhat off of it.  Very strange! I'm still shaken!  There's something weird going on out there!
((ADDENDUM FROM WITNESS))
This object, when it first caught my eye appeared to me to be a flock of birds flying in formation such as geese do but as it approached I knew it was not.
The light that I was seeing was the moon glistening off of the object.
It moved slowly at about 30-40 mph as far as I could tell.  As I stated in my report it seemed to be about the size of a house.  If it was to fly in front of the moon at the time it would have easily covered it.  It made no noise and that is what was unusual and it spooked me. It also had no lights of any kind...just like a shadow in the air.  
I observed it for 15 - 30 seconds and as it went over my house towards Mt. Taylor I couldn't or didn't want to follow it.…

summary: Two erratic blinking lights spotted in East County that moved, vanished, reappeared, traveled, and finally disappeared into eastern sky.

Then, one of the lights flickered to nothing while the second light remained lit and descended even faster before disappearing into the northern horizon.  All of the sudden, my oldest daughter saw both lights (Still blinking) reappear in western sky within a minute after vanishing.  Then the two blinking lights slowly moved to the east above us, pausing for brief moments, only to continue moving eastward.  The blinking was very irregular, sometimes they remained lit (like to blend in with the stars), other times like a strobe, and blinking steadily as well. The lights seemed to remain right over us for sometime.  My oldest and I played a game with the lights (joking that we should try to communicate with whatever it was) as they moved right above us using our flashlight's strobe setting. summary: A boomerang-shaped black object flys overhead during an eclipse in Denver
description:

At first I thought it was a huge bird but it got closer and you could tell it wasn't an animal.  It was black and blended into sky, and had white lights or dots on it but they weren't very bright.  It silently and slowly went right over the house.  It seemed like it was very close.  
We paused for a moment because we thought maybe someone was flying a kite.  I went around the house to see where it went but I couldn't see it.  It didn't seem like anyone was flying a kite nearby.  It was a clear night.  
My friend and I are 22, and we've known each other all our lives.  I am very skeptical, I don't know if it is likely that this was some sort of alien thing but I think its fun to entertain the idea.  
My friend is more skeptical than I am and she and I were both a little weirded out by the experience.  I feel a little shaken up by it, and I wanted to tell the story because I just wanted it to be on record somewhere.  
Denver is just not a place I ever expected to see a UFO, especially in a residential area.  I…

on this form i checked a box under "animals responded to the event". i did notice just before i spotted this squadron that dogs began to bark all over the neighborhood.  at the time, i did wonder if it was in response to the eclipse or just a coincidence. i really don't think it was in response to these UFOs that were flying in the upper atmosphere.  but...  who knows?

It took them less than 10 seconds to get directly overhead, as they passed us the oval on the left side of…

It was moving slowly above the neighbor's house at a bird's flight height and she could see it was grey metallic (matte - not shiny, but the sun was out, it's been cloudy).  She saw the width of the machine, it was smooth overall, but had a large visible structure located towards the end of the body that looked like a propulsion system and some large symmetrical multiple tail type structure.  
The machine was about twice the length of the plane and proportionally wider than the plane.  She was on the phone with her mother at the time, but could not turn…

summary: Spinning tubular UFO flies and flashes acrross sky while several others in sight in Boring.
description:
I had just finished working for the day and I stepped out side outside about 11:30 pm to look for my cat.  So I'm walking around and I take a gander at the sky because it looked beautiful, and I see what looks like a little yellow light bouncing around.  Shorty after seeing the yellow one, I notice a blue one beneath it doing the same thing. just bouncing slightly.
I mentally debate if what I'm seeing if actually moving at all, and my vision is observing it wrong, then all of a sudden the blue one does a full circle in a split second, just WOOOSH!, then back to where it was like it just answered my question for me.
At this point my jaw is at the floor, and Im just watching waiting for more. So I look at the 2 lights for a number of minutes, I'm going to guess 5.  I felt like taking my eyes away from the sky would have been a mistake so I kept my eyes locked.
After a bit of time passes I see in the corner of my eye, a tubular long object with a light along it that looked like a flowing lightening bolt. It was emanating from the body of the object and flowing like a beam of electricity. On both ends there was bright flashing lights too. I see this objecting spinning in full circles…

summary: Large blue light observed traveling at a slow steady course from north to south over northern New Jersey.
description:
Stepped out on to front porch at around 11 pm and saw a giant brilliant blue light through the clouds.  The weather condition is rainy, therefore the object was seen initially for only a few seconds.  Due to the brilliance of the light which was not bright as to see your shadow, but more like a deep blue that did not look natural causing me to be a bit fearful.  
At the time of the incident, two passenger jets were observed flying somewhat within the proximity of the object.  
I live not to far from Newark airport so this is a heavily air trafficked area.  I believe that those pilots would have seen this object.  
The object did not make any sound as far as I could tell.  
I continued to observe the object as best as I could see through the clouds for the next 4 minutes until lost.  It appeared that the object was traveling at a north to south direction and was on a strait steady course.  
The object appeared large and like nothing I have ever seen before.

summary: Large gray stingray shaped object chases fighter plane.
description:
I was on the grocery store parking lot placing my groceries in the trunk.  I heard a fighter plane type sound approaching us but didn't see anything.  About 3 seconds later I see a fighter plane coming from the west heading northeast. The fighter plane was traveling very low and very slow.  If I had to guess I would say 2,000 feet in altitude.  I told my son and my friend "look it's a fighter plane".  We watched it for about 8 seconds as it flied by directly above us.  Then a large gray object approached the fighter plane from the rear at a very fast speed.  The object had no navigation lights like the fighter jet had. It only had 4 very dim bar lights between the main body and the wings.  I thought it was going to crash into the fighter plane.  It slowed down suddenly about 3 plane lengths away behind the fighter plane. It followed the plane for about 5 seconds.  Then the object gained speed, made a hard right, and then a hard left, cutting off the fighter plane.  
The object could be seen more clearly when it turned because it banked left. Then you could tell that the object was shaped like a stingray without a tail.  It was gray and about 12 times larger than the fighter plane.…

summary: Bright orange orb near west side reservoir.
description:
I live in the west side of Danbury near the New York border.  I noticed a bright orange light through my living room window.  It was low in the sky behind the trees to the north of my house.  
I went out side and observed the object.  It was about the size of a full moon.  It was bright orange.  It was hovering in the sky to the north of my house behind a grove of trees, which were bare of leaves as spring has not come yet and the trees are still without leaves.  
The object hovered for 10 to 15 seconds and then moved off to the east.  The object made no sound.  Considering the size of the object it had to be fairly close to me, otherwise it would have to be truly huge.  
The fact that it made no sound, and the way it moved convinces me it was neither a plane nor a helicopter.

summary: Fireball like object seen above the small island city of Ketchikan, Alaska.
description:
Around 9:30 at night my fiancé, his brother, and myself went outside for a cigarette.
I noticed a fireball like object in the reflection of my neighbor's window.  We decided to go out into the street to get a better look and when we did we saw a large reddish orangish ball of light in the sky.
It came towards the west, got really bright, stopped for about 5 seconds, and then went out of sight towards the east in the opposite direction.  
My finance's brothers exact description was, "It looked like something on fire!"  It looked like an aerial flare from a boat but an aerial flare will arch, and this fireball maneuvered like an air craft of some sort.  
One more thing to add..  All the dogs in the area were going crazy.  
We do not have an explanation for what this object was.  We have never seen anything fly like that.  All three of us are sober. 
I am sure many people saw this tonight because the population is only about seven thousand.

There is cell phone tower to the left of the citing, a crop field behind it, and a rural neighborhood development to the right of it.

I judged the craft to be as big as my house (a 3,000 sq. ft. modified split-level) and as low in the sky as the tallest type of stadium lights.  As the craft moved, it rose higher in the sky and the lights began to intermittently, slowly dim and then brighten again, though they did not return to the same brilliance I had first seen when they were stationary in the row.
	After the object turned, I got the impression that the object was triangular in shape and that the lights had appeared in a row before only because the craft was facing me.
