One would go up and hover high north of Folsom Lake and seemed to wait and overlook the next two objects and then the following ones would disappear quickly in a ENE direction with the waiting object quickly following.  This scenario happened three times that we saw. Who knows if it was going on prior to what we saw.
Unfortunately the objects were too far away to see a definitive shape of the aircraft.  All I know is that they were very bright amber and acted almost like when you see bees coming out of a hive with a steep climb then…

summary: 40 independent orange lights seen traveling over Orangevale  CA
description:
On 3/15/14 from, 9:30 pm - 10:00 pm, I saw a total of 40 orange lights fly one by one, in a conventional manner towards our home in Orangevale, Ca.  
They were flying one by one from the area of Folsom, Ca.  They did not appear to be part of a solid object.  Most were independent flying.  A couple were in tandem.  
They would head towards Orangevale, then once they got to a certain point they would gradually blink out of sight.  A few flew off towards the east.  
There was no sound.  They were not helicopters either.  
All were the same size and color of orange.

summary: Red orb shape with no flashing lights, moving quickly across sky then disappeared very quickly
Triangle shaped movement,  Full moon, ides of march, weird shaped clouds
description: There were three craft of circular shape moving in a triangular form,  One was bright white, we think that was the mother craft.  then there was a small white one then a medium red one.  Moving to the beat of the music playing from a cell phone.  The mother craft stayed over a close by cow pasture.  The others moved west.  The moon was full and surrounded of clouds shaped actually like the milky way galaxy.  The mother craft shot a bright beam of light then dimmed a little over the cow pasture.

summary: Glowing orange spheres in a v pattern in sky southwest of Littleton, moving eastward.
description: My daughter and I were walking to the store, saw 6 glowing orange spheres in an upside down V in the sky southwest of Littleton, heading east at a high rate of speed.  The lights sequentially turned off, one by one.  Two other witnesses were watching this as well, transfixed.

summary: 3 coppery orange lights seen on Vancouver Island, BC, 15 March, 2014
description:
At 8:10pm while watching TV I noticed a bright coppery orange colored light out the window in the sky.  Sometimes I see the lights of airplanes but this was much bigger, brighter and a different color.
Within 10 seconds another light of the same size and color followed behind.  With my arm and fingers outstretched they would be about as far apart as my thumb and middle finger.
I stood up and went to my sliding door for a better view.  They were gliding in a row from north to south before smoothly turning east.  I went outside to see if I could hear anything from them, no sound heard.
A third light then appeared the same distance behind.  The 3 were evenly spaced.  Then I noticed the 2nd and 3rd light had moved a little closer together.
They disappeared one at a time in the order that they appeared.  I watched them for a good 2 minutes total.

summary: I WAS closing my garage door and i saw very odd craft but i'm not sure what they 2 and i saw a lights first was red then change to blue and was going back and forth side ways then going up and down…
description:
Now I'm very close to Fullerton Airport so i don't recall see anything like that before in my time it just kind odd going sideways and no sound at all.
We suspect an evening sighting, and have changed the time above.  PD

summary: Glowing cyan blue object in night sky
description: Sometime in the evening I noticed a tiny cyan blue object glowing outside my window. This was years back but I still remember seeing it jerking around, hopping from one point to another and moving in random directions. It moved more quickly than airplanes or helicopters I'd usually see from that same window, and at the time I'd lived in the same place my entire life. It was too far away to see any discernible characteristics so I took a couple of shots. I only got one photo of it remaining still, the first one attached below, and the rest are blurry since they were taken as the things was moving. I believe some were taken through the window and it's possible some were taken with the window down, but I can't remember for which photos for certain. Unfortunately the streaks may likely be from the camera shaking/object movement. Not sure if it really was anything but it was odd to me so I thought I'd put it out there.

summary: It was a V-shaped craft moving at a speed west to east 3 to 4 times faster than any jet.  Its V shape against the blue sky was clear.
description:
I was sitting in my back yard enjoying the warmth of the afternoon sun when my pet dog sat on my lap and looked up into the sky.  
I looked in the direction she was staring and saw the cloud cover to be very sparse and light and moving slowly when an V shaped object which appeared to be at a very high altitude maybe 40-50 thousand feet and moving  west to east at a speed 3–4 times faster than any jet I have ever seen.   
The color of the object was pale but the V shape was clear as it moved across the sky.  
The entire incident lasted only 3- 4 seconds before it left my view angle over my roof.  I got up to try to observe it further but it had already vanished from the sky.  
I went inside my home to tell my wife what I had just witnessed.
Witness indicates that the date of the event is approximate.  PD

summary: UFO changing shapes from teardrop to rectangle
description:
I went outside on break at my cosmetology school.  When I looked up at the sky there appeared to be what I thought was a plane. It was a bright light and looked like it was going to crash.  It suddenly stopped and I just stared and stared not able to take my eyes off of it.  It changed into a tear drop shape and then to a rectangle.  It then started to get very small and disappeared.  I was in too much shock to get my phone and record it but I freaked out because I had never seen something like it!
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: I believe that I witnessed a ufo, star, or planet disintegrating.
description: I witnessed a bright orange what at first glance appeared to be a planet or star in the Northern sky.  Within seconds it began to fade away.  When it was almost completely gone another object which looked like a shooting star passed directly beneath horizontaly.  I have perfect vision & know what I saw was not a figment of my imagination.

summary: It is some object, shape is like star ... But it is different .. 1 it is very low in sky then any other star 2. It is not visible after 3 hours.
description: Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: A Rectangular object with red, blue and white lights was hovering early in the morning.
description:
I was not moving the whole duration i was watching it.  Ot was slightly slanted as well.  The lights were moving and not so much blinking.  
It was such a distinct sight, i just knew it was not a bright star or a plane.

summary: Huge fireball above Miami International Airport
description: I was working the night shift as a Security Specialist for the Miami Dade Aviation Department at Miami International Airport.  At about 3 am, I came out of the guard house located at the end of the runway next to Le Jeune Road (42nd Ave) in order to stretch my legs.  At that moment I looked up to the sky and noticed that there was an unusually dense and low clowd cover.  The clowds were moving northbound fairly quick as it was very windy.  Then all of a sudden, I saw this huge yellow fireball with a long tail, silently traveling horizontally in the opposite direction of the clouds where it disappeared in a matter of seconds.  I was flabbergasted not only by the nature of the sighting but of how close to the ground the fireball was.  It couldn't have been much higher than the planes when taking off or landing at the runway.  The runway runs east-west and the fireball traveled across the runway north-south.

summary: Huge orange pulsating light seen from hwy198 on bridge in Gun Barrel City, Texas, on 03/15/2014.
description:
My friend and I were traveling south on Hwy.198 on a bridge over Cedar Creek Lake at approximately 2:30am, when we both noticed to our left a huge pulsating orange light in the distance.  
It looked like it was about two to five miles away.  
We tried to locate where it was but never saw the light after a few minutes.

summary: BOOMS GOT PROGRESSIVELY LOUDER.
description: LOUD BOOMS HEARD WITH NO FLASHES AND NO SHAKING.

summary: Fleets of "Star" or "Light" Crafts Seen Flying Over Vancouver, WA, on 3/14/2014.
description:
Last night, I observed a bunch of UFO's over my house.  I'm really glad that I decided to write down what I saw last night as it was happening...  I couldn't get good pics or video & wanted to make sure I was actually seeing what I saw...  So, I just kind of started writing out what I was seeing & doing just to know I would remember this night!  
Later, I tried talking myself out of what I saw throughout the night, & next morning, but I'm sure what I saw was real & when I read my description from last night, I realized that I can't talk myself out of it anymore...  
So I'm submitting my notes from last night that describe the entire event.  It's mostly chronological so it's how it was unfolding.  I left it all in, even a few of my personal feelings about some of the things going on.
I started writing about 5 minutes after I first saw the UFO's in the sky.  At about 12:15pm, yesterday on Friday night, March 14, 2014:  - Seeing a fleet of UFO's fly over my house right now!  Omg!  They look like seeing tiny stars or satellites.  Like when watching a satellite from space go thru the sky, except not blinking or twinkling, just solid.  There are WAY too many to be a satellite or even a…

summary: Changing white to red light that hovered and changed positions in the sky.
description:
My wife was looking at stars out the window and called to me from the other room.  There was a object at a far distance blinking white to red to white to red that was stationary.  It intermittently was obscured by cloud cover but it kept becoming visible again, however, it would appear in another area of the sky.  
At one point I checked "what planes are above me" on my IPhone and all it showed was one 737 in the sky at the particular time.   
We observed it in the sky in various locations for over 2 hours before we went to bed.  It was too far away to take picture which I tried on 2 cameras.  At one point my wife observed another light flying to the ship she described it looked like a "firefly."

summary: 4 white lights rotating in the sky,right within the clouds.
description:
Before I write this I want it understood that I was one to not pay attention to any so called UFO stories until last night, cause to be honest I had never seen anything like that before so I thought it was all BS.  Until last night,......... My bed room has a back door that leads outside onto a small roof around the back of the house, I use it when I'm going to have a smoke.  
A little after lighting my cigarette I noticed what appeared to be 4 white lights rotating in the sky, right within the clouds, the moon was out and it was bright so I could see the clouds very well, the lights seem to be rotating simultaneously two at a time in a circles motion, curious I was like, "What the hell am I looking at," trying to figure out if the lights were coming from the ground up or not, but from what I could see they were not they were coming from above the cloud.   
Then just like that the lights rotated again into one but this time it was dead center and just ! diapered.  I stood there dumfounded not understanding what I just saw, but I do know what I saw.  Again I'm not a big fan or believer in the UFO thing, but I do now this, "I know what I saw."

summary: My wife noted a strange object hovering to the east of our residence.  She called me to the window to see it.
description:
It was several hundred yards up moving very slowly south east.  We also noticed that at least 15 to 20 aircraft at different time intervals all seeming to converge on the object.  
At one point, an aircraft flew very low and fast over our residence toward the object.  
We used binocular's to look at it.  It seemed triangular with blue, red, green, and white lights.  It moved very slowly.  
While we were watching, another object appeared very similar to the first, but more to the east.  
Both had the same lights and moved very slowly southeast.

summary: The object hung suspended in the sky, a huge rectangle, at a diagonal angle.  Dark grey in color with dull green lights at the points.
description:
I go out running almost every night.  On this particular night, I was so hungry, I had a pretty decent sized sandwich a short while before going out.  This wasn't the best decision I've ever made, but it lead to the sighting of this massive UFO.  
During one portion of my run, my stomach cramps became too much.  I stopped at a bus stop bench to take some deep breaths.  After a few moments of sitting there, the street light beside the bench unexpectedly went out.  Jokingly, I saw this as a sign that I should continue walking.  I was near the University of Florida campus, walking right in front of the Law School Library, which is usually open 24 hours and always lit.  This building too was completely dark.  Finding this strange, I continued walking.
As I walked forward along the sidewalk, a fairly small plane flew over head, but very close.  Closer than any plane I'd seen flying before.  
Again, I found this strange and as I continued walking I realized that I had seen numerous planes in the sky that night and had thought it weird.  Up until this point, I wasn't thinking anything supernatural, just that strange occurrences continued to happen.
To my left after the Law Library, is…

summary: looks like an aircraft with white light brighter and bigger than a star been seeing it for almost a month straight around 6am to 6:45 .
description:
We seen it in the sky for 35 minutes at 6am it is diamond shape when you zoom in with a video camera 70x zoom and with naked eye it looks like an aircraft with white light bigger than a star. 
I've been seeing it almost every day for the past month.  
This is no joke this is not a hoax.
Venus.  PD

summary: Large round non-glowing orange color UFO and no sound.
description:
2:45 AM March 14, 2014, I got on to the freeway from the Willow Pass entrance in Concord, CA, 94520, heading south.  
Coming from the south a UFO flew over my head.  It was orange and round the size of a large passenger airplane.  It looked much closer like the height of a smaller plane traveling.  The size to my eyes was about one foot in diameter.  
I looked in the rear view mirror but did not see it again.
My mother saw one back in the 1960’s and I never thought I would see one.  So at age 76, it was quite exciting.

summary: Hovering crafts over san bernardino mountains.
description:
This is not the first time we have seen this particular craft.  It hovers over the ridgeline in wrightwood, ca.  You can see a change in color as if the craft was turning and the colors turn with it.  It has been coming around the past couple years and its always around after huge storms.  I have seen other crafts but this one seems to be the most consistent.  It will hang around and then after a few hours drop back down in the mountains.
There is also a time in January of 2011 where the entire areas power went out.  While sitting outside in a car for heat, a strange bright greenish light shined over our car.  As fast as it came, it was gone even faster.

summary: A v-shaped ufo that was translucent with a green tint traveling slowly.
description: A v-shaped craft that appeared to be translucent with a greenish tent to it on the outer edges.  It had no sound and traveled very smooth and straight.  It also had a hazy, cloudy look to It.

summary: Lights above mountains south of henderson.
description:
Mostly Stationary.  It appeared to hover.  Blinking yellow, red, and blue.  
We looked at it with binoculars and couldn't see a shape but you could see it changing colors.  
Above flight path to  airport. we could see planes flying underneath it so it was pretty high up.  
It was above the mountains in between south of Henderson and around where Lake Mead would be if the mountains were not there.  
Four of us watched it for about a half hour.

summary: Solid Amber colored object moving slow and steady, West to East, silent.
description:
Solid Amber colored cylinder shape, heading West to East, going only about 400 mph, flying way to low to be a jet, no flashing flashing indicator lights, just a solid red/orange color and was completely silent. 
Also, about a min before the incident, out of nowhere our dog started whining and acted anxious.

summary: Viewed a triangular craft with only 2 steady white lights and 2 flashing red lights which flew low, slow and almost silent.
description:
We were driving home on back country roads.  Saw a large craft flying very low and very slow.  
We drove towards the craft and stopped in the road when it passed directly over us.  I got out of the car and observed a large triangular craft with steady white lights on the bottom of the wings and a two flashing red lights one on the front of the triangle and one in the middle of the back of the triangle.  There was no green or red running lights.  
The craft could not have been more than 1000 feet above us.  I heard nothing of it until it had passed over us.  
At that point, it made what I would call a light wushing sound.  It sounded more like the wush from a draft.  I could not hear engines. 
 It did not have the jagged back edge of a stealth bomber.  It seemed to me that I could have driven my car at the speed at which it was moving.  
In order not to startle our daughter, we told her it was a plane and drove home.  
I regret not investigating further.

summary: two blue/purple crafts over downtown Hollister Ca
description:
At first it was just one craft blue very still in the sky then I thought wow that has been there for a while wonder what it is at that very moment it almost split into two craft witch danced around with each other as I sped up they sped up the then very quicly changed to a bring lavender purple color 
As I followed them further they seconized (synchronized??)) and dropped down at a moderate speed.
This is not the first time ive seen double sightings in this town an I know its not the last.

summary: Craft spotted in broad day light, disappearing and reappearing three times moving in different directions each time before vanishing.
description:
It was a bright sunny, not a cloud in the sky, windy day in South Florida; and I was doing my daily jog by the beach in the afternoon.  
While heading back jogging south along the beach I looked up into the sky and noticed a strange silver object reflecting sunlight.  At first I figured it was a plane, but then the more I watched it the more intrigued I became and I had to stop and look closer.  It wasn't on the normal flight path that all the other planes come in at towards the PBI Airport and it was flying particularly slow.  The craft was also much higher in altitude than any of the planes and was heading directly west, then it suddenly vanished.  Afterwards I kept walking and a minute later I looked back in that direction only to see the craft again almost in the same location but now was heading directly south and picking up speed then vanished again. I then started walking at slow pace while still staring where the craft disappeared and between a minute or two minutes later it appeared again suddenly, a little further south of where I originally saw it the first two times and was moving very slowly west again and then quickly vanished once more.  Each time I saw the object…

summary: Seen bright light that exceeded several hours from dark to daylight
description:
Was heading home from work when I noticed a bright light low in the sky which seemed to be following me.  
When I turned in my street to my house the light was in front of me and when I got to my house it looked stationary above my neighbors house and to the left a little.  
I grabbed my phone and started to video tape it.  It did not seem to be moving and I would notice like a second light flickering occasionally.  
I taped for a good while and decided to go get my binoculars and I headed to my back yard.  Throughout the taping you can see the sun rising and birds flying and traffic passing me by.  With the binoculars I could see what looked to be a very brilliant triangular shaped aluminum looking object and could see another object behind it connected by something.  
The objects would seem to change shapes like from a triangular to cylinder or flat and shimmering.  Neither object had the same shape.  
I video tapped until almost I think 9 am and stayed outside still observing this brilliant light in the sky.  Using my binoculars the object seemed to be going further away because it was getting smaller.  It did not go sideways st all just stayed what seemed to be stationary and…

summary: Bright object comes up from behind trees hovering over the water.
description: Son wakes me up at 5 in the morning.  Catching a bright pulsing object hovering in the sky. Had a red beam at the bottom.  Then 15 minutes later a flashing ball of lughts shoots pass the object in a circular motion.  All caught on video.

summary: Static light over the city, it was lowering and raising its brightness intensity.
description:
I came out of my house around 4:30 am and took a look to the sky, then i noticed a static light.  
First i thought it was a star but its was way to big so i thought it should be a planet.  
I stood there for a while watching it and noticed it wasn't so far away, it seemed it was as far as  an airplane could be.  
It seemed that it was just static above the city. 
Suddenly around 5:30 am the light became small from one second to another but it was still static.  
After a few seconds the light became big again, it was rather strange that it changed size so fast.  
I'm not sure what it was but i think it was some static aircraft lowering and raising the brightness intensity of its light.  
By the way, i wasn't the only one who saw it, my husband and cousin watched it with me.
Possible sighting of Venus?  PD

summary: Blue fireball in night sky.
description: NE sky, near Interstate 5, a shooting fireball was seen headed in NE direction, the fireball came in quick and low only lasting about 10 seconds until it grew lighter blue instantly and faded within seconds after appearing.

summary: 4 ufo's lights over Cook Inlet.
description:
A young man came to the local bar and asked if we had a platform out front of Ninilchik.....we all said no...he said well I saw a flash of light and then a triangle of lights out over the water....someone said where he pointed over his shoulder towards cook inlet ....then started really looking and said as a matter of fact there they are....we looked out the windows and then all went outside. ......what the @^#!/.......so in awe didnt take a picture.   
Then we all ran down to ninilchik beach seeing them all the way until we came through the two sand pillars to the beach...they were gone.  
As I looked the sky I saw six fluorescent orange lights moving in pairs of two across the night sky.  I dont care if anyone doesn't believe what I saw....they were as big or bigger than the sun and glowing fluorescent orange. ....four of them in a straight line across the mountains.
It has made believers of some of the people I was with.  I was told that my friend in the caribou hills saw it from her cabin and another two male friends one north and one south both saw them.  
I have a friend who lives on the bluff and have asked her to keep on the lookout and a camera handy.

summary: I saw a small blue light move from a star to the left, then it blinked out.
description:
On March 12, 2014, about 23:21 hours, I was standing outside my home, smoking a cigarette.  
I looked to the West and just above my roof line I saw 3 stars in a line, (that I always see early in the night and to the west) but near the lowest star on the horizon out of these 3 stars, there was a small blue light.  
I immediately focused in on it, because it was blue and it was moving.  I watched this blue light travel from (it almost looked like it was behind the star) the star to the left and at about a 40-45 degree angle towards the ground.  
It traveled quickly for a few seconds, then it blinked out, and it was gone.  I thought I might have lost sight of it because of the tree branches that are in the way, but after getting a better view of that piece of sky, I could no longer see it.  
I took out my iPhone 4S and took a picture of the sky where it was, but unless you turn up the brightness the image is almost all black.  
This morning I remarked a copy of that p! icture, this morning.  I have used MSPaint to draw the path of the UFO, the tree branches, the roof line, and the brightest stars that were visible with the naked eye. 
I will send the remarked picture and the original…

summary: Huge chevron shaped craft flies silently over park in middle of town!
description:
I left my house on my motorcycle at right about 23:00 heading to my girlfriend's house.  About halfway there, as I was driving along the south side of Pioneer Park on Whitman St., I looked up and saw a chevron shaped craft flying about fifty feet above the tops of the tallest trees in the park.
The craft appeared to be about a football field in length with three visible lights on the bottom.  One light was on the underside of the leading tip of the craft and the other lights were on the underside tail of each "wing" forming a triangle pattern.  The ship was dark grey in color and although it was well after nightfall I was close enough to observe the entire vessel.
I put the engine in neutral and hit the kill switch for the motor with my thumb.  I figured a craft that size must make noise but I was even more surprised when it wasn't making a sound. It was cruising from the Southwest corner to the Northeast at an impossibly slow speed of maybe 20 or 30 mph.
A few seconds later I could no longer see the ship because the trees were blocking my line of site, so I dropped my bike into gear and popped the clutch,since I was still in motion, and hurried to my girlfriends house.  The…

summary: Blue and Red light over the Everglades.
description:
Very bright single light fading from red to blue seen over the Everglades.  It headed east-northeast for a few seconds then headed back to its original position, then disappeared.  No sound.
We get lots of air traffic  (large planes, small planes and helicopters) mostly from west-southwest to east  for we live between the Everglades and Ft. Lauderdale International Airport, so we are no strangers to lights in the sky, but thie blue was so intense - almost like the blue in police cars, that I had to stay and observe.

summary: 5 round lit up objects flying  in different directions/coming together, northern sky for the last 3 nights, seen by 4 people.
description:
3/12/2014  Elverta, CA, 10:30 PM, for the last 3 nights there has been 5 round lit up objects in the northerly direction of Yuba City.  They look to be disc shaped or round.  They move around in different formations and then come together real close then drop away from each other again.  They stop in one spot for a little bit and then drop down or go upwards.  They are able to stop and go back in the direction they were coming from immediately.  
They have been seen in the sky by four people in our neighborhood.  
My question is, does anyone know what they are?
Possibly advertising lights?  PD

summary: I couldn't believe i didn't see this on the news!
description:
I was on my balcony and saw a bright blue light.  Looked like a star but much bigger, didn't think anything anything of it until it shot from real high in the sky to very low, and then went from left to right.  My sister was with me I called out my husband and we just watched it move up, down .. left. .. right.  Lights would change color between blue red and white... at on point it disappeared right before our eyes!.. after a few moments it appeared again.  We couldn't see it anymore because it was too low and far... after another 5 minutes it appeared again.  My brother in law was outside with us at this point.
I thought i would see something on the news but didn't. .. it was not a plane, helicopter or a toy.. it was fast. .. it was slow at times and when close enough i noticed oval shape. ..

summary: A multi colored flashing, slow moving object, high in the sky.
description:
The event was witnessed in Geldrop, a small city in The Netherlands.
It was evening and we showed the kids some stars and airplanes in the dark sky.
Then it became very clear one of the objects in the sky wasn't a plane .. it was very slow moving .. we could still see it after an hour, sometimes it was like it was hanging still.
It had three colors flashing, red, green and blue .. that's why we first thought it was an airplane (although the colors didn't match one) I've been taking pictures for over an hour, but have a bad camera.
We were with five adults who all saw the object clearly .. we also saw a plane flying by .. that was a completely different thing though.
I will send you some of the pictures by email if necessary.
The pictures can be viewed here though: https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.10202211547863910.1073741914.1046076501&type=1&l=ea17e35fd9

summary: Helicopter chasing ball of light.
description:
Anaheim, CA- Wed evening March 12, 2014 approx 7:30 pm, while sitting in the backyard looking south toward Katella Ave, I saw a bright-white star-like orb being followed or chased by a helicopter.  They both were travelling from west to east about 80 mph fast, straight and horizontal about 300 feet up.  They were travelling parallel to Katella Ave from about Beach Blvd. vicinity when I first noticed.  
I ran and got my binoculars and watched as they passed in front of me.  The copter was close to it, maybe 75 feet behind and slightly above it about 30 degrees.  I could see the copter.  I could see the orb light, there was not a craft attached to it,  just a bright sphere of light.  The orb appeared to be no larger than the cockpit of the copter.  
As they continued on fast, straight and horizontal, the orb faded out around Harbor Blvd vicinity.  The copter kept going.  
5 minutes later 2 loud military type helicopters flew by along the same path.  There were many helicopters heard that night, but I did not see any more strange flying lights.  This orb was self-illuminated and looked like a flying ball of light, not like an aircraft with a fuselage of any sort.

summary: Glowing blue light vanishes in seconds.
description:
Was looking out my window towards the city, and a huge glowing blue light was dead center.  Then seconds later it disappeared.  Still freaking out, craziest thing I've ever seen.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Small white light seen hovering above Superstition Mountain.
description:
At approximately 14:30 MST, a small bright light could be seen hovering above the highest peak of Superstition Mountain.  The light was very concentrated, and seemed to be circular.  It was a white light.  
For about 20 seconds it remained in the same spot, but it was not completely stationary. It did move up and down and side to side very slightly.  
Then, all of a sudden, it was was both lower and slightly further to the east, but still remained above the highest point on the mountain.  It remained visible for about 10 more seconds, and then was gone in the blink of an eye.
I am a 3rd year student in the fields of meteorology and astrophysics, and I storm chase and star gaze fairly frequently.  I am very familiar with atmospheric phenomenon, but this was something I could not identify or explain.  
Thinking it was a bird at first, I then realized I was way too far away to be able to see a bird above the mountain.

summary: Dark triangular object orange yellow lights on each end, very high, travelling fast.
description: We wonder whether the time of the sighting might have been midnight, rather than noon.  We have attempted to contact the source of the report on this point, but have not heard back from him, yet.  PD

summary: Bright dot of light over Woodinville skies.
description:
I saw a bright light in the south western (WSW) sky at about a 45°altitude,which was somewhat brighter than the planet Venus.  
I also saw Venus at a much lower altitude in the southeastern (SSE) at approximatley 30° altitude. 
The unknown object moved in an easterly motion extremely slow to about a 60° altitude.  
Then the object turned in a slow arc and moved northerly.  
Duration was about 15 minutes.  
What was startling was the slowness of the object.  Do they still send weather balloons aloft?

summary: BRIGHT LIGHT IN THE SKY GOES DIM!
description:
Was letting my dog outside when I looked up I'm the sky to look at the stars, when I noticed an object that seemed to flare up a bright white light and dim real quick.  
Then I noticed another object traveling the same direction at the same speed.  No blinking lights, I quickly eliminated airplane.  
And what made me scratch my head was an airplane was flying next to the two objects.

summary: Strange light stationary in the sky.
description:
I stayed at a friend’s house on the evening of March 11.  We looked at the constellations, but did not see anything unusual.
The next morning, as I was leaving, my friend looked in the sky and asked “is that a UFO?”.  It was a very bright light in the sky, too low to be a star.
I left to return to my home in San Rafael CA.  The light was stationary for the entire duration of the trip (about 30 minutes).  It just hovered in the same spot.
By the time I arrived home, it was just past dawn. The light was still there.  I grabbed a pair of binoculars. Peering through them, I could see it was several lights on the one object.  I could not make out the shape.
I went inside to make breakfast, shower, and get ready for work.  I got out of the shower, went outside, and the object was gone.

summary: Flashing lights. Blue, Red, Green, and Yellow
description:
I was lying in bed at about 2:00 am, looking out of our skylight when I noticed a flashing light.  
I shrugged it off as to being a plane yet after about 5 minutes it hadn’t moved, so I woke my boyfriend up and he informed me that when he went to bed at around midnight he had been watching it as well and thought it may have been a plane.  
The light in the sky flashes red, blue, green, and yellow.  It flashes the colored lights very fast then slows way down.  After about 30 minutes of this going on I went out on to my deck and there were about 3 of these same type of lights flashing the same colors some were fainter then others but all flashed the same colors.  
They are positioned right next to stars so that at first glance you wouldn’t even notice anything different unless the flashing catches your eye.  
I am new to Camas, WA, but I do know that the one light above our skylight was not there last night.

summary: Blinking blue and red star disapears .
description:
Was smoking outside at around 12:30 clear skys for the northwest.  Gazing up at stars but one particular star to the southwest just above the horizon was twinkling blue and red.  My neighbor walked out and I asked him do you see the same flashing im seeing.  
He said yes.  I watched it for 10 min and did not apear to move what so ever.  
Thinking it was just a star I went back in for an hour.  Came out to smoke again and all stars in the sky I remembered are still there except the blinking one has totally disappeared.  
I dont believe in aliens or spacecraft until I see one but I have seen other weird lights looking out that same direction.  This is the third .

summary: changing lights very fast speeds, movement up and down.
description: My buddy that lives in my neighborhood called me to look outside.  I went outside and saw a flying object.  We live by an airport and this was no airplane.  It was constantly changing color from blue green purple yellow white then red in the middle with blue on the outside.  It would move up and down then go very fast east and stop immediately.  When a plane approached all the lights turned off.  As the plane made a sharp turn South the lights came back on but simply blinking and headed toward the everglades.  About 15 minutes later I went back outside and noticed it seemed to start over again with the same color changing and movement. I have never seen anything like this before.

summary: Red big circle at the sky, may be at the half size of the full moon!
description:
Tonight, we had been just get out of our class around 10 pm and we were walking towards the car that I just started watching the sky as I usually do at nights.  
First the moon caught my attention, but few seconds later I was astonished by noticing a red-brown circle almost at the upper side of Orion constellation.  It was very big in comparison to the usual size of the planets like Jupitor or Venus as one can see with naked eyes!  
I checked with my friend and she was also very surprised by that.  
Actually, it was like a very big planet, I were not familiar with astronomy I would have said it was a planet passing by, but fortunately I know enough that none of the planets could be seen at this size with naked eye.  
Anyhow, I did not noticed any motion, and after few minutes it can not be seen any more. 
Anybody may know what it could have been!?

After I noticed the object in the sky I pulled over to the side of the road to get a clear view of it.  It was moving very slow and then it stopped and after 2-5 seconds slowly dissipated out of sight.  With the airport being a couple of miles away,  I waited and observed a few planes and helicopters to be sure what I had seen could not have been either.  What I had seen was quite surreal.

summary: SILVER BULLET UFO HOVERING STATIONARY IN BROOKLYN SKY, THEN VANISHED!
description:
This morning the sky was blue.  Weather was nice.  
I looked up at the sky as I left the Costco Warehouse and noticed lots of chemtrails crisscrossing the beautiful blue sky.  As I was gazing up, I noticed a silver bullet shaped object hovering stationary way up in the sky to the right of Costco between 2nd & 3rd Avenue, around 35th Street.  
I looked down and back up and saw that the object was still there not moving.  It did not have any wings or propellers.  It was not a blimp.  No sound coming from it.  It was silent and silverbullet shaped and stationary high up.  
I took out my camera to try and photograph it, but my zoom was not working properly.  As I looked up again, I noticed a airplane heading towards its direction.  As the airplane got closer towards the object...the object (UFO) simple disappeared!  Vanished right before my eyes!  
I looked all around the sky and nothing!  Where did it go?
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Loud Noise Along with UFO flashing lights aircraft
description:
Approximately 6:35 am Tuesday, March 11, 2014, I was in my room studying for a test while it was still dark out, with the sun just barely making the bottom of the horizon a lighter shade of blue.  
Out of nowhere I heard an extremely loud humming noise coming from the sky unlike any noise I had heard before.  The noise was extremely loud and continuous and when I went outside I saw a dark aircraft with numerous blinking lights (many more than an airplane) flying over my house toward to Flatiron Mountains.  
It was flying high enough that it eventually disappeared over the mountain, though it was pretty low to just go over the mountain top.  It came from the East and headed toward the West over the Flatiron Mountains.  
I watched it pass over me for about a minute or so and the loud noise continued until it was no longer in sight and earshot. It was dark which made it hard to tell the shape but rather the many blinking lights on the craft were more distinguishable!  
Eventually it disappeared over the mountains and the noise faded away along with the flashing lights.

summary: Black Triangle over Cary, N.C. Accompanied by Three Black Helicopters
description: As I finished up moving furniture for some family, I heard the distinct roar of choppers (helicopters) in the distance.  Being one to investigate late-night military craft (which I knew that they were); I sat outside on the steps, waiting for the choppers to pass.  About four and a half minutes into waiting, they broke from behind the tree line, and flew by the house.   They were blacked-out, say for the red lights on the noses of the aircraft.  As I stood to go back inside, my attention was drawn to huge white lights coming from behind the trees on the opposite side of my field of view.  I watched the lights emerge, and saw what I thought was a low-flying plane taking off from our local airport.  The craft moved quite slowly, and had three very bright white lights forming a perfect triangle.  The lights were very large to boot, almost touching one another.  I was able to make out another smaller white light in the centre of the three, as well as a slowly bli! nking red light on the plane opposite of the craft’s direction of movement (i.e. a taillight).  I was able to see a black body around the lights.  The craft disappeared behind tree cover, and never attained significant…

summary: Green light in sky

summary: dark grey or brown, amorphous object, streaking west to east over Hagerstown.
description:
Had walked outside to my car, and noticed an object with an indistinct shape, travel west to east at a rapid rate.  The object was slightly lighter in color than the nighttime sky, but was still noticeable.  It was at an indeterminate altitude, but moved from where I noticed it (about straight above me ) to the horizon very quickly.  I would have thought it was a meteor, but there was no fireball.
The weather was clear, and the moon was half full.  I noticed no airplanes in the sky at the time.  As a side note, I can regularly see airplanes in the distance headed towards Dulles airport (I assume).
I heard no noise from the object, nor did I see any lights at all from it.  It is possible it did move erratically, but the indistinct outline of it, and the speed it was travelling made it hard to tell.

summary: Saw three large, bright red-orange spheres of light in the southeastern sky.
description:
At approximately 9:00 pm on the night of March 10, 2014, I stepped outside of my driveway to take my dog for his nightly walk.  I immediately noticed a large, bright red-orange light in the southeastern sky, well above the treeline on the opposite side of the open hay field that is across the road from my driveway.  It was definitely unusual and bright and caught my attention right away.  
At first I thought it must be an airplane (small craft judging by the size, brightness, and proximity to the tree line), but the light did not blink or flash, nor move in any direction.  It just sat there.  I was checking it out for about 30 seconds, trying to figure out what it could be, when all of a sudden, it disappeared, sort of blinked off.  I thought it must be a plane banking and taking a turn and that the light just became temporarily undiscernible.  
Within seconds of it disappearing, a second large, bright red-orange light suddenly appeared in the southeastern sky! , but way more north of the original light.  I was checking out that second light just “hanging” there for a few seconds before the first light reappeared in the direction I had originally seen it in.  So I was watching…

summary: Copper orange lights grow and disappear over East Mesa.
description:
I saw two orange/copper lights, very bright and close to eachother in the western sky. I was at the intersection of Signal Butte and Baseline Road.  They were very luminous and bright and too close together for normal craft.  
As I watched, one disappeared (the one on the right) and the one at the left was pulsing.  Then the one on the right reappeared.  
They both continued overhead to the east, then got wider and less bright but their shapes were more delineated.  
The two circular objects had smaller circles at their edges, akin to a rotary dial–a circle with smaller circles all along their edges and rotating.  
As the objects got larger and lower they became transparent and then vanished.

summary: White Cylindriacal Cigar type object moves sluggishly in the northern sky.
description:
Traveling North on Co. Rd. 49, crossing Britton Bridge over Cedar Creek , with my daughter, I saw a white/silver, cylindrical object that appeared to be hovering stationary in the sky well above the tree line, about seven fingers from the horizon.
Finding a place to pull over and stop the car, I watched as this elongated object moved slowly from general west.  It moved to slow to be an airplane and there was no sound emitted as jets and planes make (even when they are not visible).  In fact, during this time I neither heard nor saw any known air crafts.  Also, there was not a cloud in the sky.
I watched for perhaps three to four minutes as it moved in a lazy fashion across the sky for at least six hand widths at arms length. I had time to notice that it did not taper to a near point at either end (as planes and helicopters do) but instead was rounded.  Not a "hard" semi-circle round, but a softer "hill" type round.  It also appeared to be long, (like a stretched blimp maybe), as well as narrow, (like a used up, shortened pencil).
I continued watching it travel eastward and in the blink of an eye, below this object and to the left, another object appeared suddenly.  It too was…

summary: Oval   silent
description:
Mar 10, 2014.   7:20 AM   looking East at Venus from Alpharetta, GA, near Hwy 400 & Mansell Rd.
Next to Venus was nearly imperceptible light that looked like it might be the entry of a satellite into sunlight.  
Continued to watch it for maybe 30 secs, but was hard to track since it was so indistinct.   During the 1st several seconds, I perceived more of a motion than a point of light, until I saw what seemed like a shapeless small cloud in this pre-dawn sky, moving more rapidly, toward just North of due West.  
When nearly overhead at its zenith, just south of straight overhead, I saw a hazy oval shape that nearly blended with the dawn sky color of maybe dark slate gray, except there were 4 blurry light sources on bottom of the shape, fore and aft, left and right.  There was no sound.   
At arm’s length, this lozenge-shaped object was about the size of the 1st joint on the thumb.
There were no clouds in the sky, and checking weather sites, this was confirmed.

summary: Overpowering, frightening, and extremely loud sounds coming from above.
description:
My boyfriend and I went into our screened in porch to smoke a cigarette together, while smoking, we heard a strange noise in the distance, shrugged it off and decided “Oh it’s just wind or traffic noise”, though there were no cars and it was very calm and still weather.  
We finished our cigarettes and went back into the house, only to hear the noise growing louder and louder.  We went back into the porch, and even our cats seemed to be upset over the noise.  The sound was very loud and overpowering, it sounded similar to a strong violent windstorm with the following sounds coming from inside it: large vacuum cleaner, heavy rotating machinery, electrical humming or buzzing.  The sound was all around us but coming from above, our first instinct was to look towards the sky, but the sky was clear.  Then we tried to make sense of it, the loudness of it should have caused vibrations in the ground but there were none, we felt like we should take cover from the wind but it was calm and still.  It lasted for about an hour and a half, give or take, and then suddenly came to an immediate stop.  
During the time the sound was active, the sound would fade in and out.  We were surprised once…

summary: Had strange dreams about humming sound that was so intense I began to feel it in my chest.
description:

Apparently, over 5000 people lost power in Philly around the same time the humming event affected me in my sleep, so maybe it had something to do with that?  
Either way, it was strange, and I wanted to see if anyone else in the area experienced this besides me.

summary: An elongated star with mutiple colors and a tail of lights.  Blue, then red/orangish tint. Many witnesses and photographic evidence.

U.S. Air Force had been in Eastern Kentucky for unexplained reasons and is still here currently. "Elongated star with multicolored lights with a tail of lights, red and blue." "Moves and returns to exact location."  "Seems to have a blue, then red/orange tint to it."

Will be checking again tonight.

summary: Green fireball object shooting downward from the sky.
description:
The sky was fairly clear and bright as I drove along Hwy 22 from Calera, AL, heading toward Hwy 119 in Montevallo, AL.  It was approximately 12:30 am the morning of March 10, 2014.
As I drove along I gazed out my driver side window and noticed an orange fire ball like object with a green tail as though a huge roman candle had been lit in space and aimed downwards to earth.  It was just above the tree tops.
I looked at the road ahead and looked back really quick to see it had fallen below the tree lines by then and much larger than before. It was a lot closer to me by this time as though we were about to meet.  My heart sank, I blinked and it just vanished as if it "went out".
I pulled over onto the side of the road to investigate somewhat but there wasn't anything burning or on fire.  I never heard any noise.  The entire ordeal happened within a 30 sec time frame.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information.  PD

summary: Orange lights across the night sky - a strange and unexplained sighting.
description:
At approximately 9:30 p.m. this evening, a number of us in our RV Park witnessed a large number of orange lights go slowly across the night sky.  Looking towards the south, the objects went from right to left and were staggered in formation.  The objects were much larger than a bright star, made no noise and seemed to be fairly far away.  At first a large number of them were grouped together, following that a few were together and then one or two in a grouping.
We contacted Bay News 9 to see if any strange reports were called in - none so far.  We also sent them pictures.  After looking our issue up on Google, there were photos posted similar to ours and we are anxious for an explanation on what we all witnessed.

summary: White sphere descends from sky in the Bosque.
description:
I was driving on Coors heading south from Alameda when I saw an extremely bright object in the sky that looked to be slowly dropping elevation. 
I pulled over to try and get the object on video as it hovered just above some houses near the Rio Grande River. 
As I watched, the light dropped below the houses where it seemed to land in the wooded area near the river.  This is when I lost view of the object. 
The entire time the object never made a sound and was much brighter than any lights on traditional aircraft.

I pulled up to a stop sign at the intersection of two roads in a wooded suburban area.  It was 8pm and darkness obscured the fact that it was fairly cloudy.

All 4 lights were slowly traveling west to east with little deviation from their path.  A single non-pulsing yellow/orange light was following a considerable distance behind the three other lights that when I first saw them were in a triangular pattern.  
It was hard to ascertain their altitude as it was night.  Most of my attention was on the group of three lights.  
As I watched the lights the shape of the formation changed.  The light in the back moved closer to the two front lights and the triangle turned more into a straight line.  All the while, the fourth light kept considerable distance.  
The intensity and color of all four lights was constant throughout my observation.  At one…

I was looking roughly southwest from North Hollywood/Toluca Lake towards the Hollywood Hills/LA/Santa Monica area and the object might have been roughly over West Hollywood or Los Angeles.  The sky was clear and blue, it was bright daylight, and it was about 75 degrees.

There were approximately 8 orange lights moving southbound over the Carrollwood Citrus Park area.  No particular formation.  No particular order.  No flashing or blinking lights.  All uniform in color.

At ground level there is virtually not a breath of wind.
The orange light had a thin red spike with an orange tip.
The spike was about 4/5 times the diameter of the light the orange tip being just one fifth the overall size.
The light made no discernible sound.

My wife saw them and said, "Yea, those look like planes lined up to land somewhere"  They look like the handle of a soup ladle.  
Well this went on for some 15 minutes before we realized they hadn't moved at all.  Then in between the gaps of the lights, another light would appear the same time as another would disappear.   So it was hard to determine if there were 6 lights lined up or 7 lights.  
Every few minutes the shape of the line would move around like they were lights hooked to a string.  Very fascinating and they were not airplanes!!!!!!!

Entered the city of Layton close to 7pm when I had noticed a formation of lights while entering the city from the Antelope Drive exit.  At first I thought it might have been just a bunch of helicopters or something of that sort, until I realized the lights were not moving nor flashing.
As I drove through town towards the Layton Hills mall, I noticed that the lights I had seen moments before were now shaped differently than before.
They went from a 55 degree angle, to 40 degree angle, to a 70 degree angle within moments.  When at 70 degrees it was curved at the top (completely mind blowing)  
As I left the city it was almost as if all the lights completely scattered and spread out.  There were 6 to 7 of them with the exception of one disappearing and reappearing in different spots.

summary: I saw an flickering orange-red sphere in the sky moving in different directions.

If I had to guess it looked like it was a couple hundred feet in the air by judging how fast we were driving.  I didnt see an object, it was only light.  It moved back and forth in many directions.  It was completely silent.  
I have watched the skies for years and have never seen anything like this before.  We watched it for about 3 minutes.

He knew nothing about it.  He did ask me how many glasses of wine I had (zero).  He told me he would come to the house and check it out, but never did.  After I hung up with him, I woke up my 11 year old son who happens to be on a UFO kick right now.  We looked at it together for a few minutes and then went back to bed (both in my bed this time because he was scared).  
I got up a little while later to look out the window and it had moved significantly farther away.  I looked again a little later after that and it was gone.  I have cell phone video of the object.  My husband…

summary: re:  Anomaly in Sky over Bartonsville, PA - Afternoon of March 6th, 2014.
description:
Natural Light Phenomenon or UFO?  Okay . . . Here’s how it went.  On the afternoon of Thursday, March 6, 2014, at 3:45 p.m., here in Bartonsville, Pennsylvania, I was on the rear enclosed sun porch making some close-up JPG pictures of old silver dollar coins.  It’s good and bright out there in the afternoon so natural light is all that’s needed.  The now antiquated Nikon D1H digital SLR somehow seems to make sharper close on pictures than the later model D2HS camera with much improved light sensor computer system.
While working there making close-up photos with the D1H, I happened to glance out the window to the southwest and noticed in the mostly blue skies, numerous plane contrails.  It was first pondered as to what might be going on to get so much weekday afternoon apparent military jet activity.  Looking up again towards our now broken whirlee-gig windmill that's atop the rear deck upper railing, a blotch of rainbow colored light was seen shining from behind an odd wispy rippled cloud.  That was about 3:48 p.m. with the afternoon sun getting lower over in the west.  It seemed then as if the sun was maybe shinning into the cloud at a precise angle and reflecting ice crystals…

summary: 5 rectangular shaped lights in an uneven row with bright, bluish-white lights on each side.

They were yellowish orange in color and had a pulsating movement to them.  On each side of the group of 5 were a bright, bluish-white light.  
The rectangle lights lasted about 9 to 10 seconds and went off one by one, left to right.  The bluish-white lights lingered on after the yellowish lights went out about 5 to 6 seconds longer.

It was like the whole sky was filled with these colored lights.  The sequence (approx.) was as under:  1. blue light - 2 secs 2. orange light - 1 sec 3. 30 sec delay 4. blue light - 2 secs 5. orange light - 1-2 secs

summary: Multiple glowing orbs seen heading NE over St. Helens
description:
Hello,  I would like to report a sighting that occurred yesterday 3/5/14 around 8:30 in the evening.
I was sitting in my car at the intersection of Vernonia Rd and Pittsburg Rd.  I was facing north on Vernonia, getting ready to turn left (west) onto Pittsburg.  
I noticed the moon and glanced in its general direction and saw what appeared to be 3 lights emitting a faint glow moving from the SW to the NE.  The objects appeared to be at the same level as the lowest cloud layer, as initially I noticed the glow in the clouds.  
I recall that the clouds were moving fast the same direction the objects were traveling.  Since the cloud layer was broken the three objects eventually moved out of the clouds and appeared to be perfect translucent orbs.  The best description I can come up with is they looked like bubbles with a thick membrane.  
At this point they were almost directly overhead and did not seem to glow as much.   I then proceeded to turn onto Pittsburg Rd and drive maybe 20 yards and stop and looked out my drives window when I noticed another one.  At this point I looked out! my passenger window (the direction they were traveling) and saw maybe 8 or 9 glowing orbs in the…

summary: Three lights in triangular formation too far apart to be any conventional aircraft.
description:
Was walking my dog on Squires Way Drive in Chesterfield.  I noticed a group of three lights in a triangular formation.  The lights were too far apart to be a single craft--my guess would be they were about the length of three widebody airplanes apart.
The lights stayed in formation for a few minutes, then changed to a perfectly horizontal line.  They then returned to the triangular formation and stayed there for several more minutes before the left light disappeared.
The remaining two lights stayed in a linear formation for another 30 seconds or so before the right light also disappeared.  The center light still remained as I turned to leave the scene.
I did see some conventional aircraft heading toward the lights immediately after they disappeared.
I attempted to video the phenomenon, but street lights in the area were too bright to capture any worthwhile video.

summary: Large, triangular UFO seen outside Huntsville doing incredible maneuvers close to the ground.
description:
The triangular object hovered above a small mountain on Hwy 36 outside of Huntsville.  I thought it was lights on a telephone tower until I passed the ridge.  
The object sat there, still, in mid-air 300 feet above the ridge.  
As I was looking up from my car, it darted to the west.  It was grayish black, 1 1/2 times the size of a jet with red and white lights on each point.  
It was silent, flew close to the ground, and did maneuvers impossible for a jet, then disappeared down into the tree line.  
I followed as it oddly played cat and mouse, like it knew I was watching.  It would disappear and then reappear in front of my car or to the side, only 200 feet or so off the ground.  I had no fear, and I loved it actually.  
I worked in the aerospace industry, and I am familiar with airplanes.  
This was not a plane.

summary: Dark gray triangle with red lights on tips, moved slowly and no sound coming from it.

It passed over the road about 50 feet up and hovered over the trees for a few seconds and then slowly went to the west.

I was on the phone with my brother and was shocked and until I decided to make a video it was too late; I didn`t have view from my window.  
I saw 4-5 airplanes after that and each of them were leaving this white mark on the sky--the object however did not.

summary: I have witnessed multiple ufos in Front Royal.  I am a very open minded person who intelligently considers various explanations before coming to a conclusion. On multiple occasions from 2013-2014 I…

It definitely needs to be investigated if only for a week or two.  I assure you that a sighting will be made.  The most disturbing sighting was on a cloudy night as I was on my front porch smoking a cigarette.  A dull metallic object caught my eye as I looked up at the sky as I often did to appreciate the view of the stars.  We don't get a great view here in the city so I made a point every night to enjoy the beauty.  As I looked up, as God be my witness no more than 30 ft directly above my head was a cigar shaped metallic craft gliding completely silent over my head then behind my house.  
I rushed cigarette still in hand which is odd because there is no smoking allowed in my home to the back deck to find the object nowhere in sight.  I was petrified to say the least.  Usually I would see multiple orbs of light far up in the sky,but this was literally right above me and absolutely NO NOISE. It was enough to keep me awake for nights on end and for me to be writing this message.  I always wondered if…

summary: I was up early on my computer doing email.  No inside room lights were on just my monitor, so the room was dark.  My monitor is 2 feet next to right of my window.  My room is on the second level of…
description:
A bright blue light caught my eye at a 45 degree angle to my view of my monitor.   
I turned to observe the light and saw a triangle shaped light, very bright and very large moving from west to east.  
The trajectory was downward a few degrees and about 14 degrees off the horizon.  It moved fast but not to fast not to make out the shape.  
I didn't observe any streaks like you see from a meteor.  No blinking lights, just a very light blue bright object moving fast through the sky.

summary: Bright, quick flashes of light directly above my house in Albuquerque
description:
I was in my backyard, on the patio, and heard a hum, like an engine or generator starting up.  
A couple of seconds later, about half of the yard became illuminated, without any sound, from a bright light directly overhead for maybe a second.  
After that, a quicker flash of light illuminated a smaller area in the yard, again without sound, about twenty feet to the right of me, immediately followed by a even quicker flash of light.  The hum and flashes didn’t last longer than 5 seconds.  
It was not a spotlight or the sweeping lights used to advertise a new nightclub opening.  No other houses or yards, as far as I can tell, were lit up.  
The light was not far off in the distance; it seemed like it was right above me.  
I did not see any objects at any time.  
My home is near Constitution and Morris.

summary: Large triangular object spotted over Turlock, California
description:
On March 4, 2014, at approximately 10:04 p.m., I had gone outside to get something out of my car in the driveway when I heard a strange loud rumbling noise.  I then noticed that I could actually feel the rumbling in the ground that I was standing on.  
I looked skyward and was confused at first because the sky looked so black - no stars at all.  
I then realized that what I was looking at was a large unknown craft moving slowly in a southeast direction.  It continued on in that direction until I could no longer see it behind the trees in the distance.  
I called our local police services to ask if anyone else had noticed anything strange and they reported that they were receiving multiple calls to report the same strange object.  
The object was triangular in shape with small faintly lit lights evenly spaced around each edge with brighter lights at each corner of the triangle.

summary: Giant Black Triangle

Then she notice tiny pin points of red lights and was scanning to one side and then saw a soft round ball of white light.  It was then that she saw an edge around this soft ball of white light.  She scanned for the edge till her head was turned the opposite direction and saw another soft round white light.  The continuing her effort to fallow the edge she found a third corner and realize this huge black triangle was over her blocking the sky and moving slowly over her.  Again it made a weird rumbling noise which vibrated up through the ground into her feet.  It was picking up speed as it traveled South east over all the other homes around her.  She froze afraid to move until it got passed her.
Next she bolted inside and got her parents who came out and it was too late it was gone, but they called the police to report it and were told that they knew already…

summary: Northern California: Bright orange light veers through sky then vanishes.

Around 20:45, I was outside locking up the animals for the night.  My home is not located in town, so no street lights.  It's very dark.  
I notice strange lights, for my protection.  So when I spotted a glow from the corner of my eye, I walked to a clearing to get a better visual.  
It was a fireball or bright light extremely high in the sky.  I'm familiar with air traffic here and this was not normal.  It was a bright or glowing deep orange-red crossing the sky.  
My mother was inside the house.  I yelled for her to fone quick.  
We stood watching for about 45 more seconds until the light disappeared, as if slipped through a trap door.

summary: Tucson sighting from Catalina Foothills:  4 lights, triangle formation, moving low and silent in a northwest direction in the Tucson sky
description:
Our Tucson apartment is on Sunrise Drive between Swan and Craycroft.  Sunrise is a main road that runs east to west along the base of the Catalina Mountains and Swan (to the west of our apt) and Craycroft (to the east) are roads that run perpendicular north and south. 
Tues night (3/4/14) at 7:39pm, my son was sitting on our third-floor, south-facing apt balcony.  From the balcony, which faces Sunrise, we have a panoramic view that includes city lights to the southwest, Davis-Montham/TIA lights to the south, and Tucson Mountains to west.  
At around 7:39, my son noticed what appeared to be a large triangle-shaped "craft" with 3 point lights (spaced evenly apart in a straight line) along the back and a single light at what would be the point of the triangle or front of "craft".  This large, expansive-looking "craft" was moving slowly and silently at an angle over Swan heading northwest in the direction of I-10.  
He immediately called me as he was watching it and I happened to be driving north on Craycroft towards Sunrise with a friend following two cars back.  All the way up Craycroft to the light at Sunrise (about 1 mile), I was unable to see anything and thought he was…

summary: Flying saucer spotted, glowing and changing color before disappearing into trees.

I saw an saucer-shaped, glowing thing going through the sky.  It seemed to be at least 50 feet away but was changing colors and glowing, I could see it. 
The object was small, but bigger than a frisbee.  It soared through the air, appearing low to the ground before disappearing into the trees.  
Possibly landed, possibly got stuck, possibly went on, possibly vanished into thin air.  
There were no effects other than my dog running in circles and birds flying away.  There was a small beep before it appeared.
Report seems to us to be a hoax.  The source of the report provides contact information which is invalid.  PD

summary: A red and green diamond shaped spacecraft.

I ran inside to get my brother and mom to witness the phenomena appearing right in front of me.  It went up, down, forwards and backwards.  
I was baffled but I realized the reason it was looking at our house is because it had the same colors as the ship, red and green.  Maybe they thought it was their spaceship.
We have corrected the date above.  We spoke via telephone with the witness, and she sounded sincere.  PD

It wasn't as high as a plane would be,  and was smaller than a normal passenger plane as well.  When it did move, it did so perfectly fluently, no sudden stops or starts. 
All of a sudden it flickered and became dimmer, then the light disappeared and so did the vehicle.  No traces.

We kept driving but I could see the lights still in the same spot behind us.  Unfortunately, we drove far enough that I could not get another look at the lights.

summary: Erratic flight path.
description:
The shape of the craft is unknown but I would have to say it appeared to be triangular at times.  I witnessed this after dark so all I could see were blinking white lights.  
The object was above the horizon when I first noticed it and was stationary.  After a minute or so it began to move upward but wobbled side to side as it rose.
The object then began to move south; toward my house.  The trajectory from the time I noticed it to the time I could no longer see it was slightly erratic but that is not what made me suspicious.  
As it moved through the sky, the object disappeared and reappeared multiple times along its flight path.
During all of this, there was a soft sound like distant rumbles of thunder.

summary: Red/orange balls of light over Temecula, CA.

summary: Strange blue light seen over Forest Hill Blvd. in Wellington, Florida
description:
I was traveling west in my vehicle on Forest Hill Blvd. near the Wellington Green mall, when I spotted a single blue light in the sky to the west of me.  The light hovered at times, but also appeared to travel, changing directions at random.
As I got closer to the light, I rolled down my window so that I could get a better look at it.  I could make out no details other than the fact there was a blue light maneuvering above the road.  Eventually, I passed under it and as far as I could tell, the light was around 50 feet directly over the road.
Traffic was heavy in the area so I couldn't take my eyes off the road for too long.  It seems likely that other people saw it, too.
I think the most logical explanation for what I saw is a remote-controlled hobbyist's aircraft such as a helicopter or quad-copter.  Due to traffic noise, I couldn't make out the sound of a motor, but the perceived altitude and way that the light moved made me think of an R/C craft.  Still, I can't say for sure what I saw.

summary: After dark, object at extreme altitude, flashing in response to spotlight, changing course, blacking out-then back on.
description:
Night Sighting.  Occulting White/Slight Amber  7:02 PM Alaska Standard Time  Ward Cove, AK 99928 (approx. 5 miles WNW of Ketchikan, AK)  
Diamond shaped object approached out of the Southwest, low on horizon, in an extremely clear and dark night sky (even with setting crescent moon)  Object appeared after several flashes by myself, toward a general area of the sky with a hand-held, million+ candle power halogen spotlight.
Object was moving at a very high speed, but deliberately changed course at least 3 times, also at very high speed.
Object also dimmed out and became bright again, as if responding to spotlight.
Object was amongst the star field, yet seemed slightly lower.  Object also pulsed a yellowish-white when signaling back to my spotlight.
Object ended up on a northerly heading, blacking out before dipping below horizon.
Object was not an aircraft, nor a satellite, or the ISS.  The turning performance would have created excessive g-forces on a man-made craft.

summary: Two circular lights seen in a clear sky around 18:15pm when driving Hawaii Kai bound on Kalanainanaole Highway in Honolulu tonight

I initially thought were lights of an airplane, but then quickly realized they were too big to be lights for an airplane.

I witnessed it for roughly 20 seconds till lost site of it.

summary: Blue U shape light moving slow and suddenly speeding up
description:
My daughter (3.5 years old) and I were going West bound on Okeechobee Blvd in West Palm Beach, FL.  We were standing at a red light on Okeechobee Blvd and SR7 corner in the left turning lane.  
I saw a blue light coming East toward the beach.  We have a lots of air traffic because of the West Palm Beach International Airport, but I never noticed a steady blue light on any aircraft before.  
First I thought is some reflection on the windshield, but when it was over us, I rolled done the passenger side window and stick out my head. It was right above us.
It was a U shape steady blue light, going slow to the East, then suddenly it speed it up so fast that is just not possible.  Then, we were going toward to South on SR7 and I was still seeing it on the North side.  It was going very slow then suddenly changing directions and speed up so fast that is just not possible.  It was above us for 2-3 minutes.  
Then, we arrived to the restaurant (PeiWei) at Forest Hill and Wellington Greens corner at Wellington Mall.  We went in but the food was not ready yet.  We went to the restroom with my daughter, stayed there for 3-5 minutes, then went back,  picked up the food, walked to the parking…

summary: Circles of light in the clouds.
description:
Tonight at approximately 6:50 p.m., I saw strange circle like shapes appearing in the clouds. The circles were made of dots rather than a solid line.  They kept transforming into different circle like shapes, looking almost deformed.  They would disappear for a minute or so and then return again.

I ran back home in a panic, not certain as to the craft's intentions.  Just before I could walk back in, I saw that it was growing fainter.  After about one minute of hovering and whirling erratically, the craft faded out of view.  I decided to continue walking, since my dog was utterly unfazed.  After about 3-5 minutes, I estimate that the time was 22:0.

I was driving, so I can not verify movement, although they appeared to be stationary. I lost line-of-sight of most of the lights behind trees and buildings while driving, but the ones that I could still see slowly disappeared after a few minutes (they could have gained altitude and moved above the cloud layer).
I know that I was not the only witness as I passed the local ice cream stand and saw a car parked with 2 people outside staring at these lights (with the same confused expression on their faces as mine).
We do get military helicopters fly over from time-to-time, but I've never seen more than 3 at a time and they tend to fly in a line following each other at the same, low altitude - and in daylight.  This cluster of lights numbered at least 8 individuals, in no noticeable formation (scattered-possible differing altitudes), and stationary or very slow moving.

I hold a private pilot license and feel fairly well versed in aerodynamic principles.  These objects were not subject to these principles.

He starts to record it but forgets to press the actual record button, of course.  I was on the verge of tears because I did not know what was going on.  The triangle moves to the left in the sky and the top point and bottom left point start to move straight out to the left while the right one stays.  The two immediately make a curved path and disappear into the clouds.  The third one stays behind a little and then after about a minute starts to float away.  We waited a few more minutes to see what else would happen but nothing did. We knew that it wasn't a plane, helicopter, or drone.  This was something unreal it seemed. I looked for it through my rear view upon moving further down the interstate, but the lights had vanished by then.

It was difficult to tell how high the object was, because there were no lights on it to help judge the distance but I would guess relatively low due to the fact that it was about 1/8 to 1/5 the size of a full moon. 
There was no sound and it was traveling east south east toward the center of Chattanooga.  I observed the object for about 12 seconds or so as it flew out of sight remaining the same speed and direction the entire time.
I've always been interested in looking up at the stars and own a telescope.  I have never seen anything like this before.  Since it had NO lights on it, it appeared a dark gray over the night sky.  
I strained to get as clear of view as possible and could not make out any form of a plane or bird.  It definitely had a triangle shape.

This my fourth sighting of this same phenomena.  They date back to the summer of 2009. The sightings are always in the same spot in the sky (from my vantage point), and on at least one other occasion, there were several of these same orbs, floating together--the most I’ve ever seen were four orbs at a time.  During two of these sightings, the orbs disappeared and reappeared in unison.
At a glance, this orb could easily pass for a very bright star, but if observed for more than five seconds, it is plain to see that it is definitely not a star.  It is the same color as the sun, dims and brightens in a pulsating fashion, and moves in odd ways.

summary: Formation or cluster of five lights catapulting and zooming dramatically near the I-5 freeway at night
description:
I was driving rapidly north on US Interstate 5 (I-5) shortly after dark, about 15 miles west of Firebaugh, California.  
Ahead of me (a hundred meters perhaps) I saw a cluster of five lights in several indeterminate/shifting colors moving rapidly from east to west about 10 meters above the freeway, in a downward trajectory.  
Then as my car reached the place where the lights were coming down, I slowed down, and observed through the driver's side window as the lights seemed to fold into themselves and lift up again abruptly into the air.  
I looked back at the car's outside side-mirror and saw the lights continue to ascend behind me in the far distance.  Then suddenly (within one second) again I saw them directly through the side window, parallel to my car, only about 10 meters above the ground; and then they zoomed across the freeway at a sharp angle in front of me (perhaps 50 meters in front of me), going from west to east, ascending rapidly and vanishing from my ! sight.
As I say, the lights "folded into themselves."  What I mean is that I didn't perceive this as a solid object or "craft" with a particular shape, with lights mounted on certain features of it, etc., as one would…
